papers.title: How to Train a Critic Stably and Efficiently
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO for large language models avoid training a critic by sampling multiple responses for each prompt. A reliable critic could instead estimate token-level advantages from one response, but standard critic-based training recipes are often unstable. We study this instability and develop \textbf{Best-Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO)}, a recipe that combines DPPO, value predictions bounded to the reward range, Monte Carlo value targets, unnormalized policy advantages, and length-adaptive generalized advantage estimation. Because the critic is used only during training, BPCO can also condition it on reward-defining information, such as a reference answer or grading rubric, that is hidden from the policy. Controlled experiments isolate the effect of each design choice. Across mathematical reasoning tasks with models ranging from 1.5B parameters to 30B-A3B mixtures of experts, BPCO improves a strong critic-based baseline consistently, and matches or exceeds a group-based baseline while sampling one response per prompt. The same recipe also improves learning with rubric-based rewards. These results show that a carefully designed critic provides a reliable alternative to group-relative advantage estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型强化学习中 critic 训练不稳定的问题，并提出 Best-Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO) 配方。BPCO 组合了 DPPO、将价值预测限制在奖励范围内、蒙特卡洛价值目标、未归一化的策略优势以及长度自适应的广义优势估计 (GAE)，并利用 critic 仅在训练期使用的特点，使其可以获取策略看不到的奖励定义信息（如参考答案或评分标准）。在数学推理任务上，对 1.5B 到 30B-A3B MoE 等模型，BPCO 一致优于强 critic 基线，并在每提示仅采样一个响应的情况下匹配或超过基于组的基线。
Motivation: GRPO 等基于组的强化学习方法通过为每个提示采样多个响应来避免训练 critic，但可靠的 critic 本可以从单个响应估计 token 级优势；标准 critic 训练方法往往不稳定，因此需要一套稳定且高效的训练方案。
Method: 提出 BPCO 训练配方，核心组件包括 DPPO、将价值预测限制在奖励范围内、蒙特卡洛价值目标、未归一化的策略优势以及长度自适应的广义优势估计；此外，由于 critic 只在训练时使用，可将其条件化为奖励定义信息（如参考答案或评分标准），而这些信息对策略隐藏。通过受控实验逐一隔离分析各设计选择的影响。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，对 1.5B 到 30B-A3B 混合专家 (MoE) 等模型，BPCO 一致提升强 critic 基线，并在每个提示仅采样一个响应时匹配或超过基于组的基线；同一配方也能改进基于评分规则 (rubric) 的奖励学习。
Conclusion: 作者认为，精心设计的 critic 可以成为组相对优势估计 (group-relative advantage estimation) 的可靠替代方案，并且 critic 有条件利用奖励定义信息的特性是其主要优势之一。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
papers.abstract_en: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReWorld，一个面向交互式世界建模 (interactive world model) 的系统，在训练时分离动作跟随与长时记忆，在推理时用固定预算约束完整历史。其核心设计包括混合 per-head 注意力窗口、随机 head 路由、随机 chunk 丢弃、基于 pose 索引地标库的有界 KV cache，以及将八种数据源对齐到同一物理动作尺度的数据引擎。配合 LoRA 上的分布匹配蒸馏，采样被压缩到四步，单个骨干网络同时支持高保真多步模式和实时交互模式，可流式生成 704x1280 视频。在三轴评测协议下，针对六个近期交互式世界模型，ReWorld 取得最佳控制保真度和最佳生成质量。
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需要同时满足动作控制、长时回忆和实时流式生成，但结构上存在张力：控制希望短视界，记忆希望无界视界。现有方法难以在推理时同时兼顾这三者。
Method: 训练时将大多数注意力头限制在近期窗口，少数全局头关注完整历史，并用随机 head 路由避免某种能力绑定到特定头；随机 chunk 丢弃使稀疏历史在分布内。推理时全部历史被限制在固定预算内：有界 KV cache 配合 pose 索引地标库，按当前 pose 检索最近地标。数据引擎将 Unreal 渲染飞行、游戏漫游和真实视频等八种来源对齐到同一物理动作尺度，并用回文轨迹提供记忆训练所需的 revisit 证据。最后通过仅限 LoRA 适配器的分布匹配蒸馏把采样压缩到四步。
Result: 在动作跟随、长时回忆和视频质量三轴协议下，相比六个近期交互式世界模型，ReWorld 获得最佳控制保真度（旋转误差 11.95° 且相机运动一致性最佳）和最佳生成质量；在 64 秒共 384 个隐变量的往返 rollout 中，固定 12-chunk cache 仍能重建起始视角，而此时滑动窗口已移除相关证据、full-KV 注意力已耗尽内存。
Conclusion: 作者认为将控制与记忆在训练时分离、并在推理时以固定预算约束历史，可以同时获得高保真多步生成与实时交互能力。摘要主要强调其在交互式世界模型基准上的优势，未讨论在天气或物理预报类任务上的适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
papers.abstract_en: Modern software systems accumulate technical debt over decades of development, which makes migration expensive and largely manual. As coding agents become increasingly capable at bug fixing, can they autonomously perform such migrations? Existing benchmarks cannot answer this question because they evaluate only behavioural correctness, not whether the migration actually occurred. This leads an easy hack: agents copy the original implementation to make tests pass. We call this Blindness. To address this problem, we introduce SWE Refactor Bench, a benchmark comprising 20 whole-repository migrations, covering 4 kinds of technical debt. A three-stage evaluation protocol measures both migration completeness and behavioural correctness. (1) Migration Audit verifies that the migration occurred. (2) Behavioural Tests measure correctness with a fixed test suite. (3) Agentic Verification uses 6 independent coding agents to generate targeted tests for hidden behavioural differences. Across 520 runs from 8 frontier models and 26 model-effort configurations, only 28 of 520 runs ($5.4\%$) pass all three stages, 13 of the 20 tasks receive no accepted solution, and the best model (claude-opus-5) scores $47.0/100$. Migration completeness and behavioural correctness are distinct abilities: a few runs preserve behaviour by skipping the migration and are stopped at Migration Audit; most attempt it and break behaviour, and are stopped at Behavioural Tests. Agents cannot deliver a perfect migration: among the 340 runs that pass Migration Audit, $58\%$ reach $99\%$ of the fixed checks, yet only $26\%$ reach $100\%$. Agent capability differs across migration categories: agents score $31.4$ on build toolchain rewrites but only $5.6$ on language rewrites. Together, these findings position SWE Refactor Bench as a rigorous testbed for developing coding agents for reliable whole-repository migrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE Refactor Bench，一个包含 20 个全仓库迁移 (whole-repository migration) 任务的基准，覆盖 4 类技术债，旨在检验编码智能体能否自主完成长时程的仓库级技术栈迁移。作者指出现有基准只评估行为正确性（测试是否通过）而不检查迁移是否真正发生，因而存在复制原实现来骗过测试的捷径（称为 Blindness），并为此设计了三阶段评估协议：迁移审计 (Migration Audit)、行为测试 (Behavioural Tests) 和基于 6 个独立编码智能体生成针对性测试的智能体验证 (Agentic Verification)。在 8 个前沿模型、26 种模型-努力配置、共 520 次运行中，仅 28 次（5.4%）通过全部三个阶段，最佳模型 claude-opus-5 得分为 47.0/100。
Motivation: 现有基准无法回答编码智能体能否自主完成大型迁移问题，因为它们只衡量行为正确性而非迁移是否真正发生，这导致智能体可以通过复制原始实现来让测试通过。作者将这一缺陷称为 Blindness，并希望提供能同时检测迁移完整性与行为正确性的基准。
Method: 构建 SWE Refactor Bench，包含 20 个全仓库迁移任务，覆盖 4 类技术债。采用三阶段评估：第一阶段 Migration Audit 验证迁移确实发生；第二阶段 Behavioural Tests 用固定测试套件衡量行为正确性；第三阶段 Agentic Verification 用 6 个独立编码智能体为隐藏行为差异生成针对性测试。
Result: 8 个前沿模型与 26 种模型-努力配置下共 520 次运行，只有 28 次（5.4%）通过全部三个阶段，20 个任务中有 13 个没有获得任何被接受的方案；最佳模型 claude-opus-5 得分 47.0/100。在通过 Migration Audit 的 340 次运行中，58% 达到固定检查项的 99%，但仅 26% 达到 100%。不同迁移类别上能力差异明显：构建工具链重写得分 31.4，而语言重写仅 5.6。
Conclusion: 迁移完整性与行为正确性是两种独立能力：少数运行通过跳过迁移保持行为，在 Migration Audit 阶段被拦截；多数运行尝试迁移但破坏了行为，在 Behavioural Tests 阶段被拦截。当前智能体无法交付完美迁移，作者将该基准定位为开发可靠全仓库迁移编码智能体的严格测试平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
papers.abstract_en: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. To address this problem, we propose Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD), a novel artificial intelligence framework that transfers institutional road safety expertise into a compact vision-language model for scalable visual road safety auditing. The key innovation is a quantified expert-grounding stage in which the teacher vision-language model is calibrated against authoritative field audits. Large-scale annotation is permitted only after the teacher reaches substantial agreement with expert risk assessments (Cohen's kappa = 0.74). The calibrated teacher then generates structured supervision that is distilled into an 8-billion-parameter student vision-language model using Low-Rank Adaptation and a single leakage-free prompt. We also introduce Bangladesh Road Safety Audit (BD-ARSA), the first open, expert-grounded Bangladeshi visual road safety audit dataset containing 21,947 image-audit records with near-national coverage, and Expert-Grounded Road Safety Auditor (EG-ARSA), the first vision-language model developed specifically for this task. Experimental results show that grounded fine-tuning substantially improves ordinal risk assessment over the zero-shot baseline, while blind expert evaluation demonstrates that the compact student outperforms both its 31 billion-parameter teacher and Gemini-2.5-Flash. These findings demonstrate that EGD provides an effective and scalable engineering solution for proactive road safety auditing in resource-constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低中收入国家道路安全审计资源受限的问题，提出专家接地蒸馏 (Expert-Grounded Distillation, EGD) 框架，将机构级道路安全专业知识迁移到紧凑的视觉语言模型 (vision-language model) 中进行可扩展的视觉道路安全审计。作者引入首个开放的孟加拉国道路安全审计数据集 BD-ARSA（21,947 条图像审计记录）和专用视觉语言模型 EG-ARSA。实验表明，接地微调显著优于零样本基线，且 80 亿参数的紧凑学生模型在盲评中超过 310 亿参数的教师模型和 Gemini-2.5-Flash。
Motivation: 低中收入国家的道路安全审计受限于不完整的事故记录、合格审计员短缺以及大规模现场检查的高成本，亟需可扩展的自动化审计方案。
Method: 提出 EGD 框架，核心是量化专家接地阶段：先将教师视觉语言模型与权威现场审计校准，达到较高一致性（Cohen's kappa = 0.74）后才允许大规模标注；随后教师生成结构化监督，通过低秩适应 (Low-Rank Adaptation) 和单一无泄漏提示蒸馏到 80 亿参数的学生模型。
Result: 摘要报告接地微调在序数风险评估上显著优于零样本基线；盲专家评估表明紧凑学生模型优于 310 亿参数教师模型及 Gemini-2.5-Flash。
Conclusion: EGD 为资源受限环境下的主动道路安全审计提供了有效且可扩展的工程解决方案。

papers.title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Model for Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring from Triaxial Bodyseismography
papers.abstract_en: Ballistocardiography (BCG) is promising for unobtrusive long-term blood pressure (BP) monitoring in laboratory settings, but traditional BCG signals are vulnerable to the variations in body-bed interaction with shifted fiducial points in temporal or amplitude axis, and BP varies with personal hemodynamic changes, causing misaligned representations that affect model generalizability and robustness. In this work, we propose a non-invasive BP estimation framework, Phy-BP, based on triaxial bodyseismography (BSG) as an extension of BCG. Firstly, an adaptive quality-control algorithm is designed to select BSG segments enriched with cardiogenic components by jointly considering neighboring beat patterns and universal cardiogenic templates. Furthermore, a physical model is established to describe 3D wave propagation in the body-bed system and is subsequently embedded into the deep learning model to characterize the intrinsic coupling among triaxial BSG signals driven by a single cardiogenic excitation. Thus, multi-axis features are aligned during model training, improving robustness against distortions in real scenarios. Experiments on a 162-hour hospital dataset collected from 21 subjects reveal that the proposed Phy-BP can dynamically filter out low-quality measurements, and the deep learning model training is constrained by physical consistency across different axes to provide faithful BP monitoring, especially when training samples are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Phy-BP，一种基于三轴身体地震图 (triaxial bodyseismography, BSG) 的无创血压估计框架，将 BCG 信号推广到更稳健的形态。方法包含自适应质量控制算法筛选富含心源性成分的片段，并把描述体-床系统三维波传播的物理模型嵌入深度学习训练，用单一心源性激励约束三轴信号的内在耦合。作者在来自 21 名受试者的 162 小时医院数据集上验证，表明该框架能动态过滤低质量测量，并在训练样本有限时借助跨轴物理一致性提供可靠的血压监测。
Motivation: 传统 BCG 信号易受体-床相互作用变化影响，导致 fiducial points 在时间或幅度轴上偏移；同时血压随个人血流动力学变化而变，造成表征错位，损害模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。
Method: 先设计自适应质量控制算法，联合考虑邻近心跳模式与通用心源性模板来挑选 BSG 片段；再建立描述体-床系统中三维波传播的物理模型，并将其嵌入深度学习模型，以刻画由单一心源性激励驱动的三轴 BSG 信号间内在耦合，从而在训练中对齐多轴特征。
Result: 在 21 名受试者、162 小时医院数据集上的实验表明，Phy-BP 能动态滤除低质量测量，并且跨轴物理一致性约束使模型在训练样本有限时仍能提供可靠的血压监测。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将物理一致性约束注入深度学习训练可以增强模型对真实场景畸变的鲁棒性，并改善小样本条件下的血压监测可靠性。

papers.title: Provably adaptive sampling with uniform and remasking discrete diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by enabling parallel updates, but their sampling efficiency can depend strongly on the choice of the forward process and the sampler. For the uniform forward process, existing lower bounds for the standard $τ$-leaping sampler scale linearly with the ambient dimension $d$, raising the question of whether this dependence is intrinsic to the forward process. We answer this question in the negative. We consider a first-order sampler based on the leave-one-out denoiser for uniform and remasking processes whose coordinate updates can be performed in parallel. In both cases, the sampler can correct denoising mistakes during the sampling process, which becomes necessary when many coordinates are updated together. Our main result establishes an adaptive sampling guarantee: up to logarithmic factors, $N = O(\mathrm{DTC}(X_0) / \varepsilon)$ discretization steps suffice to achieve sampling error $O(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}+\varepsilon)$, where $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}$ is the error in score estimation. Thus, the sampling complexity is governed by the intrinsic dependence structure of the target distribution, as measured by its dual total correlation $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$, rather than directly by the ambient dimension $d$. Our analysis proceeds through a Bayes-optimal auxiliary sampler that separates discretization error from score-estimation error. We also derive an exact information-theoretic representation of the discretization error in terms of the mutual information between different coordinates of the forward process at different times. This representation applies to general forward processes and, in the uniform and remasking cases, can be controlled by $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$. Numerical experiments on structured synthetic distributions illustrate the predicted dimension-adaptive behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离散扩散模型的采样效率，针对 uniform 前向过程的 τ-leaping 采样器现有下界随环境维度 d 线性增长的问题，提出基于 leave-one-out denoiser 的一阶并行采样器，并证明其采样步数可由目标分布的固有依赖结构 DTC(X0) 控制而非直接由 d 决定。分析通过 Bayes-optimal 辅助采样器分离离散化误差与分数估计误差，并给出离散化误差的互信息精确表示。数值实验在结构化合成分布上验证了维度自适应行为。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型可并行更新，但采样效率强烈依赖前向过程与采样器的选择；uniform 前向过程下标准 τ-leaping 采样器的下界随维度 d 线性增长，作者希望回答这种维度依赖是否为前向过程的固有性质。
Method: 考虑基于 leave-one-out denoiser 的一阶采样器，适用于 uniform 和 remasking 过程，坐标更新可并行执行；通过 Bayes-optimal 辅助采样器将离散化误差与分数估计误差分离，并推导离散化误差的精确信息论表示（不同时刻前向过程不同坐标间的互信息）。
Result: 主要结果是自适应采样保证：在忽略对数因子时，N = O(DTC(X0)/ε) 步离散化足以达到 O(ε_score+ε) 的采样误差，其中 ε_score 为分数估计误差；即采样复杂度由双总相关 (dual total correlation) DTC(X0) 衡量，而非直接由环境维度 d 决定。数值实验在结构化合成分布上展示了预期的维度自适应行为。
Conclusion: 摘要表明维度依赖并非 uniform 前向过程的内在限制，采样复杂度可由目标分布的依赖结构控制；该互信息表示适用于一般前向过程，uniform 与 remasking 情形下可由 DTC(X0) 界定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
papers.abstract_en: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Prime Agent，一个开源的长时程 (long-horizon) 评测与编码智能体工作流 harness。它通过持久化 IPython REPL 实现 Recursive Language Model 抽象，支持程序化上下文处理与 test-time compute；Continual Harness 跨轨迹保存历史、记忆、技能、提示和子智能体规范；递归子智能体通过 agent-to-agent 通信协作，并提供人类可监控的 Agents View。摘要报告该方法将 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 从 30% 提升到 95.5%，并在长上下文编码、GPU kernel 生成、仿真器构建和自主 nanoGPT speedrun 等任务上匹配或超过原生及流行 harness。
Motivation: 语言模型本质上是顺序处理器，而长时程智能体需要超越模型权重和活动上下文的额外信息与外部计算；现有 harness 容易让 harness 自身的失败变成模型的失败，从而测不准模型的真实能力。
Method: 提出一个标准化执行、恢复、验证与资源核算的 harness，同时把策略构建留给模型。核心组件包括基于 Recursive Language Model 抽象的持久化 IPython REPL、跨轨迹保存状态的 Continual Harness、支持直接 agent-to-agent 通信的递归子智能体，以及用于人类检查和管理的 daemon 会话界面。
Result: 摘要报告 Prime Agent 把 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 从 30% 提高到 95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU kernel 生成、仿真器构建和自动 nanoGPT speedrun 上匹配或超过原生及流行 harness。在 Factorio 任务上，refinement 支持持续技术推进，专用子智能体可并行化工作。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种低摩擦、表达力强的 harness 设计能防止 harness 失败转嫁为模型失败，从而把评测推向模型真实的最大底层能力。摘要未提及明显的适用限制。

papers.title: ConvergeFlow: Language Flow with Provable Convergence to Token Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in continuous diffusion and flow-based language models (LMs) have achieved performance competitive with discrete LMs. However, existing continuous frameworks still rely on decoders supervised with cross entropy (CE) because the flow trajectories are not guaranteed to terminate at valid token embeddings. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce \textbf{ConvergeFlow}, an embedding-space flow-based LM, which constrains the data predictor to the convex hull of token embeddings and trains it solely with the mean squared error objective induced by flow matching. Under suitable regularity conditions, we prove that the resulting flow converges to valid token embeddings despite errors in the data predictor, enabling direct token prediction without a CE-supervised decoder. We further develop three sampling mechanisms for controlling the trade-off between the generative perplexity and entropy. Experiments on OpenWebText demonstrate that ConvergeFlow achieves performance competitive with existing continuous and discrete diffusion LMs. These findings demonstrate the potential of the flow-based paradigm for language modeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/ConvergeFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConvergeFlow，一种基于嵌入空间的流匹配（flow matching）语言模型，将数据预测器约束在 token 嵌入的凸包内，并仅用均方误差目标训练，使流轨迹在理论上收敛到有效 token 嵌入，从而无需交叉熵监督的解码器。作者在 OpenWebText 上验证了其生成质量与现有连续/离散扩散语言模型相当，并设计了三种采样机制来平衡生成困惑度与熵。
Motivation: 现有连续扩散和流模型虽已接近离散语言模型的性能，但流轨迹无法保证终止于有效 token 嵌入，因此仍需依赖交叉熵监督的解码器；本文旨在消除这一依赖，实现直接 token 预测。
Method: 将数据预测器限制在 token 嵌入的凸包内，仅使用流匹配的均方误差目标训练；在适当正则条件下证明流在预测器存在误差时仍收敛到有效嵌入，并提出三种采样机制控制生成困惑度与熵之间的权衡。
Result: 在 OpenWebText 上的实验表明 ConvergeFlow 的性能与现有连续和离散扩散语言模型相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果展示了流模型范式在语言建模中的潜力，并公开了代码。

papers.title: FixAnything: 3D-Consistent Rendering Refinement via Video Generative Priors
papers.abstract_en: Rendering views using 3D scene representations such as Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), meshes, or even point clouds produces artifacts when input views are sparse or target views lie far from the input. Recent work mitigates these artifacts using diffusion-based generative priors, but is specialized to individual representations and require custom architectures or extensive retraining. We present FixAnything, a single model for fixing a wide range of rendering artifacts. It does so by repurposing a pretrained video generative model, leveraging its implicit multi-view priors with only minimal modification and lightweight finetuning. Our key insight is that even noisily-rendered sequences preserve camera motion and coarse scene structure, allowing cleanup to be formulated as video-to-video translation. To control what scene structure should be preserved, we introduce a binary mask denoting the clean pixels, enabling the model to anchor its output to high-quality inputs (e.g. training views) while refining the rest. To encourage FixAnything to produce 3D-consistent renderings that support downstream reconstruction, we use camera pose accuracy (recovered via structure-from-motion) as a reward signal for direct preference optimization (DPO). Across four distinct 3D representations, FixAnything consistently improves rendering quality with lightweight finetuning, demonstrating that a single generalist video prior can replace multiple specialist refinement pipelines. The simplicity of the framework enables immediate adoption of stronger future video models without architectural redesign.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FixAnything，一个统一模型，通过复用预训练视频生成模型的多视角先验，以轻量微调和最小修改修复 Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)、NeRF、网格和点云等多种 3D 表示中的渲染伪影。其核心是把带噪渲染序列视为视频到视频翻译，并用二值掩码锚定干净像素，同时以 structure-from-motion 恢复的相机位姿精度作为奖励进行直接偏好优化 (DPO)，以提升 3D 一致性。实验在四种表示上一致改善渲染质量。
Motivation: 当输入视图稀疏或目标视图远离输入时，3DGS、NeRF、网格和点云等 3D 场景表示会产生渲染伪影；现有基于扩散生成先验的修复方法针对单一表示定制，需要自定义架构或大量重训练，缺乏通用性。
Method: 利用预训练视频生成模型的多视角隐式先验，将渲染修复建模为视频到视频翻译；引入二值掩码指示干净像素以锚定高质量输入；并用结构从运动 (structure-from-motion) 恢复的相机位姿精度作为奖励信号进行直接偏好优化，鼓励 3D 一致的输出以支持下游重建。
Result: 在四种不同的 3D 表示上，FixAnything 通过轻量微调一致地提升渲染质量，表明单个通用视频先验可替代多个专门的修复管线。
Conclusion: 该框架足够简单，能在不做架构重新设计的情况下直接采用更强的未来视频模型。

papers.title: Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems under Training-Time Data Contamination
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning-based anomaly detection is increasingly used in industrial control systems (ICS), yet most studies assume that detector training data is trustworthy. In practice, training data may be corrupted through compromised logs, labeling errors, manipulated historian records, or unsafe retraining processes. This paper evaluates the robustness of offline ICS anomaly-detection pipelines on the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT) benchmark under training-time contamination. We assess 11 heterogeneous anomaly detectors under three contamination strategies: random injection, similarity-targeted injection, and feature-noise injection. The first two insert attack samples into the nominal training pool, while the third adds bounded Gaussian noise to selected normal training samples. These attacks are contamination-based rather than gradient-driven poisoning methods. Contamination budgets from 1% to 10% are evaluated using clean validation and test sets under a unified offline protocol. The results show that robustness is strongly model-dependent and cannot be predicted from clean-data performance alone. Injection-based contamination causes the greatest degradation, particularly for local-density and distance-based detectors, whereas feature-noise contamination has a comparatively limited effect. PCA, SVM, HBOS, and IForest remain relatively stable, while the tuned neural detectors demonstrate intermediate robustness. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of training-data integrity in ML-enabled ICS monitoring, subject to the evaluated dataset, models, and threat assumptions.
papers.comment: Accepted and to appear in IEEE CASCON 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/ANTS-OntarioTechU/Robustness-Anomaly-Detection-ICS-Data-Contamination
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估工业控制系统（ICS）中机器学习异常检测模型在训练数据受污染时的鲁棒性，基于 Secure Water Treatment (SWaT) 基准并采用统一离线协议。研究在 1%–10% 污染预算下评估 11 种异构异常检测器，施加随机注入、相似性定向注入和特征噪声注入三种训练时污染策略。结果显示鲁棒性高度依赖模型，注入式污染造成的性能退化最大，而 PCA、SVM、HBOS 和 IForest 相对稳定。
Motivation: 现有 ICS 异常检测研究大多假设训练数据可信，但实践中训练数据可能因日志被篡改、标签错误、历史记录被操纵或不安全的重训练流程而受损，因此需要系统评估训练时数据污染对检测鲁棒性的影响。
Method: 在 SWaT 基准上构建统一离线评估协议，使用干净验证集与测试集，对 11 种异常检测器在三种污染策略（随机注入、相似性定向注入、特征噪声注入）和 1%–10% 污染预算下进行评测；这些攻击属于基于污染的样本注入，而非基于梯度的投毒方法。
Result: 结果表明鲁棒性强烈依赖模型，无法仅凭干净数据上的性能预测；注入式污染导致最大性能下降，尤其影响局部密度型和距离型检测器，特征噪声污染影响相对有限；PCA、SVM、HBOS、IForest 保持相对稳定，调优的神经网络检测器表现出中等鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调训练数据完整性在基于机器学习的 ICS 监控中的重要性，并指出结论受限于所评估的数据集、模型和威胁假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Inertial Manifold Neural Operator for Dissipative Time-Dependent Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce the Inertial Manifold Neural Operator (IMNO) for solving dissipative time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs). The long-time dynamics of such systems often exhibit an effective low-dimensional structure due to dissipation. Unlike standard neural operator architectures such as the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), IMNO explicitly leverages the low-dimensional structure to achieve better physical interpretability, accuracy, and stability in long-horizon autoregressive training and prediction for nonlinear dissipative PDEs. For shift-equivariant PDEs, we further introduce a shift-equivariant variant (IMNO-SE) of the proposed neural operator, ensuring that a spatial shift in the input induces the same spatial shift in the output. This symmetry-preserving inductive bias substantially improves its performance in shift-equivariant PDEs. Extensive benchmark experiments are presented to evaluate IMNO's performance numerically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出惯性流形神经算子 (Inertial Manifold Neural Operator, IMNO)，用于求解耗散型含时偏微分方程 (PDE)。作者指出此类系统因耗散而在长时间动力学中呈现有效的低维结构，IMNO 显式利用该结构，比 Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) 等标准神经算子具有更好的物理可解释性、精度和长时间自回归训练/预测稳定性。针对平移等变 PDE，文章还提出平移等变变体 IMNO-SE，通过在架构中引入对称性保持的归纳偏置，保证输入的空间平移在输出中产生相同平移。摘要报告了多个基准实验以数值评估 IMNO 的性能，但未给出具体数值结果。
Motivation: 耗散型含时 PDE 的长时间动力学因耗散而具有有效低维结构，而 FNO 等标准神经算子没有显式利用这一结构，导致长时间自回归预测中的精度和稳定性受限。
Method: 提出 IMNO，在神经算子设计中显式利用耗散系统惯性流形的低维结构；对于平移等变 PDE，进一步引入 IMNO-SE 变体，通过保持空间平移对称性的归纳偏置来增强输出一致性。
Result: 摘要称通过大量基准实验对 IMNO 进行了数值评估，并指出 IMNO-SE 在平移等变 PDE 上显著提升了性能；但摘要未给出具体数据集或精度数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式利用低维耗散结构可提升非线性能耗 PDE 的物理可解释性、精度和长时间预测稳定性，且平移等变设计是平移对称 PDE 的有效增强方式。论文未在摘要中讨论方法局限。

papers.title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at Human-AI Complementarity and Alignment (HCOMP) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控的逻辑谜题实验研究按需 AI 辅助对人类长期技能发展的影响。实验让参与者在 AI 可用之前、期间和之后完成任务，并操纵 AI 请求成本。结果显示，更便宜的辅助会带来更频繁的 AI 使用，而在 AI 阶段请求过帮助的参与者在移除 AI 后表现更差，且其无辅助表现若由先前有辅助表现预测会被高估。作者用贝叶斯潜在能力模型分离初始能力、AI 后能力与个体技能变化，发现独立解题努力越多，潜在能力提升越大，说明 AI 替代独立推理会削弱技能发展。
Motivation: AI 辅助可能在短期内提升任务表现，但长期可能损害技能发展，这一张力尚缺乏受控实验证据。
Method: 开展受控逻辑谜题实验，参与者依次在 AI 可用前、期间和之后完成任务，并通过实验性地变化 AI 请求成本来影响使用频率；随后用贝叶斯潜在能力模型 (Bayesian latent ability model) 估计初始能力、AI 后能力及个体技能变化，并关联 AI 阶段内的独立推理量。
Result: 摘要报告：较低成本的辅助导致更频繁的 AI 使用；AI 阶段请求过辅助的参与者在移除 AI 后任务表现更差，且基于早期有辅助表现预测的无辅助表现被过高估计；独立解题努力越多，潜在能力提升越大。
Conclusion: 结果表明当 AI 辅助替代独立推理时，技能发展更弱；这为理解 AI 使用短期收益与长期技能损失之间的权衡提供了因果性证据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Interaction Tax: When Communication Erases Diversity in Multi-Agent Teams
papers.abstract_en: Does multi-agent LLM interaction help or hurt? Some work reports gains from debate (Du et al., 2024), critique loops (Chen et al., 2025), and mixture-of-agents synthesis (Wang et al., 2025), while other work finds that interaction adds cost without improving quality under equal budgets (Tran & Kiela, 2026; Xu et al., 2026; Jarrett et al., 2025), or that independent sampling already captures multi-agent gains (Li et al., 2024). We argue this contradiction partly reflects a missing distinction, because not all multi-agent communication is equal. Different model families find structurally different solutions, but when agents read each other's complete outputs, their proposals converge within one round, erasing the diversity that motivates using multiple models. We call this the interaction tax. We test 11 verifier-scored optimization tasks under matched budgets and find that full-solution interaction is a weak default. Independent proposal generation avoids this collapse. Full-solution interaction mainly makes agents stay close to the first solution they see instead of trying different approaches, and critique helps only if the violated rule is easy for the LLM to find and fix. These results suggest that multi-agent performance depends less on the number of agents than on the information they exchange, and interaction helps only when agents share the right information at the right time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体 LLM 交互是否真的有帮助，指出现有文献中支持与反对的证据存在矛盾，原因是忽略了交互的信息类型差异。作者提出“交互税”(interaction tax) 概念：当智能体读取彼此的完整输出时，提案会在一轮之内趋同，抹掉使用多个模型所期望的多样性。在 11 个 verifier 评分的优化任务和匹配预算下，完整解交互是弱默认选项，独立生成提案可避免这种趋同，而批评 (critique) 仅在违规规则容易被 LLM 发现和修复时才有帮助。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 交互的效果存在矛盾结论：部分工作报告辩论、批评循环和混合智能体合成带来收益，另一些工作发现同等预算下交互只增加成本不提升质量，或独立采样已能获得多智能体增益。作者认为这一矛盾源于忽略了并非所有通信都等价。
Method: 在 11 个 verifier 评分的优化任务上，以匹配预算对比完整解交互与独立提案生成两种设置，并分析一轮交互后提案的趋同程度以及批评有效的条件。
Result: 完整解交互会使智能体停留在所见第一个解附近而非尝试不同方法，导致多样性被抹除；独立提案生成能够避免这种趋同。批评只有在所违反规则容易被 LLM 找到并修复时才有效。多智能体性能更多取决于交换的信息而非智能体数量。
Conclusion: 多智能体交互只有在智能体在正确的时间共享正确的信息时才有帮助；完整输出交互作为默认策略是弱选项，这一区分有助于调和既有矛盾研究。

summary_sections.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 交互的效果存在矛盾结论：部分工作报告辩论、批评循环和混合智能体合成带来收益，另一些工作发现同等预算下交互只增加成本不提升质量，或独立采样已能获得多智能体增益。作者认为这一矛盾源于忽略了并非所有通信都等价。
summary_sections.method: 在 11 个 verifier 评分的优化任务上，以匹配预算对比完整解交互与独立提案生成两种设置，并分析一轮交互后提案的趋同程度以及批评有效的条件。
summary_sections.result: 完整解交互会使智能体停留在所见第一个解附近而非尝试不同方法，导致多样性被抹除；独立提案生成能够避免这种趋同。批评只有在所违反规则容易被 LLM 找到并修复时才有效。多智能体性能更多取决于交换的信息而非智能体数量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多智能体交互只有在智能体在正确的时间共享正确的信息时才有帮助；完整输出交互作为默认策略是弱选项，这一区分有助于调和既有矛盾研究。

papers.title: Interpretable AI with Local Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI models such as tabular foundation models and gradient-boosted ensembles can outpredict classical methods, but provide little basis for reasoning about their predictions. High-stakes decisions call for models that are both accurate and interpretable as built. Local linear modeling offers a path forward: a smooth regression function is locally well approximated by a linear one, allowing a linear fit near each query point to achieve high accuracy without sacrificing transparency. The challenges lie in learning what is "local" and developing statistical tools for interpretation. Here, we propose local distillation, in which a black-box "teacher" guides a regularized linear "student" model at each query point. The teacher (1) defines locality by upweighting training observations with similar predicted outcomes, and (2) anchors the fit with its prediction at the query point, included as a pseudo-observation whose weight is estimated from the data. For interpretation, we add a small amount of Gaussian randomization to the local objective and use refits to assess stability: selection frequencies identify reliable features at a query point, and clustering the randomized fits identifies stable subgroups across the data. Under the lasso penalty, we prove that this randomization yields feature-selection probabilities that are stable under small perturbations of the training responses. Across 17 benchmark datasets, local distillation nearly matches its AI teacher's accuracy while producing a sparse linear model at each test point. In a high-dimensional cancer gene expression example, the framework identifies patient subgroups whose local models use different genes; this heterogeneity is invisible to a global linear model, and difficult to surface in a black-box model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出局部蒸馏 (local distillation) 方法，在每个查询点用带正则化的线性学生模型拟合黑盒教师模型；教师通过加重预测结果相近的训练观测的权重来定义局部性，并用查询点处的预测作为伪观测锚定拟合。作者在 lasso 惩罚下证明随机化重拟合得到的特征选择概率对训练响应的小扰动稳定；在 17 个基准数据集上，局部蒸馏几乎匹配教师模型准确率，同时给出每个测试点的稀疏线性模型，并在高维癌症基因表达数据上识别出使用不同基因的稳定患者亚组。
Motivation: 现代 AI 模型（如表格基础模型和梯度提升集成）预测准确但难以支持对其预测进行推理，而高风险决策需要既准确又在构建时即可解释的模型；局部线性建模提供了一条路径，难点在于学习什么是“局部”并开发用于解释的统计工具。
Method: 提出局部蒸馏框架：黑盒教师在每个查询点定义局部性（对预测结果相近的训练观测加权），并以其预测作为伪观测来锚定学生模型的拟合，伪观测权重由数据估计；为进行解释，向局部目标中加入少量高斯随机化，通过重拟合评估稳定性，用选择频率识别查询点的可靠特征，并对随机化拟合聚类以识别跨数据的稳定亚组。
Result: 在 lasso 惩罚下，作者证明该随机化得到的特征选择概率在训练响应的小扰动下稳定；在 17 个基准数据集上，局部蒸馏几乎匹配 AI 教师模型的准确率，同时产出每个测试点的稀疏线性模型；在高维癌症基因表达示例中，框架识别出的患者亚组其局部模型使用不同基因，这种异质性对全局线性模型不可见且难以在黑盒模型中显现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部蒸馏能够在每个查询点兼顾黑盒教师的高准确率与局部线性可解释性，并提供基于随机化重拟合的稳定性推断工具来支持特征选择和亚组发现。

papers.title: Adapter-Based Few-Shot Continual Learning for Malicious Packet Recognition
papers.abstract_en: The continual evolution of malware variants necessitates detection systems that can adapt to new threats without retraining from scratch. However, continually updating models on new data often leads to catastrophic forgetting, where previously learned knowledge is overwritten. While continual learning has been increasingly explored for malware detection, the specific setting of Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL), where new malware classes must be learned from only a small number of labeled examples, remains comparatively underexplored. Therefore, this work investigates the FSCIL setting for malware classification. To address the stability-plasticity dilemma, we propose a hybrid framework that leverages a Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) backbone initialized through domain-specific pre-training on malware packets. Our method incorporates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to efficiently adapt the model during the base session while freezing the core backbone to preserve previously learned representations, alongside a prototype-based classification head for incremental sessions to establish robust decision boundaries from limited samples. Extensive experiments across several datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior malware FSCIL baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究恶意流量数据包识别中的少样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning, FSCIL）设置。作者提出一个混合框架：以恶意流量数据包上领域特定预训练的自监督学习（SSL）骨干为初始化，在基类会话中冻结核心骨干并采用低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）高效适配，增量会话则使用基于原型的分类头从少量样本建立决策边界。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上一致优于先前的恶意软件 FSCIL 基线并达到最新最优性能。
Motivation: 恶意软件变种持续演化，检测系统需要在不从头重训的情况下适应新威胁；持续更新模型容易导致灾难性遗忘。虽然持续学习已被用于恶意软件检测，但需要仅凭少量标注样本学习新类别的 FSCIL 场景仍相对缺乏探索。
Method: 提出混合渐进学习框架，结合领域特定预训练的 SSL 骨干、冻结骨干下的 LoRA 高效微调，以及用于增量会话的原型（prototype）分类头，以同时保持已学表示并利用有限样本建立稳健决策边界。
Result: 摘要报告，在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明该方法一致超越现有恶意软件 FSCIL 基线，并取得 state-of-the-art 性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将领域特定 SSL 预训练、LoRA 适配与基于原型的分类头结合，可有效缓解少数样本增量学习中的稳定性-可塑性困境，为恶意流量识别提供更实用的持续更新方案。

papers.title: Predicting Multiple Clinical Outcomes Related to Functional Recovery and Social Isolation Among Older Adults After Lower-Limb Fracture or Hip Replacement
papers.abstract_en: Older adults recovering after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement may experience complex recovery trajectories. Most of the time, these clinical aspects are studied in isolation, masking their joint impact on recovery. This study used the MAISON-LLF dataset, which contains multimodal sensor and clinical assessment data from 18 older adults recovering in the community after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement. Participants were monitored for up to eight weeks, corresponding to a maximum of 1,008 participant-days of sensor monitoring. Forty-six daily features were extracted from indoor motion, acceleration, step count, heart rate, out-of-home mobility, and sleep data. Five clinical outcomes were assessed every two weeks: the Social Isolation Scale, Oxford Hip Score, Oxford Knee Score, Timed Up and Go test, and 30-second Chair Stand test. We utilize an inherent relationship between multi-modal sensor data and different clinical scores and formulate it as a multi-output regression problem. We tested various machine learning and deep learning single- and multi-output regression algorithms to predict these scores simultaneously. The results showed that predicting clinical scores jointly was better than separately. The tabular DL multi-output regressor, NODE, gave a remarkable performance of MSE=3.96 and MAE=1.02 in comparison to other multi- and single-output regressors. The SHAP feature analysis further showed the importance of including multimodal sensors to provide a good estimate of patients' recovery trajectory. This work may support the simultaneous assessment of functional recovery and social engagement among community-dwelling older adults and ultimately help improve their care and quality of life.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 MAISON-LLF 数据集的多模态传感器与临床评估数据，将下肢骨折或髋关节置换术后老年人的五项临床结局（社交隔离量表、牛津髋/膝评分、起立-行走测试、30 秒椅立测试）建模为多输出回归问题，并比较了多种单输出与多输出机器学习及深度学习算法。结果显示联合预测优于分别预测，其中 tabular 深度学习多输出回归器 NODE 表现最佳（MSE=3.96，MAE=1.02），SHAP 分析表明多模态传感器特征对估计恢复轨迹很重要。
Motivation: 老年人在下肢骨折或髋关节置换术后的恢复轨迹复杂，临床方面通常被孤立研究，掩盖了它们对恢复的联合影响；现有工作缺乏同时评估功能恢复与社会参与的建模方法。
Method: 从室内运动、加速度、步数、心率、离家活动与睡眠数据中提取 46 个每日特征，将五个临床结局的同步预测表述为多输出回归问题，测试多种机器学习和深度学习单输出与多输出回归算法，并用 SHAP 进行特征重要性分析。
Result: 摘要报告联合预测临床评分优于单独预测；NODE 多输出回归器达到 MSE=3.96、MAE=1.02，优于其他多输出和单输出回归器；SHAP 分析证实了包含多模态传感器的价值。
Conclusion: 该工作可能支持社区居住老年人功能恢复与社会参与的同步评估，从而改善护理与生活质量；但样本量较小（18 名参与者），且结论局限于摘要所报告的范围。

papers.title: Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts
papers.abstract_en: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究世界模型（world model）在预测视频时是否真正学会并保持动力学不变量。作者用仅在摆锤视频上训练的冻结 DreamerV3，检查其潜变量转移是否近似守恒一个标量；无标签搜索在多个独立训练的保守模型中恢复同一能量类不变量，而在阻尼模型中找不到。自主 rollout 中该量发生漂移，将潜状态投影回初始水平集可降低三个保守模型的 rollout 误差，而随机约束通常增大误差。
Motivation: 世界模型虽能预测视频，但不一定学会可靠保持的动力学，作者希望区分动态上有意义的不变量与仅可解码的相关量，并揭示模型在想象未来时违反已学物理约束的具体失败模式。
Method: 使用冻结的 DreamerV3 在摆锤视频上训练，通过无标签搜索寻找潜转移近似守恒的标量，并比较保守模型与匹配的阻尼模型；在自主 rollout 中监测该量漂移，并测试将潜状态投影回初始水平集的效果，与随机约束做对照。
Result: 三个独立训练的保守模型中都恢复了同一能量类不变量，而同样流程在匹配的阻尼模型中未发现可比不变量；投影回初始水平集在所有三个保守模型中降低 rollout 误差，匹配的随机约束通常反而增加误差。
Conclusion: 结果区分了动态上有意义的不变量与仅仅可解码的相关量，说明世界模型能从像素学习物理约束，但其想象的前向 rollout 会违反该约束；纠正这一漂移可以改善 rollout。

summary_sections.result: 三个独立训练的保守模型中都恢复了同一能量类不变量，而同样流程在匹配的阻尼模型中未发现可比不变量；投影回初始水平集在所有三个保守模型中降低 rollout 误差，匹配的随机约束通常反而增加误差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果区分了动态上有意义的不变量与仅仅可解码的相关量，说明世界模型能从像素学习物理约束，但其想象的前向 rollout 会违反该约束；纠正这一漂移可以改善 rollout。

papers.title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards
papers.abstract_en: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EarthVerse 是一个面向科学智能体（scientific agents）的基准，聚焦动态地球系统与自然灾害分析。基准包含 405 个可复现任务，覆盖 199 个记录事件和 19 类灾害，要求智能体检查异构事件数据包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、调和来源差异并保留溯源。作者提供了可执行的细粒度 ground truth 与任务级评分规则，并在受控工具使用协议下评估了 25 个模型和智能体系统。
Motivation: 地球系统分析需要整合来源、尺度、时间与模态各异的观测数据，而自然灾害场景中证据不完整会严重影响严重性、暴露度和机制估计；现有智能体难以在端到端科学分析中维持一致的证据链。
Method: 构建 EarthVerse 基准，将科学调查组织为包作用域（package-scoped）任务，并提供可执行 ground truth 将任务分解为细粒度答案单元，同时设计任务特定评分规则评估研究过程且允许多种有效路径；还通过受控研究定位证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互与科学执行中的失败。
Result: 在 25 个系统和受控工具使用协议下，最佳平均答案单元准确率为 84.65%，最高 Strict@95 仅为 34.81%；两者差距表明当前智能体常能完成单个步骤，却无法在证据、尺度、单位、计算与物理解释之间保持一致的链条。
Conclusion: EarthVerse 为动态地球系统中端到端科学可靠性测量提供了可复现基础，并揭示当前智能体在跨步骤一致性上的系统性短板。
Relevance: 33

papers.title: The Measurement Revolution? Credible Measurement and Inference in the Age of AI
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming measurement in economics. AI models convert unstructured data, such as text and images, into structured variables at low cost, making previously prohibitive measurement feasible at scale. This shifts the bottleneck from finding any scalable measure of a phenomenon to choosing among many plausible ones, which may support different empirical conclusions. This review provides guidance for navigating that shift. We describe three stages at which AI enters the measurement pipeline---discovery, construct definition, and observation---and what each demands of researchers. We argue that credible inference with AI-generated variables requires appropriately designed validation: anchoring measurement to explicit criteria, rather than informal claims that a proxy is reasonable. We then examine how validation samples support valid inference even when AI predictions are arbitrarily biased, and what can be done when a random validation sample is unavailable.
papers.comment: This review accompanies the National Bureau of Economic Research 2026 Methods Lecture on "Estimation and Inference with AI-Generated Data."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Melissa Dell 与 Ashesh Rambachan 撰写的一篇综述，讨论人工智能正在如何改变经济学中的测量：AI 模型以低成本将文本、图像等非结构化数据转化为结构化变量，使以往难以实现的大规模测量成为可能。作者将 AI 进入测量流程的阶段分为发现、构念定义与观测，并主张用基于明确标准的验证来支撑可信推断，而非仅凭‘代理指标合理’的非正式说法。文中还分析即使在 AI 预测存在任意偏差时，验证样本如何支持有效推断，以及没有随机验证样本时能做什么。
Motivation: AI 使测量瓶颈从‘能否找到可扩展的指标’转向‘如何在众多看似合理的指标中选择’，而这些指标可能指向不同的实证结论，研究者需要系统性的导航指南。
Method: 作者以综述形式提出三条路径：梳理 AI 在测量流程中进入的三个阶段（discovery、construct definition、observation），强调验证应锚定明确的显式标准，并讨论验证样本在支持有效推断中的作用及随机验证样本不可得时的应对方案。
Result: 综述的核心论点是：若要让 AI 生成的变量支撑可信推断，必须配合恰当设计的验证机制；即使 AI 预测存在任意偏差，适当设计的验证样本仍可为推断提供有效支撑。
Conclusion: 作者强调在 AI 时代，测量验证应转向明确准则而非默认代理指标合理性，这篇综述旨在为经济学中 AI 生成的测量变量提供方法论指导。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in visual reasoning tasks, but it remains unclear whether they understand visual relations, or simply employ shortcuts such as language cues or priors. To investigate this, we use the Qwen3-VL-4B (Bai et al., 2025), a modern VLM, to decode how visual information is encoded across depths. For this, we propose a synthetic dataset of simple geometric shapes for controlled analysis, along with queries crafted to precisely test language cues. Furthermore, the dataset is modified to test causal reliance on visual evidence. Our results show that current VLMs combine genuine visual reasoning with shortcut strategies primarily rooted in language cues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉关系推理中是否真正理解视觉关系，还是仅依赖语言线索等捷径。作者使用 Qwen3-VL-4B 模型，设计了一个包含简单几何形状的合成数据集，并构造查询来精确测试语言线索，同时修改数据集以检验对视觉证据的因果依赖。结果显示当前 VLM 将真正的视觉推理与主要基于语言线索的捷径策略结合在一起。
Motivation: VLM 在视觉推理任务上表现强劲，但人们不清楚它是否真正理解视觉关系，还是利用了语言线索或先验等捷径；研究这一问题有助于厘清模型能力的来源。
Method: 使用 Qwen3-VL-4B 模型，提出一个由简单几何形状组成的合成数据集用于受控分析；设计可精确测试语言线索的查询，并通过修改数据集来检验模型对视觉证据的因果依赖。
Result: 结果显示当前 VLM 同时展现出真正的视觉推理能力和主要基于语言线索的捷径策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VLM 并非单纯依赖捷径，而是结合了真实视觉推理与语言线索驱动的策略；该合成数据集和因果测试方法可用于进一步剖析 VLM 的推理机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Names Cross Scripts: A Source-Grounded Benchmark for Historical Entity Reconciliation in the Mongol World
papers.abstract_en: Historical people may appear under different languages, scripts, and transcription traditions, while distinct individuals may share highly similar or even identical names. This makes historical identity reconciliation more than a problem of string matching or transliteration. We introduce MHER, a provenance-controlled benchmark for pairwise reconciliation of person-name attestations from the Mongol world. MHER contains a balanced 396-pair Name-only core over 84 primary historical persons and a stricter 160-pair Source-grounded subset constructed from mention-by-source evidence, with entity-disjoint development and test splits. Across five generative systems, correctly Source-grounded evidence improves paired TEST accuracy by 12.96 to 94.44 percentage points relative to Name-only input. On five identical-surface different-person cases, all models fail under names alone (0/25 model-item decisions), whereas Source-grounded evidence yields 24/25 correct resolutions, with the remaining output an abstention. Context-only ablations show that historical descriptions often carry substantial identity information, while explicitly signaled misgrounding controls produce substantially lower performance. We also find that names are not uniformly beneficial: for Qwen3-8B, restoring surface forms converts ten otherwise correct Context-only distinctions into false identity merges. These results show that historical entity reconciliation depends not only on surface correspondence, but on whether identity judgments respond appropriately to provenance-controlled historical evidence. MHER therefore provides a controlled framework for studying evidence use, abstention, and failure modes in historical NLP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MHER，一个受来源控制 (provenance-controlled) 的历史人物身份核对基准，面向蒙古世界中跨语言、跨文字、跨转写传统的个人名字 attestation 配对。基准包含 396 对的 Name-only 核心集和 160 对的 Source-grounded 子集，并采用实体不相交的开发/测试划分。摘要报告基于来源的证据显著提升配对测试准确率，并揭示仅靠名字无法区分具有相同表面形式的不同人物。
Motivation: 历史人物可能在不同语言、文字和转写传统下出现，而不同个体可能共享高度相似甚至相同的名字，因此历史身份核对不只是字符串匹配或音译问题。现有研究缺乏受来源控制的基准来系统考察证据使用与失败模式。
Method: 构建 MHER 基准，包括 Name-only 核心集和依据 mention-by-source 证据构造的更严格 Source-grounded 子集；在五个生成式系统上比较不同输入设置，并设计仅上下文消融、显式错配 (misgrounding) 对照以及恢复表面形式等实验。
Result: 与 Name-only 输入相比，正确 Source-grounded 证据将配对测试准确率相对提升 12.96 到 94.44 个百分点；在五个同名不同人案例上，仅名字输入全部失败 (0/25)，而 Source-grounded 证据获得 24/25 正确、1 次弃权。上下文消融显示历史描述常携带大量身份信息，显式错配对照则大幅降低性能；对 Qwen3-8B，恢复表面形式将十个原本正确的 Context-only 区分变成错误的身份合并。
Conclusion: 历史实体核对不仅依赖表面对应，还取决于身份判断能否恰当响应受来源控制的历史证据；MHER 为研究历史 NLP 中的证据使用、弃权 (abstention) 和失败模式提供了受控框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Action-Aligned Retrieval with Pairwise Multimodal Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
papers.abstract_en: Text-based person anomaly search requires distinguishing individuals based on fine-grained, context-dependent behaviors rather than mere appearance. Existing methods struggle to capture these context-conditioned actions, frequently relying on isolated skeletal geometry, discarding raw query details during reformulation, or utilizing absolute pointwise scoring for multimodal verification. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{ActPair}, a unified three-stage coarse-to-fine framework that combines action-aligned retrieval with pairwise multimodal reranking to bridge the pose-semantic gap. First, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) with an action-aligned multi-task objective that encourages the representations to encode action-discriminative semantics. Second, we perform parallel late-fusion retrieval using the original query and a large language model (LLM)-generated context-grounded rewrite, retaining complementary details from both semantic views. Finally, we propose an efficient off-the-shelf reranking module that leverages a pivot-promote algorithm to perform direct pairwise visual comparisons, mitigating residual spatial and compositional ambiguities without the prohibitive inference costs of exhaustive evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves the best results among the compared methods on the Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) public test and transfers effectively to an unseen, non-anomaly-specific dataset.
papers.comment: Accepted to the AI City workshop @ ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 ActPair，一个面向文本描述的人物异常搜索的统一三阶段由粗到细框架，将动作对齐检索与成对多模态重排序结合，以弥合姿态-语义鸿沟。第一阶段用动作对齐多任务目标微调视觉-语言模型 (VLM)；第二阶段对原始查询与 LLM 生成的上下文改写并行执行晚期融合检索 (late-fusion retrieval)；第三阶段提出基于 pivot-promote 算法的 off-the-shelf 重排序模块，进行直接成对视觉比较。实验表明该方法在 Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) 公开测试集上优于对比方法，并能迁移到未见过的非异常专属数据集。
Motivation: 现有文本人物异常搜索方法难以捕捉细粒度、上下文相关行为，常依赖孤立的骨骼几何、在查询改写时丢弃原始查询细节，或使用绝对逐点评分进行多模态验证，导致姿态-语义差距 (pose-semantic gap)。
Method: ActPair 包含三阶段：先以动作对齐多任务目标微调 VLM，使表示编码动作判别性语义；随后用原始查询与 LLM 生成的情境化改写做并行晚期融合检索，保留两种语义视角的互补信息；最后提出高效的 pivot-promote 重排序模块，通过直接成对视觉比较缓解残差空间与组合歧义，同时避免穷举评估的高推理成本。
Result: 在 Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) 公开测试集上，该框架在对比方法中取得最佳结果，并能有效迁移到未见过的非异常专属数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动作对齐检索与成对多模态重排序可以显著改善文本人物异常搜索，并在保持较低推理成本的同时提升跨数据集泛化能力；该工作被 AI City workshop @ ECCV 2026 接收。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SVD-Based Typicality Maps for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We present a method for analyzing the internal representations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) exploiting the geometry of their learned parameters. Each affine layer's weight matrix is factored via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and activations are projected onto the leading right singular vectors to obtain compact, layer-intrinsic representations. A class-conditional density model is then fitted at each layer, producing per-class \emph{typicality scores} that are stacked across depth into \emph{typicality maps}: two-dimensional summaries of how class-specific evidence evolves through the network. From these maps, we derive two post-hoc scores for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) detection: a \emph{Prototype Alignment Score} (PAS), measuring agreement with class reference prototype patterns, and a \emph{Multi-Layer Soft Voting} (MLSV) score, capturing cross-layer consensus without stored prototypes. On ViT-B/16 fine-tuned on CIFAR-100, the proposed scores achieve competitive detection performance without retraining or OOD exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用 Vision Transformer (ViT) 内部参数几何进行分布外 (OOD) 检测的方法。方法对每个仿射层的权重矩阵做奇异值分解 (SVD)，将激活投影到前导右奇异向量上，逐层拟合类条件密度得到 typicality scores，并跨深度堆叠为 typicality maps；据此导出 Prototype Alignment Score (PAS) 和 Multi-Layer Soft Voting (MLSV) 两个后验分数。在 CIFAR-100 上微调的 ViT-B/16 上，该方法无需重训练或 OOD 数据即可取得有竞争力的检测性能。
Motivation: 现有 OOD 检测方法常需要重训练或接触 OOD 数据，作者希望仅利用模型内部表示的几何结构和逐层类证据演化来设计即插即用的检测分数。
Method: 对每个仿射层权重矩阵进行 SVD，将激活投影到前导右奇异向量以得到紧凑的层内表示；逐层拟合类条件密度模型，得到 per-class typicality scores 并堆叠成 typicality maps；从映射中导出 PAS（与类参考原型模式对齐程度）和 MLSV（无需存储原型的跨层软投票一致性）两个后验分数。
Result: 摘要报告在 CIFAR-100 微调的 ViT-B/16 上，PAS 与 MLSV 取得有竞争力的 OOD 检测性能，且不需要重训练或 OOD 暴露。
Conclusion: 摘要认为基于 SVD 的逐层投影与类条件典型性映射可以作为免训练的 OOD 检测信号；未提及跨架构或跨数据集的泛化性与局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理微调引发的错位问题（Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, RIM），即在仅含数学、代码、链式推理等安全数据的微调过程中，LLM 仍可能产生有害行为。作者通过表征空间分析发现推理能力方向与安全行为方向耦合，并提出安全方向惩罚（Safety-Direction Penalty, SDP），在 Qwen2.5-3B 和 7B 上恢复安全性且保持推理性能。
Motivation: RIM 对 LLM 推理安全性构成挑战，且跨架构、跨规模、跨数据集的检查显示其并不总是出现，说明机制尚未被充分理解。此前工作将 RIM 归因于神经元层面的纠缠，但未揭示表征空间中的几何结构，也未给出训练期修复方案。
Method: 作者提取激活空间中分别编码推理能力与安全行为的两个方向，并证明二者耦合：提升推理的微调会移动安全表征。利用 CKA 距离比率和探针定位安全决策层，据此设计 SDP，在推理微调中惩罚沿安全方向的位移；当初始惩罚范围不足时，用相同诊断方法迭代扩展作用层。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 和 7B 上，SDP 恢复了模型安全性，同时保持了基准推理性能。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是，安全与推理方向的耦合促使在安全方向上施加位移惩罚，而层定位诊断可指导惩罚的初始范围及其迭代扩展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自反思策略优化（SRPO），一种无需外部奖励模型或更大教师模型即可将稀疏的终端监督转化为稠密 token 级训练信号的 LLM 后训练框架。SRPO 让模型分析自身完整轨迹、把错误综合为简短“反思补丁”，并用反思条件化的教师分数对学生在线轨迹提供逐 token 信号。在数学推理和长程智能体基准上，使用 Qwen3-8B 基座模型，SRPO 在 AIME'24 上以仅 8% 的监督微调训练 FLOPs 达到 73.3%，并在 WebShop、ALFWorld、SWE-Bench-Lite 上显著提升成功率。
Motivation: 自我反思是人类学习中处理信用分配（credit assignment）的有效机制，但将这一能力内化到 LLM 后训练中的潜力尚未被充分探索；现有方法往往依赖外部评论模型或分离的奖励模型，带来额外开销。
Method: SRPO 框架使 LLM 分析自身完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的“反思补丁”（reflection patches），并使用由反思条件化的教师分数（reflection-conditioned teacher scores）对学生在线采样轨迹提供稠密的逐 token 训练信号，从而把稀疏终端监督转化为稠密 token 级学习信号，且不引入外部评论模型、独立奖励模型或更大的教师模型。
Result: 在数学推理与长程智能体任务上达到先进水平且数据效率突出：基于 Qwen3-8B，AIME'24 取得 73.3%，仅消耗缩放监督微调所需训练 FLOPs 的 8%（0.08x）；WebShop 成功率达 64.7%，ALFWorld 达 76.8%，SWE-Bench-Lite 达 31.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SRPO 可作为将自我反思能力内化到 LLM 后训练的有效框架，在无外部奖励模型条件下提升长程推理性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have recently gained increasing attention as a framework for jointly modeling scene evolution and ego actions in autonomous driving. Most existing WAMs learn scene dynamics in pixel space by combining a video-generation backbone for future-observation prediction with an action head for ego-trajectory prediction. Pixels, however, provide only an indirect representation of these dynamics: they entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture, and illumination, forcing the model to infer three-dimensional transformations from two-dimensional observations. We argue that geometry, represented by point clouds, offers a more natural state space for driving because it explicitly captures spatial structure and the rigid and non-rigid transformations that govern scene evolution while directly aligning with the space in which driving actions are executed. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{GeoWAM}, a visual geometry world action model for autonomous driving. Rather than predicting future images, GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry, yielding representations that jointly encode spatial structure and temporal evolution. A geometry-conditioned action head then leverages these learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego trajectories. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations show that visual geometry world modeling yields substantially stronger driving policies than image-based alternatives, establishing future-geometry prediction as an effective pretraining objective for autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoWAM，一种面向自动驾驶的视觉几何世界动作模型（world action model）。与在像素空间预测未来图像的方式不同，GeoWAM 以点云几何为状态空间，预训练目标是预测未来场景几何，并借助几何条件动作头预测自车未来轨迹。摘要报告在开环与闭环评估中，视觉几何世界建模比基于图像的替代方案产生更强的驾驶策略。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型多在像素空间学习场景动态，但像素将几何与运动同外观、纹理、光照纠缠在一起，迫使模型从二维观测推断三维变换。作者认为点云几何能显式刻画空间结构及刚体/非刚体变换，且与驾驶动作执行的空间更一致，是更自然的驾驶状态空间。
Method: 提出 GeoWAM：预训练阶段预测未来场景几何而非未来图像，得到联合编码空间结构与时间演化的表征；随后用几何条件动作头（geometry-conditioned action head）基于这些几何动态预测未来自车轨迹。
Result: 摘要报告广泛的开环和闭环评估显示，视觉几何世界建模比基于图像的替代方案产生更强的驾驶策略，并将未来几何预测确立为自动驾驶的有效预训练目标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调未来几何预测作为自动驾驶预训练目标的有效性，研究范围限定于自动驾驶场景；摘要未给出明确的局限性讨论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 GeoWAM：预训练阶段预测未来场景几何而非未来图像，得到联合编码空间结构与时间演化的表征；随后用几何条件动作头（geometry-conditioned action head）基于这些几何动态预测未来自车轨迹。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告广泛的开环和闭环评估显示，视觉几何世界建模比基于图像的替代方案产生更强的驾驶策略，并将未来几何预测确立为自动驾驶的有效预训练目标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调未来几何预测作为自动驾驶预训练目标的有效性，研究范围限定于自动驾驶场景；摘要未给出明确的局限性讨论。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Team Semiintelligencn 在 ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge 中的解决方案，面向会话式音乐推荐构建多模态个性化系统。系统采用三阶段流水线：多模态检索（七个嵌入空间的加权质心与 BM25、艺术家子串匹配信号，经加权 RRF 融合）、轻量级重排序，以及基于 GPT-4o-mini 的人格多样化回复生成。开发阶段还实验了受约束的 LLM 引导艺术家注入、XGBoost LambdaMART 等未部署组件。提交系统在 Blind B 上取得 0.3213 的综合分数。
Motivation: 该工作针对挑战赛任务，目标是在会话式音乐推荐中综合多模态信号并个性化生成回复；同时希望验证 LLM 引导注入在候选生成中的效果，尤其是在成本与复杂度约束下哪些组件值得部署。
Method: 采用三阶段流水线：第一阶段是多模态检索，构造七个密集嵌入空间的衰减加权质心（track/user 级 CF-BPR、Qwen3 元数据/歌词/属性、CLAP 音频、SigLIP 视觉），并补充 BM25 词法检索与艺术家子串匹配，通过加权 RRF 融合，权重用差分进化在 500-session 开发集上优化；第二阶段做轻量级重排序（历史过滤、流行度平滑、目录多样性惩罚）；第三阶段用 GPT-4o-mini 生成人格多样化的回复。额外探索了受约束的 LLM 引导艺术家注入、专辑延续信号、XGBoost LambdaMART 和 GPT-4.1 prompt。
Result: 在开发集上优化 RRF 权重使 MRR 提升 +19.5%。Blind A 上，54 个会话的无约束 LLM 引导注入导致 nDCG 灾难性回归（-18.9%），而仅 9 个会话的保守注入得到最佳的 Blind A nDCG。提交系统在 Blind B 上的综合得分为 0.3213。
Conclusion: 摘要将保守式 LLM 引导注入在 Blind A 上的最优表现描述为需要进一步验证的观察；受成本与复杂度限制，部分表现更好的组件未部署到 Blind B。

papers.title: Primal--Dual Alternating Neural Learning for Timely Classification with Performance Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Timely risk classification is essential in many clinical monitoring settings, where decisions must balance the benefit of classifying patients early for subsequent intervention against the value of observing additional data. Yet most existing statistical and machine-learning methods are designed for fully observed trajectories and offer limited control over key operating characteristics such as sensitivity, specificity, and monitoring cost. We cast the sequential classification problem within a multi-objective optimization framework targeting these three criteria. We characterize the optimal decision rule through a value recursion that quantifies, at each time point, the trade-off between immediate classification and continued monitoring. To estimate the rule from data, we formulate a constrained optimization problem that maximizes specificity while enforcing prespecified sensitivity and monitoring-cost constraints. We then develop an estimation procedure that employs a recurrent neural network to approximate the evolving value processes and a primal--dual updating scheme to satisfy the performance constraints. Through simulation studies and an application to continuous glucose monitoring for hypoglycemia risk prediction, we demonstrate that the proposed method yields accurate and timely sequential decision rules that adhere to the desired operating characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对临床监测中的及时风险分类问题，提出一种带性能保证的原对偶交替神经学习方法。作者将序贯分类建模为同时优化灵敏度、特异度和监测成本的多目标优化问题，并通过值递归刻画每个时刻立即分类与继续监测之间的权衡；估计阶段用循环神经网络近似演化值过程，配合原对偶更新满足预设约束。模拟研究与连续血糖监测低血糖风险预测应用表明，该方法能得到准确、及时且符合目标运行特征的序贯决策规则。
Motivation: 现有统计与机器学习方法大多针对完全观测的轨迹设计，无法在分类时对灵敏度、特异度和监测成本等关键运行特征进行有效控制，而临床监测场景需要在早期干预收益与继续观测价值之间做权衡。
Method: 将序贯分类问题置于针对三个准则的多目标优化框架中，用值递归刻画每个时间点上立即分类与继续监测的权衡；随后提出在灵敏度与监测成本约束下最大化特异度的约束优化问题，并用循环神经网络近似演化值过程、采用原对偶更新方案满足性能约束。
Result: 摘要报告，通过模拟研究和连续血糖监测低血糖风险预测应用，所提方法能够产生准确且及时的序贯决策规则，并遵循期望的运行特征。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，采用原对偶交替更新并借助神经网络逼近值过程，可以在满足灵敏度与监测成本约束的同时实现及时而准确的分类决策。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar
papers.abstract_en: Side-Scan Sonar (SSS) is a primary modality for large-scale underwater mapping, yet automated perception and cross-modal alignment are severely bottlenecked by acoustic complexities such as speckle noise, shadows, and extreme viewpoint dependencies. Traditional handcrafted descriptors and modern deep learning matchers fail to bridge the physical domain gap between optical and acoustic imagery without 3D geometric constraints. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel geometry-driven framework for pixel-level opti-acoustic co-registration and view-invariant reflectivity mapping. Our method utilizes Structure-from-Motion (SfM) to reconstruct a dense 3D seafloor mesh, acting as a geometric anchor between the visual and acoustic domains. We introduce a First Bottom Return (FBR) extraction algorithm to dynamically correct non-linear altitude drift caused by uncalibrated SfM reconstruction. Furthermore, we apply an inverse Lambertian model and a dual-Gaussian weighting function to isolate the intrinsic seabed reflectivity, effectively neutralizing slant-range propagation loss and geometric view-dependence. By deterministically associating these isolated acoustic properties with optical pixels, our pipeline generates highly accurate, strictly co-registered multi-modal datasets. This automated, physics-guided approach eliminates the need for manual annotation and paves the way for advanced self-supervised learning in benthic habitat mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何约束的光学-声学联合配准框架，用于侧扫声呐（Side-Scan Sonar, SSS）图像与光学影像的像素级对齐，并提取视点无关的海底反射率图。方法以 Structure-from-Motion (SfM) 重建的稠密 3D 海底网格为几何锚点，结合 First Bottom Return (FBR) 算法校正高度漂移，并用逆 Lambertian 模型和双高斯权重分离固有海底反射率，最终生成严格配准的多模态数据集。摘要称该流程是全自动的、由物理规律引导，无需人工标注。
Motivation: 侧扫声呐是大尺度海底测绘的主要传感器，但斑点噪声、阴影和强视点依赖性使自动感知与跨模态对齐非常困难；传统手工描述子和深度学习方法缺乏 3D 几何约束，难以弥合光学与声学图像之间的物理域差异。
Method: 使用 SfM 重建稠密 3D 海底网格作为几何锚点；提出 First Bottom Return (FBR) 提取算法动态校正未标定 SfM 重建带来的非线性高度漂移；应用逆 Lambertian 模型与双高斯权重函数隔离内在海底反射率，消除斜距传播损耗和几何视点依赖性，并将这些声学属性与光学像素确定性关联。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能生成高度准确、严格共同配准的多模态数据集，但没有给出具体量化指标或基准数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者强调该自动化、物理引导的配准流程消除了对人工标注的需求，并为底栖生境制图中的高级自监督学习铺平道路；不过摘要未说明方法的局限或适用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. Future-based supervision enriches action learning with frames, latent observations, trajectories, or motion representations, but these signals capture particular realizations of what may happen rather than the shared semantic objective of the forthcoming behavior. We propose Intention Distillation (INDI), which distills behavior-level intent into the action decoder. During training, a frozen teacher VLM interprets a demonstrated segment from the current observation, instruction, coarse action summary, and corresponding execution video. From its standard inputs, the deployed VLA recovers the resulting multimodal intent representation at an intermediate decoder layer and uses it to organize action prediction together with representations of how the behavior unfolds and what it achieves. On SimplerEnv-Bridge, INDI improves GR00T-N1.7 from 64.3% to 84.7%, and on RoboCasa Kitchen it improves the controlled GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 64.1% to 70.3%, with consistent gains on $π_{0.5}$ across both benchmarks. In real-world tasks, INDI improves average success from 62.0% to 68.7%, with gains of up to 12.0 pp on longer-horizon tasks. Further analyses show that the recovered latent is used by the decoder, captures behavior objective and execution progress, and organizes downstream predictions in an objective-dependent manner. These results show that action decoders benefit from explicitly modeling the semantic objective of the behavior they generate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出意图蒸馏 (Intention Distillation, INDI)，将行为级意图表征蒸馏进 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型的动作解码器，以弥补行为克隆仅监督电机命令、缺乏行为语义目标的不足。在 SimplerEnv-Bridge、RoboCasa Kitchen 及真实世界任务上，INDI 一致提升 GR00T-N1.7 和 π0.5 的成功率，并表明恢复的潜表征确实被解码器用于目标依赖的动作组织。
Motivation: VLA 模型的动作解码器多依赖行为克隆，只监督演示的电机命令，未显式建模指令下行为所服务的局部目标；已有的未来信息监督（帧、潜在观测、轨迹等）捕捉的是可能发生的特定实现，而非即将发生行为的共享语义目标。
Method: 训练时使用冻结的 teacher VLM，从当前观测、指令、粗略动作摘要和对应执行视频中解释一个演示片段，得到多模态意图表征；部署时，VLA 从中间解码器层恢复该意图表征，并以此组织动作预测以及行为如何展开、达成什么的表征。
Result: 在 SimplerEnv-Bridge 上，INDI 将 GR00T-N1.7 从 64.3% 提升到 84.7%；在 RoboCasa Kitchen 上，受控的 GR00T-N1.7 基线从 64.1% 提升到 70.3%，并在 π0.5 上两个基准均获一致提升。真实世界任务平均成功率从 62.0% 提升到 68.7%，较长时程任务上最高提升 12.0 个百分点；分析显示恢复的潜表征捕捉行为目标与执行进度，并以目标依赖方式组织下游预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动作解码器显式建模所生成行为的语义目标能带来一致的性能提升，说明行为级意图表征有助于改进 VLA 任务的学习。

summary_sections.method: 训练时使用冻结的 teacher VLM，从当前观测、指令、粗略动作摘要和对应执行视频中解释一个演示片段，得到多模态意图表征；部署时，VLA 从中间解码器层恢复该意图表征，并以此组织动作预测以及行为如何展开、达成什么的表征。
summary_sections.result: 在 SimplerEnv-Bridge 上，INDI 将 GR00T-N1.7 从 64.3% 提升到 84.7%；在 RoboCasa Kitchen 上，受控的 GR00T-N1.7 基线从 64.1% 提升到 70.3%，并在 π0.5 上两个基准均获一致提升。真实世界任务平均成功率从 62.0% 提升到 68.7%，较长时程任务上最高提升 12.0 个百分点；分析显示恢复的潜表征捕捉行为目标与执行进度，并以目标依赖方式组织下游预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调动作解码器显式建模所生成行为的语义目标能带来一致的性能提升，说明行为级意图表征有助于改进 VLA 任务的学习。

papers.title: StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StrategyBench 基准，用于评估大语言模型在少样本情境学习 (few-shot ICL) 中显式策略归纳 (explicit strategy induction) 的能力。基准从 BIG-Bench 选取可归纳策略的任务，构建参考策略，并从策略质量与下游效用两个维度定义评估指标。实验表明策略效用随任务类别、策略生成与执行条件及适配设置而变化。
Motivation: 直接 ICL 只使用少量示例而不显式抽象任务规则，对示例构造敏感；人类学习者通常先总结规则再应用于新实例，论文旨在评估模型的这种显式策略归纳能力。
Method: 提出 StrategyBench，从 BIG-Bench 选择策略可归纳任务，构造参考策略，定义策略质量与下游效用两类评估指标，并从任务变化、模型配置与适配设置三个视角分析策略归纳，覆盖类别差异、生成器-执行器选择、演示设计及 SFT 适配。
Result: 实验发现显式策略效用在不同任务类别间差异显著，且同时依赖策略生成与执行条件。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式策略归纳的质量和下游效用受生成与执行等多重因素影响，并发布了基准供后续研究使用。

papers.title: What's the Catch? Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on video and image-sequence benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they capture temporal structure. To study this question, we formulate temporal grounding as an anomaly detection problem, providing a simple and controlled evaluation that directly tests sensitivity to temporal consistency. We introduce TimeCatch, where temporal anomalies are created by swapping consecutive frames and frame-level anomalies by replacing a frame with Gaussian noise. Models are evaluated on anomaly detection and localization tasks across four synthetic and real-world datasets, alongside a human study. Our evaluation reveals a substantial gap between frame-level and temporal anomaly detection. While VLMs consistently detect frame-level anomalies and often localize them accurately, they perform near chance on temporal anomaly detection and only modestly above chance on localization. Humans, in contrast, achieve near-ceiling performance on both tasks. Additional analyses across model scales, prompting strategies, sequence lengths, and visual similarity suggest that these failures cannot be explained solely by limitations in perception or model capacity. Together, these findings indicate that current VLMs can identify anomalies within individual frames but struggle to integrate information across frames to reason about temporal consistency. TimeCatch provides a controlled benchmark for evaluating temporal grounding in vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TimeCatch 基准，将时间 grounding 问题形式化为异常检测任务，通过交换连续帧制造时间异常、用高斯噪声替换帧制造帧级异常，系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）对时序一致性的敏感度。结果显示 VLM 在帧级异常检测上表现良好，但在时间异常检测上接近随机水平，定位也仅略高于随机；人类则在两类任务上均接近满分。作者认为当前 VLM 能识别单帧内的异常，却难以跨帧整合信息进行时序推理。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在视频和图像序列基准上表现强劲，但其是否真正捕捉时间结构仍不清楚；缺乏简单可控的评测来直接检验模型对时序一致性的敏感度。
Method: 将时间 grounding 建模为异常检测问题，构造 TimeCatch 基准：时间异常通过交换连续帧产生，帧级异常通过用高斯噪声替换帧产生；在四个合成与真实数据集上评估异常检测与定位，并加入人类研究作为对照。
Result: VLM 在帧级异常检测上表现一致且常能准确定位，但在时间异常检测上接近随机，时间定位仅略高于随机；人类在两个任务上均接近上限。跨模型规模、提示策略、序列长度和视觉相似度的额外分析表明，这些失败不能仅由感知或模型容量限制解释。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 能识别单帧内的异常，但难以跨帧整合信息以推理时间一致性；TimeCatch 为评估 VLM 的时间 grounding 提供了受控基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MetaCaster: Meta-Harness-Optimized Agent for End-to-End Few-Shot Learning of Lightweight Time Series Forecasters
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting (TSF) is evolving toward multimodal and agentic settings, yet using foundation models remains uneconomical in resource-constrained scenarios, where compact, specialized forecasters are more desirable. However, lightweight forecasters typically require substantial training data, limiting their use in domains with scarce, slowly accumulated, or privacy-sensitive time series. To address this dilemma, we investigate the challenging problem of few-shot learning for lightweight forecasters. We propose MetaCaster, a meta-harness-optimized multi-agent framework that uses agentic data generation to automatically train specialized lightweight forecasters from only a few examples and textual contexts. Our work highlights a new TSF paradigm in which agents act not as forecasters but as intermediary engineers that prepare efficient, task-specific forecasters for deployment. Experiments on 18 datasets, 23 state-of-the-art lightweight forecasters, and 14 baselines demonstrate that MetaCaster achieves both data efficiency and computational efficiency while maintaining high-quality TSF performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaCaster，一个元层面优化多智能体框架，面向轻量级时间序列预测器 (lightweight forecasters) 的少样本学习问题。它利用智能体式数据生成 (agentic data generation) 从少量样本和文本上下文自动训练专用轻量预测器，而非让智能体直接做预测。在 18 个数据集、23 个轻量预测器和 14 个基线上验证了数据效率与计算效率。
Motivation: 轻量级时间序列预测器在资源受限场景中更经济，但通常依赖大量训练数据，在数据稀缺、缓慢积累或隐私敏感的时间序列领域难以应用。
Method: MetaCaster 采用元优化 (meta-harness-optimized) 的多智能体框架，智能体不充当预测器，而是作为中间工程师，通过 agentic 数据生成自动为特定任务准备好专用的轻量级预测器。
Result: 实验覆盖 18 个数据集、23 个现有最优轻量级预测器以及 14 个基线，结果显示 MetaCaster 在保持高质量时间序列预测性能的同时实现了数据效率和计算效率。
Conclusion: 论文提出一种新范式：在多模态和智能体化的时间序列预测趋势下，用智能体自动构造专用轻量预测器，缓解少样本与资源约束的困境。

papers.title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems
papers.abstract_en: Memory is becoming a default subsystem in deployed LLM agents to provide persistent personalization and continuity. This naturally prompts a question: will memory system introduce new vulnerabilities into agents? Thus we propose InjecMEM, a novel memory injection attack paradigm that requires only a single interaction (no read/edit access to memory store) to steer later responses of related queries toward a pre-specified output. Guided by the retrieval-then-generate mechanism of memory systems, we craft the injection with a retriever-agnostic anchor and an adversarial command. The anchor contains high-recall topical cues so that downstream retrieval consistently associates the record with the target topic. The command is a short sequence optimized to remain effective under uncertain fused contexts, variable placements, and long prompts so that it reliably steers outputs once retrieved. We learn the command via gradient-based coordinate search, averaging over synthetic prompt templates and insertion positions, and extend it to joint optimization across backbones to study transfer. Evaluated across multiple memory systems and backbone models, InjecMEM achieves reliable topic-conditioned retrieval and targeted generation, remains effective under memory drift, and leaves non-target queries unaffected. Our results underscore the need to harden memory systems and provide a reproducible framework for studying agent memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InjecMEM，一种针对 LLM 智能体记忆系统 (memory system) 的新型记忆注入攻击范式。攻击者只需一次交互且无需对记忆库进行读取或编辑，即可在后续检索到该记录时，把相关查询的生成结果向预先指定的输出方向引导。作者基于记忆系统 retrieval-then-generate 的工作机制，构造包含高召回主题线索的 retriever-agnostic anchor 与一条对抗命令 (adversarial command)，并通过梯度式坐标搜索在合成模板与插入位置上学习命令。跨多个记忆系统和骨干模型的评估显示，该方法能实现可靠的按主题检索与定向生成，在记忆漂移下仍然有效，且不影响非目标查询。
Motivation: 记忆系统正成为已部署 LLM 智能体中提供持久个性化和连续性的默认子系统，因此需要回答一个关键问题：记忆系统是否会为智能体引入新的安全漏洞。现有工作缺乏对此类攻击面的系统研究。
Method: 利用记忆系统的检索再生成机制，将注入内容设计为两部分：具备高召回主题线索的 anchor，使下游检索稳定地将该记录关联到目标主题；以及一条短命令，针对不确定的融合上下文、可变插入位置和长提示进行优化，确保检索命中后可靠地控制输出。命令通过梯度式坐标搜索 (gradient-based coordinate search) 学习，在合成提示模板与插入位置上取平均，并扩展到跨骨干模型的联合优化以研究迁移性。
Result: 在多种记忆系统和骨干模型上的评估表明，InjecMEM 能可靠实现按主题条件的检索和定向生成，在记忆漂移下依然有效，并且不干扰非目标查询。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要加固记忆系统，并提供一个可复现的研究框架来系统研究智能体记忆的安全性。
Relevance: 0
