papers.title: Machine Learning Assisted Inverse Design of Pixelated mmWave Patch Antennas
papers.abstract_en: A machine learning-assisted framework for the inverse design of pixelated millimetre-wave patch antennas targeting the 22--30 GHz band is presented. The antenna surface is represented as a 19x23 binary pixel grid on a Rogers RT/duroid 5880 substrate, where each pixel is either metal or empty, with a continuous electrical path from the feed enforced by design. An initial dataset of approximately 6,000 full-wave CST simulations was collected from structured random pixel patterns, of which only around 40% achieved a resonance with |S11| <= -10 dB anywhere in the band, resulting in an imbalanced dataset. To improve simulation efficiency, an XGBoost binary classifier was trained on this data to distinguish resonant from non-resonant patterns before simulation. Using the classifier as a pre-simulation filter, an additional 4,000 patterns were selected and simulated, raising the overall proportion of resonant designs in the combined 10,000-sample dataset from approximately 40% to 52%. A hybrid CNN-BiLSTM forward surrogate was then trained on this augmented dataset to predict the full complex S11 response across 801 frequency points, using a physics-guided composite loss that explicitly emphasises resonance dip accuracy. Finally, an inverse design model was developed that optimises in a compact 64-dimensional latent space using gradient descent to generate pixel patterns matching a desired S11 specification. The results show good agreement between the surrogate-predicted and CST-simulated |S11| responses for the generated designs and demonstrate the feasibility of automatically designing and reconfiguring antenna structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个机器学习辅助的毫米波贴片天线逆向设计框架，面向 22–30 GHz 频段。天线表面表示为 Rogers RT/duroid 5880 基板上的 19×23 二进制像素网格；研究者先用 XGBoost 分类器筛选谐振图案，再用混合 CNN-BiLSTM 正向代理模型预测 801 个频点的复 S11，最后在 64 维潜空间用梯度下降生成满足目标 S11 的像素图案。摘要报告生成设计在代理预测与 CST 仿真之间具有良好的一致性。
Motivation: 像素化贴片天线逆向设计面临全波仿真成本高、以及谐振图案稀疏导致的类别不平衡问题——初始约 6000 个 CST 仿真样本中仅约 40% 在频段内达到 |S11|<=−10 dB，需要更高效的仿真前筛选和设计生成方法。
Method: 方法分三步：训练 XGBoost 二分类器在仿真前区分谐振与非谐振图案；训练混合 CNN-BiLSTM 正向代理预测 801 个频点的完整复 S11 响应，并使用强调谐振谷精度的物理引导复合损失；逆向设计在 64 维潜空间中用梯度下降优化像素图案以匹配目标 S11 规格。
Result: 用分类器预筛选后新增 4000 个图案并仿真，组合成 10000 样本数据集，其中谐振设计占比从约 40% 提升到 52%；生成的像素图案的代理预测 |S11| 与 CST 仿真结果吻合良好。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是该框架可以自动设计和重构天线结构，验证了机器学习辅助逆向设计在该频段贴片天线上的可行性；具体局限性未在摘要中提及。

papers.title: RAD: Rule-Augmented Relational Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is often applied to data stored in relational databases, yet most existing methods require flattening multiple tables into a single feature matrix. This flattening can obscure entity identity, schema structure, and multi-hop dependencies, limiting the detection of anomalies that depend on relational context rather than isolated feature values. Beyond preserving relational structure, relational anomaly detection raises an additional challenge: how to incorporate symbolic behavioral evidence into learned relational representations. To address these challenges, we study relational anomaly detection, where the goal is to identify anomalous entities or events in a multi-table database. We propose RAD, a rule-augmented relational anomaly detector that combines heterogeneous graph representation learning with refined symbolic rule signals. RAD derives candidate rules from random-forest paths over flattened summaries of the entities or events being scored, refines them into compact interpretable predicates, injects the resulting rule features into the graph model, and learns anomaly scores using reconstruction-based and pairwise-ranking supervision. To evaluate this setting, we introduce a relational anomaly detection benchmark spanning three settings: LANL cybersecurity event detection and two unexpected user-churn anomaly tasks derived from Amazon and H&M relational databases. Experiments show that RAD improves anomaly ranking over flattened tabular detectors and relational baselines under natural class imbalance, achieving the best average rank on AUROC and AUPRC across the benchmark. Ablations show that direct rule injection and ranking-based supervision are key contributors to performance, while edge reconstruction is not uniformly beneficial. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/noahd15/RAD_RelationalAnomalyDetection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究关系数据库中的异常检测问题，指出现有方法通常将多表展平成单一特征矩阵，从而丢失实体身份、模式结构与多跳依赖。作者提出 RAD，一种规则增强的关系异常检测器，将异构图表示学习与经过精炼的符号规则信号结合，并在 LANL 网络安全事件、Amazon 与 H&M 用户流失任务构成的新基准上验证其有效性。实验表明 RAD 在 AUROC 和 AUPRC 上取得最佳平均排名，且直接规则注入与排序监督是主要贡献。
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法多要求将关系数据库的多表展平为特征矩阵，这会掩盖实体身份、模式结构与多跳依赖，导致依赖关系上下文的异常难以被发现；此外，如何将符号化的行为证据融入学习到的关系表示仍是一个未解决的挑战。
Method: 提出 RAD，先从展平的实体或事件摘要上训练随机森林并从中推导候选规则，再将规则精炼为紧凑可解释的谓词并作为规则特征注入图模型；模型结合重构损失与成对排序监督学习异常分数，并采用异构图表示学习。
Result: 在新引入的包含 LANL 网络安全事件检测和 Amazon、H&M 用户流失异常任务的关系异常检测基准上，RAD 在自然类不平衡条件下优于展平表格检测器与关系基线，取得 AUROC 和 AUPRC 的最佳平均排名；消融实验表明直接规则注入和基于排序的监督是关键贡献，而边重构并非普遍有益。
Conclusion: 作者将关系异常检测建模为多表结构下结合符号规则与图表示学习的问题，并强调规则注入与排序监督对性能的重要性；摘要同时指出边重构并非对所有场景都有帮助。

papers.title: ProxyFormer: A Dual-Stream Proxy Architecture for Ultra-Long Context and High-Resolution Generation
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic growth of attention computation and key-value (KV) cache with respect to sequence length is a central bottleneck for ultra-long-context language models and high-resolution generative models. We propose ProxyFormer, a general dual-stream architecture built upon proxy tokens. In each layer, fine-grained local features are compressed bottom-up into a small set of proxy states; expensive global interactions are performed only in the compressed proxy space; the globally contextualized proxies are then decompressed and injected top-down back into the local stream. Because the local stream persists across layers, fine-grained information that is not captured by one compression step remains accessible for later refinement, alleviating the irreversible information loss of conventional one-shot compression. We further introduce factorized multi-level compression/decompression, layer-wise dynamic compression ratios, asymmetric dual embeddings, and a proxy-only KV-cache inference scheme. On a 16GB GPU with batch size 1, a standard decoder-only model can train sequences of only about 20K tokens, whereas ProxyFormer with a compression ratio of 64 extends the trainable sequence length to about 0.7M. A model trained with a 64K window retains 92%-95% retrieval accuracy on a multi-needle retrieval task with 1,048,576 tokens, and a model trained with an 8K window exceeds 94% accuracy when extrapolated to 256K tokens. Preliminary image-generation experiments demonstrate the feasibility of ProxyFormer for both pixel-space and latent-space flow matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProxyFormer，一种基于代理 token (proxy tokens) 的通用双流架构，用于超长上下文语言模型与高分辨率生成模型。每层将细粒度局部特征自底向上压缩为少量代理状态，只在压缩的代理空间中执行昂贵的全局交互，再自顶向下将全局上下文解压并注入局部流；由于局部流跨层持续存在，单次压缩未捕获的信息可在后续层被修正，缓解一次性压缩导致的不可逆信息损失。摘要报告在 16GB GPU、batch size 1 下，标准 decoder-only 模型只能训练约 20K token 序列，而压缩比为 64 的 ProxyFormer 可将可训练序列长度扩展到约 0.7M；64K 窗口训练的模型在 1,048,576 token 的多针检索任务上保持 92%-95% 的准确率。
Motivation: 注意力计算和键值缓存 (KV cache) 随序列长度二次增长，是超长上下文语言模型和高分辨率生成模型的核心瓶颈；同时常规的一次性压缩方法会造成不可逆的细粒度信息损失。
Method: 提出双流代理架构：底层流中细粒度局部特征被自底向上压缩成代理状态，全局交互仅在压缩代理空间中进行，之后将携带全局上下文的代理解压并自顶向下注入局部流。辅以因子化多级压缩/解压、逐层动态压缩比、非对称双嵌入 (asymmetric dual embeddings) 和仅代理的 KV 缓存推理方案 (proxy-only KV-cache inference)。
Result: 在 16GB GPU、batch size 1 下，标准 decoder-only 模型可训练约 20K token 序列，而压缩比为 64 的 ProxyFormer 将可训练序列长度扩展至约 0.7M token；64K 窗口训练的模型在 1M token 多针检索任务上保持 92%-95% 准确率，8K 窗口训练的模型外推到 256K token 时准确率超过 94%。初步图像生成实验表明该方法在像素空间和潜空间 flow matching 上均可行。
Conclusion: 摘要表明在压缩代理空间中进行全局交互并保留跨层局部流，可以在极大扩展可训练序列长度的同时保持检索精度，并初步验证其适用于高分辨率生成任务。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Strong Averaging Principle and Long-Time Dynamics for Fast-Slow SDEs with Increasing Time-Scale Separation and Degenerate Noise
papers.abstract_en: We establish a strong averaging principle for fast-slow stochastic differential equations with a time-dependent scale-separation parameter $(\varepsilon_t)_{t \geq 0}$ satisfying $\varepsilon_t \to 0$ as $t \to \infty$. In contrast to approaches based on noise-induced smoothing or elliptic regularity, our approach relies on dissipativity of the frozen fast dynamics and therefore permits degenerate diffusion coefficients. We prove a maximal $L^p$-estimate between the slow variable and the averaged ODE at late times, with the classical strong convergence rate of order $1/2$. Under an additional decay condition on $(\varepsilon_t)_{t \ge 0}$, this estimate implies that the slow variable is almost surely an asymptotic pseudo-trajectory of the averaged ODE. As a consequence, we obtain criteria for the identification of possible limit points and for convergence toward asymptotically stable equilibria for the slow variable by analyzing the dynamical behavior of the averaged equation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带时间依赖尺度分离参数 $(\varepsilon_t)_{t\geq 0}$ 的快慢随机微分方程，在 $\varepsilon_t\to 0$ 的条件下建立强平均原理。与依赖噪声诱导光滑化或椭圆正则的方法不同，文章利用冻结快动力学的耗散性，因此允许退化扩散系数。作者证明慢变量与平均 ODE 在晚时的最大 $L^p$ 估计，达到经典强收敛阶 $1/2$；在额外衰减条件下，慢变量几乎必然成为平均 ODE 的渐近伪轨，并由此得到极限点识别和渐近稳定平衡点收敛的判据。
Motivation: 现有的快慢系统平均原理常依赖噪声诱导光滑化或椭圆正则性，难以处理退化扩散系数；同时尺度分离参数随时间变化的情形也缺乏系统处理。作者希望仅依赖冻结快动力学的耗散性来建立强平均原理，并刻画慢变量的长期动力学。
Method: 基于快动力学的耗散性而非噪声光滑性建立强平均原理，证明晚时慢变量与平均 ODE 之间的最大 $L^p$ 估计；在尺度分离参数的附加衰减条件下，将估计加强为慢变量几乎必然构成平均 ODE 的渐近伪轨。
Result: 摘要报告得到强收敛阶 $1/2$ 的最大 $L^p$ 估计；在 $(\varepsilon_t)$ 的适当衰减条件下，慢变量几乎必然是平均 ODE 的渐近伪轨，并据此给出识别可能极限点以及收敛到渐近稳定平衡点的判据。
Conclusion: 作者将慢变量的长期行为约化为对平均 ODE 动力学的分析，方法适用于退化扩散系数与耗散型快动力学；该文为理论性结果，摘要未涉及数值实验。

papers.title: Diversity-Based Active Learning: An Evaluation of Metric Spaces for Active Learning Selection
papers.abstract_en: With rapid advancement over the last few years, many different methods are now widely used for classification. However, training these models requires substantial labeled data. Active Learning is a potential solution to this problem. Pool-based active learning minimizes costs by querying only the most informative samples from an unlabeled dataset. Diversity-based approaches, on the other hand, attempt to select a representative subset of the data. There are many different objectives for determining the selection process, including exact K-center, exact K-median, and Greedy K-center. In this paper, we will focus on evaluating the performance of Greedy K-center across a variety of metric spaces: the raw feature space, a Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) space, and a model-derived probability space (with and without entropy-based weighting). Using Random Forest classifiers as a baseline evaluator, our empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that mapping unlabeled instances into a predictive probability space and weighting the result by entropy often dominates the other options for active learning selection with Greedy K-center.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估池化主动学习（pool-based active learning）中多样性选择方法 Greedy K-center 在不同度量空间下的表现，包括原始特征空间、线性判别分析（LDA）空间以及模型导出的概率空间（有无熵加权）。以随机森林分类器作为基线评估器，在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，将未标注样本映射到预测概率空间并按熵加权，通常优于其他选择方案。
Motivation: 训练分类模型需要大量标注数据，池化主动学习通过只查询最有信息量的未标注样本来降低成本；多样性方法则试图选择代表性子集。但不同度量空间对 Greedy K-center 选择效果的影响缺乏系统评估。
Method: 对比 Greedy K-center 在三种度量空间中的表现：原始特征空间、LDA 空间、模型导出的概率空间（带与不带基于熵的加权），并使用随机森林分类器作为基线评估器，在合成和真实数据集上进行实验。
Result: 实验结果显示，将未标注实例映射到预测概率空间并用熵加权，在主动学习选择中通常优于其他度量空间选项。
Conclusion: 摘要强调概率空间加熵加权对 Greedy K-center 主动学习的优势，但未给出具体数值或更广泛的适用性边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Traceable Spectral Inference via Influence Functions: Efficient Data Attribution and Error Proxies for the Ariel Mission
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability is critical for machine learning models deployed in scientific space missions such as ESA's Ariel, where ground truth is unavailable during operations and physical plausibility must be assessed. While most explainable AI methods focus on feature attribution, this work investigates training data attribution through influence functions and introduces three key contributions for operational spectroscopy pipelines. First, influence is reformulated in terms of prediction rather than loss, enabling label-free deployment. Second, by leveraging the closed-form ridge solution of an Extreme Learning Machine, infinitesimal prediction influence is efficiently computed. Third, an influence-based conservative error proxy is derived by propagating training residuals through the influence sensitivities. Evaluated against simulated spectra, the proposed proxy correlates strongly with scale and shape-based spectral errors. Furthermore, influence functions enable the identification of the most influential samples and the approximation of the most harmful ones. Together, these results suggest that this approach can serve as an operational framework for scientific machine learning.
papers.comment: To appear in "Proceedings of SPAICE 2026: Third Conference on AI in and for Space"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学航天任务（ESA Ariel）中机器学习模型在运行阶段无法获取地面真值、必须评估物理合理性的问题，提出基于影响函数（influence functions）的训练数据归因方法。作者将影响函数由损失形式改写为预测形式以实现无标签部署，利用 Extreme Learning Machine（ELM）的闭式岭解高效计算微小的预测影响，并推导出基于影响的保守误差代理。在仿真光谱上的评估显示该代理与尺度、形状相关的光谱误差高度相关，并能识别最有影响及最有害的训练样本。
Motivation: 在 Ariel 等科学空间任务中，ML 模型的可解释性至关重要，但现有可解释 AI 方法大多关注特征归因，缺乏对训练数据归因的研究；且运行期间没有 ground truth，需要能够在无标签条件下衡量预测的物理合理性。
Method: 将影响函数重新定义到预测空间而非损失空间，从而支持无标签场景；利用 ELM 的闭式岭解（closed-form ridge solution）高效计算无穷小预测影响；再通过影响灵敏度传播训练残差，推导出保守误差代理（conservative error proxy）。
Result: 在仿真光谱数据上，所提出的误差代理与尺度及形状相关的光谱误差强相关；影响函数还能够识别最有影响力的训练样本，并近似最有害的样本。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作可作为科学机器学习任务的一种运行框架（operational framework），为缺乏真实标签的航天观测场景提供可追溯的数据归因与误差估计。摘要未涉及降水、临近预报或气象同化等应用。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots
papers.abstract_en: Space robots operate in extreme environments where hardware degradation can critically compromise traditional control strategies. While continual reinforcement learning offers a promising mechanism for online adaptation, it inherently requires access to a reward signal during deployment. However, precise reward computation in space is often infeasible due to the lack of external tracking systems and the overall complexity of the environment. To address the challenge of unobservable rewards, we introduce a reward-free continual learning framework that leverages latent-state world models. By pre-training a model-based agent across diverse simulations, the world model learns a robust predictor of the reward structure within its latent space. Upon deployment to an environment with severe hardware degradation, we freeze the observation encoder and reward predictor to update only the transition dynamics of the world model through unsupervised rollouts. By training the policy entirely on imagined trajectories generated by this updated world model, the agent adapts to altered dynamics without receiving new rewards. We demonstrate our approach across simulated planetary traversal, orbital navigation, and precision assembly tasks subjected to severe morphological failures.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Third Conference on AI in and for Space (SPAICE 2026) | The source code is available at https://github.com/AndrejOrsula/space_robotics_bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向太空机器人的无奖励持续学习框架，利用潜在状态世界模型 (latent-state world model) 在部署时适应硬件退化。框架先在多种仿真中预训练基于模型的智能体，使其在世界模型潜在空间中学会预测奖励结构；部署后冻结观测编码器和奖励预测器，仅通过无监督 rollout 更新转移动力学，并完全在更新世界模型生成的想象轨迹上训练策略。作者在火星表面遍历、轨道导航和精密装配等严重形态失效任务中展示了该方法的可行性。
Motivation: 太空机器人在极端环境中运行，硬件退化会破坏传统控制策略。持续强化学习本可实现在线适应，但部署阶段通常依赖奖励信号，而太空中缺少外部跟踪系统且环境复杂，精确计算奖励往往不可行，因此需要一种不依赖奖励的在线适应机制。
Method: 提出 reward-free continual learning 框架：预先在多样仿真环境中训练基于模型的智能体，使世界模型在潜在空间内学到奖励结构的鲁棒预测器；面对严重硬件退化时，冻结观测编码器与奖励预测器，只更新世界模型的转移动力学，并通过无监督 rollout 得到的想象轨迹来训练策略，从而在不接收新奖励的情况下适应改变后的动力学。
Result: 摘要报告在行星遍历、轨道导航和精密装配等仿真任务中，对严重形态失效情况验证了该方法，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 该方法通过解耦奖励预测与动力学更新，实现在奖励不可观测的太空部署场景中的持续适应，其有效性目前仅在仿真任务中得到展示。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.
papers.comment: This paper is the extended version of Contet, Grandi, Mengin. Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers. In: Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Algorithmic Decision Theory (ADT) (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何对锦标赛规则下某候选者落选给出形式化解释：通过识别使该候选者无论其余部分如何完成都必然落败的子锦标赛。作者将这种最小子锦标赛定义为破坏性最小支持 (destructive minimal supports)，并对应到可解释人工智能中的溯因解释。对六种常见锦标赛解 (maximin、uncovered set 及其加权变体、top-cycle、Copeland、Borda) 给出了必要败者与可能胜者的刻画，并确定了最小破坏性支持的大小及相关计算复杂度。
Motivation: 在锦标赛或选举场景中，人们经常需要理解为什么某个候选者没有被选中；形式化可解释人工智能中需要回答“落选者为何落选”，而现有工作缺乏对这一问题的系统刻画。
Method: 定义破坏性最小支持：候选者在任何锦标赛完成方式下都失败的最小子锦标赛，并将其视为对“该候选者落败”的溯因解释。对六种锦标赛解分别刻画必要败者 (necessary loser) 与可能胜者 (possible winner) 的条件，并研究最小破坏性支持的大小及其计算算法。
Result: 除 Borda 规则外，其余五种规则都有计算最小破坏性支持的多项式时间算法；Borda 规则被怀疑为 NP-complete。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对多数锦标赛解可以得到有效的解释算法，而 Borda 规则的计算复杂性仍未完全确定，被怀疑是难解的。

papers.title: Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding a basketball game requires recognizing events, localizing actions, identifying players, and relating these to structured game knowledge. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these abilities one at a time, leaving the interactions among these abilities under-explored. We introduce BasketballBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 7,980 questions across ten tasks in text, image, and video. It is built from the 2025-2026 NBA season and includes official playby-play, rosters and profiles for 530 active players, and 2,501 possession-level broadcast clips. We further propose BasketballSkills, an agent that composes eight basketball-specific perception and retrieval tools under four reusable skills that specify tool order, evidence bindings, and stopping conditions. Experiments show that current MLLMs struggle particularly on questions requiring the integration of multiple capabilities, whereas BasketballSkills outperforms them, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly composing domain-specific capabilities for comprehensive basketball understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出篮球综合理解的多模态基准 BasketballBench 与代理系统 BasketballSkills。BasketballBench 包含 7,980 个问题、覆盖文本/图像/视频三类模态的十项任务，数据来自 2025-2026 NBA 赛季的官方 play-by-play、530 名现役球员的花名册与资料以及 2,501 个回合级转播片段。实验显示现有 MLLM 在需要整合多种能力的题目上表现困难，而 BasketballSkills 通过显式组合领域专用工具显著胜出。
Motivation: 现有基准大多一次性只评估篮球理解中的某一项能力（如事件识别、动作定位、球员识别或结构化知识关联），这些能力之间的交互关系未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 BasketballBench 基准，并设计 BasketballSkills 代理：该代理在四个可复用技能（指定工具顺序、证据绑定和停止条件）下组合八种篮球专用感知与检索工具，以完成综合理解任务。
Result: 当前 MLLM 在需要多能力整合的问题上表现尤其困难，而 BasketballSkills 在基准上优于这些模型，表明显式组合领域专用能力的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将领域专用能力进行显式组合是迈向全面篮球理解的有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy
papers.abstract_en: Accurate organ-at-risk segmentation is essential for radiotherapy planning, but reviewing segmentations is time-consuming and subjective. We investigate normative modelling for segmentation error detection in head-and-neck CT, comparing a VAE framework with an image-conditioned segmentation diffusion model. Models were evaluated on RADCURE brainstem and spinal cord segmentations using simulated boundary and width perturbations. Error detection was assessed using the Dice similarity coefficient and the Distance to Agreement (DTA) between the input and reconstructed segmentations. While both models detected some simulated errors, regional DTA showed that the diffusion model localised subtle boundary errors more consistently. These results support image-conditioned diffusion reconstruction as a promising framework for localised, anatomy-aware segmentation QA.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向放疗计划中危及器官 (organ-at-risk, OAR) 分割的质量保证，比较了 VAE 框架与图像条件分割扩散模型 (image-conditioned segmentation diffusion model) 在头颈部 CT 分割错误检测上的表现。模型在 RADCURE 的脑干和脊髓分割上，通过模拟边界扰动和宽度扰动进行评估，并用 Dice 相似系数和 Distance to Agreement (DTA) 衡量输入与重建分割之间的误差。结果显示扩散模型在区域性 DTA 上能更一致地定位细微边界错误，作者认为图像条件扩散重建是有前景的局部、解剖感知分割 QA 框架。
Motivation: 准确的分割对放疗计划至关重要，但人工审查分割结果耗时且主观，因此需要自动化的分割错误检测方法。
Method: 将 VAE 框架与图像条件分割扩散模型进行对比，使用模拟边界与宽度扰动生成错误分割，并通过 Dice 和 DTA 评估输入与重建分割之间的一致性来检测误差。
Result: 两种模型都能检测部分模拟错误，但基于区域 DTA，扩散模型在局部化细微边界错误方面更稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为图像条件扩散重建是局部化、解剖感知的分割质量保证 (segmentation QA) 的有前景框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChebBooster: A Training-Free Approach for Efficient Diffusion Transformer Inference via Chebyshev-Inspired Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have shown strong performance in high-fidelity image generation, but their sampling process remains computationally intensive due to full model execution at every timestep. While cache-based acceleration has been explored to mitigate inference cost, naive reuse schemes suffer from low accuracy over long intervals, and Taylor-series-based extrapolation methods often face instability caused by Runge oscillations. In this paper, we propose ChebBooster, a training-free extrapolation framework based on Chebyshev polynomial theory that achieves stable and efficient acceleration for DiTs. Specifically, we adopt the Barycentric formulation to evaluate Chebyshev approximants with high numerical stability and minimal overhead, and further decouple the extrapolation into an offline weight precomputation phase and a lightweight online application stage. Extensive experiments across three representative DiT-based models, including DiT-XL/2, PixArt-$Σ$, and FLUX.1-dev, demonstrate that ChebBooster achieves consistent improvements in visual quality and inference efficiency, reaching up to $3.68\times$ latency speedup and $5.12\times$ FLOPs reduction, outperforming existing training-free baselines under diverse generation tasks and resolutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChebBooster，一种基于 Chebyshev 多项式理论的无训练外推框架，用于加速扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的图像生成推理。该方法使用 Barycentric 公式实现高数值稳定性的 Chebyshev 近似，并将外推过程分解为离线权重预计算与轻量在线应用两个阶段。在 DiT-XL/2、PixArt-Σ 和 FLUX.1-dev 上，ChebBooster 达到最高 3.68× 延迟加速和 5.12× FLOPs 减少，且在视觉质量和推理效率上优于现有无训练基线。
Motivation: DiT 在每个时间步都执行完整模型，采样过程计算开销大。已有的缓存加速方案在长时间间隔上精度低，而基于 Taylor 级数的外推方法常因 Runge 振荡而不稳定，需要一种稳定且高效的无训练加速方案。
Method: 提出 ChebBooster，基于 Chebyshev 多项式理论构建外推框架；采用 Barycentric 公式评估 Chebyshev 逼近器以获得高数值稳定性并保持极小开销；将外推解耦为离线权重预计算和轻量在线应用两个阶段。
Result: 在 DiT-XL/2、PixArt-Σ 和 FLUX.1-dev 三个代表性 DiT 模型上，ChebBooster 在不同生成任务和分辨率下均取得一致的视觉质量和推理效率提升，达到最高 3.68× 延迟加速与 5.12× FLOPs 减少，优于现有无训练基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Chebyshev 多项式外推能够以无训练方式实现 DiT 的稳定高效推理加速，并指出该方法在多种 DiT 架构上具有泛化性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exploring Long-period Architectures: Four New Planet Candidates from Kepler with Periods >342 days
papers.abstract_en: The Kepler detection pipeline, as well as the transit method, has a bias towards shorter periods, leaving a dearth of detections at longer orbital periods. This relative lack of detections has left an incomplete picture of the architectures of exoplanet systems within the long-period regime. We have built a single transit detection pipeline, utilizing a classification convolutional neural network and the onboard spacecraft diagnostics of the Kepler spacecraft, to detect long-period planets. We apply our pipeline to all currently known planetary systems in the Kepler field hosting at least one planet with an orbital period longer than 6 days. We manually vet all new signals from our pipeline, and identify four new planetary candidates, all of which are in systems where the inner planets exhibit transit timing variations (TTVs). Two of these candidates, Kepler 1752.02 and Kepler 199.03, cause two transit events that are consistent with periods of $777.78^{+0.01}_{-0.02}$ and $505.495^{+0.004}_{-0.004}$ days, and radii of $3.55^{+0.15}_{-0.15}$ and $2.74^{+0.05}_{-0.05}$ $R_{\oplus}$, respectively. Our remaining two candidates, Kepler 1897.02 and Kepler 1811.02, are single transit candidates with radii $4.81^{+0.20}_{-0.19}$ and $3.25^{+0.28}_{-0.30}$ $R_{\oplus}$, respectively. The shortest orbital periods for these candidates, consistent with the Kepler dataset (gaps and coverage), are 342 days for Kepler 1897.02 and 544 days for Kepler 1811.02. The new planetary candidates, on their own, are incapable of reproducing the observed TTV signals in the inner system. Although difficult to schedule, follow-up observations are needed to further constrain the new candidates and potentially discover the planets causing the perturbations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Kepler 探测管线对长周期行星的系统性偏置，构建了一个基于分类卷积神经网络 (CNN) 和 Kepler 航天器在轨诊断数据的单次凌星 (single transit) 探测管线，并将其应用于所有含至少一颗周期大于 6 天行星的 Kepler 已知行星系统。通过人工审查所有新信号，作者识别出四个新的行星候选体，其中两个由两次凌星事件给出约 777.78 天和 505.495 天的周期，另外两个为单次凌星候选体，并指出这四个候选体本身无法解释内系统观测到的凌星时间变化 (TTV)。
Motivation: Kepler 探测管线及凌星法本身偏向短周期，导致长轨道周期区间的系外行星系统结构图像不完整。
Method: 构建单一凌星探测管线，使用分类卷积神经网络与 Kepler 飞船在轨诊断数据来识别长周期行星；将该管线应用于 Kepler 天区中所有已知含至少一颗周期大于 6 天行星的系统，并对所有新信号进行人工核查。
Result: 识别出四个新行星候选体：Kepler 1752.02 与 Kepler 199.03 各产生两次凌星事件，周期分别为 777.78 天和 505.495 天，半径分别为 3.55 和 2.74 个地球半径；Kepler 1897.02 与 Kepler 1811.02 为单次凌星候选体，半径分别为 4.81 和 3.25 个地球半径，与 Kepler 数据覆盖一致的最短可能周期分别为 342 天和 544 天。
Conclusion: 这四个新候选体单独无法重现内系统观测到的 TTV 信号；作者指出虽然观测安排困难，但后续跟踪观测仍然必要，以进一步约束新候选体并寻找造成扰动的行星。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-access specification, a creator must discover behavior-relevant requirements omitted by the brief and determine how broadly each source-derived procedure is justified. We propose SkillAlchemy, an admission-centered framework for source-grounded skill creation. SkillAlchemy identifies implicit requirements through contrastive evidence, admits candidate procedures based on evidence-supported scope, and compiles the admitted content into a grammar-guided skill package. Extensive experiments across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks demonstrate that SkillAlchemy improves pass rate over no-skill execution by 19.9 percentage points and the strongest automated baseline by 8.6 percentage points, while achieving performance comparable to human-curated skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放世界中的技能创建问题：给定模糊的技能简报和源访问规范，创建者需发现简报遗漏的与行为相关的需求，并判断每个源派生流程的适用范围。作者提出 SkillAlchemy，一个以准入为中心 (admission-centered) 的源接地技能创建框架，通过对比证据识别隐含需求、基于证据支持的适用范围准入候选流程，并将准入内容编译为语法引导的技能包。在 87 个 SkillsBench v1.1 任务上的实验表明，SkillAlchemy 相比无技能执行将通过率提高 19.9 个百分点，比最强自动化基线提高 8.6 个百分点，并达到与人工精选技能相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有技能创建依赖人类作者、模型先验或执行轨迹，而这些来源在不熟悉的任务上常常不可用，因此需要从开放世界材料中创建技能。
Method: 提出 SkillAlchemy 框架，包含三步：通过对比证据 (contrastive evidence) 识别简报中隐含的需求；根据证据支持的适用范围准入候选流程；将准入内容编译成语法引导的技能包 (grammar-guided skill package)。
Result: 在 87 个 SkillsBench v1.1 任务上，SkillAlchemy 将通过率相对无技能执行提升 19.9 个百分点，相对最强自动化基线提升 8.6 个百分点，性能与人工精选技能相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调源接地的准入式流程能从开放世界材料中创建可靠技能，并达到接近人工水平的表现。

papers.title: The Axiomatic Trader: Latent Regularity, Information Budgets, and the Canonical Form of a Quantitative Investment System
papers.abstract_en: Systematic trading rests on one article of faith: that regularities found in the past persist. We state it as a time-invariant mechanism driven by an unobserved latent state, and show that it leaves a researcher five constants to declare --- the recurrence bound $Lambda$ at a block length $b$, the invariance defect $epsilon_0$ of the representation it is declared of, the coherence times $ell_i$ of the state's coordinates, the signal ceiling $rho$ and the fraction $kappa$ of it contingent on the regime --- after which the architecture of a correct quantitative investment system is nearly forced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量化投资系统的公理化框架，将“过去规律持续”这一系统化交易的基本信念形式化为由未观测潜状态驱动的时间不变机制。作者认为研究者需要声明五个常数——块长 b 上的递归界 Λ、表示的不变性缺陷 ε0、状态坐标的相干时间 ℓ_i、信号上限 ρ 以及其中依赖于体制的比例 κ——之后正确量化投资系统的架构几乎被强制决定。摘要未包含实验或数据验证。
Motivation: 系统化交易依赖于历史规律在未来持续存在的假设，但该假设缺乏清晰的形式化表述。论文旨在明确：要使该信念成立，研究者需要声明哪些基本常数，从而推导出系统架构的约束。
Method: 将规律持续性建模为随时间不变、由潜状态驱动的机制，并给出五个必须由研究者声明的常数：递归界及块长、表示的不变性缺陷、状态坐标的相干时间、信号上限及其对体制依赖的比例。基于这些声明，系统的正確架构被推导为近乎唯一的形式。
Conclusion: 摘要的要点是：一旦声明这五个常数，正确量化投资系统的架构几乎被强制确定，即系统设计自由度被实质性压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Photorealistic novel view synthesis of people remains challenging at high spatial resolutions and across multiple target cameras, where preserving identity, fine appearance details, and geometric coherence is critical. We build on the next-scale autoregressive paradigm and adapt it for human-centric view synthesis by enabling higher image resolutions, multi-view outputs and stronger cross-view consistency in a single forward pass. We train on a synthetic dataset of human faces spanning diverse identities and apparel. Contrary to diffusion models, this paradigm does not need 2D pre-training and, thanks to its next-scale architecture, it benefits from lower-resolution, general-purpose pre-trainings, with the full-sized purpose-specific images being used only in the last training stages. This enables our architecture to converge with a smaller amount of purpose-specific training data, allowing us to use a smaller but more realistic training dataset. The resulting model produces sharp and realistic views, with the option to synthesize multiple novel viewpoints simultaneously for improved agreement across views. Empirically, we observe gains in perceptual fidelity and cross-view coherence on human subjects, demonstrating that next-scale autoregression is an effective backbone for scalable, multi-output human view synthesis. We also couple our pipeline with an existing transformer-based model for pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting from multi-view facial inputs, resulting in accurate and photorealistic 3D models of human faces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 next-scale 自回归范式改进人脸新视角合成，通过支持更高分辨率、多视角输出和更强的跨视角一致性，在单一前向传播中生成多个新视角。方法在包含多样身份与服饰的合成人脸数据集上训练，不需要 2D 预训练，可利用低分辨率通用预训练并在最后阶段才使用全尺寸特定图像，从而减少专用训练数据量。实验观察到感知保真度和跨视角一致性的提升，并可与现有 transformer 像素对齐 3D 高斯提升模型结合，重建准确逼真的人脸 3D 模型。
Motivation: 高空间分辨率和多目标相机条件下的人物新视角合成仍具挑战，保持身份、精细外观细节和几何一致性是关键难点；扩散模型依赖 2D 预训练且需要大量专用数据。
Method: 扩展 next-scale 自回归范式到以人为中心的视图合成，支持高分辨率、多视角输出及更强跨视角一致性；在合成人脸数据集上训练，借助低分辨率通用预训练，仅最后训练阶段使用全尺寸专用图像；并与 transformer-based 像素对齐 3D 高斯提升 (pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting) 模型耦合。
Result: 摘要报告在人类主体上获得感知保真度和跨视角一致性的提升，能生成清晰逼真的视图，并可同时合成多个新视角来改善视角间一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 next-scale 自回归是可扩展的多输出人类视图合成的有效骨干，结合 3D 高斯提升可获得准确逼真的人脸 3D 模型。

papers.title: MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon planning is critical for safe autonomous driving in complex scenarios. Existing methods improve planning continuity with temporal memory, but such memory may become invalid and mislead decisions when the driving command changes. Thus, selectively leveraging useful history while suppressing command-inconsistent memory remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose MomADv2, a reliable state-space memory framework for long-horizon end-to-end autonomous driving. At its core, MomADv2 introduces a Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module, which filters historical planning queries based on temporal continuity and command consistency, selects planning modes relevant to the current command, and models the evolution of planning intentions through a selective state-space mechanism. To further alleviate local trajectory deviations and error accumulation in long-horizon planning, we design a Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner. It learns a continuous residual correction field from the refined planning output to the expert trajectory, enabling fine-grained trajectory refinement while preserving the stability of anchor-based planning. Extensive experiments on closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, as well as open-loop nuScenes, demonstrate that MomADv2 improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 15.6% over MomAD under 6-second planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MomADv2 提出一种面向长时程端到端自动驾驶规划的状态空间记忆框架，核心是选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块（Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module），按时间连续性与命令一致性过滤历史规划查询，并结合流匹配轨迹残差精修器（Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner）修正局部轨迹偏差。闭环实验在 NAVSIM 和 Bench2Drive 上进行，开环实验在 nuScenes 上进行，摘要报告在 6 秒规划下相比 MomAD 将平均碰撞率降低 15.6%。
Motivation: 现有方法用时间记忆 (temporal memory) 改善规划连续性，但当驾驶命令改变时，历史记忆可能失效并误导决策，因此需要选择性地利用有用历史并抑制与当前命令不一致的记忆。
Method: 提出 MomADv2，包含两个组件：一是基于状态空间的选择性规划记忆查询模块，按时间连续性和命令一致性过滤历史规划查询、选取与当前命令相关的规划模式，并通过选择性状态空间机制建模规划意图演化；二是流匹配轨迹残差精修器，学习从精修规划输出到专家轨迹的连续残差修正场，在保持基于锚点规划的稳定性同时实现细粒度轨迹修正。
Result: 在闭环 NAVSIM 与 Bench2Drive、开环 nuScenes 上的实验表明，MomADv2 提升长时程规划一致性，并在 6 秒规划下将平均碰撞率较 MomAD 降低 15.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过将历史信息筛选、命令一致性约束与状态空间建模结合，形成可靠的时间记忆可以改善长时程端到端自动驾驶规划的一致性与安全性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Item-based Collaborative Structures via Noise Rescheduling in Diffusion for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Discrete Diffusion Models (DDMs) have recently been introduced to recommendation systems, modeling user history as a token generation process via iterative denoising. However, while effective at capturing user-level sequential patterns, these methods often fail to explicitly integrate item-based collaborative filtering information, a critical component for accurate recommendation. This deficiency manifests in two key aspects: (1) the item representation is often semantic-focused, lacking collaborative priors for diffusion training; and (2) the denoising process employs a uniform noise schedule, treating all tokens indiscriminately and ignoring item-level adaptive structural dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose ANR-DiffRec, a unified framework designed to encode item-based collaborative structures into discrete diffusion for generative recommendation. First, we explicitly incorporate an item co-occurrence matrix to guide semantic ID generation, providing a structured collaborative prior for discrete diffusion training. Second, we introduce an item-based adaptive noise rescheduling mechanism that dynamically adjusts denoising weights according to both local contextual recoverability and behavior-aware item dependencies. Specifically, the proposed strategy jointly models intra-item structural context and inter-item collaborative signals, enabling structure-aware denoising during diffusion training. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommendation models. Code: https://github.com/CalmaQi/ANR-DiffRec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ANR-DiffRec，一个将物品级协同结构编码进离散扩散模型（discrete diffusion model）的生成式推荐框架。方法用物品共现矩阵提供结构化协同先验，并设计基于物品的自适应噪声重调度机制，在多个基准上一致优于现有生成式推荐模型。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散推荐模型主要建模用户级序列模式，缺少显式的基于物品的协同过滤信息，表现为物品表示缺乏协同先验、去噪过程采用统一噪声调度而忽略物品级自适应结构依赖。
Method: 提出 ANR-DiffRec：一方面显式引入物品共现矩阵引导语义 ID 生成，为离散扩散训练提供结构化协同先验；另一方面提出基于物品的自适应噪声重调度机制，依据局部上下文可恢复性与行为感知的物品依赖动态调整去噪权重，联合建模物品内结构上下文和物品间协同信号。
Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法一致优于最先进的生成式推荐模型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将物品协同结构显式整合进离散扩散训练可以提升生成式推荐的准确性，并已公开代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Interactive clinical agents must gather decisive evidence and convert it into grounded actions under partial observability. A correct final diagnosis alone does not show that an agent respected evidence and care-process constraints. We introduce MediSkill-Evo, a clinical agent that evolves governed process knowledge without backbone fine-tuning. It separates experience into four typed banks for clinical skills, process rules, symbolic schemas, and measurement procedures. Provenance, support, replay, and controller-defined safety checks govern publication to a frozen test-time snapshot. A Process-Constrained Preference Harness binds evidence to its source, rejects controller-invalid candidates, and ranks actions with a safety-prioritized Clinical Process Critic. We evaluate complete agent systems across two backbone endpoints and six controlled stress dimensions under the same Doctor-turn limit. On 300 held-out Qwen encounters, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy from 61.33 percent to 69.00 percent and treatment-intent coverage from 33.62 percent to 66.44 percent, while reducing automatically scored critical failures from 31.00 percent to 16.33 percent relative to AgentClinic. On 180 hard-isolation conditions derived from 30 cases, target recovery reaches 93.61 percent under patient-behavior pressure, 100.00 percent for temporal evidence, and 92.22 percent for triage red flags. An exploratory 100-case MedSAM comparison evaluates request-gated tool-interface feasibility. These results provide descriptive end-to-end evidence for the complete system on fixed evaluation suites, not causal evidence for an individual bank or clinical validation of the automatic judge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MediSkill-Evo，一个在部分可观测条件下进行证据落地临床交互的智能体。它不微调主干模型，而是通过四种类型的经验库（临床技能、过程规则、符号模式、测量程序）自演化，并用出处、支持、回放和控制器安全检查约束其发布。在 300 例 Qwen 对话中，诊断准确率从 61.33% 提升到 69.00%，治疗意图覆盖率从 33.62% 提升到 66.44%，自动评分的严重失败率从 31.00% 降至 16.33%（相对 AgentClinic）。作者强调这是固定评测集上的描述性端到端证据，而非对单个经验库的因果证据或自动评估器的临床验证。
Motivation: 交互式临床智能体必须在不完全可观测条件下收集关键证据并将其转化为有依据的行动，但仅正确的最终诊断并不能说明智能体是否遵守了证据与照护过程约束。
Method: MediSkill-Evo 在不进行主干微调的前提下演化受治理的过程知识，将经验分为临床技能、过程规则、符号模式和测量程序四类经验库，并通过出处、支持、回放及控制器定义的安全检查控制发布；同时使用 Process-Constrained Preference Harness 将证据绑定到来源、拒绝控制器无效候选，并由安全优先的 Clinical Process Critic 对动作排序。
Result: 在 300 例 Qwen 对话中，诊断准确率从 61.33% 提升到 69.00%，治疗意图覆盖率从 33.62% 提升到 66.44%，严重失败率从 31.00% 降至 16.33%。在由 30 例病例衍生的 180 个困难隔离条件下，患者行为压力下目标恢复率达 93.61%，时间证据下为 100.00%，分诊红旗下为 92.22%；另有 100 例 MedSAM 的探索性比较用于评估请求门控工具接口可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这些结果为完整系统在固定评测集上提供了描述性端到端证据，但不构成对单个经验库的因果证据，也不能视为自动评估器的临床验证。

papers.title: Right-Sizing LLM-Agent Decomposition in VAT Determination: A Pilot Controlled Sweep
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLM-agent systems make conflicting design bets: decompose work across many narrow agents, or use one strong tool-using agent. This pilot studies that choice on bounded cross-border VAT determination with reverse charge, where every case has an oracle label and each intermediate decision is independently scoreable. We hold the activity surface fixed (subtasks, tools, I/O schemas, validation checks, orchestrator, base model, and merge policy) and vary only the assignment of subtasks to workers across four orchestrated configurations, from one wide worker to five narrow ones, against S0, a tuned no-orchestrator single agent, with a deterministic rule engine as oracle. The program spans 4,400 runs: a 40-case, five-repeat main sweep, matched-token arms separating prompt-budget from agent-count effects, and three failure-injection arms, all judged against pre-registered falsification criteria. The two intermediate configurations lead on accuracy (0.830, against endpoints at 0.720 and 0.770) but miss the pre-stated bar against the fine endpoint, so the intermediate-optimum hypothesis remains unsupported at pilot scale. The single agent does not Pareto-dominate the orchestrated set. The matched-token criterion fires: the budget-matched single agent lands 6.5 points below the leader, but the interval includes zero, so any advantage is consistent with a prompt-budget explanation. Under injection, availability faults are absorbed at every granularity, with wide-scope restart over-recovering its baseline by +0.160, while one schema-conforming hallucinated record degrades every configuration and inverts the ordering, hitting fragmented configurations hardest. The contribution is a bounded, preregistered pilot heuristic for right-sizing decomposition (place one partition boundary at the dependency-layer midpoint), released with oracle, dataset, harness, raw traces, and analysis pipeline.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 4 figures. Code, data, and traces: https://github.com/pedro-santos-eng/Right-sizing-LLM-agent-decomposition-in-VAT-determination
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究LLM-agent任务分解的粒度选择：在跨境增值税（VAT）认定任务中，固定子任务、工具、I/O模式、校验、编排器、基座模型和合并策略，仅改变子任务到worker的分配，比较一个宽worker到五个窄worker的四种编排配置，以及无编排的单agent基线S0。实验共4,400次运行，两个中间配置准确率最高（0.830，端点为0.720和0.770），但未达到预先设定的阈值，因此中间最优假设在试点规模下不成立；单agent并未Pareto支配编排集合。
Motivation: 现有LLM-agent系统在“拆分为多个窄agent”与“单个强工具使用agent”之间做出相互冲突的设计选择，缺乏在可逐项计分且有oracle标签的任务上的受控证据来指导分解粒度。
Method: 将活动表面（子任务、工具、I/O schemas、校验、编排器、基座模型和合并策略）保持不变，仅改变子任务到worker的分配，设置四种编排配置与S0基线，并以确定性规则引擎作为oracle。实验包含40案例五次重复的主扫描、匹配token臂以区分提示预算与agent数量效应，以及三种故障注入臂，全部依据预注册的证伪标准评判。

papers.title: KellyBoost: Growth-Optimal Portfolio Construction with Gradient-Boosted Trees
papers.abstract_en: KellyBoost is a single multi-output XGBoost model whose softmax output is the portfolio: with y the vector of per-asset holding-period returns, the training loss is - log(1 + w y), the negative log growth rate, so the fitted model is the growth-optimal (Kelly) allocation conditioned on the features. The objective is exact rather than a surrogate: we derive the gradient, the analytic diagonal Hessian and the full Hessian in closed form, verify them by finite differences, and ship a dependency-free reference engine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KellyBoost 是一个单多输出 XGBoost 模型，其 softmax 输出直接作为资产配置权重，训练损失定义为负对数增长率 -log(1 + w·y)，从而拟合给定特征条件下的增长最优（Kelly）配置。摘要报告作者推导了该精确目标的梯度、解析对角 Hessian 和完整 Hessian 的闭式形式，用有限差分验证，并发布了无依赖的参考实现。
Motivation: 针对增长最优（Kelly）投资组合构建，作者希望直接优化精确的复合增长率目标，而不是使用代理损失，从而得到条件于特征的增长最优配置。
Method: 使用单多输出 XGBoost，softmax 输出即投资组合权重 w；以 y 为各类资产持有期收益向量，训练损失为 -log(1 + w·y)。作者推导了该损失的梯度、解析对角 Hessian 和完整 Hessian 闭式表达式，并用有限差分验证正确性，附带无依赖的参考引擎实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该目标是精确而非代理，并通过闭式梯度和 Hessian 以及发布的参考引擎支持该训练框架的实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity
papers.abstract_en: User representation learning in real-world industrial scenarios is commonly scaled by increasing user amount, behavioral sequence length and model size. However, existing methods face two challenges: (i) Bottleneck for raw data scaling at billion-scale capacity, as performance exhibit diminishing performance gains with larger-scale raw text user behavioral input, which can be mitigated by tokenization. (ii) Lack of quantitative analysis of how tokenization configurations should scale with data size. In this report, we propose User Behavioral Densing Law for characterizing the quantitative relationship between data scale and the minimum sufficient tokenization capacity. Firstly, we conduct a pilot study on raw & tokenized scaling comparison on billion-scale Alipay dataset, revealing the raw data scaling bottleneck and the sustained gains enabled by tokenization. To derive the scaling pattern governing the minimum sufficient tokenization configuration at different data scales, theoretical analysis and systematic experiments are employed to summarize the quantitative scaling pattern. We find an approximately linear relationship between the logarithms of minimum sufficient tokenization capacity and input data size measured by tokens, and the scaling slope varies systematically with the tokenization method and data source, reflecting differences in representation-space redundancy and intra-source uniqueness. Guided by the proposed law, we further develop ALGN, an adaptive variable-length tokenization method that improves capacity allocation. Extensive experiments across diverse data sources, tokenization methods, and downstream tasks demonstrate the generalizability and reliability of the User Behavioral Densing Law, providing practical guidance for tokenization configuration selection in large-scale user representation learning. Moreover, ALGN outperforms existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用户行为稠密化定律（User Behavioral Densing Law），刻画数据规模与最小充分分词容量（minimum sufficient tokenization capacity）之间的定量关系。作者在亿级支付宝数据集上进行原始输入与分词输入的扩展性对比，发现原始数据扩展存在瓶颈而分词化能带来持续收益；进一步通过理论分析与系统实验总结出最小充分分词容量与以 token 计的数据规模在对数尺度上近似线性。基于该定律提出自适应变长分词方法 ALGN，并在多种数据源、分词方法和下游任务上验证其泛化性与有效性。
Motivation: 现有用户表征学习通过增加用户量、行为序列长度和模型规模来扩展，但在亿级容量下原始文本行为输入的扩展收益递减，且缺乏关于分词配置如何随数据规模扩展的定量分析。
Method: 首先在亿级支付宝数据集上进行原始与分词化的扩展对比实验，识别原始数据扩展瓶颈；随后通过理论分析与系统实验推导最小充分分词配置随数据规模的变化规律，提出 User Behavioral Densing Law；并据此设计自适应变长分词方法 ALGN，优化容量分配。
Result: 研究发现最小充分分词容量与以 token 计量的输入数据规模的对数之间近似线性，且斜率随分词方法和数据源系统变化，反映表征空间冗余与源内独特性差异。ALGN 在不同数据源、分词方法和下游任务上优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该定律为大规模用户表征学习中的分词配置选择提供了实用指导，ALGN 可改善容量分配；但摘要未讨论明显的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Domain, Multi-Task Data-to-Text Generation without In-Domain Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Structured data exists in many forms (tables, knowledge graphs, charts, and time series), and converting it into text may involve different generation tasks. However, most prior work on data-to-text (D2T) generation has focused on specific tasks and datasets, relying either on task-specific training data or on the zero-shot capabilities of large language models. We study cross-domain D2T generation in a setting where neither in-domain training text nor test references are available, and where domains, generation goals, and input structures vary substantially. We compare data-driven knowledge distillation (DDKD) against zero-shot inference and fine-tuning on out-of-domain D2T data, and introduce structure-preserving augmentation via structural subsampling and perturbation. Experiments on five benchmarks show that, at constant model size (1.7B parameters), DDKD consistently outperforms both fine-tuning and zero-shot inference. Moreover, the resulting small models outperform a much larger finetuned model on two of the five domains, achieving comparable performance on the remaining three. We further construct QUINTD-5, a fivefold extension of QUINTD-1, and show that simply scaling real target-domain inputs yields only modest gains, whereas our augmentation strategy remains more effective and more cost-efficient for cross-domain distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在无领域内训练文本和测试参考、且各领域与生成目标差异较大的设定下的跨域数据到文本 (data-to-text, D2T) 生成，比较数据驱动的知识蒸馏 (DDKD)、零样本推理和在域外 D2T 数据上的微调，并提出基于结构子采样和扰动的结构保持增强方法。五个基准上的实验表明，在固定 1.7B 参数规模下 DDKD 一致优于微调和零样本推理，所得小模型在两个领域超过更大的微调模型，其余三个领域表现相当。作者还构建了 QUINTD-5 数据集，发现仅扩展真实目标域输入的收益有限，而所提增强策略在跨域蒸馏中更有效且成本更低。
Motivation: 以往 D2T 生成研究大多依赖任务特定训练数据或大语言模型的零样本能力，缺少对无领域内训练文本、无测试参考且领域和输入结构差异大的跨域多任务设定的系统研究。
Method: 对比数据驱动的知识蒸馏 (DDKD)、零样本推理和利用域外 D2T 数据微调三种方案，并引入结构保持增强 (structure-preserving augmentation)，通过结构子采样 (structural subsampling) 和扰动 (perturbation) 对训练数据进行增强。
Result: 在五个基准上，固定 1.7B 参数规模时 DDKD 一致优于微调和零样本推理；蒸馏得到的较小模型在两个域上超过更大的微调模型，并在其余三个域取得可比性能。此外，构建五倍扩展的 QUINTD-5 后，仅扩展真实目标域输入只带来少量增益，而增强策略更有效且更节省成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构保持增强是跨域 D2T 蒸馏中比简单扩展目标域输入更有效且成本更低的途径，并表明较小模型在部分领域可以超越更大微调模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-lingual Biography Enrichment via Claim Extraction and Alignment
papers.abstract_en: English Wikipedia is often treated as the default encyclopedic source, yet non-English Wikipedia editions can contain richer locally grounded information for long-tail figures. We study cross-lingual biography enrichment: enriching an existing English biography with facts supported by a non-English biography about the same person. Focusing on women from non-English-speaking contexts, we introduce \textsc{CLAW-4L}, a benchmark consisting of 300 Wikipedia biography pairs linking an English biography with its French, Chinese or Azerbaijani counterpart, along with claim annotations and a fine-grained claim-pair relation corpus. We propose a claim-based enrichment framework that extracts English claims from both biographies, aligns them to identify enrichment evidence from the non-English biography, and rewrites the English biography using the selected claims. Our results show that non-English Wikipedia biographies provide valuable evidence for improving English biography coverage, while lower-resource settings remain challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨语言传记增强（cross-lingual biography enrichment）：利用同一人物在非英语维基百科中的传记事实来扩充英语传记。作者构建了 CLAW-4L 基准，包含 300 对英语-法语/中文/阿塞拜疆语传记配对及细粒度声明对关系标注，并提出基于声明（claim）的框架：从双语传记中抽取声明、对齐以识别非英语侧的证据、再用选中的声明重写英语传记。摘要报告非英语传记能有效提升英语传记覆盖度，但低资源语种设置仍具挑战。
Motivation: 英语维基百科常被当作默认百科来源，但非英语版本对长尾人物可能包含更丰富、更贴近当地背景的事实；尤其对非英语语境的女性人物，这些信息尚未被系统性用于弥补英语传记的空白。
Method: 提出 CLAW-4L 基准（300 对英语与法语、中文、阿塞拜疆语传记配对，含声明标注和细粒度声明对关系语料），并设计基于声明的增强框架：分别抽取两种语言传记中的英语声明，通过对齐识别来自非英语传记的补充证据，最后用选中的声明重写英语传记。
Result: 结果表明非英语维基百科传记能为提升英语传记覆盖度提供有价值的证据，同时摘要指出低资源环境（lower-resource settings）下的表现仍然困难。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨语言声明抽取与对齐可用于传记增强，但低资源语种仍是主要瓶颈；该工作的适用范围限定在拥有跨语言对应传记的人物。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 结果表明非英语维基百科传记能为提升英语传记覆盖度提供有价值的证据，同时摘要指出低资源环境（lower-resource settings）下的表现仍然困难。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为跨语言声明抽取与对齐可用于传记增强，但低资源语种仍是主要瓶颈；该工作的适用范围限定在拥有跨语言对应传记的人物。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Video generation is progressing beyond isolated clips toward long-form narratives and interactive worlds, requiring models to preserve identities, follow user controls, and remain stable over extended rollouts. We present JoyAI-Echo-1.5, a unified audio-visual generation system with two purpose-built variants. The long-video variant introduces composable cross-shot memory that aggregates visual evidence across multiple prior shots and speaker cues derived from speech-filtered full-shot audio, enabling persistent character appearance and voice identity across flexible combinations of text, image, and memory conditioning. The world-model variant converts heterogeneous navigation inputs into calibrated metric 6-DoF camera trajectories and injects them through a geometry-aware conditioning pathway, enabling controller-agnostic interaction across flexible viewpoints. To support efficient long-horizon generation, we transform a bidirectional audio-visual backbone into a causal few-step generator using progressive teacher forcing and short- and long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing on self-generated rollouts. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in both settings. JoyAI-Echo-1.5 achieves improvements over existing long-video baselines in cross-shot consistency, visual quality, text alignment, and speech fidelity. Its world-model variant ranks first on WBench, with an average score of 81.7, and achieves leading visual quality and long-horizon persistence on SANA-WM-Bench. Together, these results indicate that memory, geometric control, and rollout-aware training provide a practical foundation for generating coherent stories and continuously evolving interactive worlds. Project page: https://echo-team-joy-future-academy-jd.github.io/Echo-1.5-Page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 JoyAI-Echo-1.5，一个统一的音视频生成系统，包含长视频与世界模型两个变体。长视频变体通过可组合的跨镜头记忆 (composable cross-shot memory) 和基于语音过滤音频的说话人线索，保持角色外观与语音身份在多镜头中的一致；世界模型变体将异构导航输入转换为标定的度量 6-DoF 相机轨迹，并通过几何感知条件路径支持灵活视点交互。训练上将双向音视频骨干改造为因果少步生成器，使用 progressive teacher forcing 与短/长时程 Self-Gradient Forcing。实验表明其在长视频基准上提升跨镜头一致性、视觉质量、文本对齐与语音保真度，世界模型变体在 WBench 上以平均分 81.7 排名第一。
Motivation: 视频生成正从孤立片段走向长叙事和交互世界，这要求模型在长时间 rollout 中保持身份一致、遵循用户控制并保持稳定，而现有模型难以同时满足这些需求。
Method: 长视频变体提出 composable cross-shot memory，聚合多个先前镜头的视觉证据，并结合从 speech-filtered full-shot audio 提取的说话人线索，支持文本、图像与记忆条件的灵活组合。世界模型变体将异构导航输入转换为标定的度量 6-DoF 相机轨迹，通过 geometry-aware conditioning pathway 注入，实现与控制器无关的视点交互。训练方面，作者将双向音视频骨干转换为因果少步生成器，并采用 progressive teacher forcing 以及基于自生成轨迹的 short- 和 long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing。
Result: 长视频变体在跨镜头一致性、视觉质量、文本对齐和语音保真度上优于现有长视频基线。世界模型变体在 WBench 上排名第一，平均得分 81.7，并在 SANA-WM-Bench 上取得领先的视觉质量和长时程持久性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为记忆、几何控制与 rollout-aware training 为生成连贯故事和持续演化的交互世界提供了实用基础。摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Spectrum-Aware Bounds on Invertibility for Privacy-Enhancing Instance Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Instance encoding is a popular empirical technique for privacy enhancement when sharing data to an untrusted server. It transforms sensitive data through an encoding process before sharing, with the hope that the encoding process retains utility but makes it hard to reconstruct the original data. However, most work offers no theoretical guarantee that the encoding process is actually irreversible. A recent work derived a mean-squared error (MSE) bound limiting any adversary's reconstruction accuracy, offering one of the first theoretical results in this domain. This bound, however, has three critical limitations: it is often too loose, only works with randomized encoders (excluding many deterministic encoders practitioners use), and only bounds MSE. We introduce a family of new bounds that (1) are tighter, (2) applicable even to fully deterministic encoders, and (3) can extend beyond MSE to other norm-based similarity metrics, by properly accounting for the encoder's spectral structure. We evaluate our bounds across a range of encoders, datasets, and attacks, showing they hold consistently and improve upon the existing bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究隐私增强的实例编码（instance encoding）的可逆性理论保证。作者指出现有 MSE 界存在三个局限，提出一类基于编码器谱结构的新界，声称其更紧、适用于完全确定性的编码器，并能推广到其他基于范数的相似度度量。实验覆盖多种编码器、数据集与攻击，结果显示新界一致成立且优于既有界。
Motivation: 实例编码在共享数据时普遍缺乏编码不可逆性的理论保证。既有 MSE 界太松、只适用于随机编码器、且只限 MSE，无法覆盖实践中常用的确定性编码器，因此需要更通用且更紧的重建精度理论上界。
Method: 通过合理刻画编码器的谱结构（spectral structure），推导出一族新的可逆性界，用于限制任意对手的重建精度；该族界不依赖随机性，并可扩展到 MSE 之外的范数相似度指标。
Result: 在多种编码器、数据集和攻击设置下评估，新界始终成立，且在紧度上优于已有的 MSE 界；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式考虑编码器的谱结构可以显著改进对实例编码不可逆性的理论刻画，并扩展了该领域此前极为有限的理论结果。

papers.title: Adversarial Entropy Inflation Against Gumbel-Based Inference Verification
papers.abstract_en: Gumbel-based inference verification bounds LLM weight exfiltration by only forgiving token choices that plausibly arise from honest GPU nondeterminism, reporting a >200x slowdown for a steganographic adversary under benign prompt traffic. This bound assumes a passive attacker; we show it degrades sharply against an adversary who instead controls the prompt distribution. Because the verifier's admissible-token-set size is driven by the model's own output entropy, prompts engineered to break grammatical and sub-word structure -- rather than benign conversational traffic -- widen that set and open a materially larger covert channel. Across six instruction-tuned models spanning 1B to 32B parameters and three random seeds, our strongest attack (character- and script-level disruption) roughly doubles bits leaked per token relative to benign prompts, cutting the slowdown factor to 60x - 118x. These results indicate that static, benign-traffic-calibrated thresholds are insufficient for this defense, and that jitter-forgiveness thresholds should instead be calibrated dynamically against local token entropy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究针对基于Gumbel的推理验证（Gumbel-based inference verification）的对抗性熵膨胀攻击。该验证机制通过只容忍看似源于GPU非确定性的token选择来限制LLM权重窃取（weight exfiltration），在良性提示流量下报告对隐写攻击者造成>200倍减速。作者表明该防御在攻击者主动控制提示分布时严重退化：通过破坏语法和子词结构的提示可扩大验证器的可接受token集合，从而打开更大的隐蔽信道。在六个1B到32B参数的指令微调模型和三个随机种子上的最强攻击（字符与脚本级扰动）大致使每token泄露比特数翻倍，并将减速因子降至60x-118x。
Motivation: 现有Gumbel推理验证防御假设攻击者是被动的，并使用良性对话流量校准其阈值；作者指出当攻击者转而控制提示分布时，这一假设不再成立，防御的有效性会急剧下降。
Method: 提出对抗性熵膨胀攻击：通过设计打破语法和子词结构的提示（字符级和脚本级扰动）提升模型输出熵，从而扩大验证器中可接受token集合的规模，增大隐蔽信道容量。
Result: 在六个指令微调模型（1B-32B）和三个随机种子上的实验表明，最强攻击相对良性提示约使每token泄露比特数翻倍，将验证机制报告的减速因子从>200x降低到60x-118x。
Conclusion: 静态的、基于良性流量校准的阈值不足以支撑该防御；抖动宽恕阈值（jitter-forgiveness thresholds）应根据局部token熵进行动态校准。

papers.title: Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Stream Attention (DSA)，一个用于 12 周前瞻 ILI（流感样疾病）预测的多模态深度学习框架，输入为 36 周的多模态历史数据，让数值与文本（新闻标题）两条流相互调节。摘要报告在 Time-MMD 健康领域数据集上，DSA 的中位测试 MSE 为 0.416，显著低于 iTransformer、TaTS 和 GPT4MTS 等基线，并在外部地理数据集上同样排名第一。消融与扰动式忠实度分析表明，双向跨模态注意力优于任一单向方向，且收益不依赖文本编码器选择或语言模型微调。
Motivation: 长程 ILI 预测对公共卫生准备很重要，但公开监测数据通常将数值流行病学信号与噪声大、结构松散、相对滞后且与短期趋势间接相关的文本信息配对，因此两类模态的融合需要精心设计。
Method: DSA 用基于 Transformer 的数值编码器和领域适配的标题编码器分别编码两种模态，再通过双向 Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) 机制使文本（新闻标题）调节数值信号解释、数值信号亦调节文本解释；CMA 输出随后送入因果时序模型进行预测。
Result: 在十个随机种子下，DSA 的中位测试 MSE 为 0.416，对比 iTransformer 的 0.668、TaTS 的 0.607 和 GPT4MTS 的 0.851，对应平均误差降低 54.95%、37.29% 和 67.23%，配对 Cohen's d 分别为 0.555、0.337 和 0.345，且在 100% 的 bootstrap 抽样中排名第一；其最差窗口误差也远低于所有基线。外部地理数据集上 DSA 在九个基线中再次排名第一；消融显示双向注意力优于任一单向方向，且文本到数值方向在目标掩码下的影响更强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数值流与文本流应相互条件化，双向跨模态注意力机制在长程 ILI 预测中具有功能性的信息增益，且该优势不依赖于文本编码器选择或语言模型微调。

papers.title: Walking on the DARKSIDE
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) recognise patterns but do not natively track the path of exclusions that a coherent discourse demands. When an input rests on a fabricated authority, a misapplied mechanism, or a surreptitious analogy, an unsteered LLM tends to engage with it as if it were grounded, and to reify the misstep into any structured output it generates. Logic-Augmented Generation (LAG) with POLANYI++, an LLM-steering method that uses heuristics, ontologies and problem solving methods for tacit knowledge extraction, produces an Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) in OWL2, but inherits the same vulnerability: a sophisticated nonsensical input is reified into the graph alongside the legitimate triples, and is hardly detectable by automated reasoners since the XKG is generated jointly with the wrong assumptions. We introduce DARKSIDE, a coherence auditing method on top of POLANYI++. It formalises the trail as an explicit data structure of accumulated exclusions over discourse time, complemented by a warrant axis that classifies each named referent as Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed or Fabricated, with an escalation rule that pushes the DelegationRiskAssessment to UNSAFE when the fabricated rate is positive or the unsupported rate exceeds a threshold. We evaluate DARKSIDE as a steering layer over a Gemini 3 on BSBench, a 100-item adversarial corpus of sophisticated-sounding nonsense across software engineering, finance, healthcare, physics and law, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 as an independent judge. The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 在结构化输出中会把看似合理但实质荒谬的输入一并实体化 (reify) 的问题，提出 DARKSIDE，一种叠加在 POLANYI++ 之上的连贯性审计 (coherence auditing) 方法。它把话语时间上的排除轨迹形式化为显式数据结构，并用 warrant 轴将指称对象分为 Warranted、Unattested、Misattributed、Fabricated 四类，配合升级规则将 DelegationRiskAssessment 推向 UNSAFE。作者在 Gemini 3 上以 BSBench 对抗语料评估，并用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 作独立裁判，声称实验证据支持本体中介的负向轨迹装置能部分弥补 LLM 的 pattern-vs-path 差距。
Motivation: LLM 擅长识别模式但不原生追踪连贯话语所需的排除路径，未加引导的模型会把基于虚假权威、误用机制或隐蔽类比的输入当作有根据的内容，并在生成的结构化输出中固化该错误；逻辑增强生成 (LAG) 与 POLANYI++ 生成的 Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) 继承了这一脆弱性，使复杂无意义的输入与合法三元组一起被实体化，且难以被自动推理机检测。
Method: 提出 DARKSIDE，在 POLANYI++ 之上运行的连贯性审计方法：将排除轨迹形式化为随话语时间累积的显式数据结构，并加入 warrant 轴对每个命名指称进行分类 (Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed, Fabricated)；当 Fabricated 率为正或 Unsupported 率超过阈值时，升级规则把 DelegationRiskAssessment 置为 UNSAFE。评估采用 BSBench 这一含 100 个条目的对抗语料，覆盖软件工程、金融、医疗、物理和法律领域。
Result: 摘要报告，将 LLM 前向传播包裹在本体中介的负向轨迹装置中，能部分支撑起模式与路径之间的结构性差距，即 XKG 充当缺失的记忆，warrant 轴充当认知防火墙；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为经验证据支持其架构性主张：本体中介的负向轨迹审计层可部分缓解 LLM 在结构化生成中对精致伪装的荒谬输入不加区分的问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual deepfake detection is an actively studied topic, where one of the main challenges is to develop detectors able to generalize across deepfake generation methods. We conjecture that overfitting can be mitigated by extracting multiple high-level cues from the available audio and visual modalities via pre-trained models. We therefore assemble a wide variety of pre-trained models to extract features that encode mouth movements, face parsing, facial expressions, head pose, gaze tracking, heart rate, audio emotion and speech activity. We further integrate both unimodal and multimodal cues via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone to detect deepfakes. We perform in-domain and cross-domain experiments on five benchmarks for deepfake detection (MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb) to compare our framework (DF-MoE) with state-of-the-art methods. Our results indicate that DF-MoE obtains superior deepfake detection results, surpassing all competing methods. We release our code at https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DF-MoE，一个基于多模态稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 的音频-视觉深度伪造检测框架。作者用多种预训练模型提取嘴部运动、人脸解析、面部表情、头部姿态、视线跟踪、心率、音频情感和语音活动等特征，并在统一 MoE 主干中融合单模态与多模态线索。在 MAVOS-DD、AVLips、PolyGlotFake、BioDeepAV、FakeAVCeleb 五个基准上的域内与跨域实验中，DF-MoE 超越了所有对比方法。
Motivation: 音频-视觉深度伪造检测的主要挑战是跨生成方法的泛化；作者推测过拟合可以通过从音频和视觉模态中提取多个高层线索来缓解。
Method: 收集多种预训练模型提取嘴部运动、人脸解析、面部表情、头部姿态、视线跟踪、心率、音频情感和语音活动等特征，并通过 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 主干集成单模态与多模态线索进行检测。
Result: 在五个基准（MAVOS-DD、AVLips、PolyGlotFake、BioDeepAV、FakeAVCeleb）上的域内和跨域实验中，DF-MoE 获得优于所有对比方法的深度伪造检测结果。
Conclusion: 摘要认为多模态稀疏 MoE 与预训练特征相结合可以提升深度伪造检测的泛化能力；作者公开代码 https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate watch-time (WT) prediction is an important requirement for short-video recommendations. Yet WT distributions are near-zero-inflated, long-tailed and multimodal. The recent Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network (EGMN) models the full conditional WT distribution rather than a single point estimate and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our large-scale reproduction study reveals that EGMN is vulnerable to variance collapse, component redundancy, and inactive components. We propose a Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture (HEGM) model that addresses these failure modes through a hierarchical skip-watch decomposition, KL-based variance regularization, structured initialization, removing the forced Gaussian shift and the entropy regularizer. Across public and large-scale industrial datasets, HEGM improves ranking accuracy and threshold-event prediction, while maintaining competitive point-estimation accuracy and substantially improving mixture stability and interpretability. A 1.5-month production A/B test confirms statistically significant engagement lifts. Our code and models are publicly released at https://github.com/rw404/HEGM.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对短视频推荐中的观看时长 (watch-time) 分布预测问题，指出 Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network (EGMN) 在大规模复现中存在方差坍塌、分量冗余和无效分量等缺陷，并提出层次化指数-高斯混合模型 (HEGM)。HEGM 通过层次化跳过观看分解、KL 方差正则化、结构化初始化等方式，在公开与工业数据集上提升排序精度和阈值事件预测，同时保持有竞争力的点估计精度，并显著改善混合模型的稳定性与可解释性。1.5 个月的生产 A/B 测试确认了参与度的统计显著提升。
Motivation: 观看时长分布接近零膨胀、长尾且多模态，EGMN 虽建模完整条件分布并达到最优性能，但大规模复现研究发现其易出现方差坍塌、分量冗余和无效分量，影响预测稳定性与可解释性。
Method: 提出 Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture (HEGM) 模型，通过层次化 skip-watch 分解、基于 KL 散度的方差正则化、结构化初始化来缓解上述失败模式，并移除强制高斯偏移与熵正则器。
Result: 在公开数据集和大规模工业数据集上，HEGM 优于 EGMN 的排序准确率与阈值事件预测，同时保持有竞争力的点估计精度并显著提升混合模型的稳定性和可解释性；1.5 个月的生产 A/B 测试显示参与度显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HEGM 能有效解决 EGMN 的方差坍塌、分量冗余和无效分量问题，代码与模型已公开；摘要未明确讨论本文的局限性。

papers.title: OptiSight: Bridging Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Control for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous indoor navigation requires both semantic understanding and precise geometric control. We propose OptiSight, a hybrid framework that combines Vision-Language Model reasoning with deterministic visual servoing through a finite-state Chain-of-Thought architecture. Grounded-SAM localizes open-vocabulary targets, while camera projection geometry converts visual observations into navigation commands without requiring dense mapping. The VLM is queried only at key decision points, reducing computational overhead while geometric control handles continuous navigation. Experiments in AI Habitat demonstrate reliable zero-shot navigation across diverse indoor scenarios, including obstacle avoidance and semantic ambiguity, while operating within an 8~GB VRAM budget. The source code is available at https://github.com/avanalperen/OptiSight-Python-Multimodal-CoT-for-Visual-Reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptiSight，一个面向室内具身导航 (embodied navigation) 的混合框架，将视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的语义推理与确定性视觉伺服 (visual servoing) 结合，并通过有限状态 Chain-of-Thought 架构组织。Grounded-SAM 用于开放词汇目标定位，相机投影几何将视觉观测转换为导航指令，无需稠密建图；VLM 仅在关键决策点被查询以降低计算开销。AI Habitat 实验表明，该方法可在 8GB VRAM 预算内实现多样室内场景的零样本导航，包括避障与语义歧义场景。
Motivation: 自主室内导航既需要语义理解又需要精确的几何控制，现有方法往往依赖稠密建图或频繁调用大模型，计算开销高。
Method: 提出 OptiSight 混合框架：用 Grounded-SAM 做开放词汇目标定位，用相机投影几何把视觉观测直接转为导航命令，并以有限状态 Chain-of-Thought 架构安排决策，仅在关键决策点查询 VLM，连续导航由几何控制完成。
Result: 在 AI Habitat 中的实验显示，该方法能在多种室内场景下实现零样本导航，支持避障与语义歧义处理，且运行在 8GB VRAM 预算内。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合 VLM 稀疏查询与确定性几何控制可以在降低计算开销的同时保持零样本导航能力，并已开源代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond chlorophyll: machine learning estimates of diagnostic phytoplankton pigments from multispectral ocean colour data
papers.abstract_en: Phytoplankton play a central role in marine ecosystems and the global carbon cycle, with different groups contributing differently to ocean biogeochemical processes. While standard techniques exist for monitoring phytoplankton concentration from ocean-colour data, their community composition remains difficult to observe at large scales. Chlorophyll-a, widely available from satellite ocean-colour observations, is commonly used as a measure of phytoplankton biomass but provides limited information on taxonomic composition. Accessory pigments, some of which are diagnostic of important phytoplankton groups, offer additional information on community structure, but their retrieval from ocean-colour data is challenging because of limited spectral resolution and strong covariance with chlorophyll-a. In this study, we evaluate machine learning methods for estimating diagnostic pigment concentrations from multispectral satellite observations. Using a global dataset of 33,640 High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) measurements matched with ESA Ocean Colour Climate Change Initiative (OC-CCI) reflectance data, we compare Random Forest and TabPFN models trained on multispectral reflectance with baseline models using chlorophyll-a alone. A temporally stratified validation scheme is employed to reduce the effects of autocorrelation. Results show that multispectral models consistently outperform approaches based solely on satellite-derived chlorophyll-a, demonstrating that ocean-colour reflectance contains additional information relevant to pigment discrimination. Improvements vary by pigment, with those strongly correlated with chlorophyll-a showing limited gains, while others exhibit substantial improvement. These findings highlight the potential of machine learning to extract ecologically relevant information from satellite data beyond conventional chlorophyll-based approaches.
papers.comment: Submitted to Frontiers of Marine Science. 21 pages, 8 Figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估用机器学习从多光谱卫星海洋水色数据估计诊断性浮游植物色素浓度的方法。基于33,640条高效液相色谱（HPLC）现场测量与ESA Ocean Colour Climate Change Initiative（OC-CCI）反射率数据的匹配数据集，比较了Random Forest和TabPFN模型与仅使用叶绿素-a的基线模型。结果表明多光谱模型一致优于仅依赖卫星叶绿素-a的方法，说明反射率中含有超出叶绿素信息的色素判别信号。
Motivation: 浮游植物群落组成在大尺度上难以观测，叶绿素-a虽广泛可得但只能反映总生物量，对分类学组成信息有限；辅助色素可指示重要浮游植物类群，但从水色数据中反演受光谱分辨率不足和与叶绿素-a强共线性制约。
Method: 使用全球HPLC测量与OC-CCI多光谱反射率匹配的数据集，训练Random Forest和TabPFN模型估计诊断色素浓度，并以仅用叶绿素-a的模型为基线；采用时间分层验证（temporally stratified validation）以降低自相关影响。
Result: 多光谱模型在所有色素上一致优于仅用卫星叶绿素-a的基线；改进幅度因色素而异，与叶绿素-a强相关的色素增益有限，其他色素则有显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调机器学习能够从卫星多光谱水色数据中提取超出传统叶绿素方法的生态学相关信息，但指出不同色素的改善程度并不一致。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文评估用机器学习从多光谱卫星海洋水色数据估计诊断性浮游植物色素浓度的方法。基于33,640条高效液相色谱（HPLC）现场测量与ESA Ocean Colour Climate Change Initiative（OC-CCI）反射率数据的匹配数据集，比较了Random Forest和TabPFN模型与仅使用叶绿素-a的基线模型。结果表明多光谱模型一致优于仅依赖卫星叶绿素-a的方法，说明反射率中含有超出叶绿素信息的色素判别信号。

summary_sections.result: 多光谱模型在所有色素上一致优于仅用卫星叶绿素-a的基线；改进幅度因色素而异，与叶绿素-a强相关的色素增益有限，其他色素则有显著提升。

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation for ECG Classification via SQI-Gated Self-Training and Beat-Rhythm Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for electrocardiogram (ECG) classification often suffer from significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen domains due to shifts in acquisition devices and patient populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical solution by adapting models using only unlabeled data at inference time. However, existing TTA methods often underperform on ECG tasks, since naive online updates ignore the hierarchical beat-rhythm structure of cardiac cycles and are vulnerable to signal artifacts, which leads to unstable adaptation and model drift. We propose BeatRhythm-TTA, an ECG-tailored TTA framework that explicitly accounts for ECG's noisy observations and structured beat-rhythm semantics under domain shift. First, to handle pervasive ECG artifacts, we introduce a Signal Quality Index (SQI)-gated adaptation scheme that selectively filters out low-quality signals to prevent harmful updates. Second, to leverage ECG's beat-rhythm semantics, we enforce dual-level consistency so the model preserves beat morphology and rhythm dynamics while adapting to shifted acquisition conditions. Extensive experiments on multi-label ECG diagnosis across three adaptation protocols, using PTB-XL as the source domain and CPSC2018/Georgia as two target domains, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, yielding an average +2.70% relative improvement in Macro-F1 over the best competing method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BeatRhythm-TTA，一个面向心电图的测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation, TTA) 框架，针对临床部署中采集设备和人群分布改变导致的域偏移，显式建模 ECG 的噪声观测与 beat-rhythm 结构。方法包含基于信号质量指数 (Signal Quality Index, SQI) 的门控自适应，以及保留心跳形态和节律动力学的双层级一致性约束。摘要报告在 PTB-XL 作为源域、CPSC2018/Georgia 作为目标域的多标签 ECG 诊断实验中，相比最佳对比方法平均提升 +2.70% 相对 Macro-F1。论文已被 MICCAI 2026 录用。
Motivation: ECG 分类模型在未知域部署时因采集设备和患者人群的分布偏移而性能显著下降；现有 TTA 方法在 ECG 任务上表现不佳，因为朴素在线更新忽略心动周期的层级 beat-rhythm 结构，且易受信号伪影影响，导致自适应不稳定和模型漂移。
Method: 提出 SQI 门控的自适应方案，选择性地过滤低质量信号以避免有害更新；同时施加双层级一致性约束，使模型在适应新采集条件的过程中保持 beat 形态和节律动态。
Result: 在多标签 ECG 诊断、三种自适应协议下，以 PTB-XL 为源域、CPSC2018 和 Georgia 为目标域的实验中，该方法相比最佳对比方法取得平均 +2.70% 的相对 Macro-F1 提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，显式考虑 ECG 的噪声观测和结构化 beat-rhythm 语义的 TTA 框架，可以缓解域偏移下的不稳定自适应和模型漂移问题。

papers.title: Towards Actionable Surgical Team Dynamics: from Teamwork to Counterfactual Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Modeling team interactions in high-stakes environments such as operating rooms is critical for understanding how coordination, communication, and individual behaviors shape team performance and safety outcomes. Existing datasets in this domain are often fragmented across modalities, annotation schemes, and formats, limiting their ability to support integrated analyses of real-world collaborative processes. We address this limitation by introducing an extended multimodal dataset for surgical team interaction analysis, built from real operating room recordings. Starting from an existing corpus, we construct an analysis-ready version of the data by providing speaker diarization, transcripts, and multi-level annotations capturing team performance, interaction processes, and individual characteristics. Team performance is assessed using a standardized surgical teamwork evaluation protocol, while interaction quality and individual attributes are annotated through structured rating schemes covering collaboration, group dynamics, and non-technical skills. To further support the study of coordination breakdowns and performance variability, we introduce counterfactual annotations that describe plausible alternative team outcomes in the presence of observed interaction failures, enabling analysis of how specific behavioral patterns may relate to different trajectories of team performance. In addition, we provide structured temporal and relational representations designed to support computational modeling of teamwork processes and the design of AI-assisted collaborative systems. The dataset is designed to support the study of how individual actions, interaction patterns, and team-level processes jointly contribute to team outcomes in surgical settings, providing a unified resource for analyzing collaborative behavior in high-stakes domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个面向手术室团队交互分析的多模态数据集扩展版本。作者基于现有语料，提供说话人分离 (speaker diarization)、转写文本以及团队表现、交互过程和个人特征的多层级标注，并引入描述交互失败时可能出现的替代团队结果的反事实标注。数据集以统一资源形式支持对高压力场景中团队协作的计算建模与 AI 辅助协作系统设计。
Motivation: 现有手术团队交互数据在模态、标注方案和格式上碎片化，难以支撑对真实协作过程的整合分析，限制了团队表现与安全结果的研究。
Method: 基于真实手术室录音的现有语料构建分析就绪版本：提供说话人分离、转写和多层级标注；团队表现采用标准化手术团队评估协议，交互质量与个人属性通过结构化评分方案标注；并新增反事实标注以及面向计算建模的时间与关系表示。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标；核心成果是提供了一个统一的多模态数据集，包含多层标注、反事实标注和结构化的时间与关系表示。
Conclusion: 数据集旨在支持研究个体行动、交互模式与团队层面过程如何共同影响手术环境中的团队结果，并为高压力领域中的 AI 辅助协作系统设计提供资源。

papers.title: Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: Image acquisition with a camera involves several degradations due to the optical system, sensor, or low-level processing steps. We address blind deblurring in professional photography: we aim to invert unknown isotropic blur without knowledge of the degradation kernel.For such inverse problems,where some high-frequency information is lost, it is challenging to use generative models to produce details that are both photo-realistic and faithful to the input. We propose SuperSharpen, a diffusion-based blind deblurring method offering explicit control over restoration strength through a blur measure. We compare two conditioning strategies: a ControlNet-style adapter on a frozen backbone, and full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Our experiments show that finetuning achieves better fidelity with fewer hallucinated details. We validate our approach on synthetic and real-world blur, demonstrating improved perceptual quality and controllable restoration strength.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向专业摄影中的盲去模糊问题，提出名为 SuperSharpen 的扩散模型方法，在未知各向同性模糊核的情形下恢复清晰图像，并通过对模糊度量 (blur measure) 的控制显式调节恢复强度。作者比较了两种条件化策略：在冻结骨干上的 ControlNet 风格适配器，以及对扩散先验的完全微调。实验表明完全微调在保真度上更好，幻觉细节更少，并在合成与真实模糊数据上验证了感知质量和可控恢复强度。
Motivation: 相机成像过程中的光学系统、传感器和低层处理会引入多种退化，其中盲去模糊需要在不清楚退化核的情况下逆转未知的各向同性模糊。对于这类丢失高频信息的逆问题，生成模型难以同时产生照片级真实且对输入忠实的结果，这是该工作要解决的核心难点。
Method: 提出 SuperSharpen，一种基于扩散模型的盲去模糊方法，通过模糊度量显式控制恢复强度。作者比较了两种条件化方式：在冻结扩散骨干上使用 ControlNet 风格的适配器，以及对扩散先验进行完全微调。
Result: 实验表明完全微调比适配器策略获得更好的保真度，并产生更少的幻觉细节；在合成和真实模糊数据上，该方法展现出改进的感知质量和可控的恢复强度。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在盲去模糊这类逆问题中，完全微调扩散先验比冻结骨干加适配器更有利于忠实恢复，同时通过模糊度量可以实现可控的去模糊强度。该工作发表为 6 页的 IEEE ICIP 2026 论文。

papers.title: The Emergence of Relevance Through Axiomatic Attention Patterns During LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: LoRA fine-tuning is standard for adapting LLMs to reranking, but it remains unclear where in the network task-specific relevance behavior is learned and what attention-level changes accompany that learning. Through ablation and attention experiments, we identify where LoRA attention updates to RankLLaMA improve performance and whether those gains coincide with interpretable relevance-oriented attention patterns such as lexical matching, rarity sensitivity, and query-document interaction. We find that given LoRA fine-tuned MLPs throughout the network, restricting LoRA attention updates to a compact mid-network region is sufficient for recovering over half of the performance gained by applying LoRA to all attention layers, and that omitting attention fine-tuning in this region hurts performance more than elsewhere in the network. Additionally, we show that regions where applying LoRA affects performance the most overlap with regions where fine-tuning increased attention to axiomatic IR features. Rarity sensitivity, document-query interaction, and several compositional features are highly correlated with gains in ranking performance. Our results support an interpretable, correlational account of how relevance-oriented behavior emerges during LoRA fine-tuning and point toward improved strategies for adapting rerankers.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings. 17 Pages. 25 Figures. 5 Tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LoRA 微调在将 LLM 适配为 reranker 时，任务相关的相关性行为究竟在网络的哪一部分被学习，以及对应的注意力层面变化。通过消融和注意力实验，作者定位 RankLLaMA 中 LoRA 注意力更新对性能的贡献，并检验这些提升是否伴随可解释的相关性导向注意力模式（如词法匹配、稀有度敏感性和 query-document 交互）。结果表明，一个紧凑的 mid-network 区域内的 LoRA 注意力更新即可恢复全部注意力层微调所获性能的一半以上，且性能收益最大的区域与注意力向公理化 IR 特征增强的区域高度重叠。
Motivation: LoRA 微调是适配 LLM 进行 reranking 的常用方法，但学界尚不清楚任务相关的相关性行为在网络何处被学习，也缺少对微调过程中注意力层面变化的分析。
Method: 通过对 LoRA 注意力更新进行逐区域消融（ablation）并配合注意力模式分析，识别 RankLLaMA 中 LoRA 注意力更新提升性能的位置，并检验这些区域是否产生词法匹配、稀有度敏感性、query-document 交互等可解释的相关性导向注意力特征。
Result: 在保持网络中 MLP 被 LoRA 微调的前提下，仅对紧凑的 mid-network 区域施加 LoRA 注意力更新即可恢复全注意力层微调的一半以上性能；省略该区域的注意力微调比省略其他区域伤害更大。性能收益最大的区域与微调后注意力增强的公理化 IR 特征区域重叠，稀有度敏感性、文档-查询交互及若干组合特征与排序性能提升高度相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持一种可解释的、相关性的（correlational）视角：相关性导向行为在 LoRA 微调中以注意力模式变化的形式涌现，并为改进 reranker 适配策略提供方向。
Relevance: 3
