papers.title: Can Coding Agents Build Robust Baselines? A Skill-Based Approach for Automating the Medical Imaging Model-Development Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Developing competitive deep learning baselines for medical imaging remains a highly iterative process requiring literature review, implementation, experimentation, and expert refinement. Existing automation approaches typically optimize isolated components, such as architecture search or hyperparameter tuning, rather than the complete baseline development process. We present an agentic AI Scientist workflow that combines literature-guided reasoning, automated code generation, and hypothesis-driven experimentation to generate competitive baseline models for medical imaging challenges. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks spanning segmentation, classification, and detection. Across all tasks, the Experimentation Pipeline consistently improves validation performance, achieving competitive leaderboard results, including 6th place on both PUMA tracks (15 teams) and 31st place on MILK10k (125 teams). On MIDOG25, the resulting model also demonstrates strong domain generalization across scanners, tumor types, and species. Using the same workflow across all challenges without task-specific redesign, we demonstrate that skill-based, literature-guided agentic workflows can substantially reduce the engineering effort required to develop competitive medical imaging baselines.

papers.title: IntentQA: Intent Question Answering in Videos by Cognitive Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding requires intelligent agents to transcend mere recognition of visual facts and comprehend the underlying intents behind human actions (often termed the "dark matter" of social intelligence). To bridge the gap between visual observation and intent reasoning, we introduce a novel task, IntentQA, and contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset specifically tailored for this purpose. However, recognizing that standard metrics may overestimate capabilities due to dataset biases, we go beyond simple accuracy to rigorously evaluate model robustness. We augment the benchmark by generating five distinct contrast sets via Large Language Models (LLMs) and introducing a "Contrast Performance Decline" metric. We propose the X-CaVIR (eXplainable Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning) framework, which leverages three types of "Cognitive Context" to enhance video analysis: i) Situational Context via a cross-modal Video Query Language (VQL) module, ii) Contrastive Context via a Contrastive Learning module, and iii) Commonsense Context via a Commonsense Reasoning module. Crucially, to overcome the opacity of traditional black-box models, we refine the integration of LLMs within X-CaVIR by employing a transparent pipeline that synergizes video captions with VQA model outputs. This approach not only improves performance by effectively utilizing rich commonsense knowledge but also renders the reasoning process explicitly interpretable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our components, the superiority of X-CaVIR over state-of-the-art baselines, and its stability against perturbations on the contrast sets.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出新任务 IntentQA 及配套的大规模视频问答数据集，目标是从视频中的视觉观察推理人类行为背后的意图。为应对数据集偏差导致指标虚高的问题，作者用大语言模型生成五种对比集，并提出“对比性能下降”指标来评估鲁棒性。提出 X-CaVIR 框架，利用情境上下文、对比上下文和常识上下文三种认知上下文，并通过透明流水线整合 LLM 与视频字幕、VQA 模型输出，使推理过程可解释。实验表明各组件有效，X-CaVIR 在基准上优于 SOTA 基线，并在对比集上保持稳定。
Motivation: 视频理解要求智能体超越对视觉事实的识别，理解人类行为背后的意图，这是社会智能中常被忽视的部分；现有 VideoQA 工作缺乏面向意图推理的数据集，也缺少对模型鲁棒性受数据集偏差影响的评估。
Method: 构建 IntentQA 数据集，并用大语言模型生成五种对比集，提出“对比性能下降”指标；提出 X-CaVIR 框架，包含跨模态 Video Query Language 模块（情境上下文）、对比学习模块（对比上下文）和常识推理模块（常识上下文），并以透明流水线将视频字幕与 VQA 输出结合来利用 LLM 的常识知识。
Result: 大量实验验证了各模块的有效性，X-CaVIR 在 IntentQA 上超过现有 SOTA 基线，并在对比集扰动下表现出稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者强调透明地整合 LLM 不仅能利用丰富常识提升性能，还能让推理过程显式可解释；结合对比集与性能下降指标，可以更严格地评测模型鲁棒性。

papers.title: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
papers.abstract_en: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. We also introduce VideoRover-Bench, a benchmark stratified by video duration and research difficulty. Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench show that our VideoRover-8B-RL achieves performance comparable to proprietary models in the direct-answer setting without tool use while outperforming larger open-source models equipped with the same tool suite. Ablation studies and training dynamics further validate the complementary roles of active video grounding, external retrieval, and long-horizon reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoRover，一个统一的视频深度研究 (Video Deep Research) 框架，用于开放世界视频问答；它迭代地协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索与网页浏览，使局部视频片段指导外部检索，检索证据再触发进一步的视频检查与验证。作者构建了自动化数据标注流程，得到 26K 条经过验证的 SFT 轨迹和 3K 条挑战性 RL 实例，并引入按视频时长与研究难度分层的基准 VideoRover-Bench。实验显示 VideoRover-8B-RL 在无工具使用的直接回答设置下能达到与专有模型相当的性能，同时优于配备相同工具套件的更大开源模型。
Motivation: 开放世界视频理解常常需要模型定位稀疏的视觉证据并获取视频及其参数化记忆中不存在的外部知识；然而主动时域感知 (Thinking-with-Videos) 与多步信息检索 (Deep Research) 两种能力通常是分开开发的，缺少一个统一框架来协同二者。
Method: 提出 VideoRover 框架，在给定视频-问题对后，利用每个工具结果选择下一步动作，形成循环闭环：局部的视频裁剪引导外部检索，检索到的证据再触发进一步的视频检查和验证；同时提出自动化数据构建流程，生成 SFT 轨迹与 RL 实例，并设计分层基准 VideoRover-Bench。
Result: 在 VideoDR 和 VideoRover-Bench 上的实验表明，VideoRover-8B-RL 在直接回答、不使用工具的设置下性能可与专有模型相媲美，并优于使用相同工具套件的更大开源模型；消融实验验证了主动视频定位、外部检索和长时序强化学习 (long-horizon reinforcement learning) 三者的互补作用。
Conclusion: 工作强调将视频定位、外部检索与长时序强化学习统一到单一框架中，可以显著提升开放世界视频智能体的研究能力；摘要未讨论具体的失败案例或局限。

papers.title: Mycelial Search: A Graph-Structured Metaheuristic for Continuous Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Continuous optimisation methods need to balance sharing information and maintaining alternative search directions. In this paper, we introduce Mycelial Search (Myco), a graph-structured metaheuristic designed around active tips, community-weighted flow, adaptive cord plasticity, and anchor-based injection. Candidate solutions form an evolving spatial graph in which a Louvain partition distinguishes within-community from cross-community information exchange. Adaptive cord plasticity subsequently modifies active tip-to-tip edges according to their alignment with the local flow. An anchor-based injection mechanism supplements the graph-driven tip dynamics. We evaluated Myco on the CEC 2022 single-objective bound-constrained benchmark suite at dimensions $D=10$ and $D=20$, using 30 independent runs per algorithm-function pair. The comparison includes eleven established optimisers from several search families. Myco reaches competitive results on selected functions across both dimensions. The ablation analysis further shows that community structure regulates the range of graph-based information exchange, whereas cord plasticity controls the persistence of local directional influence. These findings indicate that graph-structured local interaction can support continuous optimisation, while its effectiveness depends on landscape structure and information transfer across local search regions.
papers.comment: Submitted to "Expert Systems With Applications"; 18 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. To facilitate reproducibility, the Python implementation of Mycelial Search (Myco) is publicly available on [GitHub](https://github.com/dehshibi/Mycelia-Search)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mycelial Search (Myco)，一种图结构的元启发式算法，用于连续优化问题。候选解构成一个演化的空间图，通过 Louvain 分区区分社区内与跨社区的信息交换，自适应菌丝可塑性 (cord plasticity) 根据与局部流动的对齐程度修改活性尖端 (active tips) 之间的边，锚点注入 (anchor-based injection) 机制补充图驱动的尖端动力学。在 CEC 2022 单目标有界约束基准套件的 D=10 和 D=20 维度上，与 11 个既有优化器比较，Myco 在部分函数上取得有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: 连续优化方法需要在信息共享与维持备选搜索方向之间取得平衡，而现有方法在这两方面往往难以兼顾；本文旨在探索图结构的局部交互能否支持更有效的连续优化。
Method: 提出图结构元启发式算法 Myco，其核心组件包括活性尖端、社区加权流 (community-weighted flow)、自适应菌丝可塑性以及锚点注入；候选解形成演化空间图，Louvain 分区被用于区分社区内与跨社区信息交换，菌丝可塑性按边与局部流动的对齐程度动态调整尖端间连边。
Result: 在 CEC 2022 单目标有界约束基准套件上，于 D=10 和 D=20 维度下、每个算法-函数组合进行 30 次独立运行，并与来自多种搜索家族的 11 个已知优化器比较；Myco 在选定的函数上达到有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 消融分析显示，社区结构调节基于图的信息交换范围，而菌丝可塑性控制局部方向影响的持续性；作者据此认为图结构的局部交互可以支持连续优化，但其有效性依赖景观结构以及跨局部搜索区域的信息传递。

papers.title: Beyond Point Predictions: Uncertainty-Aware Satellite Poverty Mapping for Public Policy
papers.abstract_en: Despite their critical importance for policy and research, high-resolution poverty data remain limited across much of Africa. Machine learning (ML) with earth observation (EO) imagery has recently emerged as a way to supplement these data by predicting (i.e., estimating) poverty where it has not been directly measured. Yet to be used reliably, decision-makers and analysts need assurances that they will not be misled by the errors in these predictions. To meet this need, we develop an uncertainty-aware EO-ML method for poverty mapping based on simultaneous quantile regression and a novel form of conformal prediction. Using a spatiotemporal transformer trained on sequences of Landsat and nighttime-light images, we produce prediction intervals for neighborhood-level International Wealth Index estimates across Africa which are statistically guaranteed to achieve their desired coverage rates. While our method's point-prediction performance matches the state of the art, its prediction intervals are wider than might be expected given its high $R^2$ of $0.75$. However, other models of similar accuracy likely suffer from comparable uncertainty, pointing to an inherent limitation: even with its remarkably high explanatory power, EO-ML cannot naively be relied upon for policy-making, such as when designing poverty-targeting programs. To handle this challenge, we develop a procedure to efficiently allocate aid using both ground-truth surveys and model predictions while provably ensuring the risk of excluding eligible neighborhoods remains below a prespecified level. In simulations, this approach delivers substantially more aid per eligible recipient than other strategies, thereby demonstrating that EO-ML can indeed be a reliable supplement to traditional data sources---as long as methods
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非洲高分辨率贫困数据稀缺的问题，提出一种基于不确定性感知的地球观测-机器学习（EO-ML）贫困制图方法。作者使用同时分位数回归（simultaneous quantile regression）与一种新型 conformal prediction，在 Landsat 和夜间灯光影像序列上训练时空 Transformer，为非洲街区级 International Wealth Index 估计生成有统计覆盖率保证的预测区间。摘要指出，虽然点预测性能与最先进方法持平，R² 达 0.75，但预测区间比预期更宽，说明高解释力并不意味着可无保留地用于政策制定；为此还开发了结合实地调查与模型预测的援助分配程序，并证明能控制排除合格街区的风险。
Motivation: 非洲大部分地区缺乏高分辨率贫困数据，而基于 EO 影像的机器学习可用于填补未直接测量的地区，但决策者需要确信预测误差不会误导政策。
Method: 提出不确定性感知的 EO-ML 方法，结合同时分位数回归与新型 conformal prediction，使用在 Landsat 和夜间灯光影像序列上训练的时空 Transformer，生成街区级贫困估计的预测区间；并开发一种援助分配程序，利用实地调查和模型预测，同时保证排除合格街区风险低于预设水平。
Result: 摘要报告点预测性能与最先进方法相当，R² 为 0.75，但预测区间比高 R² 所暗示的更宽；模拟显示所提出的援助分配策略比其它策略向每个合格受助者提供更多援助。
Conclusion: 作者认为，即使 EO-ML 具有很高的解释力，也不能天真地依赖其进行扶贫政策设计；但通过不确定性感知方法和受控风险的援助分配程序，EO-ML 可以作为传统数据来源的可靠补充。

papers.title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hint-based reinforcement learning addresses reward sparsity in long-horizon agentic tasks by retaining a prefix of an expert trajectory before each rollout, letting the policy explore from a state closer to success. Its effectiveness hinges on the guidance depth: how much of the trajectory to keep. Existing methods treat this depth as a deterministic scalar. Scheduled approaches share one value across samples and ignore per-task heterogeneity; per-sample probing estimates it separately at the cost of extra rollouts. We find that useful guidance occupies a band of depths whose informativeness profile is approximately Gaussian around the band center, rather than concentrating at a single optimal point. We propose Agent-G$^2$, a Gaussian guidance framework that draws the depth per task from a Gaussian whose center and spread are estimated online from rollouts already collected for policy optimization, requiring no probe rollouts or learned depth predictor. The center combines a global baseline with per-cluster difficulty, and the spread tracks within-cluster variance. We evaluate Agent-G$^2$ on ALFWorld and WebShop on Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct. Agent-G$^2$ outperforms the strongest hint-based, hint-free, and Aux-RL baselines on ALFWorld by 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 points at under one-third the rollout cost of per-sample probing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent-G$^2$，一种把提示深度 (guidance depth) 建模为高斯分布的提示式强化学习 (hint-based RL) 框架。作者发现专家轨迹保留深度的有用信息并非集中在单一最优点，而是占据一个深度带，其信息量轮廓近似高斯。该方法直接从策略优化已收集的 rollout 中在线估计每个任务深度的中心与散布，无需额外探测 rollout 或学习深度预测器。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上以 Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct 评估，Agent-G$^2$ 在 ALFWorld 上超过最强 hint-based、hint-free 与 Aux-RL 基线，且 rollout 成本低于逐样本探测方法。
Motivation: 长周期 agentic 任务中奖励稀疏问题可通过提示式强化学习缓解，但 guidance depth（保留多少专家轨迹）的设定至关重要。现有方法把深度当作确定性标量：全局调度忽略任务间异质性，逐样本探测虽精确但需要额外 rollout，成本高。作者观察到有用指导信息沿深度呈近似高斯带分布，因此需要一种能刻画该分布、且不引入额外 rollout 开销的建模方式。
Method: Agent-G$^2$ 对每个任务从高斯分布中采样 guidance depth，其中心由全局基线与按簇难度 (per-cluster difficulty) 组合而成，方差则跟踪簇内方差 (within-cluster variance)。深度分布的中心与散布均从策略优化过程中已收集的 rollout 在线估计，不依赖探测 rollout 或学习式深度预测器。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct 进行评估：Agent-G$^2$ 在 ALFWorld 上超过最强的 hint-based、hint-free 和 Aux-RL 基线 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 个点，同时其 rollout 成本低于逐样本探测方法的三分之一。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，将 guidance depth 建模为高斯分布能够更好地捕捉 per-task 异构性，并以显著更低的 rollout 成本取得更强的提示式 RL 性能。摘要未讨论方法的具体适用范围或局限。

papers.title: Spicing up Genetic Netlist Generation with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Analog circuit topology synthesis remains challenging because useful designs occupy a tiny fraction of a combinatorial search space, and small structural changes can induce highly nonlinear changes in behavior. Evolutionary algorithms are attractive because they can optimize over discrete circuit topologies using only black-box evaluations, but they often require many SPICE simulations and may converge prematurely. We introduce LLM-SPICEMixer, a hybrid synthesis framework that augments genetic netlist generation with IGEL (Inspiration-Guided Evolution with LLMs), an LLM-based proposal operator. During search, IGEL prompts an LLM with high-performing circuits from the elite set and instructs it to generate a new SPICE netlist, which is then evaluated by SPICE and selected using the same reward mechanism as conventional genetic operators. Thus, the LLM contributes structured topology proposals while simulation remains the source of truth. We evaluate LLM-SPICEMixer on a challenging benchmark task: synthesizing transistor-level circuits that implement a discriminant function for Iris classification. Compared with the genetic framework without LLM guidance, LLM-SPICEMixer improves the median final training reward by 8.4% and the median validation-selected test reward by 8.8%. The best validation-selected circuit achieves 93.3% test accuracy at the nominal tt corner and 85.9% average test accuracy across 17 process, voltage, and temperature corners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-SPICEMixer，一个面向模拟电路拓扑综合的混合框架，用基于 LLM 的提议算子 IGEL（Inspiration-Guided Evolution with LLMs）增强遗传网表生成。搜索中 IGEL 以精英集中的高表现电路提示 LLM 生成新 SPICE 网表，再由 SPICE 评估并沿用与常规遗传算子相同的奖励机制进行选择，仿真仍作为最终判据。在实现 Iris 分类判别函数的晶体管级电路综合任务上，相较无 LLM 指导的遗传框架，中位最终训练奖励提升 8.4%，中位验证选择测试奖励提升 8.8%。
Motivation: 模拟电路拓扑综合困难，因为有用设计只占组合搜索空间的极小部分，且微小结构变化可能引起高度非线性的行为变化；进化算法虽可基于黑箱评估优化离散拓扑，但常需大量 SPICE 仿真并可能过早收敛。
Method: 提出混合综合框架 LLM-SPICEMixer，引入 LLM 提议算子 IGEL：在搜索过程中用精英集中的高表现电路提示 LLM，让其生成新的 SPICE 网表，生成的网表经 SPICE 评估后使用与常规遗传算子相同的奖励机制参与选择，仿真始终作为真实来源。
Result: 在 Iris 分类判别函数晶体管级电路综合基准上，相比无 LLM 指导的遗传框架，中位最终训练奖励提升 8.4%，中位验证选择测试奖励提升 8.8%；最佳验证选择电路在标称 tt 角取得 93.3% 测试准确率，在 17 个工艺、电压、温度角上的平均测试准确率为 85.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 LLM 能够贡献结构化拓扑提议，同时仿真保持为最终评判来源，从而改善遗传网表生成的综合效果。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. Each scenario includes a gold safety decision, evidence annotations, a safe-response policy, and counterfactual interventions. The three-probe protocol queries models with natural-response, evidencereporting, and counterfactual-response prompts, then scores them using an evidence-aware judge. Across eleven evaluated VLMs, natural severity accuracy ranges from 27.6% to 52.8%, relaxed diagnostic consistency from 6.1% to 29.3%, and unsafe-to-safe counterfactual transition success from 30.4% to 58.4%. These gaps show that the evaluated VLMs are not reliably safe for the right multimodal reason and motivate evaluation beyond refusal counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EviSafe，一个基于证据的视觉语言模型（VLM）安全评估框架，它同时考察自然用户可见行为、对文本与视觉证据的显式引用，以及对安全关键证据做反事实改变时的行为敏感性。框架实例化为 EviSafeBench，包含 1,181 个黄金图像-文本场景和 2,452 个针对性反事实变体，覆盖八个安全域和八类风险源，每场景配有黄金安全决策、证据标注、安全响应策略和反事实干预。三探针协议分别用自然响应、证据报告和反事实响应提示查询模型，并由证据感知裁判打分。在 11 个 VLM 上，自然严重度准确率、松弛诊断一致性和非安全到安全反事实转换成功率均偏低，说明现有评估仅看拒答数量不足。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 安全基准只评估最终响应（是否拒答、警告或顺从），无法判断模型是否因正确的多模态原因而安全。表面安全的响应可能源于关键词触发的拒答、漏掉视觉危险，或对良性敏感输入的过度拒答。
Method: 提出证据驱动的 EviSafe 框架及其实例化基准 EviSafeBench，每个场景包含黄金安全决策、证据标注、安全响应策略和反事实干预。采用三探针协议，分别使用自然响应、证据报告和反事实响应提示查询模型，并用证据感知裁判对模型输出打分。
Result: 在 11 个被评估的 VLM 上，自然严重度准确率介于 27.6% 到 52.8%，松弛诊断一致性介于 6.1% 到 29.3%，非安全到安全反事实转换成功率介于 30.4% 到 58.4%。
Conclusion: 这些差距表明被评估的 VLM 并非因正确的多模态原因而可靠地安全，推动安全评估应超越拒答次数统计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FIDES: A Concordance Protocol for LLM-Generated Trading Strategies
papers.abstract_en: An LLM asked for a trading strategy returns three artifacts at once: a natural-language rationale, an executable implementation, and once run, a track record. Whether these are the same object is rarely checked. We present FIDES, a measurement protocol that treats them as three views to be reconciled rather than one deliverable to be graded. Through dual delivery, a single model call returns both a natural-language strategy with an explicit claimed edge and a self-contained strategy(df) function. FIDES executes the code in a sandbox against a lag-one out-of-sample backtest and scores three concordance gaps: say to do, do to real, and say to result. On 8 liquid US ETFs across four models plus a two-stage elicitation arm, 40 strategies, 2023 to 2024 out-of-sample, three findings stand out. First, concordance does not predict profit: only 2 of 40 strategies beat buy-and-hold, and a plain sma(50,200) rule outperforms every model's mean Sharpe. Second, self-assessment is badly calibrated: 32 of 40 strategies claim to beat buy-and-hold and exactly one does. Third, swapping the language-code judge for a second model flips say to do on more than half of items. Injecting Close.shift(-1) drops do to real by 0.33 on average, while our runtime future-information probe fired on neither clean nor injected code. We frame FIDES as a protocol for measurement fidelity, not a claim about market performance.

papers.title: Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Fashion complementary image generation (CIG) aims to create garments that stylistically match a seed item based on user intent, making it a natural multimodal grounding problem where models must interpret language in visual context. Existing CIG benchmarks rely on rigid template prompts (e.g., "a photo of a skirt"), failing to reflect natural user queries and obscuring model behavior across levels of linguistic specificity. We introduce fashion complementary image generation with free-form instructions, a multimodal language-grounding setting where a model generates a compatible garment from a seed image and a natural-language instruction. To this end, we enrich three CIG benchmarks with low-, medium-, and high-specificity instructions generated by a vision-language model and validated by human annotators. We instantiate the task with StyleFlow, a Rectified Flow Matching model that jointly conditions on the seed image and instruction within a single multimodal transformer. Across image quality metrics, catalog-alignment analysis, ablations, and human evaluation, StyleFlow consistently produces instruction-aligned and stylistically coherent garments while reducing architectural complexity and inference cost relative to auxiliary-module approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自由形式指令下的时尚互补图像生成 (free-form instruction fashion complementary image generation) 任务，并构建了包含低、中、高三种语言具体性程度指令的基准。作者用 Rectified Flow Matching 实现 StyleFlow 模型，在单个多模态 Transformer 中联合条件于种子图像与自然语言指令。实验表明 StyleFlow 在图像质量、目录对齐分析和人工评估中都能生成与指令一致且风格协调的服装，同时相比辅助模块方法降低架构复杂度和推理成本。
Motivation: 现有 CIG 基准依赖固定模板提示（如 "a photo of a skirt"），无法反映用户的自然查询，也难以揭示模型在不同语言具体性层级下的行为表现。
Method: 用视觉语言模型为三个 CIG 基准生成低、中、高具体性的指令，并经过人工标注者验证；随后提出 StyleFlow，一个基于 Rectified Flow Matching 的模型，在单个多模态 Transformer 中联合编码种子图像与指令。
Result: 在图像质量指标、目录对齐分析、消融实验和人工评估中，StyleFlow 一致地生成与指令对齐且风格协调的服装，同时相比辅助模块方法降低架构复杂度和推理成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为自由形式指令设定能更自然地表征用户意图，且 StyleFlow 以更简化的架构实现了指令对齐的互补服装生成。

papers.title: Evaluating SAT Solver Metrics as Predictors of Human-Perceived Nonogram Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic solver effort is often assumed to align with perceived puzzle difficulty, but this assumption is rarely tested against human solving data. We evaluate this assumption for Nonograms, a popular logic puzzle similar to Sudoku in which numeric clues along each row and column determine a unique solution grid. We formulate Nonograms as a constraint satisfaction problem and solve them using existing SAT solvers. We then conduct a user study in which we collect data on both participant interactions and reported difficulty. We find that neither participants' reported difficulty nor their behavioural signals correlate meaningfully with SAT solver metrics; however, we find evidence that expertise moderates the relationship between solver metrics and reported difficulty. In this process, we uncover distinct, recurring solving strategies that indicate human preference for complex propagation, diverging from solver-measured complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验了算法求解器的工作量是否与人类感知的谜题难度一致，以 Nonograms 这一类似 Sudoku 的逻辑谜题作为对象。作者将 Nonograms 建模为约束满足问题并用现有 SAT 求解器求解，同时开展用户研究收集参与者的交互行为和自报难度。结果发现自报难度和行为信号与 SAT 求解器指标均无有意义的关联，但专业知识会调节二者关系；研究中还观察到人类会偏好复杂的传播策略，与求解器测得的复杂度相背离。
Motivation: 算法求解代价常被假定与人类感知难度一致，但这一假设很少用真实的人类求解数据检验；本文针对该假设在 Nonograms 谜题上的有效性进行实证评估。
Method: 将 Nonograms 形式化为约束满足问题，使用现有 SAT 求解器求解，并设计用户研究同时采集参与者的交互行为和自我报告的难度评级。
Result: 参与者的自报难度及行为信号与 SAT 求解器指标均未显示出有意义的显著相关；不过有证据表明专家水平会调节求解器指标与自报难度之间的关系。
Conclusion: 摘要认为算法求解工作量并不必然对应人类感知难度，且人类求解者会发展出与求解器复杂度度量不同的重复性策略，暗示需要更贴近人类认知的难度度量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测器（memory-based anomaly detectors）在稀疏训练污染下的表现，指出被选入记忆的 patch 会被当作正常参考，却未单独检查其几何稀有性是否值得信任。作者在固定表示和记忆预算下比较随机、medoid、local 与 global 覆盖率选择器，并提出 CLEANCON（一种 out-of-bag 跨图像支持门控）以改变候选图像资格。实验显示全局覆盖率会强烈过度代表稀疏污染，而 CLEANCON 能将最终记忆污染降至接近零并在全部 12 组匹配比较中提升类别宏平均 P-AP；但记忆污染程度并不能按 P-AP 对记忆排序。
Motivation: 记忆型异常检测器将训练 patch 存入记忆库并以此评分测试 patch，但缺乏对 patch 几何稀有性的安全验证，稀疏训练污染可能被当作正常参考，影响检测可靠性。
Method: 提出 CLEANCON，一种 out-of-bag 跨图像支持门控方法，在固定表示、绝对记忆大小、构建器和推理规则的前提下改变候选图像资格；同时系统比较随机、medoid、local 与 global 四种覆盖率选择器。
Result: 全局覆盖率选择会强烈过度代表稀疏污染；CLEANCON 将最终记忆污染降至约零，并在全部 12 组匹配比较中提升类别宏平均 P-AP。但沿保留率扫描时，污染最低的记忆并未取得最高 P-AP，性能随污染上升仍在改善。
Conclusion: 摘要强调记忆污染程度不能按 P-AP 对记忆进行排序，表明仅以污染最小化作为记忆选择标准并不充分。代码已公开。

papers.title: ADDA: a Modular Framework for Representing, Simulating and Assimilating Dynamics with End-to-end Differentiability
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) is an essential tool for prediction and understanding in the geosciences. DA combines simulation programs representing scientific knowledge with observations that constrain system dynamics, resulting in analyses and forecasts that incorporate both knowledge and data. DA tasks can be addressed with a diverse toolset, including variational, ensemble and learning-based methods. In particular, many recent works have proposed using automatic differentiation tools for variational, learning-based or hybrid methods. However, comprehensive comparisons across algorithms and dynamical systems remain challenging, due to the incompatibility of simulation and assimilation codes, inflexible handling of spatial and temporal discretizations, specialization of DA methods to specific simulations, and limited support for automatic differentiation and parallel computation in simulations. To address this challenge, we introduce Automatic Differentiation for Data Assimilation (ADDA), a software framework for defining and working with system states, simulations, observation schemes and DA methods. ADDA provides a powerful and flexible set of base classes for representing dynamical systems and observation operators, with support for collocated and staggered grids, unstructured meshes, Lagrangian state variables and irregular or continuous-time observations. Parallel processing and differentiability are first-class features, with support for batch axes and automatic differentiation throughout. ADDA is implemented in PyTorch library, but supports DA for JAX-based computation of dynamics and their gradients. To demonstrate its features, we further provide differentiable, ADDA-compatible implementations of 10 dynamical systems of various dimensionalities and scales, from which we design multiple illustrative DA examples. All of our code is publicly available at https://github.com/m-dml/ADDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADDA（Automatic Differentiation for Data Assimilation），一个用于表示、模拟和数据同化 (DA) 动力系统的模块化软件框架，以 PyTorch 实现并将端到端可微性作为核心特性。框架提供系统状态、仿真、观测算子和 DA 方法的基础类，支持共位/交错网格、非结构网格、拉格朗日状态变量以及不规则或连续时间观测，并支持批处理轴和全程自动微分。作者还提供了 10 个 ADDA 兼容的可微动力学系统实现，并基于它们设计了多个数据同化示例。
Motivation: 现有数据同化工具面临模拟与同化代码不兼容、时空离散化处理不灵活、DA 方法高度特化于特定仿真、缺乏自动微分与并行支持等问题，导致跨算法和跨动力系统的全面比较困难。
Method: ADDA 定义了一组灵活的基础类来统一表示动力系统和观测算子，涵盖多种网格类型与观测形式，并将并行处理与自动微分设计为全局特性，支持批处理轴。框架本身基于 PyTorch，但也能支持由 JAX 计算的动力学及其梯度。
Result: 摘要报告提供了 10 个不同维度与规模的、ADDA 兼容的可微动力学系统实现，并据此构建了多个数据同化示例；未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者希望通过 ADDA 消除 DA 研究中的代码兼容性阻碍，提供一个可公开获得的统一框架（代码已开源）以支持变分、集合和基于学习等各类 DA 方法的研究。
Relevance: 85

papers.title: Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract_en: Learned KV-cache eviction often faces a soft-to-hard mismatch: during training, differentiable gates typically attenuate token contributions, whereas inference saves memory only when KV entries are physically removed. We ask whether the attention substrate affects this soft-to-hard transition. Using GPT-2-scale Transformers trained on OpenWebText, we run a controlled $2\times2\times2$ comparison over attention type, learned gating, and positional encoding. Although sigmoid attention is worse as a dense language model, learned hard eviction changes the useful operating points: sigmoid-gated models delete KV entries with negligible PPL change relative to their own no-eviction references. Under a matched live-cache protocol on the same dense backbones, learned sigmoid gates obtain lower PPL than our H$_2$O and KeyDiff implementations, whereas softmax gates do not uniformly beat these post-hoc methods. The results suggest that attention normalization can substantially affect whether a training-time soft gate transfers cleanly to hard KV deletion.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference (AdaptFM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学习式 KV 缓存驱逐（learned KV-cache eviction）中的软到硬不匹配问题，即训练时可微门控只是衰减 token 贡献，而推理时只有物理删除 KV 项才能节省内存。作者在 OpenWebText 上训练 GPT-2 规模 Transformer，进行 2×2×2 受控比较，覆盖注意力类型、学习式门控和位置编码。结果表明 sigmoid attention 作为稠密语言模型更差，但学习式硬驱逐改变了有效工作点：sigmoid 门控模型删除 KV 项后相对其自身无驱逐参考的 PPL 变化可忽略。
Motivation: 学习式 KV 驱逐普遍存在软到硬不匹配：训练中的软门控与推理时的硬删除行为不一致。论文追问注意力基底（attention substrate）本身是否影响这种软到硬迁移的可行性。
Method: 在 GPT-2 规模 Transformer 上于 OpenWebText 训练，采用 2×2×2 受控对比，维度包括注意力类型（sigmoid vs softmax）、学习式门控和位置编码，并在匹配的 live-cache 协议下评估。
Result: sigmoid 门控模型删除 KV 项后相对自身无驱逐参考的 PPL 变化可忽略；在相同稠密骨干下，学习式 sigmoid 门控获得比实现的 H2O 和 KeyDiff 更低的 PPL，而 softmax 门控并不能一致地胜过这些事后（post-hoc）方法。
Conclusion: 注意力归一化方式会显著影响训练期软门控能否干净地迁移到硬 KV 删除。

papers.title: What Memory Composition Does Not Tell Us About Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测（memory-based anomaly detection）中记忆组成的影响，在稀疏训练污染（sparse training contamination）条件下比较随机、medoid、局部与全局覆盖选择器。作者提出 CLEANCON，一种 out-of-bag 跨图像支持门控，在固定表征、绝对记忆大小、构建器和推理规则的前提下改变候选图像资格。结果显示全局覆盖会强烈过度表征稀疏污染，而 CLEANCON 可将最终记忆污染降至接近零并在全部 12 组配对比较中提升类别宏平均 P-AP；但保留率扫描表明最低污染的记忆并非 P-AP 最高，性能随污染上升仍继续改善。
Motivation: 基于记忆的异常检测器将名义训练 patch 存入记忆并以此打分，但被选中覆盖的 patch 未经几何稀有性检查就被当作正常参考，这种耦合在训练数据存在稀疏污染时可能不可靠。
Method: 在固定表征和记忆预算下对比随机、medoid、局部和全局覆盖选择器，并引入 CLEANCON 门控机制来改变候选图像资格，同时保持表征、绝对记忆大小、构建器与推理规则不变。
Result: 全局覆盖对稀疏污染有强烈过度表征；CLEANCON 使最终记忆污染降至接近零，并在所有 12 组匹配比较中提升类别宏平均 P-AP。但保留率扫描显示最低污染记忆未取得最高 P-AP，性能在污染上升时仍继续改善。
Conclusion: 作者据此认为记忆污染程度并不能按 P-AP 对所得记忆进行排序，即更低的记忆污染并不直接意味着更好的异常检测性能。

papers.title: Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments
papers.abstract_en: Accurate visual localization on robotic and wearable platforms remains challenging in dense urban environments. Existing methodologies typically rely on GPS for absolute positioning, yet GPS signals frequently degrade in urban canyons due to multipath propagation. Consequently, standard solutions like visual odometry suffer from unmitigated drift over time, while map-matching techniques struggle to acquire the reliable GPS priors they need, on top of being too computationally heavy for real-time edge execution. To address these limitations, we propose Spotter, a robuts and real-time visual localization framework that uses building facades as a reliable source of global geo-reference, while retaining the capability to integrate GPS signals when available. In an offline stage, Spotter processes Google Street View panoramas by semantically segmenting facades and pairing multi-view stereo depth with cartographic data to build a compact metric database. At runtime, query images are matched via a cascaded retrieval and geometric verification pipeline to recover fine-grained global camera localization. We benchmark Spotter on a newly collected dataset of pedestrian sequences acquired with wearable smart glasses across several districts of Barcelona. Experimental results show that Spotter outperforms odometry-based baselines and achieves localization accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art map-based methods while operating at significantly higher frame rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spotter，一种面向 GPS 退化城市环境的实时视觉定位框架，利用建筑立面作为全局地理参考。离线阶段处理 Google Street View 全景图，语义分割立面并结合多视图立体深度与制图数据构建紧凑度量数据库；运行时通过级联检索与几何验证恢复相机定位。作者在巴塞罗那多个区域的可穿戴智能眼镜行人序列新数据集上评测，显示优于里程计基线，精度接近基于地图的最先进方法且帧率更高。
Motivation: 现有视觉定位依赖 GPS 获取绝对位置，但城市峡谷中多径效应使 GPS 信号退化；视觉里程计随时间漂移，地图匹配方法需要可靠 GPS 先验且计算量过大，难以在边缘实时运行。
Method: 提出 Spotter 框架：离线阶段从 Google Street View 全景图语义分割建筑立面，将多视图立体深度与制图数据配对构建紧凑的度量数据库；运行时采用级联检索与几何验证（cascaded retrieval and geometric verification）匹配查询图像，并保留可融合 GPS 信号的能力。
Result: 在新采集的巴塞罗那多个区域智能眼镜行人序列数据集上，Spotter 优于里程计基线，定位精度与最先进的基于地图方法相当，同时运行帧率显著更高。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：在 GPS 退化环境中，利用建筑立面作为地理参考并混合可用 GPS 信号，可在提升帧率的同时达到与基于地图方法相当的定位精度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Poisson Subspace Clustering: Focusing on the Essentials in Count Data
papers.abstract_en: Count data represented as a matrix of non-negative integer values, such as contingency tables, are prevalent across diverse domains. When clustering such data sets, specific methods are required, as generic algorithms often fail to consider their unique distributional properties, leading to unreliable outputs. An effective strategy is to use well-established statistical models such as the Poisson and negative binomial distributions. We present 3CPO, a clustering algorithm based on statistically solid modeling of count data. In addition to the cluster labels, it identifies a subset of relevant columns, enhancing the interpretability of the results. We propose a simple iterative algorithm that maximizes the posterior probability to find good clustering solutions and discuss its properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate its ability to define high-quality clusters within associated subspaces for various data domains, ranging from gene expressions and texts to economics. Our findings suggest that 3CPO is a robust solution for clustering count data in a statistically sound and interpretable manner. Our code is available at https://github.com/collinleiber/3CPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3CPO，一种基于泊松分布等统计模型对计数数据 (count data) 进行聚类的算法，在输出聚类标签的同时识别相关列子集以增强可解释性。摘要报告其在基因表达、文本和经济等数据域上都能在关联子空间内得到高质量聚类，并提供了开源代码。
Motivation: 计数数据以非负整数矩阵形式广泛存在，通用聚类算法往往忽略其独特的分布性质，导致结果不可靠，因此需要针对这类数据的专门聚类方法。
Method: 3CPO 基于对计数数据的统计建模，提出一个简单的迭代算法，通过最大化后验概率来寻找良好聚类解，并讨论该算法的性质；除聚类标签外，它还会识别相关列的子集以提升可解释性。
Result: 大量实验表明，3CPO 在基因表达、文本和经济学等不同数据域中都能在关联子空间内定义高质量聚类。
Conclusion: 作者认为 3CPO 是以统计上合理且可解释的方式对计数数据进行聚类的稳健解决方案，代码已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: How Much Regularization Survives Averaging? Update Masking in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning on non-IID data seeks flat minima to generalize across clients, and existing methods borrow sharpness-aware minimization from centralized training. There is a second way to reach flat minima, in which the regularization comes for free from noise added to the parameter updates, and it has never been carried over to the federated setting. We show the reason. Masking charges the optimizer for moving in sharp directions. We prove that when each client draws its own mask, federated averaging weakens that charge by exactly the cohort size, and that giving every client the same mask brings it back by a factor equal to the inverse gradient diversity of the cohort. In our experiment setting on CIFAR-10, that factor is 1.19 out of a possible 10. Turning off minibatch sampling raises it to 8.96, while changing data heterogeneity a hundredfold leaves it between 1.17 and 1.50. The configurations keeping the regularization train far too poorly to use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中通过更新掩码（update masking）引入参数更新噪声、从而免费获得正则化并寻找平坦极小值（flat minima）的可行性。作者证明在非IID联邦平均下，若每个客户端独立采样掩码，沿尖锐方向移动的代价会被平均过程削弱为客户端规模分之一；若所有客户端共享同一掩码，则可按类别梯度多样性（gradient diversity）的倒数恢复该强度。CIFAR-10 实验显示恢复因子仅 1.19（理论上限为 10），关闭小批量采样可提升到 8.96，而数据异构性变化百倍时因子只在 1.17–1.50 之间，且能保持正则化强度的配置训练表现太差而无法使用。
Motivation: 非IID联邦学习需要平坦极小值以在各客户端间泛化，现有方法借鉴集中式训练中的 sharpness-aware minimization；而另一种通过参数更新噪声免费获得正则化的途径尚未被引入联邦设置，本文试图阐明其为何无法直接迁移。
Method: 理论上分析更新掩码在联邦平均中的行为：证明各客户端独立采样掩码时，沿尖锐方向的优化代价被平均过程削弱为客户端规模分之一，而统一掩码可按逆梯度多样性恢复强度，并在 CIFAR-10 上测量实际恢复因子及不同变体。
Result: CIFAR-10 实验中恢复因子为 1.19（理论上限 10）；关闭小批量采样时升至 8.96；数据异构性变化百倍时因子保持在 1.17–1.50；能够有效保持正则化强度的配置训练性能过差，无法实际使用。
Conclusion: 论文表明联邦平均会显著稀释独立掩码噪声带来的正则化效应，在可直接使用的配置下该正则化机制无法落地，且摘要未提出修复方案。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 论文表明联邦平均会显著稀释独立掩码噪声带来的正则化效应，在可直接使用的配置下该正则化机制无法落地，且摘要未提出修复方案。

papers.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose language models can reason and synthesize knowledge, but complex work also requires sustained interaction with files, information sources, and executable code, together with state maintenance, failure recovery, and verifiable delivery. We call this \emph{working capability}: sustained, verifiable progress toward a real-world objective. Apodex 1.1 develops this capability along two complementary dimensions. \emph{Environment Scaling} expands the diversity and verifiability of executable file, search, and code environments, while \emph{Agentic Coordination Scaling} trains agents to decompose long-horizon tasks, delegate parallel work, integrate asynchronous results, and replan. A shared execution harness and AgentOS maintain task state and provenance across tools and agents, and training turns environment trajectories and coordination traces into reliable behavior. Across complex professional work, finance, scientific research, mathematics, coding, and search, Apodex 1.1 reaches the leading performance band despite using a substantially smaller model than many frontier systems. The 35B-parameter Apodex 1.1 Mini further retains strong working capability in a locally deployable form. These results ground agentic intelligence in useful, verifiable work completed over time and advance our goal of building a \emph{Heavy-Duty Solver} for ambitious, long-running tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Apodex 1.1，一个面向复杂实际工作的智能体系统，旨在让语言模型具备持续的“工作能力”(working capability)：与文件、信息源和可执行代码长期交互，并维护状态、恢复失败、产出可验证结果。系统从环境扩展 (Environment Scaling) 和智能体协调扩展 (Agentic Coordination Scaling) 两个维度训练，并借助共享执行框架与 AgentOS 维护任务状态和来源。摘要报告其在专业工作、金融、科研、数学、编码和搜索等任务上进入领先性能区间，且参数量明显小于许多前沿系统。
Motivation: 通用语言模型能够推理和综合知识，但复杂工作还需要与文件、信息源、可执行代码的持续交互，以及状态维护、故障恢复和可验证交付，现有模型在这类长期真实任务上能力不足。
Method: Apodex 1.1 沿两条互补维度构建：环境扩展 (Environment Scaling) 增加可执行文件、搜索和代码环境的多样性与可验证性；智能体协调扩展 (Agentic Coordination Scaling) 训练智能体分解长时程任务、委派并行工作、整合异步结果并重新规划。训练利用共享执行框架和 AgentOS 记录的环境轨迹与协调痕迹，将其转化为可靠行为。
Result: 摘要称 Apodex 1.1 在复杂专业工作、金融、科学研究、数学、编码和搜索等领域达到领先性能区间，尽管使用的模型规模远小于许多前沿系统；35B 参数的 Apodex 1.1 Mini 在本地可部署形式下仍保持较强工作能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调把智能体智能建立在长期、有用且可验证的实际工作上，并以此推进构建面向宏大长时任务的 Heavy-Duty Solver 目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven human motion synthesis has made substantial development with two core modules of motion representation and generative architecture. For representation, Vector Quantization (VQ)-based methods compress motion data into discrete tokens while latent-based models operate directly in continuous space. However, both of these representations exhibit significant limitations. VQ-based methods suffer from inherent information loss, which compromises the quality, diversity, and generalization of generated motions, while continuous representation on holistic whole-body motion hinders part-level flexibility. For architecture, diffusion and autoregressive diffusion models have demonstrated their superiority, yet the fine-grained controllability over individual body parts is also limited. Thus, we propose a unified spatiotemporally decoupled framework named DeMoDiff, which jointly redesigns representation and architecture. To enhance representation extraction capabilities and offer greater part-level controllability, we present a spatial-temporal VAE that encodes each body joint rather than compressing the whole-body motion into a single latent space. Then, we incorporate spatial-temporal masking and attention mechanisms into an autoregressive diffusion generator, achieving both generative capability and controllable editability. Extensive experiments on the HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and compelling motion generation results. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong temporal and spatial editing capabilities, further validating its effectiveness. Our project page: https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeMoDiff，一个时空解耦的自回归扩散模型（autoregressive diffusion model），用于文本驱动的人体运动生成。该方法同时重设计运动表示与生成架构：提出 spatial-temporal VAE，将每个身体关节分别编码，而不是把全身运动压缩进单一潜空间，并在自回归扩散生成器中引入时空掩码与注意力机制。在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 数据集上，模型取得重建性能 SOTA，并具备较强的时空编辑能力。
Motivation: 现有运动表示存在明显局限：VQ（Vector Quantization）类方法有固有信息损失，损害生成质量、多样性和泛化性；而连续表示作用于整体全身运动，缺乏部位级（part-level）灵活性。同时，扩散和自回归扩散架构对单个身体部位的细粒度控制也有限。
Method: 提出统一的时空解耦框架 DeMoDiff，联合重设计表示与架构。表示侧使用 spatial-temporal VAE，逐关节编码以增强表示提取能力并提供部位级可控性；生成侧在自回归扩散生成器中加入时空掩码与注意力机制，兼顾生成能力和可编辑性。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得重建性能的 state-of-the-art，并产生有说服力的运动生成结果；框架还展示了较强的时序与空间编辑能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时重设计表示和架构能够在不牺牲生成质量的前提下获得部位级可控性与可编辑性，验证了该框架用于人体运动生成与编辑的有效性。

papers.title: A Multidimensional Data-Driven Hybrid Transformer Framework for Non-invasive Continuous Blood Pressure Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Objective. To develop and evaluate a cuffless continuous blood pressure (BP) estimator using temporal physiological and demographic features. We propose a hybrid Transformer framework to estimate diastolic and systolic BP from ECG/PPG-derived feature sequences. Approach. Rather than raw waveforms, the framework models 10-step sequences of six physiological descriptors and two demographic covariates. A Multi-Source Temporal Encoder Module combines Transformer, Kolmogorov-Arnold Network, and XGBoost branches to capture complementary temporal, nonlinear, and tabular information. A Dynamic Conditional Fusion-Decoder applies differential multi-head attention, token-weighted aggregation, and gated residual correction. A robust composite objective jointly optimizes DBP and SBP. Main results. Using the MIMIC-III Waveform and Clinical Databases, the source pool comprised 28,486 waveform segments from 203 subjects, and feature generation retained 53,621 observations from 166 subjects. On 2,431 segment-level held-out test windows, mean error +/- standard deviation was 0.41 +/- 3.74 mmHg for diastolic BP and -1.60 +/- 5.95 mmHg for systolic BP, with 95% limits of agreement of [-6.93, 7.74] and [-13.25, 10.06] mmHg, respectively. The proportions within 10 mmHg were 98.48% and 94.36%. The framework achieved the lowest standard deviations and narrowest limits of agreement among the locally retrained baselines. Significance. The feature-sequence fusion framework improved agreement with reference BP and fell within numerical AAMI and BHS Grade A thresholds on this split. This retrospective analysis is not formal device validation; subject-disjoint and external evaluation remain necessary before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于混合 Transformer 的无袖带连续血压估计框架，利用 ECG/PPG 衍生的特征序列而非原始波形，估计舒张压 (DBP) 和收缩压 (SBP)。模型在 MIMIC-III 数据的留出测试窗口上达到较低误差和较窄一致性界限，满足数值上的 AAMI 和 BHS Grade A 阈值。作者强调这是回顾性分析，尚需受试者不相交和外部验证。
Motivation: 无袖带连续血压估计需要从时间生理和人口统计学特征中稳定地推断血压，现有方法在准确性和一致性上仍有提升空间。
Method: 框架建模 10 步序列的六种生理描述符和两个人口统计学协变量。多源时间编码器模块组合 Transformer、Kolmogorov-Arnold Network 和 XGBoost 分支，分别捕获时序、非线性和表格信息；动态条件融合解码器采用差分多头注意力、token 加权聚合与门控残差修正；复合目标函数联合优化 DBP 和 SBP。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III Waveform and Clinical Databases 上，源池含 203 名受试者的 28,486 个波形段，特征生成保留 166 名受试者的 53,621 个观测。在 2,431 个段级留出测试窗口上，DBP 平均误差 ± 标准差为 0.41 ± 3.74 mmHg，SBP 为 -1.60 ± 5.95 mmHg；95% 一致性界限分别为 [-6.93, 7.74] 与 [-13.25, 10.06] mmHg；10 mmHg 内比例分别为 98.48% 和 94.36%。该框架在本地重训练的基线中取得最低标准差和最窄一致性界限。
Conclusion: 特征序列融合框架改善了与参考血压的一致性，并在该划分下达到数值上的 AAMI 和 BHS Grade A 阈值；但该研究为回顾性分析，并非正式设备验证，临床使用前仍需受试者不相交和外部评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner
papers.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deliver impressive perception yet still falter on scientific and mathematical reasoning. Parameter-level adaptation is unavailable for closed-weight or on-device backbones, and stateless prompting forfeits any compounding benefit from problems already solved. We propose \textbf{DG-Mem}, a dual-grained agentic memory framework that augments a frozen MLLM with a non-parametric, externally stored memory built once from training-time rollouts and consulted read-only at test time. Motivated by the Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) account of human memory, DG-Mem factors its store into an instance-grounded exemplar memory and a category-level schema memory of IF-THEN rules, with a transient reflection store mediating their construction so that schemas are synthesized only from abstract reflections, never from exemplar text. Two design choices distinguish DG-Mem: an online concept categorizer that grows the category space incrementally during training rather than committing to a predefined taxonomy, and a Shapley context attribution procedure that decomposes correctness across the entire retrieved rule set and yields a per-rule utility that re-weights retrieval at test time. The pipeline introduces no gradient updates and is deployable on closed-weight or on-device backbones. Across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four open-weight and proprietary backbones (Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, GPT-5-Nano, Gemini-3-Flash), DG-Mem improves consistently over no-memory and competitive memory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DG-Mem，一种用于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的双粒度智能体记忆框架，通过非参数、外置且只读的记忆增强冻结的 MLLM，提升其在科学与数学推理上的表现。受互补学习系统 (Complementary Learning Systems, CLS) 启发，记忆被划分为实例级示范记忆与类别级 IF-THEN 规则模式记忆，并由瞬态反思存储介导构造。整个流程无梯度更新，可部署在闭源权重或端侧骨干上；在 MathVista、MMMU、MMMU-Pro 上对四个开放权重与专有骨干均一致优于无记忆和竞争性记忆基线。
Motivation: 前沿 MLLM 在感知上表现好，但在科学与数学推理上仍不足；闭源权重或端侧骨干无法做参数级适配，而无状态提示 (stateless prompting) 无法利用已解决问题的累积收益。
Method: 提出双粒度记忆框架 DG-Mem：包含实例锚定的示范记忆和类别级的 IF-THEN 规则模式记忆，构造过程由瞬态反思存储中介，确保模式只从抽象反思综合而非示范文本；另有两个关键设计，即在训练中增量扩展类别空间的在线概念分类器，以及用 Shapley 上下文归因分解整个检索规则集的正确性贡献，得到每条规则的效用并用于测试时重加权检索。
Result: 在 MathVista、MMMU 和 MMMU-Pro 上，基于 Qwen3.5-27B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、GPT-5-Nano 和 Gemini-3-Flash 四种开放权重与专有骨干，DG-Mem 一致优于无记忆基线和竞争性记忆基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调无需梯度更新的非参数外部记忆可以增强冻结 MLLM，且适用于闭源权重或端侧部署；其适用场景聚焦于多模态模型在科学和数学推理任务上的记忆增强。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective first-person statements, and direct requests for assistance. We find that model performance degrades in the request-for-assistance-based form. Using Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), we trace this discrepancy to an attribution bias: the model places greater emphasis on benign task-framing tokens (e.g., "Can you help me...") than on tokens signaling the underlying unethical behavior (e.g., "without getting caught"), which we term cue-tokens. We hypothesize that this under-attribution contributes to harmful compliance. To test this, we introduce two LRP-guided decoding methods that steer generation toward trajectories more relevant to cue tokens. Empirical evaluations show that these interventions promote safer responses, supporting cue-token attribution's role in compliance failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究大语言模型在伦理对齐上的失败模式，提出一种探测方法，将不道德场景分别以客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述和直接求助请求三种结构形式呈现给 LLM。作者发现模型在求助请求形式下表现更差，并借助层相关传播（Layer-wise Relevance Propagation, LRP）将差距归因于一种注意力偏差：模型更关注良性的任务框架词（如“Can you help me...”），而较少关注表征不道德行为的线索词（如“without getting caught”）。作者进一步提出两种 LRP 引导的解码方法，使生成轨迹更偏向与线索词相关的内容，实验表明这些干预能促进更安全的回答。
Motivation: LLM 被对齐以同时优化 helpfulness 与 harmlessness，但这两个目标可能冲突并导致对齐失败；论文试图系统研究模型在何种结构形式下更容易出现不道德顺从，并理解其背后的机制。
Method: 提出一种探测方法，将不道德场景以客观分类、主观第一人称陈述和直接求助请求三种模态呈现；使用 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) 追踪模型在请求式形式下的归因偏差；并设计两种 LRP 引导的解码方法，引导生成朝与线索词（cue-token）更相关的方向进行。
Result: 模型在求助请求形式下的表现明显下降；LRP 显示模型对良性任务框架词的注意力权重高于对不道德线索词的注意力；两种 LRP 引导的解码干预均能促进更安全的输出，支持线索词归因不足在合规失败中的作用。
Conclusion: 摘要提出，线索词被低估（under-attribution）是导致 LLM 有害顺从的因素之一，LRP 引导解码可以缓解这一问题；但结论局限于该归因假设和所提干预在安全生成上的支持性证据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Automated Construction of FAIR Digital Object Knowledge Graphs from Flat Cultural Heritage Records
papers.abstract_en: The FAIR Digital Object (FDO) framework mandates that metadata attribute values be expressed as persistent identifiers (PIDs) wherever possible, to produce a fully machine-actionable graph in which every reference is resolvable. The Europeana Data Model was designed long before the FDO specification, and it stores most metadata values as plain text. This serves human browsing well enough, but gives an automated agent nothing to follow across records or collections. We present a pipeline that transforms flat Europeana records into an FDO-compliant knowledge graph structured with CIDOC-CRM. Following the FDO specification, we model every heritage entity as a discrete FDO with its own PID, type, profile, and metadata layer. The core technical challenge is automating the FDO-prescribed distinction between values that must become PID references (resolvable entities) and those that may remain literals (terminal leaves such as notes, measurements, and dates). We address this with a large language model that classifies each metadata value, routes it to a controlled vocabulary (Getty AAT, Wikidata, VIAF, PeriodO), and links it to a shared entity FDO. We evaluate using 637 archaeological records from five Europeana providers, processing each with the LLM. The pipeline links 86% of metadata slots, resolving 58.5% of values Europeana had not already enriched. It also merges cross-lingual surface forms that byte-identical matching keeps apart, where 17 of 33 such merges are correct on manual review. Graph connectivity does not separate this from string matching; what distinguishes the FDO graph is that every node is typed and resolvable.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication as a short paper at CIKM 2026 (The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个流水线，将扁平的 Europeana 文化遗产记录自动转换为符合 FAIR Digital Object (FDO) 规范、以 CIDOC-CRM 结构化的知识图谱。核心是用大语言模型判断每个元数据值应成为 PID 引用（可解析实体）还是保留为字面量，并路由到受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO）后链接到共享实体 FDO。评估使用来自五个 Europeana 提供方的 637 条考古记录，流水线链接了 86% 的元数据槽位，并解决了 58.5% 原本未被 Europeana 富集的值。
Motivation: FDO 框架要求元数据属性值尽量使用持久标识符（PID），以形成完全机器可操作的图，但 Europeana 数据模型设计早于 FDO 规范，大多以纯文本存储元数据，不利于自动化代理跨记录或跨集合进行追踪。
Method: 提出将平面 Europeana 记录转换为 FDO 合规知识图谱的流水线：按 FDO 规范为每个遗产实体建模为独立 FDO（含 PID、类型、profile 与元数据层），并利用大语言模型自动区分应变为 PID 引用的值与可保留为字面量的值，将其路由到受控词表并链接到共享实体 FDO。
Result: 基于 637 条来自五个 Europeana 提供方的考古记录，流水线链接了 86% 的元数据槽位，解决了 58.5% 原本未被 Europeana 富集的值；在人工审查的 33 个跨语言表面形式合并中，有 17 个正确。图连通性与字符串匹配并无显著差别，其区别在于每个节点都有类型且可解析。
Conclusion: 作者强调该 FDO 图的价值不在于连通性提升，而在于每个节点均被类型化且可解析，从而满足 FDO 的机器可操作要求。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HetSkills 框架，在统一潜空间中渐进学习异构技能以支持基于物理的角色控制。该框架先学习一个跟踪技能来建立运动控制基础并生成可复用的共享运动解码器，再通过运动直觉蒸馏和任务引导模块将文本到运动生成锚定在语言语义上。实验表明该方法在运动跟踪、文本到运动生成、运动补全和下游任务适应上均有良好效果。
Motivation: 不同技能往往来自异构数据源、监督形式和任务，传统方法通常需要为每个任务单独训练控制器，难以在统一框架中整合技能。
Method: 将统一潜空间视为共享可执行接口；先学习跟踪技能以获得无需重训即可复用的运动解码器；通过运动直觉蒸馏避免文本到运动技能走捷径，并设计任务引导模块根据高层语言指令动态调整动作。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在运动跟踪、文本到运动生成、运动补全和下游任务适应上有效，即使在困难条件下也取得较高成功率（未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: HetSkills 能够在保持自然运动的同时持续扩展技能库，适用于长时程任务；摘要未说明明显局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
papers.abstract_en: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. Despite its simplicity, Mixed SFT achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60 times less training compute. The advantage is consistent across in-domain mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain reasoning tasks. Moreover, we show that higher pre-RLVR accuracy does not necessarily translate into higher post-RLVR accuracy, highlighting the need to evaluate no-CoT training strategies in the context of the full post-training pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 next-chunk reasoning RL 这一利用无 CoT（no-CoT）数据的训练方法做受控研究，检验其收益究竟来自 RL 公式本身还是来自对 no-CoT 数据的更有效暴露。作者提出一个简单的替代方案 Mixed SFT，即单一监督微调阶段同时训练 no-CoT 与 long-CoT 数据。摘要报告 Mixed SFT 在 post-RLVR 性能上限上明显更高，且训练计算量减少超过 60 倍。
Motivation: 现有评估主要把 next-chunk reasoning RL 与常规 SFT 基线对比，无法确定增益来源是 RL 本身还是数据暴露方式；作者希望厘清这一点，以便评估 no-CoT 训练策略的真正价值。
Method: 作者对 next-chunk reasoning RL 进行受控研究，并提出此前被忽视的简单替代方案 Mixed SFT：一个单一的监督微调阶段，联合训练 no-CoT 数据与 long-CoT 数据。
Result: 摘要报告 Mixed SFT 比 next-chunk reasoning RL 取得明显更高的 post-RLVR 性能上限，同时训练计算量少 60 倍以上；该优势在领域内数学推理与领域外推理任务上一致。摘要还指出更高的 pre-RLVR 精度并不必然带来更高的 post-RLVR 精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应在完整后训练流水线（full post-training pipeline）的背景下评估 no-CoT 训练策略，单独衡量微调或 RL 阶段的表现可能具有误导性。

papers.title: From Multimodal Observation to Interpretable Suggestions: Counterfactual Time-Expanded Relational Modeling of Surgical Teams
papers.abstract_en: In surgery, patient safety is threatened not only by technical issues but also by poor teamwork. However, existing surgical AI-based solutions focus mainly on visual workflow and technical execution, neglecting the modeling of team interactions and missing opportunities to actively support clinicians in improving their teamwork skills. To address this gap, we propose a tempo-relational framework for modeling surgical team dynamics from multimodal observations. By leveraging Time-Expanded graphs, the approach captures both relational structure and temporal evolution, achieving strong expressivity while remaining robust in the low-data regime typical of surgical settings. Beyond prediction, such modeling enables the generation of efficient, interpretable, and actionable suggestions for clinicians. More specifically, we generate suggestions via a counterfactual procedure that identifies minimal yet structured changes in individual behaviors and interaction patterns associated with improvements in team performance. Experiments with simulated surgical procedures show that our approach improves predictive performance in diverse behavioral and interaction goals while offering meaningful insights into team dynamics. This work advances surgical AI beyond outcome-driven prediction towards a socially grounded, team-centric, and actionable paradigm to better understand and support the development of team skills in surgical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向手术团队动态建模的 tempo-relational 框架，基于多模态观测并用 Time-Expanded 图同时刻画关系结构与时间演化。框架不仅能预测团队行为与交互目标，还通过反事实过程生成可解释、可操作的建议，以帮助临床医生改进团队协作。在模拟手术流程上的实验显示该方法在多种行为与交互目标上提升预测性能，并在低数据条件下保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有手术 AI 方案主要关注视觉工作流与技术执行，忽略团队交互建模，也缺乏主动支持临床医生提升团队协作能力的手段，而团队协作不佳会威胁患者安全。
Method: 采用 Time-Expanded 图建模团队动态，兼顾关系结构与时间演化，以适应手术场景中的低数据（low-data）条件；在此基础上通过反事实（counterfactual）过程识别与团队表现提升相关的个体行为和交互模式的最小结构化改变，从而生成可解释且可执行的建议。
Result: 在模拟手术流程的实验中，该方法在多种行为和交互预测目标上取得更好的预测性能，并能为团队动态提供有意义的洞察。
Conclusion: 该工作将手术 AI 从以结果为导向的预测推进到以团队为中心、可操作的范式，强调对社会性团队技能的建模与支持，并指出该框架在低数据手术场景下仍保持表达能力与稳健性。

summary_sections.method: 采用 Time-Expanded 图建模团队动态，兼顾关系结构与时间演化，以适应手术场景中的低数据（low-data）条件；在此基础上通过反事实（counterfactual）过程识别与团队表现提升相关的个体行为和交互模式的最小结构化改变，从而生成可解释且可执行的建议。
summary_sections.result: 在模拟手术流程的实验中，该方法在多种行为和交互预测目标上取得更好的预测性能，并能为团队动态提供有意义的洞察。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作将手术 AI 从以结果为导向的预测推进到以团队为中心、可操作的范式，强调对社会性团队技能的建模与支持，并指出该框架在低数据手术场景下仍保持表达能力与稳健性。

papers.title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable parameters, or fine-tuning. In the first stage, E2S-Pruner treats each attention head as an independent evidence source, estimates its reliability from evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and represents each visual token using three states: important, unimportant, and uncertain. In the second stage, Dempster--Shafer evidence theory is used to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse complementary evidence from multiple network layers. We further introduce a spatial novelty constraint that promotes coverage of distinct image regions and prevents the retained tokens from concentrating in a few locally salient areas. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, E2S-Pruner retains 98.0%, 96.8%, and 90.6% of the aggregate performance when the average numbers of retained visual tokens are 192, 128, and 64, respectively, while improving throughput by 1.96x and 2.09x under the 128-token and 64-token settings. Experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B further demonstrate cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E2S-Pruner，一种用于视觉语言模型视觉 token 剪枝的无辅助模型、无可训练参数、无需微调的两阶段证据融合框架。第一阶段将每个注意力头视为独立证据源，依据证据清晰度和头间一致性估计可靠性，并把视觉 token 归类为重要、不重要和不确定三态；第二阶段用 Dempster-Shafer 证据理论量化跨层冲突并融合多层互补证据，同时引入空间新颖性约束避免保留 token 集中在少数局部显著区域。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，平均保留 192、128、64 个视觉 token 时分别保持 98.0%、96.8% 和 90.6% 的聚合性能，吞吐量分别提升 1.96x 和 2.09x；Qwen2-VL-7B 上的实验进一步验证跨模型泛化。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝方法大多基于注意力分数并直接跨注意力头与网络层聚合输出，难以刻画证据不确定性（evidential uncertainty）和证据冲突，导致剪枝对模型性能的保持能力受限。
Method: 提出渐进式两阶段证据融合框架：第一阶段把每个注意力头当作独立证据源，通过证据清晰度与头间一致性估计其可靠性，并对每个视觉 token 输出重要、不重要、不确定三种状态；第二阶段利用 Dempster-Shafer 证据理论融合多层互补证据并量化层间冲突；另加入空间新颖性约束以促进保留 token 覆盖不同图像区域。整体方法无需辅助模型、额外可训练参数或微调。
Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，保留平均 192、128、64 个视觉 token 时，聚合性能分别保持 98.0%、96.8% 和 90.6%，128-token 与 64-token 设置下吞吐量分别提升 1.96x 和 2.09x；Qwen2-VL-7B 上的实验显示该方法具有跨模型泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，无训练的两阶段证据融合配合空间新颖性约束能够在显著降低视觉 token 数量的同时保持绝大部分下游性能并提升吞吐量，且方法可推广到不同视觉语言模型；代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Laws of Context Allocation: Causal Measurement and Closed-Loop Orchestration in Generative Search
papers.abstract_en: As Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shifts toward diverse portfolio generation, it is stymied by two critical bottlenecks: flawed measurement of evidence utilization, and suboptimal context budget allocation. We resolve both sequentially. To resolve measurement, we expose a pervasive ``diagnostic illusion'': standard relevance proxies fail catastrophically on hard negatives. We replace them with an efficient causal leave-one-out probe that accurately isolates generative reliance and formally calibrates the structural dilution of LLM attention. To resolve allocation, we deploy this causal probe in a deconfounded factorial grid. We prove that the prevailing strategy of monolithic context widening is an architectural trap penalized by relevance decay. Instead, allocating compute iteratively across multiple sequential generations drives transformative portfolio recall gains of 16.7--20.5 absolute percentage points, scaling robustly up to 32B models. Finally, we unify these solutions into a deployable closed-loop submodular scheduler. Augmented by an attribution-steered contrastive decoder to override LLM attention inertia, our architecture systematically forces fresh evidence integration. By dominating classical open-loop baselines, we establish sequential, feedback-driven orchestration as the definitive paradigm for generative search. Our code, data, and causal measurement instruments are available at https://github.com/PeiYangLiu/ascp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 RAG 生成式搜索中证据利用的度量偏差与上下文预算分配问题。作者指出现有相关性代理在硬负样本上存在“诊断错觉”，改用因果留一法探针 (causal leave-one-out probe) 来分离生成对证据的依赖并校准 LLM 注意力稀释；随后将该探针用于去混淆的因子网格，证明迭代式多轮生成分配比单次扩大上下文带来更显著的组合召回提升（16.7–20.5 个百分点）。最终将这些组件统一为闭环次模调度器，并加入归因引导的对比解码器。
Motivation: RAG 转向多样化组合生成时，现有度量无法准确刻画证据利用，且上下文预算分配次优；标准相关性代理在硬负样本上会严重失效，形成“诊断错觉”。
Method: 提出高效的因果留一法探针替代相关性代理，用来隔离生成对证据的因果依赖并校准注意力结构稀释；将探针部署在去混淆因子网格中，并构建闭环次模调度器 (closed-loop submodular scheduler)，配合归因引导的对比解码器 (attribution-steered contrastive decoder) 强制整合新鲜证据。
Result: 摘要报告在组合式召回 (portfolio recall) 上获得 16.7–20.5 个绝对百分点的提升，且该收益在最高 32B 参数的模型上仍稳健；与经典开环基线相比占据优势。
Conclusion: 作者主张顺序、反馈驱动的编排（sequential, feedback-driven orchestration）是生成式搜索的范式，而单次扩大上下文（monolithic context widening）会因相关性衰减成为架构陷阱；代码与数据已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Semantic Reconstruction and 3-D Detection via Learned Multi-Pair Fusion in RF Imaging
papers.abstract_en: We consider a multistatic radio-frequency imaging problem with anisotropy, in which the reflection from a point depends on the positions of the transmit (Tx) and receive (Rx) arrays. The goal is to label the voxels of a field of view by a finite set of semantic classes and to group them into object instances. For the image formation of each Tx--Rx pair we apply a standard inverse-problem solver, and we feed the resulting per-pair reconstructions into a trained three-dimensional (3-D) U-Net that performs the fusion implicitly and the per-voxel classification explicitly. On a controlled, under-determined multistatic setup, we consider the following image formation methods: back-projection (BP) and the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) from a single deterministic snapshot, and incoherent BP and group-LASSO from multiple fading snapshots. For each imaging method we train a separate U-Net that fuses the six Tx--Rx pairs (its input channels) and assigns each voxel a probability vector over the classes. Taking the most probable class gives a labeled volume---the semantic reconstruction. Object instances and their oriented bounding boxes then follow by geometric post-processing (clustering and principal-component analysis). Across a wide range of signal-to-noise ratio, the semantic reconstruction (scored against ground truth by segmentation intersection-over-union) and the resulting 3-D detection degrade far more gracefully than the classical intensity reconstruction: the detection in particular stays reliable well into noise levels at which that reconstruction has dissolved. Because real scenes contain objects of classes the network was not trained on, we add an explicit unknown class trained by outlier exposure, which labels held-out novel objects as unknown instead of mislabeling them as a known class by reconstructed shape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有各向异性反射的多基地射频成像问题，目标是对视场体素做语义分类并将其聚集成目标实例。对每个 Tx-Rx 对先用标准逆问题求解器成像（BP、LASSO，以及多衰落快照下的非相干 BP 和 group-LASSO），再把六对图像的逐对重建输入 3-D U-Net，由网络隐式融合并以逐体素分类显式输出语义标签；随后通过聚类和主成分分析等几何后处理得到目标实例及有向包围盒。摘要报告在宽信噪比范围内，语义重建与 3-D 检测比经典强度重建退化更平缓，并引入由 outlier exposure 训练的显式未知类来处理训练中未见过的物体类别。
Motivation: 各向异性多基地 RF 成像中，反射依赖 Tx 与 Rx 阵列位置，经典强度重建在低信噪比下会迅速失效，因此需要更鲁棒的语义级重建与 3-D 检测方案。
Method: 为每个 Tx-Rx 对应用逆问题求解器得到逐对重建，再将六个通道输入独立的 3-D U-Net 进行隐式融合与逐体素语义分类；分类结果经几何后处理（聚类与 PCA）生成目标实例和有向包围盒。针对未知类别，使用 outlier exposure 训练一个显式的 unknown 类。
Result: 在该受控的欠定多基地设置中，语义重建（按分割交并比评分）和 3-D 检测随信噪比降低的退化远慢于经典强度重建；在强度重建已失效的噪声水平下，检测仍保持可靠。
Conclusion: 作者强调，加入由 outlier exposure 训练的显式未知类后，网络会把留出的新类别物体标为 unknown，而不是依据重建形状将其误判为已知类。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Future Querying: Can LLMs Serve as Implicit Medical World Models?
papers.abstract_en: Traditional clinical prediction models rely on task-specific pipelines and curated, structured data, which scale poorly and underutilize unstructured text. To address this, we introduce future querying, a paradigm that probes whether large language models (LLMs) can function as implicit medical world models by evaluating their ability to answer time-indexed clinical queries about a patient's future. Our framework operates on unstructured clinical documentation using endpoint-agnostic training, enabling a single model to answer diverse clinical queries over patient trajectories without manual feature engineering or task-specific retraining. We show that small, locally fine-tuned open-weight models can match or approach larger proprietary systems, making the framework suitable for privacy-preserving, on-premise deployment. Evaluated on a new synthetic medical reports dataset and real ICU notes from the MIMIC-IV dataset, our results provide encouraging evidence that LLMs can capture aspects of clinical dynamics.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted at The 1st MICCAI Workshop on Medical World Models (MICCAI-2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“future querying”范式，检验大语言模型（LLM）能否作为隐式医学世界模型，回答关于患者未来的时间索引临床查询。框架基于非结构化临床文档和端点无关训练（endpoint-agnostic training），无需人工特征工程或任务特定重训，单个模型即可回答多种临床查询。作者在小规模本地微调的开源权重模型上与更大的专有系统比较，并在新合成的医学报告数据集和 MIMIC-IV 真实 ICU 笔记上评估。结果为 LLM 能捕捉部分临床动态提供了初步证据。
Motivation: 传统临床预测模型依赖任务特定流程和经过整理的结构化数据，扩展性差且未充分利用非结构化文本，这是本文试图填补的空白。
Method: 引入 future querying 范式，在非结构化临床文档上训练模型回答带时间索引的临床查询；采用端点无关训练使单一模型应对多类查询，并评估小规模本地微调的开源权重模型，以支持隐私保护下的本地部署。
Result: 摘要报告小规模本地微调的开源权重模型可以匹配或接近更大的专有系统；在合成医学报告数据集及 MIMIC-IV 真实 ICU 笔记上的结果表明 LLM 能捕获临床动态的某些方面。
Conclusion: 本文认为该框架适用于隐私保护、本地部署的医疗场景，但结果仅是对 LLM 具备隐式医学世界模型能力的初步证据。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告小规模本地微调的开源权重模型可以匹配或接近更大的专有系统；在合成医学报告数据集及 MIMIC-IV 真实 ICU 笔记上的结果表明 LLM 能捕获临床动态的某些方面。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文认为该框架适用于隐私保护、本地部署的医疗场景，但结果仅是对 LLM 具备隐式医学世界模型能力的初步证据。

papers.title: Multi-Winner Voting with Argumentative Ballots
papers.abstract_en: We introduce multi-winner voting with argumentative ballots (MVArg) and investigate theoretical properties. As our conceptual contribution, we generalise approval ballots to argumentative ballots, thereby allowing voters to express defeasible preferences over candidates. We accordingly generalise voter cohesion and justified representation axioms JR, PJR and EJR. As our theoretical contribution, we establish several key results. First, MVArg is strictly more expressive than multi-winner voting with approval ballots (MV). Second, our notions of cohesion and justified representation are conservative generalisations of their counterparts in MV. Third, the MVArg counterpart of JR can always be satisfied, whereas the counterparts of PJR and EJR cannot always be. Fourth, although verifying whether a winner set satisfies the MVArg counterpart of JR is already coNP-hard, such a winner set can be constructed in polynomial time. All definitions, propositions, auxiliary lemmas and theorems have been formalised and mechanically checked in Lean 4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出带论证式选票的多赢家投票机制 (multi-winner voting with argumentative ballots, MVArg)，将批准投票 (approval ballots) 推广为允许选民表达可废止偏好 (defeasible preferences) 的论证式选票，并相应推广了选民凝聚性 (voter cohesion) 与代表性公理 JR、PJR、EJR。摘要报告了若干理论结果：MVArg 严格强于普通批准式多赢家投票 (MV)；其凝聚性与正当代表性概念是 MV 对应概念的保守推广；JR 的对应版本总能被满足，而 PJR 与 EJR 的对应版本则不一定；验证某赢家集合是否满足 JR 对应版本已是 coNP-hard，但这样的赢家集合可在多项式时间内构造。全部定义、命题、辅助引理与定理均已在 Lean 4 中形式化并机器验证。
Motivation: 标准批准式选票无法表达候选人的可废止偏好，难以刻画选民更细微的偏好结构；作者希望通过引入论证式选票扩展多赢家投票的表达能力，并研究其公理性质与计算复杂性。
Method: 定义 MVArg，将批准选票推广为论证式选票，把选民凝聚性和 JR、PJR、EJR 公理推广到该设定；在理论上分析其表达力、公理可满足性与验证复杂性，并在 Lean 4 中对所有结论进行形式化证明。
Result: 摘要列出四项主要结果：MVArg 严格比 MV 更具表达力；新的凝聚性与正当代表性概念是 MV 中对应概念的保守推广；JR 对应版本总可满足而 PJR、EJR 对应版本不可总满足；验证 JR 对应版本为 coNP-hard，但可多项式时间构造满足该公理的赢家集合。
Conclusion: 作者从理论上建立了论证式选票多赢家投票的公理基础，并强调全部结论经由 Lean 4 机器检查；该工作属于纯理论性质，未涉及实验或应用。

papers.title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but incorrect answers with unwarranted confidence. A central limitation is that standard LLMs represent uncertainty through a single predictive distribution, conflating epistemic ignorance with genuine ambiguity. We introduce Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs): an ensemble of LoRA adapters induces a credal set whose lower and upper probabilities expose the spread of plausible predictive distributions rather than collapsing to a single softmax output. From this representation we derive two complementary commitment scores. Credal Token Commitment (CTC) is a token-space score that combines lower-bound support, credal width, and intersection entropy, computed without additional generation. Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC) extends commitment to semantic space using sampled completions, with SCC-Gap measuring the mismatch between token-level and semantic-level support. We evaluate hallucination detection, calibration, selective prediction, and reasoning on Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B across OpenBookQA, CoQA, TriviaQA, and ARC-Challenge. CLLM is the best method on QA accuracy at competitive expected calibration error, and CTC tracks the best hallucination AUROC within 1.5 pp on most settings without additional generation. On selective prediction at 80% coverage, CLLM with SCC reaches 99.0% accuracy on OpenBookQA, and on ARC-Challenge CLLM with Csem confidence achieves <= 0.6% ECE across the three backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs)：用一组 LoRA 适配器的集成诱导一个 credal set，以 lower/upper probabilities 呈现合理预测分布的离散程度，而不是折叠成单一 softmax 输出。在此基础上导出 token 空间的 Credal Token Commitment (CTC) 和语义空间的 Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC) 两个互补的承诺分数，用于幻觉检测、校准、选择性预测和推理。实验在 Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 上跨 OpenBookQA、CoQA、TriviaQA、ARC-Challenge 进行。
Motivation: 标准 LLM 通过单一预测分布表示不确定性，将认知无知 (epistemic ignorance) 与真实歧义 (ambiguity) 混为一谈，从而经常给出流畅但错误且过度自信的答案。
Method: CLLM 利用 LoRA 适配器集成构造 credal set，由其下/上概率刻画预测分布的 spread；从该表示推导出 token 空间的 CTC（结合 lower-bound support、credal width 和 intersection entropy，无需额外生成）以及语义空间的 SCC，并用 SCC-Gap 衡量 token 级与语义级支持之间的不匹配。
Result: 在所列骨干模型与基准上，CLLM 在 QA 准确率上最优且预期校准误差 (ECE) 具有竞争力；CTC 在多数设置下无需额外生成即可达到最佳幻觉 AUROC 的 1.5 pp 以内。选择性预测在 80% coverage 时，CLLM 配合 SCC 在 OpenBookQA 上达到 99.0% 准确率；在 ARC-Challenge 上，CLLM 配合 Csem 置信度在三个骨干模型上做到 ECE ≤ 0.6%。
Conclusion: 作者主张用 credal 集替代单一 softmax 分布可以更好地区分 token 级与语义级不确定性，并在幻觉检测与选择性预测上带来收益；评估集中于 QA 与推理类基准。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Classification of Environmental Mitigations in Hydropower Licensing Documents
papers.abstract_en: Identifying and classifying environmental mitigation obligations in Federal Energy Regulatory Commission hydropower licensing documents is a labor-intensive task requiring deep domain expertise. We formulate this as a multi-label classification problem over a structured 135-category taxonomy and address the central challenge of severe label scarcity: 40 of 135 categories have no training examples, and 26 have fewer than five. A supervised Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT)-based pipeline, while effective on well-represented categories, achieves F1 of zero on unseen classes regardless of augmentation strategy. We introduce a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that conditions classification on retrieved category definitions, enabling zero-shot generalization across the full label space. We further propose a hybrid system that combines BERT detection with RAG classification, exploiting the high recall of fine-tuned detection and the zero-shot coverage of retrieval-augmented reasoning. Evaluated on the full set of 2017 license documents (5,860 paragraphs, 135 categories), the hybrid achieves a Micro F1 of 0.524, outperforming the BERT-only pipeline (0.477) and the RAG-only pipeline (0.416) across all training-support buckets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将美国联邦能源监管委员会（FERC）水电许可证文件中的环境缓解义务识别建模为基于 135 类结构化分类法的多标签分类问题，并针对严重的标签稀缺（40 个类别无训练样本、26 个类别少于 5 个样本）提出检索增强生成（RAG）流程：通过检索类别定义来条件化分类，实现全标签空间的零样本泛化。作者进一步提出将 BERT 检测与 RAG 分类结合的混合系统，利用微调检测的高召回率和检索增强推理的零样本覆盖。在 2017 年许可证文件全集（5,860 个段落、135 个类别）上，混合系统取得 Micro F1 0.524，优于仅 BERT（0.477）和仅 RAG（0.416）。
Motivation: 人工识别和分类水电许可文件中的环境缓解义务耗时且需要深入领域知识；监督式 BERT 流程在样本充足的类别上有效，但在未见类别上无论采用何种增强策略 F1 都为零，因此需要能够覆盖完整标签空间的零样本方案。
Method: 将任务形式化为结构化分类法下的多标签分类；提出 RAG 流程，在分类时以检索到的类别定义为条件，支持零样本泛化；并提出混合系统，将高召回率的微调 BERT 检测与具备零样本覆盖的 RAG 分类相结合。
Result: 在 2017 年许可证文档全集（5,860 个段落、135 个类别）上，混合系统的 Micro F1 为 0.524，超过仅 BERT 流程的 0.477 和仅 RAG 流程的 0.416，且在各类训练支持度分桶上均表现更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调混合系统结合了 BERT 检测的高召回率与 RAG 的零样本覆盖能力，从而在全标签空间实现优于任一单独流程的分类效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images
papers.abstract_en: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mover360，一个面向 360° 全景图像的可控物体编辑框架。针对 equirectangular projection (ERP) 图像的横向环绕、纬度相关畸变和全局场景连续性，框架以物体 Translation 为主要任务，并支持参考引导的 Insert 与 Remove 作为辅助任务。作者通过固定 prompt 加 ERP 对齐的指令图统一点、框、掩码三种控制方式，并基于预训练 diffusion transformer 做轻量适配。摘要报告其在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量上优于多种透视编辑、插入和修复基线，并发布代码与 benchmark。
Motivation: 360° 图像的 ERP 表示具有水平环绕、纬度相关畸变和全局场景连续性，导致面向透视图像的编辑器和用户都难以完成对象级编辑；现有方法无法很好处理这些特性。
Method: Mover360 以单点击的默认点模式重定位物体，利用全景上下文和辅助深度条件推断合理尺寸、支撑关系与光照；用户界面将点、bbox、mask 三类控制统一编码为固定 prompt 和 ERP 对齐的紧凑指令图。训练数据来自 UE5 数据生成管线，包含表面感知的物体放置和随机光照，从而构建合成与真实全景的双域 benchmark。
Result: 在合成与真实两个测试域以及两种评估协议下，Mover360 在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量上均优于用于透视编辑、插入和修复的强基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一指令图加轻量 diffusion transformer 适配能有效完成全景图像中的可控物体操作，并公开了代码与包含三类任务真值的基准数据集。

papers.title: MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge
papers.abstract_en: In this technical report, we present a training-free framework for audio-guided video object segmentation, which integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with SAM-based segmentation models. We decompose the task into several stages and identify suitable foundation models for each stage. Without introducing additional model training or task-specific fine-tuning, our approach leverages the strong multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to model text-visual correspondence and employs SAM-based models for accurate object mask generation. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of leveraging foundation models for audio-guided video segmentation and achieves competitive performance in the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
