papers.title: Think Only When Needed: Prompt-Authority Control for Selective Slow-Path Intervention in Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval can efficiently and effectively augment a frozen vision--language--action (VLA) policy without retraining, yet retrieved text becomes a control intervention once it enters the executed prompt. In a matched audit, raw appended text reduces mean success from 92.47\% to 3.00\%, while meaningful and length-matched meaningless appends both fail on all 500 states. This result identifies \emph{prompt-form collapse}: changing the instruction form, rather than adding useful semantics, can dominate execution. We introduce TOWN-VLA (Think Only When Needed), a prompt-authority interface that separates candidate generation from permission to alter the policy input. A fixed compatibility rule authorizes a canonical compact instruction; otherwise, the interface restores the original Base prompt exactly. Across 900 audited routes, every route follows this contract: 525 routes recover Base with matching hashes, and all 375 authorized prompts preserve the task signature. On a matched $4\times7$ LIBERO-Plus evaluation with 10{,}030 episodes per method, success rises from 69.5\% to 73.1\% ($+362$ episodes; 95\% CI 1.89--5.45 points), improving on six perturbation axes and all four suites. On a physical PiPER arm with a frozen \pizerofive{} checkpoint, success rises from 52.7\% to 78.7\% over 150 trials per method ($p=3.16\times10^{-6}$). Prompt authority is enforceable for a frozen controller; oracle-free admission calibration is the next deployment target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冻结的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略中检索文本作为控制干预的问题，提出 TOWN-VLA (Think Only When Needed) 提示词权限接口，将候选生成与修改策略输入的权限分离。审计发现原始追加文本使平均成功率从 92.47% 降至 3.00%，且语义有意义或无意义的等长追加在 500 个状态上全部失败，作者将其归因于"提示词形式坍缩" (prompt-form collapse)。固定兼容性规则会授权规范的紧凑指令，否则接口精确恢复原始 Base 提示词；在 LIBERO-Plus 与实体 PiPER 机械臂上均报告成功率提升。
Motivation: 检索增强可以无需重训练地为冻结的 VLA 策略提供高效增强，但检索到的文本一旦进入执行提示词就变成控制干预。作者通过匹配审计发现，改变指令形式而非增加有用语义会主导执行，即提示词形式坍缩，从而需要一种机制来控制何时允许提示词干预策略输入。
Method: 提出 TOWN-VLA 提示词权限接口，将候选生成与是否允许修改策略输入分离开来。固定兼容性规则用于授权一种规范紧凑指令 (canonical compact instruction)；若不符合规则，则接口精确恢复原始 Base 提示词，保证权限可执行。
Result: 在 900 条审计路线中，525 条恢复 Base 且哈希匹配，375 条授权提示词保留任务签名。在匹配的 4×7 LIBERO-Plus 评估 (每方法 10,030 个回合) 中，成功率从 69.5% 提升到 73.1% (+362 回合；95% CI 1.89–5.45 点)，覆盖六个扰动轴和四个套件；在冻结 PiZero5 检查点的物理 PiPER 机械臂上，150 次试验每方法，成功率从 52.7% 升至 78.7% (p=3.16×10⁻⁶)。
Conclusion: 作者强调提示词权限 (prompt authority) 对冻结控制器是可执行的，下一步部署目标为免真值 (oracle-free) 的准入校准 (admission calibration)。

papers.title: Which Histories Matter for Time Series Forecasting? Learning Predictive Relevance with Future Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Historical retrieval for time-series prediction commonly treats past similarity as a proxy for usefulness. We ask a different question: which historical examples should be expected to matter for a query? We define predictive relevance as expected future utility conditioned on inference-time information, using realized futures only during training as privileged supervision. A normalized-pattern retriever first forms a coarse candidate set, and a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) learns a listwise future-compatibility target while keeping inference-time scoring strictly past-only. Our method retains similarity-based candidate generation but reranks its candidates by a more predictive relevance criterion. Optimal relevance decomposes into candidate-level utility and query-specific compatibility, motivating Candidate-Prior and Shuffled-Future controls. Across six benchmarks, the reranker improves Pattern retrieval while revealing candidate-global, query-specific, and mixed relevance regimes. On all 12 confirmatory tasks, it improves Pattern and outperforms a matched-protocol Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting (SARAF) retrieval rule. Architecture-matched ablations show that correct future supervision, rather than the MLP or added context alone, drives gains in query-specific regimes. Alternative-similarity experiments show that a strong last-value-anchored L2 rule remains superior in some domains, whereas future-supervised relevance is particularly strong where our diagnostics indicate query-specific relevance, especially on Solar. Candidate-pool diagnostics show that this contrast is not explained solely by coarse Pattern retrieval. Overall, historical relevance is structured and domain dependent rather than governed by a universally superior retrieval rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列预测中的历史样本检索问题，提出以“预测相关性 (predictive relevance)”替代单纯的历史相似性作为排序标准。方法上先用归一化模式检索器生成候选集，再用轻量残差 MLP 学习基于未来实现的列表级兼容性目标，训练时使用实际未来作为特权监督，推理时仍只用过去信息。在六个基准和 12 个确认性任务上，重排序器改进了 Pattern 检索效果，并优于匹配协议的 SARAF 检索规则；消融实验表明收益主要来自正确的未来监督而非模型或额外上下文。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测的历史检索通常把过去的相似性当作有用性的代理，但相似并不等于对未来预测有帮助，缺少从未来效用角度定义历史相关性的框架。
Method: 将预测相关性定义为在推理时可获信息条件下对未来效用的期望，训练时用实现后的未来作为特权监督。采用归一化模式检索器生成粗候选集，再由轻量残差多层感知机 (MLP) 学习列表级未来兼容性目标；最优相关性分解为候选级效用和查询特定兼容性，并据此引入 Candidate-Prior 和 Shuffled-Future 对照。
Result: 在六个基准上重排序器提升 Pattern 检索效果；全部 12 个确认性任务中均改进 Pattern 并超越匹配协议的 SARAF 检索规则。架构匹配的消融显示正确未来监督是查询特定相关场景中的主要驱动因素；替代相似性实验显示基于最后值锚定的 L2 规则在部分领域仍更强，而未来监督相关性在诊断为查询特定相关的场景（尤其是 Solar）中表现突出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调历史相关性是有结构且依赖领域的，不存在普遍最优的检索规则；不同领域呈现出候选全局、查询特定和混合相关模式，未来监督下的重排序更适合查询特定相关场景。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: What is mathematics now, and what should it be?
papers.abstract_en: Advances in neural theorem provers have been impressive, but the successes obscure a broader vision of what AI can do for mathematics and how mathematicians can engage with AI. This essay advances a more expansive and optimistic point of view.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇由 Jeremy Avigad 撰写的随笔认为，神经定理证明器 (neural theorem provers) 的进展虽然令人瞩目，但这些成功反而掩盖了 AI 能为数学带来什么的更广阔视野。作者主张以更宏大、更乐观的角度看待 AI 与数学家的合作方式。文章属于观点性文本，没有报告实验数据。
Motivation: 现有 AI 数学研究多聚焦于神经定理证明器的性能指标，而忽略了 AI 在数学中更广泛的可能角色以及数学家参与 AI 研究的方式；作者希望指出这一视野上的局限。
Method: 本文是一篇观点随笔 (essay)，通过论述提出一种更宽泛且乐观的 AI 与数学关系图景，而非提出新的算法或系统。
Result: 摘要未报告任何实验结果或量化数据；主要输出是观念层面的扩展性论点。
Conclusion: 作者认为应当超越定理证明器的具体成就，重新审视 AI 对数学的潜在贡献以及数学家与 AI 协作的更多可能性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction: Benchmarking Neural Architectures and Validation on EXL-50U
papers.abstract_en: Fast and reliable plasma equilibrium prediction is essential for real-time tokamak operation and control, but conventional Grad-Shafranov (GS) solvers are often too costly for real-time deployment. We develop an AI surrogate framework and benchmark five architectures (MLP, CNN, FNO, Transformer, and KAN) on a numerical GS database with 100,000 IID and 10,000 OOD samples. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate accuracy, inference efficiency, model scaling, and robustness. We also establish device-level validation on the EXL-50U tokamak by linking numerical GS solutions, surrogate predictions, and the standard Shape Editor reference to assess simulation-to-device consistency. The surrogates achieve errors of $10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$ relative to GS solutions, while the GS-to-device discrepancy remains at $10^{-3}$. Transformer gives the best IID accuracy, whereas CNN offers the best balance of accuracy, robustness, and speed, reaching 0.7 ms TensorRT latency. On unseen plasma geometries and parameter regimes, CNN and FNO show the strongest extrapolation stability, with 4%-5% relative $L_2$ error, while models with weaker inductive biases degrade more substantially. Scaling data and model capacity improves interpolation but not necessarily extrapolation, revealing a trade-off between capacity and OOD generalization. Overall, this work provides a systematic, device-consistent benchmark for AI-based GS prediction and practical guidance for selecting reliable surrogates for real-time plasma control and fusion applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对托卡马克实时运行与控制中平衡预测速度不足的问题，提出AI代理模型框架，并在包含100,000个IID和10,000个OOD样本的数值Grad-Shafranov（GS）数据库上统一基准测试五种架构：MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN。同时通过连接数值GS解、代理预测和Shape Editor参考，在EXL-50U装置上建立设备级验证。摘要报告代理模型相对GS解的误差为10^-3至10^-2，GS到设备的一致性误差为10^-3；Transformer在IID上精度最佳，CNN在精度、鲁棒性和速度上最均衡，TensorRT延迟0.7 ms；CNN和FNO在未见等离子体几何和参数区间上外推稳定性最强，相对L2误差4%-5%。
Motivation: 实时托卡马克运行和控制需要快速可靠的等离子体平衡预测，但传统Grad-Shafranov（GS）求解器往往计算成本过高，难以在实时部署中使用。
Method: 开发AI代理模型框架，在一个统一的实验协议下对MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN五种神经架构进行基准测试，评测精度、推理效率、模型扩展性和鲁棒性；并将数值GS解、代理预测和标准Shape Editor参考相链接，在EXL-50U装置上评估模拟到设备的一致性。
Result: 代理模型相对GS解的误差为10^-3至10^-2，GS到设备的偏差保持在10^-3量级。Transformer在IID数据上精度最好，CNN在精度、鲁棒性和速度之间取得最佳平衡，TensorRT延迟为0.7 ms；CNN和FNO在未见等离子体几何与参数区间上的外推稳定性最强，相对L2误差4%-5%，而归纳偏置较弱的模型退化更明显。扩展数据量和模型容量能改善插值但不一定能改善外推。
Conclusion: 该工作为基于AI的GS预测提供了系统且设备一致的基准，并为实时等离子体控制与聚变应用中选取可靠代理模型给出了实际指导。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对托卡马克实时运行与控制中平衡预测速度不足的问题，提出AI代理模型框架，并在包含100,000个IID和10,000个OOD样本的数值Grad-Shafranov（GS）数据库上统一基准测试五种架构：MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN。同时通过连接数值GS解、代理预测和Shape Editor参考，在EXL-50U装置上建立设备级验证。摘要报告代理模型相对GS解的误差为10^-3至10^-2，GS到设备的一致性误差为10^-3；Transformer在IID上精度最佳，CNN在精度、鲁棒性和速度上最均衡，TensorRT延迟0.7 ms；CNN和FNO在未见等离子体几何和参数区间上外推稳定性最强，相对L2误差4%-5%。
summary_sections.motivation: 实时托卡马克运行和控制需要快速可靠的等离子体平衡预测，但传统Grad-Shafranov（GS）求解器往往计算成本过高，难以在实时部署中使用。
summary_sections.method: 开发AI代理模型框架，在一个统一的实验协议下对MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN五种神经架构进行基准测试，评测精度、推理效率、模型扩展性和鲁棒性；并将数值GS解、代理预测和标准Shape Editor参考相链接，在EXL-50U装置上评估模拟到设备的一致性。
summary_sections.result: 代理模型相对GS解的误差为10^-3至10^-2，GS到设备的偏差保持在10^-3量级。Transformer在IID数据上精度最好，CNN在精度、鲁棒性和速度之间取得最佳平衡，TensorRT延迟为0.7 ms；CNN和FNO在未见等离子体几何与参数区间上的外推稳定性最强，相对L2误差4%-5%，而归纳偏置较弱的模型退化更明显。扩展数据量和模型容量能改善插值但不一定能改善外推。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为基于AI的GS预测提供了系统且设备一致的基准，并为实时等离子体控制与聚变应用中选取可靠代理模型给出了实际指导。

papers.title: BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations
papers.abstract_en: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. Furthermore, we propose a dense, hierarchical feature fusion strategy across all four network stages to preserve fine-grained sediment details alongside deep semantic abstractions. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that the framework natively groups complex benthic topographies into stable, noise-free semantic clusters without relying on manual annotations. During supervised downstream tasks on the S3Seg dataset, the fused representations exhibited exceptional data efficiency, achieving 96% of its absolute peak performance using only 10% of the available annotated data, ultimately reaching a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 71.4% and an overall accuracy of 86.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BenthicDINO，一种面向侧扫声呐 (side-scan sonar, SSS) 图像的物理信息自蒸馏框架，基于 DINOv3 架构和 ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny 主干。方法通过模拟声学退化的物理增强、Hilbert-Schmidt 独立性准则 (HSIC) 惩罚以及四阶段稠密层次特征融合来显式施加视角不变性。在 S3Seg 数据集上，仅用 10% 标注数据即达到峰值性能的 96%，最终 mIoU 为 71.4%、整体准确率为 86.5%。
Motivation: SSS 图像中的物理声学伪影使表征混杂了海底反射率与瞬态观测几何，而现有自监督学习 (SSL) 框架使用针对自然图像设计的增强，既未考虑声学退化，也未显式施加视角不变性。
Method: 构建物理信息自蒸馏框架，包含两个主要机制：物理动机增强（模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射定标误差）以及 HSIC 惩罚项，用于将稠密 patch 特征与物理观测参数解耦；另提出跨全部四个网络阶段的稠密层次特征融合，以保留细粒度沉积物细节和深层语义抽象。
Result: 摘要报告该框架无需人工标注即可将复杂底栖地形聚为稳定、无噪声的语义簇；在 S3Seg 的监督下游任务中，融合表征展现出突出数据效率，使用 10% 可用标注数据达到绝对峰值性能的 96%，最终 mIoU 为 71.4%，整体准确率为 86.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为物理信息视角不变性与稠密特征融合能够产出稳健的语义表征，并在标注稀缺条件下保持高性能。该结论主要限定于侧扫声呐底栖场景与 S3Seg 数据集。

papers.title: Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack
papers.abstract_en: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套基于 YOLO11 迁移学习和 ByteTrack 的蜂巢入口自动监测系统，用于检测和计数快速移动的小目标蜜蜂。研究表明，渐进式骨干解冻 (progressive backbone unfreezing) 的检测器达到约 97.0% 的精确率和 98.7% 的 mAP50，且比全量微调收敛更稳定；轻量数据增强优于重度增强。在独立的 25 FPS 侧视视频上，优化后的系统正确计数 43/47 只进入蜜蜂 (91.5%) 和 7/30 只离开蜜蜂 (23.3%)，误差主要来自快速运动和运动模糊导致的漏检。
Motivation: 蜂巢入口处蜜蜂体积小、运动快，自动检测与计数在真实记录条件下可靠性不足，需要研究数据增强、骨干网冻结策略和跟踪器参数对性能的影响。
Method: 采用 YOLO11 迁移学习和 ByteTrack 跟踪算法，对比不同数据增强强度、骨干网冻结策略，并对 ByteTrack 参数进行优化以改善低置信度检测下的轨迹连续性。
Result: 渐进式骨干解冻策略获得约 97.0% 精确率和 98.7% mAP50；轻量增强优于重度增强。在独立 25 FPS 侧视视频上，进入蜜蜂计数准确率为 91.5%，离开蜜蜂仅为 23.3%，误差分析表明多数错误源于运动模糊导致的漏检，参数优化后跟踪失败明显减少。
Conclusion: 作者认为适度增强、渐进式骨干解冻和 ByteTrack 调参能提高自动蜂巢入口监测在真实记录条件下的可靠性，但外出蜜蜂的低计数率仍是一个明显局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SGHA: A Single-Loop Fully First-Order Algorithm for Nonconvex-Strongly-Convex Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study the oracle complexity of finding an $ε$-stationary point for nonconvex-strongly-convex (NC-SC) bilevel optimization using only first-order oracles. Existing methods achieving the best-known complexity guarantees typically rely on double-loop, penalty-based procedures. We propose a novel single-loop algorithm based on a constrained reformulation in which lower-level stationarity is imposed as a constraint. Specifically, we construct a regularized Lagrangian by introducing a quadratic regularizer and restricting the dual variable to a bounded domain, and then apply Smoothed Gradient Descent Ascent [Zhang et al., 2020], with Hessian-vector products approximated via finite differences of gradients. We refer to the resulting deterministic and stochastic algorithms as SGHA and Stoc-SGHA, respectively. In the deterministic setting, SGHA achieves an oracle complexity of $O(\barκ_y^{5}ε^{-2})$, where $\barκ_y$ denotes the relevant condition number. In the stochastic setting, Stoc-SGHA achieves an oracle complexity of $O\left(\barκ_y^{17}ε^{-6}ρ^{-3}\right)$ with probability at least $1-ρ$ for any $ρ\in(0,1)$, and an oracle complexity of $O\left(\barκ_y^{17}ε^{-6}\right)$ in expectation under an additional bounded-iterate assumption. Moreover, under an additional stochastic smoothness assumption imposed only on the lower-level objective, the stochastic oracle complexity of Stoc-SGHA improves to $O\left(\barκ_y^{11}ε^{-4}ρ^{-2}\right)$ with high probability and $O\left(\barκ_y^{11}ε^{-4}\right)$ in expectation, matching the $ε$-dependence of the lower bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非凸-强凸（NC-SC）双层优化，提出一种单循环、仅用一阶oracle的算法SGHA及其随机版本Stoc-SGHA。其核心是将下层平稳性作为约束，构造带二次正则项和受限对偶变量的正则化拉格朗日，并应用Smoothed Gradient Descent Ascent，Hessian-vector积通过梯度有限差分近似。确定性复杂度为O(κ̄_y^5 ε^{-2})，随机版本在额外假设下可改善复杂度，并在ε依赖上匹配现有下界。
Motivation: 现有取得最优oracle复杂度的NC-SC双层优化方法通常依赖双循环或基于惩罚的框架，结构复杂。本文希望设计一个更简单的单循环全一阶算法，同时保持最优的oracle复杂度。
Method: 提出约束重构：将下层平稳性作为显式约束，引入二次正则化并将对偶变量限制在有界区域，构造正则化拉格朗日。随后采用Smoothed Gradient Descent Ascent（S-GDA）进行优化，并用梯度的有限差分近似Hessian-vector积，从而避免二阶信息，得到确定性算法SGHA和随机算法Stoc-SGHA。
Result: 确定性SGHA达到O(κ̄_y^5 ε^{-2})的oracle复杂度。随机Stoc-SGHA以至少1-ρ概率达到O(κ̄_y^17 ε^{-6} ρ^{-3})，在额外有界迭代假设下期望复杂度为O(κ̄_y^17 ε^{-6})。若进一步对下层目标施加随机光滑假设，高概率复杂度改善为O(κ̄_y^11 ε^{-4} ρ^{-2})，期望复杂度为O(κ̄_y^11 ε^{-4})，其ε依赖与下界匹配。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过单循环全一阶算法即可在NC-SC双层优化中实现与现有双循环/惩罚方法相当甚至匹配下界的oracle复杂度，且随机版本在较温和假设下也能保持良好保证。

papers.title: Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation
papers.abstract_en: We study spherical occupancy profiles-the ray-wise occupancy probability profiles P(r) = T(r) o(r) distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions-as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D reconstruction from images. On a 999-object subset of Google Scanned Objects with 48 turntable views each, we train (i) a discriminative per-ray decoder that injects global view-averaged and ray-specific image evidence into a FiLM-conditioned profile head, reaching median soft depth error 0.035 (normalized) on an independent 90-object test split, and (ii) a generative pipeline built on a profile VAE and a latent diffusion model, which supports unconditional sampling that matches the reconstruction manifold and image-conditioned multi-solution reconstruction whose per-object solution spread is quantifiable and tunable via classifier-free guidance. We further analyze the morphology of predicted profiles: post-hoc power sharpening and a learned sharpening target both recover ground-truth profile width without degrading depth, exposing a monotonic width-peak frontier in the L1-per-ray loss family and motivating a principled redefinition of morphology gates. Real-photo validation on two DTU scenes confirms the pipeline transfers to non-synthetic input. Our results suggest that ray-wise occupancy profiles offer a compact, learned, and uncertainty-aware interface between multi-view reconstruction and generative priors.
papers.comment: 12 pages,5 figures,5 tables. Code and data will be released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究球面占用剖面（spherical occupancy profiles），即将多视图3D高斯重建中逐射线蒸馏出的占用概率分布 P(r)=T(r)o(r)，作为判别式与生成式3D重建的统一中间表示。在Google Scanned Objects的999个对象子集上训练了FiLM条件化的逐射线判别解码器以及基于剖面VAE和潜在扩散模型（latent diffusion model）的生成管线。摘要报告判别解码器在独立测试集上达到中位归一化软深度误差0.035，生成管线支持无条件采样和图像条件下的多解重建，并在DTU真实照片上验证了可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有方法通常将多视图重建与生成建模视为分离的任务，缺乏一个紧凑、可学习且对不确定性敏感的共享中间表示。作者希望用射线级占用剖面统一判别式重建与生成式先验，并量化生成结果的多解性。
Method: 从多视图3D高斯重建中提取逐射线占用剖面 P(r)=T(r)o(r)，训练一个将全局视角平均证据与射线特定图像证据注入FiLM条件剖面头的判别式解码器；同时构建由剖面VAE和潜在扩散模型组成的生成式管线，并引入classifier-free guidance以控制和量化多解重建的解扩散。
Result: 判别式解码器在90个对象的独立测试拆分上达到中位归一化软深度误差0.035；生成式管线支持匹配重建流形的无条件采样和图像条件的多解重建。形态学分析发现post-hoc幂锐化与学习式锐化目标均能恢复ground-truth剖面宽度而不降低深度，且在L1逐射线损失族中呈现单调的宽度-峰值前沿；DTU两个场景的真实照片验证表明管线可迁移到非合成输入。
Conclusion: 作者认为逐射线占用剖面为多视图重建与生成先验之间提供了一种紧凑、可学习且具备不确定性感知的接口。摘要未明确讨论局限性，但指出未来可进一步规范形态学门控（morphology gates）的定义。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究球面占用剖面（spherical occupancy profiles），即将多视图3D高斯重建中逐射线蒸馏出的占用概率分布 P(r)=T(r)o(r)，作为判别式与生成式3D重建的统一中间表示。在Google Scanned Objects的999个对象子集上训练了FiLM条件化的逐射线判别解码器以及基于剖面VAE和潜在扩散模型（latent diffusion model）的生成管线。摘要报告判别解码器在独立测试集上达到中位归一化软深度误差0.035，生成管线支持无条件采样和图像条件下的多解重建，并在DTU真实照片上验证了可迁移性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法通常将多视图重建与生成建模视为分离的任务，缺乏一个紧凑、可学习且对不确定性敏感的共享中间表示。作者希望用射线级占用剖面统一判别式重建与生成式先验，并量化生成结果的多解性。
summary_sections.method: 从多视图3D高斯重建中提取逐射线占用剖面 P(r)=T(r)o(r)，训练一个将全局视角平均证据与射线特定图像证据注入FiLM条件剖面头的判别式解码器；同时构建由剖面VAE和潜在扩散模型组成的生成式管线，并引入classifier-free guidance以控制和量化多解重建的解扩散。

papers.title: Cognitive Profiling of LRMs' Reasoning Traces Using Bloom's Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized reasoning in LLMs, and the increasing public availability of reasoning traces creates valuable opportunities to study model behavior not only at the surface level but also at the granularity of individual reasoning steps. However, understanding the types of thinking employed during reasoning - which offers critical insights into models' reasoning patterns and enables actionable applications - remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce a framework for automatic annotation of reasoning steps through the lens of Bloom's Taxonomy, which classifies thinking into six cognitive levels, such as Remembering, Applying and Evaluating. Using this framework, we perform a large-scale analysis across models and datasets, revealing both similarities and differences in thinking patterns across models and tasks. Moreover, we demonstrate that thinking-type information derived from reasoning traces correlates with correctness, paving the way for improved reasoning. Our findings establish a fine-grained framework for analyzing thinking patterns in LRMs and provide actionable insights for enhancing reasoning quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Bloom 分类学 (Bloom's Taxonomy) 的自动标注框架，将大型推理模型 (LRMs) 的推理步骤划分为 Remembering、Applying、Evaluating 等六个认知层级。作者在多个模型和数据集上进行大规模分析，发现不同模型与任务在思维模式上既有相似性也有差异，并证明推理轨迹中的思维类型信息与正确性相关。
Motivation: 随着 LRMs 推理轨迹的公开可用，研究者可以在单步粒度上研究模型行为，但推理过程中所采用的思维类型尚未被充分探索，而这对于理解推理模式和支撑可落地的应用很关键。
Method: 引入一套基于 Bloom 分类学的自动推理步骤标注框架，将每个推理步骤归入六种认知水平，并据此对不同模型和数据集上的思维模式进行大规模比较分析。
Result: 大规模分析揭示了不同模型与任务之间思维模式的异同，并表明从推理轨迹中提取的思维类型信息与回答正确性存在相关性，可为改进推理提供方向。
Conclusion: 该工作为分析 LRMs 的思维模式建立了一个细粒度框架，并为提升推理质量提供了可操作的洞见。

papers.title: Statistics of Temperature Extremes and Implications for Electrical Power Infrastructure in Continental France
papers.abstract_en: In this article, we present extreme value statistics of temperature extremes over continental France with a focus on their implications for electrical power infrastructure. These are obtained by fitting a non-stationary generalised extreme value distribution using a Bayesian setup, which also provides errors or uncertainty values for all estimates. Within this method, a combination of simulated data from a collection of 28 CMIP6 models and measured records from the E-OBS dataset is used. The investigated climate scenarios are SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5, considering both historical and future climates spanning the years from 1850 to 2099. The method provides full spatial resolution on a 0.25 degree grid, allowing to asses extreme temperatures at arbitrary locations. Leveraging this particular aspect, various maps revealing the spatial structure of annual maximum high temperature extremes over continental France for the median and the statistical upper bound are shown together with summary information for the administrative regions in France towards the end of the century. It is statistically possible that the south west region of Occitanie could reach temperatures of up to 57°C under a high emission scenario by 2080, which is the highest compared to all other regions in continental France. We also perform a comparison to the reference climate adaptation trajectory for France (TRACC - Trajectoire de réchauffement de Référence pour l'Adaptation au Changement Climatique), showing that it potentially underestimates the stated maximum temperatures which could be surpassed by up to +8°C. Furthermore, five reference electrical power infrastructure locations are investigated on how they are potentially affected by temperature extremes with the quantified intensities.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 7 figures, submitted to journal: Weather and Climate Extremes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对法国大陆的温度极端值开展极值统计，重点评估其对电力基础设施的潜在影响。作者用贝叶斯框架拟合非平稳广义极值分布（GEV），结合28个CMIP6模型模拟数据与E-OBS观测资料，在0.25度网格上给出覆盖1850-2099年、含SSP2-4.5、SSP3-7.0和SSP5-8.5情景的极端温度估计。结果显示到2080年高排放情景下Occitanie地区统计上可能达到57°C的最高温度，并发现TRACC参考气候适应轨迹可能低估最高温度达+8°C。文章还考察了五个参考电力基础设施地点的受影响强度。
Motivation: 温度极端值对电力基础设施的设计和运行有重要影响，但此前缺少兼顾高空间分辨率、不确定性与多气候情景的极端温度估计，难以为法国区域层面的基础设施规划和气候适应提供可靠依据。
Method: 采用非平稳广义极值分布（GEV）并在贝叶斯框架下拟合，融合28个CMIP6模式模拟数据和E-OBS观测记录，在0.25度网格上提供完整空间分辨率的极端温度统计，并给出估计的不确定度。
Result: 摘要给出了法国大陆年最大高温极值的中位数与统计上界空间分布图，以及行政区域汇总；在高排放情景下Occitanie到2080年可能达到57°C。与TRACC参考轨迹对比，该轨迹可能低估最高温度，被超越幅度可达+8°C；此外还量化了五个电力基础设施参考位置受极端温度的潜在影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法能够在任意位置评估极端温度，揭示法国在世纪末前可能面临的严重高温风险，并指出当前参考适应轨迹可能低估极端最高温度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI emotional support is better only when chosen, but shifts preferences even when it is not
papers.abstract_en: People increasingly face a novel decision when seeking emotional support: human or AI. In existing studies, AI's empathic messages are rated as well as or better than humans'. But these studies either assigned the support source or honored people's choice. In real life, support is often incongruent with choice, as people want one source and receive the other. Across three experiments (N = 1,951), participants chose whether to share an emotional experience with a human or an AI, then were randomly assigned to a congruent or incongruent partner. AI support was rated as superior only among those who had chosen it. Yet regardless of congruence, interacting with AI increased willingness to choose it again. In a 28-day study with OpenAI (N = 981), daily conversations shifted preferences toward AI and away from humans, but only when conversations turned personal. Emotional support choices are thus path-dependent, progressively redirecting away from human connection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人们在寻求情感支持时选择人类或AI，以及实际分配来源与个人选择是否一致对支持评价和后续偏好的影响。三项实验（N=1,951）显示，AI的情感支持只有在参与者主动选择AI时才被评为更优；但无论分配是否与选择一致，与AI互动都会提高再次选择AI的意愿。为期28天、与OpenAI合作的纵向研究（N=981）进一步发现，日常对话只有在变得私人化时才会把偏好从人类推向AI。作者据此认为情感支持选择是路径依赖的，会逐渐远离人类连接。
Motivation: 现有关于AI共情信息的研究要么人为指定支持来源，要么尊重参与者的选择，但现实情境中经常出现“想要一种来源却得到另一种”的不一致情况；本文针对这一缺口，考察选择与分配不一致如何影响AI情感支持的评价和后续选择偏好。
Method: 通过三项实验让参与者先选择与人类或AI分享情绪体验，再随机分配为与选择一致或不一致的伙伴；此外开展一项28天的纵向研究，记录日常对话中偏好从人类向AI转移的过程。
Result: AI支持仅在主动选择AI的人群中被评价为更优；无论一致性如何，与AI互动都会增加再次选择AI的意愿；28天研究中，只有当对话变得私人时，偏好才从人类转向AI。
Conclusion: 摘要强调情感支持选择具有路径依赖性（path-dependent），会逐步将人们的偏好从人类连接引向AI，提示长期使用AI支持可能改变未来支持来源的选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a prior for many CT problems simultaneously. We evaluate the proposed method using the same frozen model on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning flaw analysis in additively manufactured metal parts imaged with cone-beam X-ray CT and concrete microstructure imaged with parallel-beam neutron CT. Our proposed method out-performs analytic reconstructions in all three cases, providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究是否可以用一个跨多个成像域训练的扩散模型作为多种 CT 重建问题的通用先验。作者在三个数据集上使用同一个冻结模型进行评估，数据集在模态、束几何、材料和退化类型上各不相同，涵盖增材制造金属件的锥束 X 射线 CT 与混凝土微观结构的平行束中子 CT。所提方法在所有三种情况下都优于解析重建，朝可复用的异构 CT 重建基础先验迈出一步。
Motivation: CT 通量受限于扫描时间，而稀疏视角或低剂量测量需要信息丰富的先验；现有先验通常针对单一扫描设置训练，模态、几何或材料改变时需重新训练。
Method: 提出使用跨多个成像域训练的单一扩散模型作为即插即用先验 (plug-and-play prior)，在多种 CT 问题上重复使用同一个冻结模型。
Result: 摘要报告在三个数据集（模态、束几何、材料和退化类型均不同）上使用同一冻结模型，所提方法在所有三种情况下均优于解析重建。
Conclusion: 这项工作表明单一多模态扩散模型可作为异构 CT 重建问题的基础先验，并指出这是向可复用基础先验迈进的一步。

papers.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
papers.abstract_en: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoWM，一个面向可进入生成媒体 (enterable generative media) 的全模态世界模型，能响应连续导航并联合生成 720p 视频、环境声音、音乐和语音。交互围绕相机意图组织：第一人称场景指定观察者运动，第三人称场景中相机-角色动态从数据中学习而无须视角专用控制器。离散命令与连续姿态被映射为共享的度量尺度相对 6-DoF 轨迹，并通过数据集级校准保持异构数据间的运动幅度。训练上采用互补数据引擎、渐进训练加自回归后训练，以支持长视界生成。
Motivation: 现有生成世界模型难以在统一框架中同时处理连续导航、视听联合生成和长视界交互，尤其是多视角与异构数据下保持运动幅度一致性。
Method: 提出统一的交互表示，将离散命令和连续姿态映射到共享度量尺度的相对 6-DoF 轨迹，并用数据集级校准保持运动幅度；同时构建互补数据引擎，采用渐进训练与自回归后训练联合学习视听生成和轨迹控制。
Result: 在公共世界模型基准上，EchoWM 实现强轨迹跟随和高视觉质量，支持第一人称与第三人称交互以及多种主体，并在长视界生成中保持环境声音和语音的同步。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Label-free Representation Quality Metrics in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present a comparative study of label-free metrics for assessing the quality of representations in deep neural networks to understand their reliability under a wide variety of configurations. We group existing label-free metrics into three families based on their construction and analytically establish connections between metrics within the same family. We then characterise the sensitivity of spectral metrics through controlled synthetic experiments. Finally, all label-free metrics are evaluated against downstream task accuracy across a diverse set of 260 vision models on six datasets spanning generic object classification, fine-grained object classification, scene recognition and geospatial task, stratifying results by architecture class and training objective. We find that intrinsic dimensionality (ID) is the most reliable predictor among the metrics considered. However, the reliability of all metrics, including ID, is moderated by architecture class and training objective. Our results provide a clearer understanding of what label-free representation quality metrics measure, when they are reliable, and how to interpret them in practice.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yknkAksqr1
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026), ISSN 2835-8856
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对深度神经网络表示质量的免标签度量（label-free metrics）进行系统性比较研究，将现有度量按构造方式分为三个家族并建立同一家族内部度量的分析联系，通过受控合成实验刻画光谱度量（spectral metrics）的敏感性，并在260个视觉模型、6个数据集（涵盖通用分类、细粒度分类、场景识别和地理空间任务）上评估这些度量与下游任务准确率的一致性。研究发现内在维度（intrinsic dimensionality, ID）是最可靠的预测指标，但所有度量（包括ID）的可靠性都受架构类别和训练目标的调节。
Motivation: 目前缺乏对各类免标签表示质量度量在不同配置下可靠性的统一理解，研究者难以判断这些度量实际测量了什么、何时可信，因此需要系统地比较并解释其行为。
Method: 将免标签度量按构造方式归为三个家族并建立家族内度量之间的解析联系；用受控合成实验表征光谱度量的敏感性；最后在260个视觉模型和6个数据集上按架构类别与训练目标分层，评估所有度量与下游任务准确率的一致性。
Result: 在260个视觉模型、6个数据集上的评估表明，内在维度（ID）是所考察度量中最可靠的预测指标；但包括ID在内的所有度量的可靠性均会因架构类别和训练目标不同而发生变化。
Conclusion: 该研究增进了对免标签表示质量度量测量内容、适用条件及实践解读方式的理解，并强调使用这些度量时应考虑架构类别和训练目标的调节作用。

papers.title: NetConfArena: An Executable Benchmark for LLM Agents in Closed-Loop Network Configuration
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly attractive for automating network configuration, yet their reliability and failure patterns are poorly understood. An essential prerequisite is to assess such agents in a realistic but risk-free environment. Existing benchmarks, however, fall short: they often treat configuration as static command generation or rely on overly simplified settings. Such evaluations understate the core challenges of network configuration, where correctness requires reasoning about protocol complexity and topology dependence. We present NetConfArena, an executable benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in closed-loop network configuration. NetConfArena places agents in emulated multi-device networks, provides a standardized and compact action interface for task execution, and evaluates the resulting network behavior with hidden task-specific executable test cases. The benchmark relies on an LLM-assisted, emulation-grounded pipeline, which converts human-oriented network materials into reusable parameterized task templates. We evaluate representative LLM agents on 480 task instances instantiated from 96 protocol-focused task templates, yielding 3840 execution trajectories, and show that failures are not limited to command errors. The failures also reveal gaps in task-specification adherence and robust planning and execution. These findings suggest two future directions: using validated trajectories as supervision signals to improve foundation models, and designing harness mechanisms that make agent execution more reliable and accountable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NetConfArena，一个用于评估大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体在闭环网络配置任务中表现的可执行基准。该基准在仿真的多设备网络环境中提供标准化动作接口，并使用隐藏的可执行测试用例评估网络行为。作者基于 96 个协议相关的任务模板实例化出 480 个任务，收集了 3840 条执行轨迹，发现智能体的失败不仅限于命令错误，还涉及任务规格遵循以及规划与执行的鲁棒性。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在自动化网络配置方面越来越受关注，但其可靠性和失败模式尚不清晰。现有基准要么把配置当作静态命令生成，要么依赖过度简化的设置，无法反映网络配置中协议复杂性和拓扑依赖带来的核心挑战，因此需要一个现实且无风险的环境来评估这类智能体。
Method: NetConfArena 将智能体置于仿真的多设备网络中，提供标准化且紧凑的动作接口，并用隐藏的任务特定可执行测试用例评估网络行为。基准构建依赖一个由 LLM 辅助、以仿真为基础的流水线，将面向人类的网络材料转换成可复用的参数化任务模板。
Result: 在 96 个协议聚焦的任务模板实例化出的 480 个任务实例上评估了代表性 LLM 智能体，共生成 3840 条执行轨迹。结果表明失败不仅限于命令错误，还暴露出任务规格遵循不足以及规划和执行不够稳健的问题。
Conclusion: 摘要提出两个未来方向：利用经过验证的轨迹作为监督信号来改进基础模型，以及设计能提升智能体执行可靠性和可问责性的 harness 机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays
papers.abstract_en: In light-field (LF) imaging systems, dense spatial sampling from a camera array enables powerful post-capture capabilities such as refocusing and depth estimation. However, real-world LF capture is often affected by hardware malfunctions, where one or more cameras in the array fail, leading to missing sub-aperture images and degraded reconstruction quality. This paper addresses the problem of defective or missing view restoration in light-field camera arrays. We propose a novel generative framework that synthesizes the absent views by exploiting information from a carefully selected subset of neighboring cameras. These selected images, along with a positional encoding map indicating both their locations and the desired target view, are fed into a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) trained to generate the missing viewpoint in a geometrically consistent manner. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world LF datasets demonstrate that our method produces visually plausible and photometrically accurate reconstructions, outperforming baselines for view interpolation both quantitatively and qualitatively. The proposed framework thus offers a robust and efficient solution for fault-tolerant light-field image acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）的生成式框架，用于恢复光场（light-field）相机阵列中因硬件故障而缺失的视角。方法利用从相邻相机中精心挑选的子集图像，并结合指示位置与目标视角的位置编码图（positional encoding map），生成几何一致的缺失视图。在合成和真实世界光场数据集上的实验表明，该方法在定性和定量上均优于视角插值基线。
Motivation: 真实光场捕获中相机阵列可能因硬件故障导致一个或多个相机失效，产生缺失的子孔径图像并降低重建质量。现有视角插值基线不足以充分恢复这种缺失视图，因此需要容错的重建方案。
Method: 提出生成式框架，从相邻相机中选取子集，将其与表示位置及目标视角的位置编码图一起输入条件生成对抗网络（conditional GAN），训练网络以生成几何一致的缺失视角。
Result: 在合成和真实世界LF数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能生成视觉上合理、光度准确的重建，并在定量和定性上优于视角插值基线。
Conclusion: 该框架为容忍故障的光场图像采集提供了一种鲁棒且高效的解决方案，可处理相机阵列中的缺失视角。摘要未明确提出局限性。

papers.title: BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 in the 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BenthicFlow，一个基于单一条件流匹配 (flow matching) 模型的框架，用于联合生成对齐的纹理图和深度图，从而生成可空间扩展的水下 RGBD 马赛克，无需额外的拼接模型。马赛克随后通过表面对齐的高斯曲面片 (Gaussian surfels) 提升为显式 3D 底栖环境。实验跨多个地理位置不同的调查点，表明该方法能保留各站点特有外观，同时生成与目标分布匹配的大规模 3D 场景。
Motivation: 水下环境的 3D 场景理解因缺乏高质量 3D 数据以及表面训练的模型难以泛化到水下场景而面临挑战。现有方法使用单独训练的模型在事后拼接独立生成的瓦片，且仅在单个调查点内展示异质景观，缺少统一框架。
Method: 采用单一条件流匹配模型联合生成对齐的纹理和深度图；受 MultiDiffusion 启发的采样过程在整个生成轨迹中调和重叠窗口，从而无需独立拼接模型即可生成可扩展的 RGBD 马赛克；随后用表面对齐的高斯曲面片将马赛克提升为显式 3D 底栖环境。
Result: 跨多个地理位置不同的调查站点的实验显示，BenthicFlow 保留了站点特有外观，同时生成连贯的大规模 3D 场景，并密切匹配目标数据分布。摘要未报告具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 该框架的核心贡献是消除对独立拼接模型的需求，用统一生成式流程同时实现纹理、深度对齐与可扩展 3D 场景构建。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, understanding humor remains challenging because humorous content often depends on subtle interactions among entities, events, context, and implicit relationships across image and text modalities. These interactions can involve complex chains of reasoning that are difficult to capture through conventional prompting or linear chain-of-thought reasoning. In this work, we propose CaRGo-T (Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought), a reasoning framework that represents the causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph-based reasoning structure. The graph is serialized into a code-based representation generated by a VLM, which can subsequently be interpreted by the same or a different VLM to produce the final prediction in zero-shot or in-context learning settings. We evaluate CaRGo-T on humor understanding and humor detection across four datasets spanning diverse forms of comedic content, including satire, sarcasm, and memes. Experiments with state-of-the-art commercial and open-source VLMs show that CaRGo-T consistently improves performance over existing reasoning-based baselines, achieving gains of approximately 1-20% on humor understanding and 1-3% on humor detection. Further analysis using mutual information indicates that the reasoning representations produced by CaRGo-T contain more information relevant to the target output than those generated by baseline reasoning approaches. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CaRGo-T（Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought），一种用于多模态幽默理解的推理框架，将幽默内容中实体、事件、语境与跨模态隐式关系背后的因果和上下文联系表示为轻量级图结构。该图被序列化为由 VLM 生成的代码表示，之后由同一或另一个 VLM 解释，在零样本或上下文学习（in-context learning）设置中产生最终预测。在覆盖讽刺、反讽和梗图的四个数据集上，CaRGo-T 相比现有推理基线在幽默理解上提升约 1-20%，在幽默检测上提升约 1-3%。
Motivation: 大规模视觉语言模型（VLM）在多数多模态任务上表现优异，但理解幽默仍具挑战，因为幽默常依赖图像与文本模态间实体、事件、上下文及隐含关系的微妙交互，这类交互涉及复杂推理链，难以被常规提示或线性思维链（chain-of-thought）捕捉。
Method: 提出 CaRGo-T，将多模态幽默中的因果与上下文关系建模为轻量级图推理结构，并把图序列化为代码表示；该表示由 VLM 生成，随后由相同或不同的 VLM 解释以输出最终预测，支持零样本和上下文学习两种设置。
Result: 在涵盖讽刺、反讽和梗图的四个数据集上，结合商业与开源 VLM 的实验显示，CaRGo-T 相比现有推理基线在幽默理解上提升约 1-20%、在幽默检测上提升约 1-3%；互信息（mutual information）分析进一步表明其推理表示包含更多与目标输出相关的信息。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将因果与上下文关系组织为图结构并借助代码序列化可以稳定改进多模态幽默理解与检测，且代码已开源。

papers.title: Counterfactual Transition Graphs: Evaluating Cross-Class Transition Quality
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual (CF) explanations for time-series classifiers are usually evaluated one example at a time: what minimal edit flips this single window's prediction? We argue that the more informative question for diagnostic interpretability is structural: how does the classifier connect its own classes to each other? We propose a counterfactual transition graph (CGT) in which each node is a class and each edge weight is the CF reliability of the transition from one prototype to another under a proximity aware retrieval sweep. On a six-class hand-movement task, we induce a CGT that reveals a non-trivial topology, which is not predicted by the binary confusion matrix: it shows that counterfactual reachability does not align with classifier accuracy and even runs counter to it (Spearman $ρ=-0.37$ over the 15 pairs), i.e. the boundaries the classifier separates most confidently are among those an in-distribution edit can least often cross. Our framework is method agnostic, i.e. any CF-explainers can be used. Presently, we use it to juxtapose replacement-based CFs with gradient-based CFs; gradient-based methods reach almost any class by stepping off the data manifold, while replacement-based methods stay on it and fail on precisely the rigid boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反事实转移图 (counterfactual transition graph, CGT) 来评估时间序列分类器的跨类别反事实转换质量，图中每个节点是一个类别，边权表示从一个原型到另一个原型的反事实可靠性。在六类手部运动任务上，CGT 揭示了与二元混淆矩阵预测不同的非平凡拓扑，并且反事实可达性与分类器准确率不一致甚至相反 (Spearman ρ=-0.37)。框架与具体反事实解释器无关，当前用于并置对比替换型与梯度型反事实方法。
Motivation: 现有时间序列分类器的反事实 (CF) 解释通常逐样本评估单个窗口的最小编辑，忽略了更结构性的诊断问题：分类器如何将其类别相互连接。作者认为需要一种评估跨类别转换质量的结构化视角。
Method: 提出反事实转移图 (CGT)，节点对应类别，边权为在邻近感知检索 (proximity aware retrieval sweep) 下从一个原型到另一个原型转换的反事实可靠性；该框架是方法无关的，可接入任意反事实解释器。
Result: 在六类手部运动任务上，CGT 显示反事实可达性不随分类器准确率对齐甚至与之相反 (15 对中 Spearman ρ=-0.37)，即分类器最自信区分的边界恰是在分布内编辑最难跨越的。对比中，梯度型方法可离开数据流形到达几乎所有类别，而替换型方法留在流形上并在这些刚性边界上失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分类器置信边界与反事实可达性之间存在系统性错位，并指出该框架是方法无关的，适用于并置不同反事实解释器；结论限于所用任务及所对比的替换型与梯度型方法。

papers.title: When More Modalities Hurt: Modality Dropout for Heavy-Duty Vehicle Engine Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Heavy-duty vehicle diagnostics generate three disconnected data modalities: unstructured multi- lingual service complaints, high-dimensional sensor telemetry with over 80% missing values, and Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs). We investigate whether fusing these modalities improves engine component classification on a proprietary dataset from a major truck manufacturer. Through 5-fold cross-validation across multiple model configurations spanning three model families on five engine component classes (885 samples, the full cross-database matched population for this manufacturer), we find that naive fusion provides modest gains over text alone (65.3%). However, modality dropout during training, which randomly disables entire modalities per batch, forces the network to exploit weaker inputs and achieves 68.8% accuracy on text+DTC fusion (weighted F1: 0.67), a 3.5-point improvement over text-only (65.3%, weighted F1: 0.64) and the best result across all methods including logistic regression and gradient-boosted trees. Per-class analysis shows that the dominant modality varies by fault type: text describes symptoms, DTCs encode structured fault signals, and sensors measure physical state. On intake/exhaust faults, sensors alone reach 93% where text achieves 80%. On fuel system faults, fusion with modality dropout nearly triples accuracy from 15% to 38% over text alone. To our knowledge, this is the first application of three-way modality fusion combining text, sensors, and fault codes in industrial vehicle diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重型车辆发动机诊断中三种互不关联的数据模态（非结构化多语言维修投诉文本、缺失率超80%的高维传感器遥测数据、诊断故障码 DTC）的融合效果。基于某卡车制造商专有数据集的 885 个样本、5 折交叉验证和多个模型配置，作者发现训练时随机丢弃整模态（modality dropout）能迫使网络利用较弱输入，在文本+DTC 融合上达到 68.8% 准确率（加权 F1 0.67），比纯文本（65.3%，加权 F1 0.64）提升 3.5 个百分点，且优于逻辑回归和梯度提升树等所有基线。
Motivation: 重型车辆诊断数据包含文本、传感器和故障码三种异构且互不连通的模态，现有工作很少在工业车辆诊断中系统考察三者融合是否能提升发动机部件分类性能。
Method: 作者在训练中引入 modality dropout，即每个 batch 随机禁用整类模态，迫使网络在缺失某些模态时仍能利用较弱输入，从而提升跨模态泛化；并与朴素融合、逻辑回归和梯度提升树等方法对比。
Result: 摘要报告 modality dropout 在文本+DTC 融合上达到 68.8% 准确率（加权 F1 0.67），较纯文本（65.3%，加权 F1 0.64）提高 3.5 点；进气/排气故障上传感器单独达 93%（文本为 80%），燃油系统故障上融合将准确率从 15% 提升至 38%。
Conclusion: 作者指出主导模态随故障类型而变化：文本描述症状、DTC 编码结构化故障信号、传感器反映物理状态；据其所知，这是工业车辆诊断中首次结合文本、传感器和故障码的三模态融合。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Conformal Risk Minimization for Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: In high-stakes healthcare applications, machine learning models are frequently trained on data from one patient population and deployed on another, creating a distribution shift that degrades both accuracy and reliability. Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation (SSDA) addresses this by leveraging labeled data from some source domain to improve model performance on a target domain where labels are scarce. However, existing SSDA methods optimize primarily for point-prediction accuracy and offer no principled uncertainty quantification --- a prerequisite for clinical trust. Conformal Prediction (CP) can address this limitation by providing prediction sets with rigorous, distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, applying CP post-hoc to a pre-trained model can yield prohibitively large prediction sets, as SSDA pre-training methods do not account for the nonconformity score geometry that determines conformal set size. Conformal Risk Minimization (CRM) has been used to resolve this issue in the fully supervised setting by integrating the CP objective directly into model training, but it requires a large labeled dataset to compute nonconformity thresholds during training, precisely the data that is scarce in the SSDA regime. We propose an end-to-end framework that integrates CRM into the SSDA training objective, enabling effective CRM in the limited-labeled-target-data regime. The key idea is to utilize Optimal Transport (OT) to generate pseudolabels for unlabeled target instances, providing the additional training signal needed by CRM to operate using only a small labeled target set. This results in a model jointly optimized for domain invariance and conformal efficiency, producing prediction sets that are compact, coverage-valid, and support domain-specific constraints such as excluding mutually contradictory diagnoses in skin lesion classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端框架，将保形风险最小化（Conformal Risk Minimization, CRM）整合进半监督域适应（Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation, SSDA）的训练目标，并利用最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）为无标签目标域样本生成伪标签，从而在仅有的少量目标域标注数据下训练出预测集紧凑且覆盖有效的模型。摘要以皮肤病变分类中的相互矛盾诊断排除等医疗场景为例，展示该方法同时优化域不变性与保形效率。
Motivation: 现有SSDA方法主要优化点预测精度，缺乏适用于临床信任的不确定性量化；事后应用保形预测（Conformal Prediction）会产生过大的预测集，因为预训练过程没有考虑决定保形集大小的非一致性分数几何。CRM虽能在全监督设定下解决此问题，但其训练需要大量标注数据来计算非一致性阈值，而这正是SSDA场景中稀缺的资源。
Method: 提出将CRM目标直接融入SSDA训练目标，核心思想是用最优传输为无标签目标域样本生成伪标签，提供CRM在小型标注目标集下运行所需的额外训练信号，从而联合优化域不变性和保形效率。
Result: 摘要报告该方法生成的预测集紧凑且覆盖有效，并支持域特定约束，例如在皮肤病变分类中排除相互矛盾的诊断；未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能在目标域标注数据稀缺的SSDA场景下实现有效的保形风险最小化，兼顾域不变性和保形效率。

papers.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The alignment of Large Language Models heavily relies on English-centric high-quality preference data, which often leads to suboptimal performance in other languages. In this paper, we propose Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization (CRPO), a novel framework that leverages robust preference knowledge from English to facilitate preference alignment in the target language. We design a hierarchical structure within parallel preference pairs across the target language and English to jointly optimize intra- and inter-lingual preferences, thereby enhancing language adaptation and output quality. Building on the LambdaLoss framework, CRPO goes beyond the binary comparison based optimization by providing a relative ranking signal across multiple candidate responses. Our experiments across five languages with varying resource scales demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms standard approaches in both instruction-following and knowledge utilization capability. Notably, the robust performance gains observed across various weighting schemes further validate the empirical effectiveness of our hierarchical design in a multilingual setup. Furthermore, our findings highlight that CRPO significantly improves both reward margins and the log-probability of desirable responses, contributing to a more stable preference manifold for cross-lingual alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨语言排序偏好优化 (Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization, CRPO)，利用英语中稳健的偏好知识来促进目标语言的偏好对齐。该方法在目标语言与英语的平行偏好对内设计层次结构，联合优化语言内与跨语言偏好，并基于 LambdaLoss 框架提供多个候选响应的相对排序信号。在五种资源规模不同的语言上的实验显示，CRPO 在指令遵循与知识利用能力上一致优于标准方法，并显著改善奖励边际与期望响应的 log-probability。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型对齐严重依赖以英语为中心的高质量偏好数据，这往往导致模型在其他语言上的表现次优。
Method: 构建目标语言与英语之间平行偏好对的层次结构，同时优化语言内偏好与跨语言偏好；在此基础上扩展 LambdaLoss 框架，从二元比较优化转向多候选响应上的相对排序信号。
Result: 在五种资源规模不同的语言上，CRPO 一致优于标准对齐方法；在不同加权方案下性能增益保持稳健，并显著提升奖励边际 (reward margin) 与期望响应的 log-probability。
Conclusion: 摘要认为层次化的跨语言偏好设计能够贡献更稳定的偏好流形 (preference manifold)，从而增强多语言设置下跨语言对齐的效果。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出跨语言排序偏好优化 (Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization, CRPO)，利用英语中稳健的偏好知识来促进目标语言的偏好对齐。该方法在目标语言与英语的平行偏好对内设计层次结构，联合优化语言内与跨语言偏好，并基于 LambdaLoss 框架提供多个候选响应的相对排序信号。在五种资源规模不同的语言上的实验显示，CRPO 在指令遵循与知识利用能力上一致优于标准方法，并显著改善奖励边际与期望响应的 log-probability。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有大语言模型对齐严重依赖以英语为中心的高质量偏好数据，这往往导致模型在其他语言上的表现次优。
summary_sections.method: 构建目标语言与英语之间平行偏好对的层次结构，同时优化语言内偏好与跨语言偏好；在此基础上扩展 LambdaLoss 框架，从二元比较优化转向多候选响应上的相对排序信号。
summary_sections.result: 在五种资源规模不同的语言上，CRPO 一致优于标准对齐方法；在不同加权方案下性能增益保持稳健，并显著提升奖励边际 (reward margin) 与期望响应的 log-probability。

papers.title: Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding for Low-Bit LLM Weight Repair
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit weight quantization saves storage but leaves errors that degrade language-model quality. We introduce Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding (AWSRC), a compact repair codec for an existing quantization backbone. Given a reconstructed weight $W_0$, AWSRC encodes the residual $W-W_0$ using deterministic seed-generated bases. The sidecar stores seed selectors, low-bit coefficients, and scales rather than an explicit codebook. Activation statistics prioritize errors that affect layer outputs. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adding 0.162 scope-bits/weight to an INT4 RTN backbone closes 88.2%, 78.9%, and 71.3% of the matched PPL, KL, and accuracy gaps to BF16. Repairing a matched strong low-bit backbone also improves all measured quality metrics. With a matched 49.25 MB sidecar, about 0.8% of the BF16 model-weight payload, AWSRC gives the best perplexity and mean task accuracy among sparse, low-rank, and vector-quantized codecs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding (AWSRC)，一种紧凑的修复编解码器，用于低比特 LLM 权重量化的误差补偿。该方法不显式存储码本，而是用确定性种子生成基来编码残差 W-W0，旁路仅保存种子选择器、低比特系数和缩放；激活统计被用来优先修复影响层输出的误差。在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，向 INT4 RTN 骨干添加 0.162 scope-bits/weight 即可分别关闭 88.2%、78.9% 和 71.3% 的与 BF16 相比的 PPL、KL 和准确率差距。在约 49.25 MB 旁路（约占 BF16 模型权重有效载荷的 0.8%）下，AWSRC 在稀疏、低秩和向量量化类修复编解码器中取得最佳困惑度和平均任务准确率。
Motivation: 低比特权重量化虽然节省存储，但会引入降低语言模型质量的误差，需要一种开销极小的修复方案来弥补量化误差。
Method: AWSRC 编码残差 W-W0 时使用确定性种子生成的基，并在旁路存储种子选择器、低比特系数和缩放而非显式码本；同时利用激活统计优先处理对层输出影响较大的权重误差。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，INT4 RTN 骨干添加 0.162 scope-bits/weight 后，与 BF16 的匹配 PPL、KL 和准确率差距分别被关闭 88.2%、78.9% 和 71.3%；在 49.25 MB 匹配旁路（约 BF16 权重有效载荷的 0.8%）下，AWSRC 在稀疏、低秩和向量量化编解码器中获得最佳困惑度和平均任务准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 AWSRC 能以极小的旁路开销显著缩小低比特量化骨干与 BF16 的质量差距，且作为现有量化后端的修复层也能改善一个匹配的强低比特骨干的所有测量质量指标。

papers.title: An end-to-end-trained vision-language model for native-language prostate pathology report generation
papers.abstract_en: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies worldwide, and structured reporting of each biopsy core burdens pathologists. Existing tools frame this as classification, leaving pathologists to assemble coherent reports, while many slide-level vision-language models rely on English-centric encoders that transfer poorly to other clinical languages. We present a slide-level framework generating prostate biopsy reports that is language-independent by construction: tokenizer and model are trained from scratch, demonstrated here in German. To address paired-data scarcity, an automated pipeline uses a locally deployed large language model to split composite reports into core-specific image-text pairs, yielding 17,344 pairs from 2,402 historical cases without manual annotation. Evaluated for clinical attributes rather than linguistic similarity, the model achieves 96.2% F1 for malignancy detection and 65.2% for Gleason grading, competitive with an FDA-cleared classifier. Grading is further validated on three external cohorts with latent-space augmentation. Institutions can thus train native-language reporting models on their own archives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端训练的、语言无关的 slide-level 视觉-语言模型，用于生成前列腺活检报告，并在德语上演示。作者利用本地部署的大语言模型将复合报告自动拆分为 core-specific 图像-文本对，得到 17,344 对（来自 2,402 个历史病例）且无需人工标注。模型按临床属性评估，恶性检测 F1 达 96.2%，Gleason 分级为 65.2%，并通过潜在空间增强在三个外部队列中验证分级效果。
Motivation: 前列腺癌活检的结构化报告负担沉重，现有工具多被框定为分类任务，需要病理学家自行组织成连贯报告；同时许多 slide-level 视觉-语言模型依赖英语中心的编码器，向其他临床语言迁移效果差。
Method: 提出一个语言无关的框架：tokenizer 与模型均从头训练，不以某种语言为中心，示范语言为德语。为缓解配对数据稀缺，自动化流程使用本地部署的 LLM 将复合报告拆分为 core-specific 的图像-文本对，最终从 2,402 个历史病例得到 17,344 对，无需人工标注；外部队列验证中采用潜在空间增强（latent-space augmentation）。
Result: 模型在恶性检测上达到 96.2% F1，在 Gleason 分级上达到 65.2%，与 FDA 批准的分类器相当；Gleason 分级在三个外部队列上进一步得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，机构可以用自己档案中的数据训练母语报告生成模型，且该方法在构建上语言无关、无需人工标注即可扩展。

papers.title: How Merge-Tolerant Are Vision Transformers for Wheat Phenotyping?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based wheat phenotyping requires repeated measurements under deployment constraints, from growth-stage recognition to wheat-head counting and organ segmentation. Plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) provide a common architecture for these tasks, but quadratic attention limits high-throughput and edge inference. Training-free token merging is attractive because it can be inserted into trained models without retraining. We provide a systematic benchmark of ToMe and Mutual Pair Merging across growth-stage classification, wheat-head detection, and wheat-organ segmentation, measuring task quality, throughput, token count, and peak GPU memory, with additional Raspberry Pi 5 measurements. The benchmark reveals a clear hierarchy: classification is highly merge-tolerant, while detection and segmentation are constrained by repeated instances, thin organs, dense boundaries, reconstruction, and runtime overhead. Optimized attention backends can erase apparent speedups, so deployment value must be profiled on the target runtime rather than inferred from token count.
papers.comment: Accepted to the CVPPA workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对两种无需训练的 token 合并方法 ToMe 和 Mutual Pair Merging 在小麦表型分析任务上做了系统基准测试，覆盖生长阶段分类、麦穗检测和小麦器官分割，测量任务质量、吞吐量、token 数量和峰值 GPU 内存，并补充 Raspberry Pi 5 的实测。结果表明分类任务对合并高度容忍，而检测和分割受重复实例、细长器官、密集边界、重建和运行开销限制；优化后的 attention 后端可能抹平表观加速，因此部署价值需在目标运行时上实测。
Motivation: 基于视觉的小麦表型分析需要在部署约束下进行重复测量，而普通 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的二次复杂度 attention 限制了高通量和边缘推理；无训练 token 合并可插入已训练模型而无需重训练，因此有吸引力。
Method: 对 ToMe 与 Mutual Pair Merging 在生长阶段分类、麦穗检测、麦穗分割三类任务上进行系统基准，对比任务质量、吞吐量、token 数与峰值 GPU 内存，并包含 Raspberry Pi 5 上的额外测量。
Result: 基准显示明确层级：分类高度可合并，检测与分割则受重复实例、细薄器官、密集边界、重建及运行时开销制约；优化后的 attention 后端可能抵消表观速度提升，即 token 数减少并不直接等价于实际加速。
Conclusion: 作者强调 token 合并的部署价值必须在目标运行时上分析，而不能仅依据 token 数量推断。

papers.title: MIVIFI: Bridging Perspective and Fisheye Domains for Training Multi-View Fisheye Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Achieving 360° coverage is critical for the visual perception systems of autonomous vehicles. Fisheye cameras offer a cost-effective solution by enabling full surround coverage with as few as two sensors. However, existing multi-view fisheye datasets are limited, and synthesizing rare corner cases typically requires computationally expensive 3D simulations, hindering the training. While generative models have achieved significant success in standard perspective imagery, their application to wide-angle distortion remains unexplored. In this work, we formally introduce the novel problem of multi-view fisheye image generation conditioned on volumetric semantic representations and present two distinct methods. We first propose SyntheOcc-FE, which adapts the SyntheOcc architecture to fisheye data. While effective, this method is constrained by the scarcity of fisheye datasets, which limits its generalization. To overcome these limitations, we propose our second method, MIVIFI (multi-view fisheye), which leverages cross-domain learning with Equirectangular Projections. By bridging the gap between dataset domains using KITTI-360 fisheye images alongside nuScenes multi-view standard images, our approach enables high-fidelity manipulation of scene content. This framework enables the structural modification of semantic occupancy inputs to introduce or eliminate specific actors and facilitates the rendering of diverse meteorological conditions and illumination scenarios absent in the limited fisheye datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our methods achieve robust photorealistic multi-view fisheye image generation and highlight the specific advantages of our cross-domain strategy for handling data scarcity.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文正式提出多视角鱼眼图像生成问题，条件为体素语义表示 (volumetric semantic representations)，并给出两种方法：一是 SyntheOcc-FE，将 SyntheOcc 架构适配到鱼眼数据；二是 MIVIFI (multi-view fisheye)，利用等距柱状投影 (Equirectangular Projections) 做跨域学习，用 KITTI-360 鱼眼图像与 nuScenes 多视角标准图像桥接数据集域差距。摘要称该方法能高保真操纵场景内容、增删特定目标，并渲染鱼眼数据集中缺失的气象与光照条件。
Motivation: 自动驾驶感知需要 360° 覆盖，鱼眼相机用少量传感器即可实现，但现有多视角鱼眼数据集稀缺，合成罕见 corner case 通常依赖昂贵的 3D 仿真；生成模型在标准透视图像上成功，却未应用于广角畸变场景。
Method: 提出两种方法：SyntheOcc-FE 将 SyntheOcc 生成架构适配到鱼眼数据，但受限于鱼眼数据集稀缺；MIVIFI 采用跨域学习，利用 KITTI-360 鱼眼图像和 nuScenes 多视角标准图像，通过等距柱状投影桥接域差距，并基于语义占用输入的结构修改实现场景内容增删与天气、光照渲染。
Result: 定量与定性实验表明两种方法都能生成鲁棒的逼真多视角鱼眼图像，并突出跨域策略在处理数据稀缺性方面的优势。
Conclusion: 跨域学习策略能够缓解鱼眼数据集稀缺的限制，实现多视角鱼眼图像的逼真生成与场景内容编辑，并渲染训练数据中不存在的气象和光照条件。

papers.title: Pointing-VLA: Typed Spatial Grounding Interfaces for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often expose spatial grounding through autoregressive text coordinates or opaque action tokens, creating brittle interfaces between multimodal reasoning and robot execution. We present Pointing-VLA, a typed hidden-state spatial readout built on Embodied-R1. Geometry-specific heads predict normalized points, object-functional grounding (OFG) heatmaps, and visual trajectories without serializing geometry as text. For the evaluated Bridge/WidowX and physical pick-place deployments, an explicit execution contract assigns PICK to source-conditioned OFG and PLACE to Pointing, providing direct stage-aligned spatial targets. Pointing-VLA achieves SOTA performance on Bridge/WidowX, averaging 72.9\% across the evaluated four-task set without Bridge-specific finetuning under collision-enabled CuRobo execution. Pointing and OFG show complementary strengths across native and cross-dataset evaluations. The OFG/contact readout transfers to NORA-1.5, preserving or improving success while reducing recorded controller time by more than 20$\times$; typed heads are also 6.68--6.90$\times$ faster than Embodied-R1 text decoding on a shared external suite. When integrated as spatial guidance for a $π_{0.5}$ action policy, Pointing-VLA raises autonomous real-robot success from 52.7\% to 80.7\% across three visual contexts. These results establish typed spatial readouts as an efficient, inspectable interface between embodied reasoning and robot execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pointing-VLA，一种构建在 Embodied-R1 上的 typed hidden-state 空间读出接口，用几何专用头预测归一化点、物体功能接地 (OFG) 热图和视觉轨迹，而不是把空间信息序列化成文本。在 Bridge/WidowX 与真实 pick-place 部署中，显式执行契约把 PICK 分配给源条件 OFG、PLACE 分配给 Pointing，提供与阶段对齐的空间目标。摘要报告 Pointing-VLA 在 Bridge/WidowX 上取得 SOTA，四任务平均 72.9%（无 Bridge 专用微调、启用碰撞的 CuRobo 执行），并作为空间引导将 π0.5 策略的真实机器人成功率从 52.7% 提升到 80.7%。

Result: 在 Bridge/WidowX 上实现 SOTA，四任务平均 72.9%；OFG/接触读出迁移到 NORA-1.5 后保持或提升成功率，同时将已记录控制器时间减少超过 20 倍；typed heads 在共享外部套件上比 Embodied-R1 文本解码快 6.68–6.90 倍；集成到 π0.5 动作策略后，真实机器人成功率从 52.7% 提高到 80.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 typed spatial readouts 是一种高效且可检查的接口，能连接具身推理与机器人执行；Pointing 与 OFG 在原生和跨数据集评估中表现出互补优势。

papers.title: A Simulator-Grounded Framework For Constructing Verifiable Muscle-Grounded QA From 3D Tongue Meshes
papers.abstract_en: Existing articulatory corpora based on real-time MRI and electromagnetic articulography capture tongue shape and motion but do not provide traceable labels for the muscle-driven process that generated an observed configuration. We introduce a simulator-grounded data-construction framework and instantiate it as 3DTongueQA. Controlled 11-dimensional muscle activations are mapped to fixed-topology tongue meshes with the ArtiSynth Badin finite-element model, converted into structured biomechanical records, and rendered as deterministic QA on muscle state, geometry, and target-directed change. We screen 295,157 configurations, retain 295,115 valid meshes, and construct 891,156 QA records per language. Language naturalization changes only surface form and is verified against the source records; English and Korean instantiations demonstrate construction-level portability. A swappable SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B baseline reaches 62.9 $\pm$ 9.2 Muscle EM, 74.0 $\pm$ 0.2 Value Accuracy, and 65.9 $\pm$ 4.7 Direction EM, while mismatching the paired mesh reduces Muscle EM to 2.2; a dataset-leakage-controlled anchor-held-out model retains 80.4--98.6\% of the full-inventory scores on unseen anchors. Task-specific structured readouts further reach 88.7 $\pm$ 0.7 Muscle EM and 93.3 $\pm$ 1.0 Direction EM. These complementary results show that the constructed supervision supports both efficient structured prediction and heterogeneous natural-language QA rather than being tied to a particular decoder architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于模拟器 (simulator-grounded) 的数据构建框架，并实例化为 3DTongueQA：用 ArtiSynth Badin 有限元模型将受控的 11 维肌肉激活映射到固定拓扑的舌网格，转换为结构化生物力学记录，再渲染为关于肌肉状态、几何和定向变化的确定性 QA。研究筛选了 295,157 个配置并保留 295,115 个有效网格，每种语言构建出 891,156 条 QA 记录；英文和韩文实例展示了构建层面的可移植性。摘要还报告了 SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B 基线在多个指标上的结果，显示该监督既支持结构化预测也支持自然语言 QA。
Motivation: 现有基于实时 MRI 和电磁发音成像 (electromagnetic articulography) 的发音语料库虽然捕捉了舌形与运动，但没有为产生观测配置的肌肉驱动过程提供可追踪的标签，因此难以支撑可验证的肌肉级 QA。
Method: 提出模拟器驱动的数据构建框架：将受控的 11 维肌肉激活通过 ArtiSynth Badin 有限元模型映射为固定拓扑舌网格，再转成结构化生物力学记录并渲染为确定性 QA；语言自然化只改变表面形式，并对照源记录进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告筛选 295,157 个配置、保留 295,115 个有效网格，每种语言构建 891,156 条 QA；SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B 基线达到 62.9 ± 9.2 Muscle EM、74.0 ± 0.2 Value Accuracy、65.9 ± 4.7 Direction EM，而错配配对网格会使 Muscle EM 降至 2.2；受数据泄漏控制的 anchor-held-out 模型在未见 anchor 上保留全量库存分数的 80.4%–98.6%，任务特定结构化读出达到 88.7 ± 0.7 Muscle EM 和 93.3 ± 1.0 Direction EM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所构建的监督既能支持高效的结构化预测，也能支持异构的自然语言 QA，并不依赖特定解码器架构；英文和韩文实例表明该框架具有构建级可移植性。

papers.title: Bridge Damage Detection from Low-Light UAV Imagery via Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Poor illumination obscures small, low-contrast defects in UAV bridge imagery, reducing the reliability and operational flexibility of automated inspection. This paper investigates whether degradation-aware image restoration can improve bridge damage detection under low-light conditions and transfer from synthetic degradations to real inspection scenes. We propose DaL- MoE, a detector-agnostic restoration front end trained with an ISP-aware low-light synthesis pipeline and equipped with degradation-aware guidance estimation and complementary experts for noise suppression, color adjustment, and structural-detail recovery. On paired synthetic data, DaL-MoE achieves 23.12 dB PSNR and 0.8482 SSIM, increasing YOLOv11m box mAP50 from 0.3097 to 0.4923 and mask mAP50 from 0.2281 to 0.3529. On real low-light UAV imagery without paired normal-light references, sim-to-real evaluation shows improved defect visibility and more complete detections than direct inference on raw low-light inputs. Future work will develop low-light-aware bridge damage detectors with stronger cross-scene generalization across bridge sites, imaging conditions, and illumination levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低光照 UAV 桥梁图像中的损伤检测问题，提出检测器无关的复原前端 DaL-MoE，配合 ISP 感知的低光合成流程与退化感知的专家路由。在成对合成数据上，该方法将 YOLOv11m 的 box mAP50 从 0.3097 提升至 0.4923，mask mAP50 从 0.2281 提升至 0.3529，并在真实低光 UAV 图像上通过 sim-to-real 评估改善了缺陷可见性与检测完整性。
Motivation: 低光照会掩盖 UAV 桥梁图像中尺寸小、对比度低的缺陷，降低自动检测的可靠性和作业灵活性，因此需要研究退化感知的图像复原能否提升低光条件下的桥梁损伤检测性能。
Method: 提出 DaL-MoE，作为检测器无关的复原前端，采用 ISP 感知的低光合成流程进行训练，并配备退化感知的引导估计和互补专家模块，分别处理噪声抑制、色彩调整和结构细节恢复。
Result: 在成对合成数据上达到 23.12 dB PSNR 和 0.8482 SSIM；YOLOv11m 的 box mAP50 从 0.3097 提升到 0.4923，mask mAP50 从 0.2281 提升到 0.3529。在无成对正常光参考的真实低光 UAV 图像上，sim-to-real 评估显示缺陷可见性增强且检测更完整。
Conclusion: 摘要认为退化感知的复原前端能改善低光 UAV 桥梁损伤检测，并指出未来将开发低光感知的损伤检测器，以增强跨桥梁场地、成像条件和光照水平的跨场景泛化能力。

papers.title: LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space
papers.abstract_en: Personalized text generation for authors and literary writing is essential for applications such as adaptive writing assistants, creative support tools, and computational literary analysis. However, existing approaches to author modeling and personalization often represent writing behavior as independent labels, requiring large-scale corpus collection or fine-tuning for each author or stylistic category. Such formulations are costly, difficult to interpret, and poorly suited for generalizing across authors. Inspired by the Big Five model's dimensional view of personality, we propose LiteraryBigFive, a framework that reframes authorial writing characteristics as coordinates within a unified and interpretable space. In this space, we derive each interpretable axis (e.g., Classicism, Emotionality) from activation-space contrasts between author-written and neutral passages, yielding distinct stylistic dimensions that allow texts or authors to be positioned within a five-dimensional system. Beyond localizing different authors, we further introduce an interpretable steering mechanism, which adaptively guides text generation toward target coordinates to perform author-personalized writing. Experimental results show that LiteraryBigFive improves authorial expressiveness while preserving semantic fidelity. The derived author per-axis scores strongly correlate with real-world literary consensus, offering transparent and interpretable explanations of author-specific generation behavior: https://github.com/Znull-1220/LiteraryBigFive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiteraryBigFive，一个将作者写作风格表示为统一可解释五维空间中坐标的框架，灵感来自人格心理学的大五模型。该方法通过作者文本与中性文本在激活空间中的对比来定义每个解释轴（如 Classicism、Emotionality），并引入可解释的引导机制，使文本生成向目标坐标移动以实现作者个性化写作。实验显示该方法在提升作者风格表现力的同时保持语义保真度，且作者各轴得分与真实文学共识高度相关。
Motivation: 现有作者建模与个性化方法通常将写作行为表示为独立标签，需要为每位作者或风格类别收集大规模语料或进行微调，成本高、难以解释，且跨作者泛化能力差。
Method: 借鉴大五人格模型的维度化观点，将作者写作特征定义为统一可解释空间中的坐标；每个可解释轴通过作者所写段落与中性段落的激活空间对比得出，并设计一个自适应的可解释引导机制，在生成过程中将文本引向目标坐标以完成作者个性化写作。
Result: 实验表明 LiteraryBigFive 在提升作者风格表现力（authorial expressiveness）的同时保持了语义保真度；推导出的作者各轴得分与真实文学共识强烈相关。
Conclusion: 该框架为作者特定生成行为提供了透明、可解释的解释，适用于自适应写作助手、创意支持工具和计算文学分析等场景。

papers.title: Statistical Machine Translation Systems of English-Pnar Language Pair : Some Insights of the Emperical Study
papers.abstract_en: Pnar, an Austroasiatic language spoken by approximately 0.4 million people in the Jaintia Hills of Meghalaya, lacks the digital corpora and natural language processing (NLP) resources. This paper presents the first machine translation study for the English and Pnar language pair. Using articles collected from the Wyrta newspaper, we built a parallel corpus comprising of 10,234 sentences and trained phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) systems the models using 9,563 parallel corpora under three configurations for each direction using Moses, GIZA++ , KenLM, varying lexicalized reordering and minimum error rate training (MERT) tuning. The models are evaluated on a held out test set of 371 sentences, the best performing system achieves a BLEU score of 14.97 (chrF2: 33.42, TER: 77.60) for Pnar to English and 11.16 (chrF2: 31.38, TER: 93.51) for English to Pnar, establishing the first quantitative benchmark for this language pair. Lexicalized reordering improves translation quality by 3.73 BLEU points for Pnar to English, reflecting the structural shift from the source language's SOV word order to the target language's SVO order, whereas MERT tuning degrades BLEU performance under low resource conditions. Finally, we analyze the remaining translation errors, including morphological out of vocabulary (OOV) words, long-distance reordering and Khasi code mixing and discuss future directions toward neural and multilingual machine translation for Pnar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次针对英语和 Pnar 语（印度梅加拉亚邦约 40 万人使用的 Austroasiatic 语系低资源语言）开展机器翻译研究。作者从 Wyrta 报纸收集文章构建了 10,234 句平行语料，使用 Moses 在三种配置下训练基于短语的统计机器翻译（SMT）系统，并在 371 句测试集上评估，最佳系统在 Pnar→英语方向取得 BLEU 14.97，在英语→Pnar 方向取得 BLEU 11.16，为该语言对建立了首个定量基准。
Motivation: Pnar 语缺乏数字语料库和自然语言处理资源，此前没有任何英语-Pnar 机器翻译研究；该工作旨在填补这一空白，并为后续神经机器翻译和多语言模型提供基础。
Method: 利用 Wyrta 报纸文章构建平行语料（10,234 句），训练时使用 9,563 句平行语料，基于 Moses 框架并搭配 GIZA++ 词对齐和 KenLM 语言模型，通过变化词汇化重排序（lexicalized reordering）和最小错误率训练（MERT）调参形成三种配置，最后在 371 句测试集上评估。
Result: 最佳配置下 Pnar→英语的 BLEU 为 14.97（chrF2: 33.42，TER: 77.60），英语→Pnar 的 BLEU 为 11.16（chrF2: 31.38，TER: 93.51）。词汇化重排序在 Pnar→英语方向提升 3.73 BLEU，反映了源语言 SOV 到目标语言 SVO 的结构变化；而低资源条件下 MERT 调参会降低 BLEU。

papers.title: Quantum Reservoir Computing with Physics-Informed Correction for Reduced-Order PDE Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We study a hybrid proposal--correction architecture for reduced-order PDE forecasting in which a pure-state quantum reservoir computer (QRC) predicts latent coefficient dynamics and a PINN-based physics-informed corrector (PIC) refines local rollout windows. The method is evaluated on Burgers and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS), with KS as the primary chaotic benchmark. On KS, QRC+PIC consistently improves over QRC alone in RMSE, NRMSE, and PDE residual, while Burgers highlights a regime in which simple baselines remain strong. These results suggest that QRC proposals with local physics-informed correction are a viable benchmark-dependent reduced-order forecasting strategy.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at QNRL@WCCI 2026. To appear in Advances in Quantum Neural and Reinforcement Learning, Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol. 3063, Springer Singapore, 2026
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Quantum Neural and Reinforcement Learning, Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol. 3063, Springer Singapore, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于降阶PDE预报的混合提案-校正（proposal-correction）架构：纯态量子储层计算（QRC）负责预测潜在系数动力学，基于PINN的物理信息校正器（PIC）对局部滚动窗口进行细化。方法在Burgers和Kuramoto-Sivashinsky（KS）方程上评估，其中KS是主要混沌基准；在KS上QRC+PIC相对单独QRC在RMSE、NRMSE和PDE残差上持续改进，而Burgers则展示了一个简单基线仍然很强的区间。
Motivation: 混沌PDE的降阶预报中，单纯量子储层计算对潜变量动力学的预测精度有限，需要物理约束来修正局部滚动误差，因此作者研究混合量子-经典校正架构的可行性。
Method: 采用两阶段混合架构：QRC先生成潜在系数的预测提案，再由基于PINN的PIC对局部的滚动预报窗口进行物理信息校正，从而结合量子计算的表示能力与物理方程约束。
Result: 在KS混沌基准上，QRC+PIC在RMSE、NRMSE和PDE残差上均一致优于单独QRC；在Burgers上，简单基线仍有竞争力，说明收益依赖具体问题区间。
Conclusion: 作者认为量子储层计算提案配合局部物理信息校正是一种可行但依赖基准的降阶预报策略，性能优势并非普遍成立。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: DeMixPert: Decomposed Response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for OOD Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptome-wide responses to unseen genetic perturbations remains a major computational challenge because accurate prediction requires recovering both perturbation-specific transcriptional shifts and heterogeneous cellular responses. Existing methods often entangle deterministic response structure with stochastic population-level variation, causing dominant shared patterns to mask weaker perturbation-specific signals and impair distributional modeling. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{DeMixPert}, an approach for Decomposed response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) single-cell Perturbation prediction. DeMixPert decomposes perturbation-induced changes into a basal-state-dependent systematic response, a perturbation-specific response, and population-level variation. The systematic component is derived from the basal state encoded from control-cell expression, whereas the perturbation-specific component is inferred from pretrained target embeddings for unseen-target generalization. DeMixPert models population-level variation using a Gaussian prototype Invertible Network and adaptively combines reusable Gaussian prototypes according to the basal state and perturbation condition. The resulting mixture is mapped to a condition-specific variation distribution. Sampled variations are integrated with the systematic and perturbation-specific components, followed by joint decoding with the basal state to reconstruct perturbed-cell gene expression. Experimental results show that DeMixPert effectively captures heterogeneous single-cell perturbation responses and achieves superior performance across unseen-perturbation settings. The source code is made publicly available upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeMixPert，用于未见扰动 (unseen perturbation) 的单细胞转录组响应预测。该方法将扰动引起的表达变化分解为依赖于基底状态 (basal state) 的系统性响应、扰动特异性响应和群体水平变异，并用高斯原型可逆网络 (Gaussian prototype Invertible Network) 建模群体变异，最终联合解码重建扰动后细胞基因表达。摘要报告该方法能有效捕捉异质性单细胞响应，并在多种未见扰动设定下取得更优性能。
Motivation: 预测未见过基因扰动的全转录组响应很困难，因为既要恢复扰动特异性的转录变化，又要刻画异质性的细胞响应。现有方法常将确定性响应结构与随机群体水平变异混在一起，使主导的共享模式掩盖较弱的扰动特异性信号，损害分布建模。
Method: DeMixPert 将扰动诱导的变化分解为基底状态依赖的系统性响应、扰动特异性响应和群体水平变异三部分。系统性响应来自对照细胞表达编码的基底状态，扰动特异性响应由预训练的目标嵌入推断以支持未见扰动泛化；群体水平变异用高斯原型可逆网络建模，并根据基底状态和扰动条件自适应组合可复用的高斯原型，映射到条件特异性变异分布。采样得到的变异与系统性和扰动特异性成分整合后，与基底状态联合解码重建扰动细胞的基因表达。
Result: 实验表明 DeMixPert 能有效捕捉异质性的单细胞扰动响应，并在跨未见扰动设定（unseen-perturbation settings）下取得优于对比方法的性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将响应分解为系统性、扰动特异性和群体变异三部分有助于提升 OOD 扰动预测；源码将在发表后公开提供。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Molecular LLM Agents: From Architectural Design to Scientific Autonomy
papers.abstract_en: Molecular science represents an important frontier for LLM-based agents. Unlike general agents that mainly operate over natural language, code, or web environments, molecular LLM agents must perceive, reason about, and act upon chemical objects across symbolic strings, molecular graphs, 3D conformations, spectra, simulations, and wet-lab measurements. Their capabilities depend on chemically faithful molecular perception, an LLM-centered agent framework, domain-specific tool grounding, and computational or experimental feedback, in addition to planning and tool use. This work develops a conceptual framework for molecular LLM agents from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce an architectural view of molecular-agent design, covering molecular representation and perception, the agent framework, domain-specific toolboxes, and learning and optimization. Second, we propose a scientific autonomy ladder inspired by staged autonomy in engineering systems, categorizing agents into four levels: L1 assistive or fixed workflows, L2 adaptive computational agents, L3 feedback-aware physical experiment agents, and L4 scientific-agenda agents. Together, these two perspectives establish a comprehensive framework for comparing existing molecular LLM agents, identifying missing capabilities and deployment risks, and guiding the design, evaluation, and deployment of future agents in molecular discovery workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向分子科学的大语言模型智能体（molecular LLM agents）的概念框架，从两个互补视角展开：一是架构设计，覆盖分子表示与感知、以LLM为中心的智能体框架、领域专用工具箱以及学习与优化；二是借鉴工程系统分级自主性提出的科学自主性阶梯，将智能体分为L1辅助/固定流程、L2自适应计算、L3反馈感知物理实验和L4科学议程四层。摘要未涉及具体实验，属于概念性框架工作。
Motivation: 分子科学中的LLM智能体需要处理符号字符串、分子图、3D构象、光谱、模拟和湿实验测量等多种化学对象，与主要面向自然语言、代码或网页环境的通用智能体存在本质差异，现有工作缺乏统一的比较与设计框架。
Method: 构建分子智能体的架构视角，涵盖分子表示与感知、LLM为核心的智能体框架、领域专用工具和训练优化；同时提出基于工程系统分级自主性的科学自主性阶梯，将智能体划分为L1到L4四个层级。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，仅提出概念框架与分类体系。
Conclusion: 该框架可用于比较现有分子LLM智能体、识别缺失能力与部署风险，并为分子发现流程中智能体的设计、评估和部署提供指导。

papers.title: Training-Free Pseudo-Fusion for Composed Image Retrieval with Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an emerging paradigm in content-based image retrieval that enables users to formulate compositional queries by combining a reference image with an auxiliary modality, usually text-based. This approach supports fine-grained search where the target image shares structural elements with the user-provided image while incorporating the modifications specified by the auxiliary text. Conventional CIR methods rely on multimodal fusion to combine visual and textual features into a joint query embedding, which requires training modules that align composed queries with the targets. In this work, we propose PeFuse (for pseudo-fusion), a training-free framework that leverages pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models to bridge modalities via generative conversion. We introduce two novel strategies: uni-directional and bi-directional conversion, which convert CIR into four single-modality retrieval problems. These methods reformulate CIR as either intra-modal or cross-modal single-query retrieval tasks, bypassing the need for dedicated task-specific training. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that converting CIR into text-to-image retrieval tasks is more effective than alternative conversion strategies, achieving competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining high flexibility thanks to replaceable components of the conversion pipeline. These results highlight the effectiveness of the pseudo-fusion paradigm for zero-shot CIR. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/StevenXuf/PeFuse4CIR.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PeFuse，一种无需训练的伪融合 (pseudo-fusion) 框架，用于组合图像检索 (CIR)，借助预训练扩散模型 (Diffusion Models) 和多模态大语言模型 (Multimodal Large Language Models) 通过生成式转换桥接模态。作者提出单向与双向转换两种策略，将 CIR 转化为四个单模态检索问题，从而绕过任务专属训练。标准基准实验表明，将 CIR 转换为文到图检索任务最为有效，性能与现有最先进方法相当或更优，并因转换管线组件可替换而保持高灵活性。
Motivation: 传统 CIR 方法依赖多模态融合来将视觉与文本特征组合成联合查询嵌入，需要训练专门模块使组合查询与目标对齐，训练成本高。本文希望利用现成的预训练生成模型，在不进行任务专属训练的情况下完成零样本 CIR。
Method: 提出 PeFuse 框架，引入 uni-directional 与 bi-directional conversion 两种新策略，把 CIR 重构为模态内或跨模态的单查询检索任务，并通过生成式转换替代显式多模态融合。转换管线中的组件可替换，使框架具备灵活性。
Result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，将 CIR 转换成 text-to-image 检索任务比其他转换策略更有效，能够取得与最先进方法相当或更优的性能，同时保持零样本 CIR 下的竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为伪融合范式对零样本 CIR 有效，并公开代码。摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 0
