papers.title: PolyChirp: Multi-Species Birdsong Classification Using TinyML on Low-Power Acoustic Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in the field of TinyML has demonstrated that low-power hardware based on microcontrollers can achieve bird species monitoring in real time based on acoustic sensor data for an entire breeding period on a single battery charge. However, the state of the art on low-power microcontrollers was so far limited to binary classification of a single species. In contrast, real fauna monitoring deployments often target multiple species simultaneously. To address this challenge we develop PolyChirp, an approach combining biological domain expertise, automated dataset curation, neural architecture optimization and novel hardware to achieve multiclass bird species detection in the wild. PolyChirp is based on newly designed tiny multiclass models that leverage recent microcontrollers and hardware acceleration with a neural processing unit (NPU). We evaluate the predictive performance of these models, and we measure their computational performance -- memory footprint, latency, energy consumption -- on common microcontroller hardware. Our results demonstrate that PolyChirp not only outperforms state-of-the-art on single species binary classification, but also achieves robust classification of up to 10 species simultaneously, while still fitting with the resource envelope of a sensor that must remain operational in the field for a full season on a single battery charge.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on the Internet of Sounds (IS2) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyChirp，一种面向低功耗声学传感器的多物种鸟类鸣声分类方法，结合生物学领域知识、自动化数据集整理、神经架构优化与新型微控制器硬件（含 NPU 加速）。摘要报告其不仅超越单物种二分类的现有最优水平，还可在保持单次电池充电覆盖整个繁殖期的资源约束下，稳健分类多达 10 个物种。
Motivation: 现有低功耗微控制器上的鸟类监测虽能实时运行整个繁殖期，但仅限于单一物种的二分类，而真实动物监测部署通常需要同时识别多个物种，这一能力缺口限制了 TinyML 声学监测的实际应用。
Method: PolyChirp 将生物领域知识、自动化数据集整理、神经架构优化与新型硬件结合，设计了基于最新微控制器和神经网络处理单元（NPU）硬件加速的微型多类模型，并同时评估其预测性能与计算性能（内存占用、延迟、能耗）。
Result: 摘要显示 PolyChirp 在单物种二分类上超越现有技术水平，并实现对多达 10 个物种的稳健同时分类，同时仍满足传感器单次电池充电在野外运行一整季的资源预算。
Conclusion: 作者认为多物种鸟类检测可以在低功耗声学传感器上实现，且不牺牲长期现场部署所需的资源约束，为真实生态监测提供了可行的 TinyML 方案。

papers.title: Shaping the Evolutionary Dynamics of Robot Morphology via Adaptive Control Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robot co-design via bi-level optimization couples within-lifetime controller learning for fitness evaluation with cross-generational morphological evolution. Prior work has established that well-adapted morphology facilitates faster control learning, a property termed morphological intelligence. Yet how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution remains unexplored. This paper examines both directions for a holistic account of brain-body interplay. We first show that morphological contributions to control learning decouple into two orthogonal dimensions. We formalize the convergence speed as morphological intelligence and identify the performance ceiling as a complementary quantity termed true potential. A concise functional relation is then established to jointly characterize both quantities from individual learning curves, which, when aggregated at the population level, capture evolutionary profiles. Through extensive experiments on simulated voxel-based soft robots, we reveal that premature fitness evaluation systematically underestimates true potential and biases selection towards fast learners. This restricts design space exploration, compromising both optimization efficiency and morphological diversity. Notably, the widely recognized morphological Baldwin effect emerges as an artifact of this bias rather than a general evolutionary tendency. We therefore propose AdaControl, which monitors disproportionate selection for morphological intelligence during evolution and allocates minimally sufficient control learning for unbiased fitness evaluation. With AdaControl, a simple genetic algorithm rivals state-of-the-art generative-model-based co-design methods in discovering diverse high-performing designs while cutting computation by up to 80% versus exhaustive control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器人大脑-身体协同设计中，控制学习如何反过来塑造形态进化。作者将形态对控制学习的贡献解耦为两个正交维度，把收敛速度形式化为形态智能 (morphological intelligence)，把性能上限定义为真实潜力 (true potential)，并提出 AdaControl 方法以自适应分配最小充分控制学习，避免过早适应度评估造成的选择偏差。在模拟体素软体机器人实验中，简单遗传算法配合 AdaControl 能媲美基于生成模型的最先进协同设计方法，同时最多节省约 80% 的计算开销。
Motivation: 已有工作确立了良好适配的形态有助于加速控制学习（即形态智能），但控制学习如何反过来影响形态进化尚未被探索。本文希望给出大脑-身体相互作用的整体解释，并指出过早的适应度评估会系统性地低估真实潜力并使选择偏向快速学习者，从而限制设计空间探索。
Method: 作者将形态对控制学习的贡献解耦为收敛速度与性能上限两个正交维度，分别刻画为形态智能和真实潜力，并用一个简洁的函数关系从个体学习曲线中联合表征二者，再在种群层面聚合得到进化特征。在此基础上提出 AdaControl：在进化过程中监测对形态智能的不成比例选择，并分配最小充分 (minimally sufficient) 的控制学习量以实现无偏适应度评估。
Result: 在模拟体素软体机器人 (voxel-based soft robots) 上的大量实验表明，过早适应度评估会系统性地低估真实潜力，并将选择偏向快速学习者，损害优化效率与形态多样性；被广泛认可的形态鲍德温效应 (morphological Baldwin effect) 实际上是这种偏差的产物而非一般进化趋势。AdaControl 配合简单遗传算法能够匹敌基于生成模型的协同设计方法，发现多样且高性能的设计，同时相比穷举式控制最多减少约 80% 的计算量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，控制学习会反向塑造形态进化，自适应地分配控制学习量可以实现无偏的适应度评估，从而兼顾设计发现效率与形态多样性。方法的验证场景为模拟体素软体机器人，摘要未涉及真实机器人或超出该场景的泛化性说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Jiuge-Tuiqiao: An Interpretable Human-AI System for Classical Chinese Poetry Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Classical Chinese poetry composition has long valued Tuiqiao, the iterative refinement of words, imagery, and prosody. However, many current AI poetry systems follow a one-shot generation paradigm, which reduces users to prompt providers and weakens their creative agency. We present Jiuge-Tuiqiao, an interactive human-AI collaborative system for classical Chinese poetry composition. The system is designed around a triadic model: user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation. Users can lock characters or lines, receive real-time prosody feedback, and obtain interpretable refinement suggestions grounded in high-frequency collocations, PPL-ranked classical lines, and structured knowledge extracted from classical encyclopedias. This design turns AI from an autonomous generator into a background assistant that supports the user's own process of poetic refinement. Preliminary experiments and user feedback suggest that Jiuge-Tuiqiao improves controllability, interpretability, and user engagement in classical poetry composition.
papers.comment: Accepted to the System Demonstrations Program at EMNLP 2026. Code and demo: https://github.com/jiangli-va/Jiuge-Tuiqiao
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Jiuge-Tuiqiao，一个面向古典中文诗歌创作的交互式人机协同系统。系统围绕用户驱动控制、古代文献引导证据和 AI 辅助生成的三元模型设计，允许用户锁定字词或诗句、获取实时格律反馈，并得到基于高频搭配、PPL 排序的古典诗句和类书结构化知识的可解释修改建议。初步实验和用户反馈表明，该系统在诗歌创作中提升了可控性、可解释性和用户参与度。
Motivation: 现有 AI 诗歌系统多采用一次生成（one-shot generation）范式，把用户降级为提示词提供者，削弱了用户的创作主动性；而古典诗歌创作历来重视 Tuiqiao（推敲），即对话语、意象和格律的迭代打磨。
Method: 提出一个交互式人机协同系统，核心是三元模型：用户驱动的控制、古代文献引导的证据、AI 辅助的生成。系统支持锁定字词或诗句、实时格律反馈，并给出基于高频搭配、PPL 排序古典诗句以及从类书（classical encyclopedias）中抽取的结构化知识的可解释改进建议。
Result: 初步实验和用户反馈显示，该系统在古典诗歌创作中改善了可控性、可解释性和用户参与度；摘要未报告具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者将 AI 从自主生成器转变为支持用户自身推敲过程的背景助手，并强调该系统在古典诗歌创作中的价值；结论基于初步实验与用户反馈，尚属系统演示阶段的成果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Inverse Step is a Convex Program: Bayes-Limit Calibration of Diffusion Inversion
papers.abstract_en: One implicit DDIM inversion step is the cheapest probe of whether a pretrained diffusion model encodes local manifold geometry. It is the stationarity condition of an explicit potential, $x-G(x)=\nablaΨ_t(x)$, strongly convex at the Bayes limit with modulus exactly $e^{-h_t}$ for the step's log-SNR gap $h_t$ $-$ for every data law, schedule and point, with no manifold, reach or unimodality hypothesis. Three consequences must be kept apart. (i) The solution is unique at the Bayes limit; a second one requires the trained score to violate the posterior-covariance bound by $1/(1-e^{-h_t})$, a hypothesis-free certificate of model error; the same bound makes contraction a schedule constant, $ρ_g^{\star}=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326$ throughout the standard DDPM schedule. (ii) The solver can still fail: Picard iteration is unit-step gradient descent on $Ψ_t$, unstable wherever $λ_{\max}(\nabla^2Ψ_t)>2$, so oscillation certifies nothing; damping below $2/λ_{\max}$ cures it. (iii) The geometry lives in the convergence domain: on the scale-free depth $w=rκ_{\max}$ the oscillation shell sits at $w=\tfrac12$, schedule-free, and the divergence shell at $w=1/(1+ρ_g^{\star})$, with a measured finite-noise correction in $\|\mathrm{II}\|^2$. Exact scores reproduce both to within $0.54\%$ on three classes; no trained score we probe shows a shell $-$ a derived limitation, not a null result: the Fermi window conflicts with the model's own training support by $3.6$-$5.6\times$, and the trained Hessian-Lipschitz constant is $2$-$12\%$ of the curvature the law reads, $0$ on a ReLU net. Finally the unconditional ceiling $σ_tλ_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$, from $\mathrm{Cov}(x_0\mid x_t)\succeq0$ alone, holds for the exact score to $3\times10^{-7}$ but is violated in all DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256 settings, by $1.26$-$4.66\times$.
papers.comment: Revised follow-up of "Extracting Local Manifold Geometry from Pretrained Diffusion Models in One Inverse Step" (ICML 2026 Workshop SPIGM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练扩散模型中一步隐式 DDIM 求逆 (implicit DDIM inversion) 的性质，证明该步骤是某个显式势函数 $x-G(x)=\nabla\Psi_t(x)$ 的平稳条件，并在 Bayes 极限下以模量 $e^{-h_t}$ 强凸，其中 $h_t$ 为步骤的对数信噪比间隔。摘要给出唯一性、收缩常数、Picard 迭代不稳定几何（振荡壳与发散壳）以及无条件上界 $\sigma_t\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$ 等结果，说明精确分数与训练分数在若干设置中的定量差异。
Motivation: 现有工作将预训练扩散模型当作局部流形几何的编码器，但缺少一种廉价且严格的探测方式；本文要回答一步逆过程在什么条件下唯一、何时求解失败，以及模型误差能否被无假设地认证。
Method: 把一步隐式 DDIM 求逆转化为一个强凸势函数 $\Psi_t$ 的驻点条件，并从后验协方差界 $\mathrm{Cov}(x_0\mid x_t)\succeq0$ 出发，推导解的唯一性、收缩率、梯度下降（Picard 迭代）稳定性条件、尺度无关的振荡/发散壳位置，以及无条件上界 $\sigma_t\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$。
Result: 摘要报告：Bayes 极限下解唯一，第二个解需要训练分数违反后验协方差界 $1/(1-e^{-h_t})$；收缩常数 $\rho_g^{\star}=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326$；振荡壳在 $w=1/2$、发散壳在 $w=1/(1+\rho_g^{\star})$；精确分数在三个类别上复现两者至 $0.54\%$ 误差，而所有被探测的训练分数都不显示壳；无条件上界 $\sigma_t\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$ 对精确分数成立至 $3\times10^{-7}$，但在 DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256 设置中被违反 $1.26$-$4.66\times$。
Conclusion: 作者强调训练分数不显示壳不是零结果，而是推导出的局限：Fermi 窗口与模型自身训练支撑冲突 $3.6$-$5.6\times$，且训练 Hessian-Lipschitz 常数仅为定律所读曲率的 $2$-$12\%$（ReLU 网络上为 0）。这表明模型误差可以无假设地量化，但标准 DDPM 训练配置会破坏该理论上界。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：Bayes 极限下解唯一，第二个解需要训练分数违反后验协方差界 $1/(1-e^{-h_t})$；收缩常数 $\rho_g^{\star}=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326$；振荡壳在 $w=1/2$、发散壳在 $w=1/(1+\rho_g^{\star})$；精确分数在三个类别上复现两者至 $0.54\%$ 误差，而所有被探测的训练分数都不显示壳；无条件上界 $\sigma_t\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$ 对精确分数成立至 $3\times10^{-7}$，但在 DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256 设置中被违反 $1.26$-$4.66\times$。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调训练分数不显示壳不是零结果，而是推导出的局限：Fermi 窗口与模型自身训练支撑冲突 $3.6$-$5.6\times$，且训练 Hessian-Lipschitz 常数仅为定律所读曲率的 $2$-$12\%$（ReLU 网络上为 0）。这表明模型误差可以无假设地量化，但标准 DDPM 训练配置会破坏该理论上界。

papers.title: Partial-Moment PINNs for Caldeira--Leggett Parameter Learning in Quantum Brownian Motion
papers.abstract_en: We study parameter recovery in the Caldeira--Leggett (quantum Brownian) oscillator from partial moment traces. Our model is a moment-level PINN that predicts the five first/second moments and enforces the linear CL/HPZ ODEs by automatic differentiation. Physical structure is imposed through a PSD (Cholesky) covariance head, high-temperature CL assumptions with $D_{xp}\approx0$, and fluctuation--dissipation ties between $D_{pp}$ and $γ$. On synthetic CL data with channels ${μ_x,σ_{xx},σ_{xp}}$, the constrained variant recovers $(ω,γ)$ accurately, stabilizes $D_{pp}$, and achieves low rollout error compared to finite differences and Kalman--EM (expectation--maximization) with exact Van Loan discretization. Fisher-style checks confirm that diffusion needs at least one variance observable, and sparse $σ_{pp}$ ``anchors'' restore conditioning. We also show that the same PINN can learn time-varying HPZ coefficients.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Published in the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN), IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026)
papers.journal_ref: 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN), IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从部分矩迹（partial moment traces）恢复 Caldeira--Leggett（量子布朗）振子的参数。作者提出矩级 PINN，预测五个一阶/二阶矩，并通过自动微分强制线性 CL/HPZ 常微分方程；物理结构由 PSD（Cholesky）协方差头、高温 CL 假设（Dxp≈0）以及 Dpp 与 γ 的涨落-耗散关系施加。在合成 CL 数据上，约束变体准确恢复 (ω,γ)、稳定 Dpp，并与有限差分和 Kalman-EM 相比取得更低 rollout 误差。
Motivation: 量子布朗运动中从矩迹反演 Caldeira--Leggett 参数是逆问题，朴素推断可能病态；需要借助矩结构和物理约束来提升参数可辨识性与数值稳定性。
Method: 提出矩级 PINN，预测五个一阶/二阶矩并利用自动微分约束线性 CL/HPZ ODE；网络 head 采用 PSD（Cholesky）协方差结构、高温 CL 假设 Dxp≈0，并施加 Dpp 与 γ 的涨落-耗散关系。还用稀疏 σpp 锚点改善条件数，并将框架扩展到时变 HPZ 系数。
Result: 在合成 CL 数据（通道 μx, σxx, σxp）上，约束变体准确恢复 (ω,γ)，稳定 Dpp，rollout 误差低于有限差分和 Kalman-EM（使用精确 Van Loan 离散化）。Fisher 式检查表明扩散至少需要一个方差观测量，且稀疏 σpp 锚点能恢复条件数。
Conclusion: 作者表明物理约束的矩级 PINN 能从部分矩迹中稳健学习 CL 参数及时间相关的 HPZ 系数；同时强调观测中至少保留一个方差通道对扩散项可辨识性至关重要。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Loopy: Seamless Video Loop Generation via Anchored Looping Shift of Positional Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Looping videos are essential for practical applications such as web graphics, game development, and social media. However, existing approaches typically fail to generate high-quality looping videos due to the neglect of how video generation models perceive temporal order and how this relates to the looping behavior. In this work, we are the first to reveal that position embedding at different attention layers within DiT exhibits varying levels of positional control, with the most pronounced layer acting as an anchor. We formulate this anchored layer as the reference point of the looping video, offering strong contextual priors for the remaining layers to facilitate the generation of seamless and coherent video content. Based on this insight, we propose an anchored position embedding shifting strategy that applies layer-specific shift lengths according to each layer's temporal control effect, effectively transforming DiT's temporal perception from a straight line to a circle. Leveraging this strategy, we develop a general framework, Loopy, for high-quality looping video generation, supporting both RGB and RGBA videos, while also enabling advanced AIGC features such as identity control and style transfer. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves temporal consistency and visual fidelity in generated looping videos. The released model is available on our website: https://donghaotian123.github.io/Loopy.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 21 figures, accepted by ACM TOG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环视频生成问题，首次揭示 DiT 中不同注意力层的位置嵌入对时间控制强度不同，其中最显著的层可作为锚点。基于此提出锚定位置嵌入平移策略，将 DiT 对时间的感知从直线变为圆环，并构建通用框架 Loopy，支持 RGB 和 RGBA 视频生成以及身份控制和风格迁移等 AIGC 功能。实验表明该方法显著提升循环视频的时间一致性与视觉保真度。
Motivation: 现有循环视频生成方法往往忽略生成模型如何感知时间顺序、以及该感知与循环行为的关系，导致难以生成高质量的循环视频。
Method: 提出锚定位置嵌入平移策略：根据每个注意力层对时间的控制效果为其施加不同的平移长度，将 DiT 的时间感知建模为圆环；以此为基础构建通用循环视频生成框架 Loopy。
Result: 实验显示方法显著改善生成循环视频的时间一致性和视觉保真度。
Conclusion: 作者强调揭示 DiT 层间位置嵌入控制差异并利用锚定层作为上下文先验，是生成无缝循环视频的关键；模型已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: POOL: Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes
papers.abstract_en: Black-box large language models need confidence scores that can separate likely-correct from likely-incorrect outputs, enabling systems to prioritize human review, route uncertain cases to stronger models, or choose abstention thresholds on development data. Yet existing confidence estimators face a cost-quality trade-off: verbal confidence is cheap but is often overconfident, while sampling-based uncertainty is more informative but scales linearly with the number of samples per query. We propose \textsc{POOL} (\emph{Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes}),a cost-efficient framework that addresses this trade-off taking inspiration from group-testing.\textsc{POOL} clusters query stems with overlaps, evaluates a base estimator on representative medoids, softly propagates confidence scores to nearby queries, and selectively evaluates high-disagreement cases. We instantiate this framework with \textsc{Hy@}$p$, a hybrid estimator that combines verbal confidence with spectral answer diversity computed from the negative von Neumann entropy of sampled answer embeddings.Across six domains from three datasets and five black-box LLMs, \textsc{Hy@}5 achieves higher average AUROC than verbal confidence and \textsc{Vn@}10 sampling while using half as many samples as \textsc{Vn@}10. \textsc{POOL}-\textsc{Hy@}5 retains 93.5--97.9\% of its AUROC while saving 19.3--39.3\% of generations. On paraphrase-dense workloads, generation savings rise to 73-76\%, showing that semantic redundancy can be leveraged to lower confidence-estimation costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 POOL（Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes），一个面向黑盒大语言模型置信度估计的成本高效框架，借鉴分组测试（group-testing）思路：对查询词干聚类、在代表 medoid 上评估基础估计器、将置信度软传播到邻近查询，并选择性评估高分歧案例。框架实例化为 Hy@$p$，一种融合口头置信度与基于采样答案嵌入负 von Neumann 熵的谱多样性指标。实验覆盖三个数据集的六个领域和五个黑盒 LLM，显示 Hy@5 在平均 AUROC 上超过口头置信度和 Vn@10 采样，同时只用后者一半的样本；POOL-Hy@5 在保留 93.5–97.9% AUROC 的同时节省 19.3–39.3% 的生成，在高释义密度工作负载上生成节省达 73–76%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 置信度估计面临成本与质量权衡：口头置信度便宜但常过度自信，采样类不确定性信息量更大但随每查询样本数线性增长。论文旨在打破这一权衡，以更低成本获得接近采样方法的置信度质量。
Method: 提出 POOL 框架，聚类查询词干，用 medoid 代表簇进行评估，将置信度软传播到邻近查询，并选择性补充评估高分歧案例；同时提出混合估计器 Hy@$p$，组合口头置信度与由采样答案嵌入的负 von Neumann 熵计算的谱多样性。
Result: 在三个数据集、六个领域、五个黑盒 LLM 上，Hy@5 的平均 AUROC 高于口头置信度和 Vn@10 采样，且样本量仅为 Vn@10 的一半；POOL-Hy@5 保持 93.5–97.9% 的 AUROC，同时节省 19.3–39.3% 的生成，在释义密集负载下生成节省达 73–76%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 POOL 可以利用查询间的语义冗余来降低置信度估计成本，在保留大部分判别性能的同时减少生成开销；其适用性主要体现在语义重叠较多的查询场景中。

papers.title: AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling in Tool-Rich Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly operate over large collections of tools, functions, APIs, and specialized agents. As the candidate action space grows, a function-calling model must process more schemas, consume more prompt tokens, and distinguish among increasingly similar or irrelevant alternatives. We study a complementary systems strategy: reduce the candidate set before language-model inference while leaving the downstream model unchanged. We introduce AgentWeave, a deterministic pre-inference routing layer that constructs a bounded model-visible action space using eligibility, requirement, capability, and routing signals. We evaluate AgentWeave with a frozen BFCL-derived routing-pressure protocol using the public MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b model. On 48 fresh BFCL V4 multiple-function tasks, AgentWeave achieves 6/48 (12.5%) native BFCL successes, whereas all-tools, deterministic random top-8, and semantic top-8 baselines each achieve 0/48. The paired success difference is +12.5 percentage points with a 10,000-resample paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval of +4.17 to +22.92 points and exact McNemar p=0.03125. Relative to all-tools exposure, AgentWeave presents 70.18% fewer tools, uses 61.70% fewer input tokens, and exhibits 50.95% lower mean local-model latency. The result is deliberately narrow: this is a BFCL-derived routing-pressure study rather than an official full BFCL leaderboard score, and absolute task success remains low. The evidence nevertheless shows that candidate-space construction can materially affect a fixed model's function-calling behavior and motivates evaluating routing as a distinct stage before model reasoning.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Open-source implementation and reproducibility artifacts available in the AgentWeave repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentWeave，一个在语言模型推理前对工具/函数调用候选集进行确定性路由的层，通过 eligibility、requirement、capability 和 routing 信号构建有界的模型可见动作空间。在 BFCL V4 的 48 个多函数任务上，用冻结的 MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b 模型评估，AgentWeave 获得 6/48 成功，而 all-tools、随机 top-8 和语义 top-8 基线均为 0/48，同时减少 70.18% 工具、61.70% 输入 token 和 50.95% 本地模型延迟。作者强调这是 BFCL 派生的路由压力研究，而非官方排行榜结果。
Motivation: 工具丰富的语言模型中，候选动作空间增大导致模型需处理更多 schema、消耗更多输入 token，并区分越来越相似或无关的备选。论文针对这一问题提出在模型推理前减少候选集，同时保持下游模型不变。
Method: 提出确定性的预推理路由层 AgentWeave，利用 eligibility、requirement、capability 和 routing 信号构建有界的模型可见动作空间。评估采用冻结的 BFCL 派生路由压力协议，使用公开的 MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b 模型，与 all-tools、确定性随机 top-8 和语义 top-8 基线对比。
Result: 在 48 个 BFCL V4 多函数任务上，AgentWeave 达到 6/48（12.5%）原生 BFCL 成功，而三个基线均为 0/48；配对成功差异为 +12.5 个百分点，10,000 次重采样的配对 bootstrap 95% 置信区间为 +4.17 至 +22.92，精确 McNemar p=0.03125。相对 all-tools，工具数减少 70.18%，输入 token 减少 61.70%，本地模型延迟降低 50.95%。
Conclusion: 作者明确表示结果是有意窄化：这是 BFCL 派生的路由压力研究，而非完整 BFCL 排行榜分数，绝对任务成功率仍然较低。证据表明候选空间构造能实质影响固定模型的函数调用行为，并支持把路由作为模型推理之前的独立阶段来评估。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者明确表示结果是有意窄化：这是 BFCL 派生的路由压力研究，而非完整 BFCL 排行榜分数，绝对任务成功率仍然较低。证据表明候选空间构造能实质影响固定模型的函数调用行为，并支持把路由作为模型推理之前的独立阶段来评估。

papers.title: When a neural surrogate cannot accelerate a solver: runtime share, closed-loop drift, and the economics of uncertainty gating in a stiff coupled simulation
papers.abstract_en: Learned surrogates for expensive inner solver blocks are a widely pursued route to faster multiphysics simulation. We report a controlled, end-to-end negative result and identify three structural barriers, none of them a deficiency of the network we trained. The testbed is the implicit Newton solve coupling energy-dependent neutrino radiation to matter in a general-relativistic radiation-hydrodynamics code, its most expensive physics routine per call. First, per-call cost and share of runtime are different quantities, and only the second bounds acceleration. An exclusive self-time profile puts the target block at 16.9% of critical-rank wall clock, capping any surrogate at ~1.2x by Amdahl's law. A surrogate 5.8x cheaper per call merely ties the solver, and the configuration stable enough to run without fallback reaches only parity. Second, offline accuracy cannot rank surrogates for deployment: across fourteen networks the pooled Spearman error-versus-survival correlation (rho = +0.73) is a between-family confound that vanishes under control (rho = -0.04). Third, a correct out-of-distribution gate cannot accelerate a loop that leaves its training distribution. We give the break-even deferral fraction in closed form: because the visited states sit 73x off the data manifold, the gate defers 96.8 to 99.7% of cells, almost invariant to surrogate quality. Including its own cost, the gated loop is a 0.94 to 0.96x slowdown. We further separate stability from fidelity: a never-crashing gated run accumulates a linear -19.9% density bias over 6000 steps. The error is a directed, ballistically accumulating bias, not the variance-driven divergence the autoregressive literature targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一个受控的端到端负结果：在广义相对论辐射流体力学代码中，用学习代理替换最昂贵的隐式牛顿求解器无法加速整体模拟。作者识别三个结构障碍：运行时占比与单次调用成本不同、离线精度无法为部署排序代理、正确的分布外门控无法加速离开训练分布的循环。门控循环最终是0.94-0.96倍减速，且无崩溃的代理运行在6000步内累积-19.9%密度偏差。
Motivation: 学习代理加速多物理模拟中的昂贵内层求解器是热门方向，但现有评估常关注单次调用成本而非运行时占比，且忽略闭环运行中的分布漂移和门控成本，导致代理可能实际无法加速。
Method: 以相对论辐射流体力学中耦合中微子辐射与物质的隐式牛顿求解为测试平台，进行端到端对照实验。分析自耗时间占比并用Amdahl定律推导加速上限；训练14个网络，用Spearman相关性检验离线精度与部署存活的关联；引入闭式断点延迟分数公式，并计算分布外门控的延迟率与偏置。
Result: 目标块占临界等级墙钟16.9%，使代理加速上限约1.2倍；单次调用便宜5.8倍的代理仅持平，稳定无回退配置只达到平手。跨14个网络，误差-存活Spearman相关性rho=+0.73是族间混杂，控制后rho=-0.04。访问状态距数据流形73倍，门控延迟96.8%-99.7%的单元，门控循环是0.94-0.96倍减速；无崩溃门控运行在6000步内累积线性-19.9%密度偏置，属于定向弹道累积偏置。
Conclusion: 作者强调代理不能加速求解器的结构性障碍不是网络缺陷；稳定性与保真度分离，门控运行即使不崩溃也会积累有向偏置，而非自回归文献目标中的方差驱动发散。

papers.title: Grounding Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Need Object Localization for Spatial Reasoning?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer spatial questions, yet the mechanisms connecting object grounding to spatial reasoning remain poorly understood. It is underexplored whether spatial reasoning internally requires precise objects localization, or can bypass explicit localization through global layout cues. In this work, we investigate two representative model families, LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablation, layer-wise probing, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis. We find that spatial relation prediction follows a staged grounding-to-reasoning process in which object-aligned tokens establish coarse target-reference anchors, while precise bounding-box boundaries are not required. Positional information becomes decodable before relation decisions emerge, and a small set of attention heads mediates the causal effects of both localization and spatial reasoning. The two tasks share early grounding-related processing but ultimately rely on partially distinct specialized pathways. Through rigorous experiments, we provide a token-, layer-, and head-level account of how VLMs transform object grounding into spatial relations, showing that knowing where objects are is not equivalent to knowing how they relate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在空间关系预测中，对象定位 (object grounding) 与空间推理之间的内部机制是否必须依赖精确的边界框定位。作者对 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 使用 token 消融、逐层探针、注意力切除和因果中介分析等机制可解释性工具，发现空间关系预测呈现分阶段的 grounding-to-reasoning 过程，对象对齐 token 提供粗略的目标-参考锚点，而精确边界框并非必需。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 能回答空间问题，但对象定位与空间推理之间的因果机制尚不清楚，尤其是空间推理是否内部依赖精确的物体定位，还是可以通过全局布局线索绕过显式定位。
Method: 使用 token 消融 (token ablation)、逐层探针 (layer-wise probing)、注意力切除 (attention knockout) 和因果中介分析 (causal mediation analysis) 等机制解释工具，对 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 两类模型进行系统分析。
Result: 空间关系预测遵循分阶段的 grounding-to-reasoning 过程，对象对齐 token 建立粗略锚点，精确边界框边界不必要；位置信息先于关系决策变得可解码，少量注意力头中介定位与空间推理的因果效应；两个任务共享早期 grounding 处理，但最终依赖部分不同的专门通路。
Conclusion: 摘要强调知道物体在哪里不等同于知道它们如何关联，并从 token、层和注意力头三个粒度提供了 VLM 将对象定位转化为空间关系的机制解释。

papers.title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid progress of diffusion models and large-scale video generation, generative world models are increasingly expected to replace traditional simulators, including physics engines, game engines, and reinforcement-learning environments. Yet the remaining distance from generation to simulation lacks a systematic assessment. We present a capability-based study using an external yardstick: eight capabilities of a traditional simulator, namely asset construction, physics engine, interaction, controllability, stability, state feedback, diversity, and evaluation metrics. We trace three main technical routes--latent dynamics, video generation, and joint-embedding prediction--and map exactly 200 representative works published from 2018 to June 2026 onto these capabilities. Our analysis shows that world models have achieved functional substitution in interaction and controllability for specific scenarios, but remain short of traditional simulators in formal guarantees of physical laws, structured state feedback, and reproducible long-horizon evolution. State feedback is the most neglected cross-route shortcoming: only 6 of 163 implementation papers expose a runtime interface for querying entity states or physical parameters. We identify six research directions: formalized physics, a unified action interface, first-class state feedback, long-horizon stability, downstream-utility evaluation, and cross-route hybridization. Project page: https://github.com/AtongWang/world-model-simulators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对生成式世界模型（generative world model）距离替代传统模拟器（物理引擎、游戏引擎、强化学习环境）还有多远进行了系统性能力评估。作者以传统模拟器的八项能力为外部标尺，梳理潜变量动力学（latent dynamics）、视频生成（video generation）、联合嵌入预测（joint-embedding prediction）三条技术路线，并映射 2018 年至 2026 年 6 月的 200 篇代表性工作。分析结论是世界模型在特定场景的交互性和可控性上已实现功能替代，但在物理定律形式保证、结构化状态反馈、可复现长时程演化上仍不及传统模拟器，其中状态反馈是最被忽视的跨路线短板。
Motivation: 扩散模型和大规模视频生成的快速进展使生成式世界模型被越来越多地期望替代传统模拟器，但从生成到模拟之间的剩余差距缺乏系统的量化评估。
Method: 采用外部标尺的基于能力的研究方法：定义传统模拟器的八项能力（资产构建、物理引擎、交互、可控性、稳定性、状态反馈、多样性、评估指标），沿潜变量动力学、视频生成、联合嵌入预测三条技术路线，将代表性工作映射到这些能力上。
Result: 分析显示，世界模型在特定场景下已在交互和可控性上实现功能替代，但在物理定律的形式保证、结构化状态反馈和可复现的长时程演化方面仍不足；状态反馈是最被忽视的短板，163 篇实现论文中仅 6 篇暴露了用于查询实体状态或物理参数的运行时接口。
Conclusion: 作者提出六个研究方向：形式化物理（formalized physics）、统一动作接口（unified action interface）、一等公民状态反馈（first-class state feedback）、长时程稳定性（long-horizon stability）、下游效用评估（downstream-utility evaluation）和跨路线混合（cross-route hybridization）。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Cultural Moment Benchmark: Evaluating Video Cultural Reasoning and Grounding in Southeast Asia
papers.abstract_en: Cultural understanding in video means more than recognizing what is visible; it requires grasping the symbolic and temporal significance of cultural concepts. We decompose this into three abilities: naming what a concept symbolizes, visually recognizing it on video, and locating its sub-events in time. Existing video-cultural benchmarks tend to test what is seen, collapsing these three abilities into a single score that hides the bottleneck. We introduce the Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB): 306 expert-curated concepts from seven countries in Southeast Asia across five categories. We evaluate each concept through three stages, one per ability. Given a description, Stage 1 (S1) selects from four candidate concept names, Stage 2 (S2) selects from four candidate video moments, and Stage 3 (S3) predicts the start and end times of the moment in a video. To keep each stage focused on a distinct ability, we use three design choices: semantic-similarity distractors (S1, S2), unlabeled video moments (S2), and free-form localization on a different example video (S3). Across six vision-language models, failure modes vary by ability and modality. i) Even the strongest closed-source models score below 30% when all three stages must be correct; ii) The three abilities do not fully cascade: naming a concept correctly helps half the models recognize it on video, but recognizing it has little effect on locating the sub-event in time; iii) Audio is complementary, redundant, or distracting depending on the concept, more often distracting in non-Latin-script countries; removing both audio and subtitles hurts Games and Music the most. Our 14-rater human study shows that even Expert raters score below chance on concepts from a neighboring country, indicating that CMB requires country-specific cultural knowledge. CMB acts as a diagnostic harness, attributing failures to a specific ability or modality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB)，一个面向东南亚七国 306 个专家精选文化概念的视频文化推理基准，将文化理解拆解为命名概念、视觉识别和子事件时间定位三种能力，并分别用三个阶段评测。六个视觉语言模型在所有三阶段全部正确的得分均低于 30%，且三种能力并非完全级联，音频在不同概念上表现为互补、冗余或干扰。14 名人工评分者的研究表明，即使是专家评分者在邻国文化概念上也低于随机水平，说明 CMB 需要国家特定的文化知识。
Motivation: 现有视频文化基准往往把命名、视觉识别和时间定位三种能力合并为单一分数，掩盖了真正的瓶颈所在，无法定位模型在哪个环节失败。
Method: CMB 对每个概念设置三个阶段：S1 从四个候选概念名中选择、S2 从四个未标注视频片段中选择、S3 在不同示例视频上进行自由形式的时间定位；通过语义相似干扰项、未标注片段和不同示例视频三种设计来隔离各阶段能力，并配有 14 名评分者的人工研究。
Result: 最强闭源模型在三阶段全对的得分也低于 30%；正确命名概念只对一半模型识别视频有帮助，而识别对时间定位几乎没有影响；音频因概念而异，在非拉丁字母国家更多是干扰，移除音频和字幕对 Games 和 Music 伤害最大；专家评分者在邻国概念上低于随机水平。
Conclusion: CMB 可作为一个诊断工具，将模型失败归因到具体能力或模态；同时强调视频文化理解需要国家特定的文化知识。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 最强闭源模型在三阶段全对的得分也低于 30%；正确命名概念只对一半模型识别视频有帮助，而识别对时间定位几乎没有影响；音频因概念而异，在非拉丁字母国家更多是干扰，移除音频和字幕对 Games 和 Music 伤害最大；专家评分者在邻国概念上低于随机水平。
summary_sections.conclusion: CMB 可作为一个诊断工具，将模型失败归因到具体能力或模态；同时强调视频文化理解需要国家特定的文化知识。

papers.title: Improving O-RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports: A Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid versus End-to-End LLM Reasoning Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Background: Automating clinical guideline-based decision-making with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because of reliability, hallucination, and limited interpretability. We compared the performance of LLMs and reasoning strategies for automated Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS) classification from free-text pelvic ultrasound reports. Methods: In this retrospective study, consecutive patients with ovarian masses who underwent pelvic ultrasound were included. Eight LLMs were tested with three reasoning strategies: implicit-knowledge end-to-end, rule-informed end-to-end, and a feature-based hybrid architecture that decoupled feature extraction from rule-based classification. The reference standard was O-RADS categorization established by expert consensus. Results: A total of 310 women with 390 ovarian masses were evaluated. The feature-based hybrid architecture using Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated the best performance, achieving an accuracy of 99.2% (387 of 390) and almost perfect agreement with the reference standard (weighted kappa = 1.00; 95% CI: 0.99-1.00). Its performance surpassed that of original clinical reports (accuracy, 87.7% [342 of 390]; weighted kappa = 0.94; 95% CI: 0.91-0.96) and end-to-end LLM strategies (accuracy range, 65.6% [256 of 390] to 95.9% [374 of 390]). For structured feature extraction, Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated higher overall accuracy than Claude Fable 5 (98.9% vs 97.8%; P < 0.001). The hybrid architecture reduced misclassification errors and mitigated the overstaging tendency observed in original reports. Conclusion: The feature-based hybrid LLM architecture that separates clinical feature extraction from deterministic guideline execution enables highly accurate, reliable, and interpretable automated O-RADS classification, providing a promising approach for standardized, guideline-based clinical decision-making.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾性比较了多种大语言模型（LLM）与推理策略在基于自由文本盆腔超声报告自动进行卵巢-附件报告与数据系统（O-RADS）分类上的表现。研究纳入310名女性的390个卵巢肿块，提出将特征提取与规则分类解耦的基于特征的混合架构（feature-based hybrid architecture），使用Gemini 3.6 Flash达到99.2%（387/390）的准确率，与专家共识参考标准几乎完全一致（加权kappa = 1.00）。该性能显著优于原始临床报告（87.7%）以及端到端LLM策略（65.6%-95.9%）。
Motivation: 用LLM自动化执行基于临床指南的决策仍面临可靠性、幻觉和可解释性有限等挑战；需要一种高准确且可解释的方案来自动完成O-RADS风险分层。
Method: 比较八种LLM在三种推理策略下的表现：隐式知识端到端、规则提示端到端，以及将临床特征提取与确定性规则分类相分离的基于特征的混合架构，并以专家共识的O-RADS分类作为参考标准。
Result: 基于特征的混合架构配合Gemini 3.6 Flash取得最佳性能，准确率99.2%，加权kappa为1.00（95% CI: 0.99-1.00），超过原始临床报告（准确率87.7%，kappa 0.94）和端到端策略（准确率范围65.6%-95.9%）。在结构化特征提取上Gemini 3.6 Flash整体准确率高于Claude Fable 5（98.9% vs 97.8%，P < 0.001）；混合架构还减少了误分类并缓解了原始报告中存在的过度分期倾向。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将临床特征提取与确定性指南执行分离的混合LLM架构能够实现高准确、可靠且可解释的自动化O-RADS分类，为标准化、指南驱动的临床决策提供了一种有前景的方法。

papers.title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) now support forecasting systems that combine language-based reasoning with temporal data, evidence retrieval, external tools, and iterative prediction. We investigate LLM-based forecasting agents, meaning systems in which a language model contributes to a scored prediction about a future or currently unobserved target. We organize architectures into three groups. Standalone LLM workflows operate on encoded time series or event context. Tool- and retrieval-augmented agents incorporate external evidence. Hybrid systems pair LLMs with statistical or foundation models. We then review training methods and evaluation protocols. We examine negative as well as positive evidence, including sensitivity to small input perturbations, ablations in which the LLM component does not improve accuracy, and benchmark gains that may reflect contamination instead of temporal reasoning. We cover applications in finance, weather, health, energy, and operations, and we summarize the benchmarks and datasets used for evaluation. The evidence indicates that measurement is a central limitation. Future work requires calibration under distribution shift, contamination-resistant live evaluation, explicit reporting of cost and accuracy together, and methods for handling feedback between deployed forecasts and the outcomes being forecast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于基于大语言模型（LLM）的预测智能体（forecasting agents）的系统性综述，覆盖方法、训练、评估与应用。作者将这类系统按架构分为三类：独立 LLM 工作流、工具与检索增强智能体、以及 LLM 与统计模型或基础模型混合的系统，并回顾了训练方法和评估协议。文中同时梳理了正面与负面证据，指出测量问题（包括基准污染与对扰动的敏感性）是当前核心局限，最后给出未来研究方向。
Motivation: 预测任务需要把语言推理与时间序列数据、证据检索、外部工具和迭代预测结合，但现有证据显示基准提升可能来自数据污染而非真正的时间推理能力，且部分消融中 LLM 组件并不能提高精度；因此有必要对这些 LLM 预测系统的架构、训练、评估和应用做批判性整理。
Method: 采用综述方法，先按架构将系统划分为三类：在编码时间序列或事件上下文上运行的独立 LLM 工作流；引入外部证据的工具和检索增强智能体；LLM 与统计模型或基础模型配对的混合系统。随后回顾训练方法和评估协议，并总结金融、天气、健康、能源、运营等应用领域及所用的基准和数据集。
Result: 摘要同时报告正面和负面证据，包括系统对小输入扰动敏感、在部分消融中 LLM 组件并未提升准确性，以及基准收益可能反映数据污染而非时间推理；作者据此强调测量是当前研究的核心限制。
Conclusion: 作者认为未来工作需要实现分布偏移下的校准、抗污染的实时评估、成本与精度并报的透明度，以及处理已部署预测与目标结果之间反馈的方法；这些改进比继续堆叠架构更为关键。
Relevance: 72

papers.title: Macro-Action Topological Navigation under Noisy Localization using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Navigating large, photorealistic 3D apartments from raw pixels is widely considered infeasible for plain reinforcement learning. We build an agent that does it anyway, estimating its own pose from the camera alone. The agent has to reach several target objects in sequence, and their positions change between episodes, so it must explore to find them. It builds on our earlier object-centric topological controller, which still read the agent's true pose and its object detections from the simulator. Here we replace that true pose with an onboard, object-centric estimate. For each object we keep a bank of ORB features that, when the object is seen again, yield a rough pose measurement, which a minimal Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fuses with a motion model. As on a real robot, the executed motions are noisy. The estimate drifts, but the agent and the nearby objects drift together, so a locally consistent pose is enough to follow each short edge and then home in visually on the target, which lets us replace full SLAM with a much smaller model, closer to how biological navigation appears to work. In the photorealistic Habitat simulator, the agent reaches its target objects from vision alone, with a pose that only needs to be locally consistent.
papers.comment: 15 pages, Accepted at the Artificial Intelligence Symposium (AIS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在噪声定位条件下用强化学习在大规模照片级真实 3D 公寓中仅从原始像素导航。代理从相机输入估计自身位姿，构建于此前基于对象中心的拓扑控制器之上，但用机载、对象中心的位姿估计替代模拟器提供的真实位姿。在 Habitat 模拟器中，该代理仅凭视觉、在只需局部一致位姿的条件下能依次到达多个目标物体。
Motivation: 从原始像素在大规模照片级真实 3D 环境中导航通常被认为对纯强化学习不可行；此前的对象中心拓扑控制器依赖模拟器提供的真实位姿和物体检测，本文的目标是去掉真实位姿，改为由相机图像估计的、仅需局部一致的位姿估计。
Method: 为每个物体维护一组 ORB 特征，再次看到该物体时产生粗略位姿测量，再由一个最小扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）与运动模型融合。执行动作带有噪声，位姿估计会漂移，但代理与附近物体一起漂移，因此局部一致的位姿足以沿每个短边移动并视觉上锁定目标，从而用更小的模型替代完整 SLAM。
Result: 在照片级逼真的 Habitat 模拟器中，代理仅从视觉到达其目标物体，且位姿估计只需局部一致即可支持导航。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部一致的位姿估计足以支撑基于宏动作的拓扑导航，这更接近生物导航的工作方式，不需要全局一致的完整 SLAM；但结果局限于模拟器环境。

papers.title: Graph Representation Learning of Lightweight IoT Ciphers
papers.abstract_en: SIMON and SIMECK belong to a family of Lightweight Cryptographic Algorithms (LCAs) based on the Feistel block cipher, designed for Internet of Things (IoT) devices. As with all Feistel ciphers, they are susceptible to differential cryptanalysis, necessitating rigorous resilience evaluations. While state-of-the-art techniques leverage heuristics and sampling to improve efficiency, little work has applied Machine Learning (ML) guided Graph Representation Learning (GRL) to efficiently identify and visualise high-probability differential clusters. We address this gap by introducing an efficient feature engineering strategy that extracts four differential attributes from a partial Difference Distribution Table (pDDT), revealing structural information concealed in raw differential data. Utilising the enriched features, we construct and compare three ML-guided directed graphs for SIMON$32$ and SIMECK$32$ using K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Decision Trees (DT), and Random Forests (RF). To the best of our knowledge, our framework produces the first graph-based visualisation of the differential clustering effect, in which high-probability single-bit differentials form geometrically close clusters in the learned embedding. All three models achieve a precision of $1.0$ in identifying high-probability differentials, confirming zero false positives. KNN achieves the strongest cluster separation, the highest F1 score and the lowest graph construction time of approximately $2.3$ seconds, while DT and RF produce optimal paths with near-perfect regression. The results are consistent across both LCAs, demonstrating the applicability of the framework to other AND-rotation LCA families.
papers.comment: This is the author's version of a paper accepted at the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 SIMON 和 SIMECK 两类基于 Feistel 结构的轻量级分组密码，提出一种从部分差分分布表 (pDDT) 提取四种差分属性的特征工程策略，并利用 KNN、决策树 (DT) 和随机森林 (RF) 构建三种 ML 引导的有向图，以高效识别和可视化高概率差分簇。摘要报告三个模型识别高概率差分的精确率均为 1.0（零假阳性），其中 KNN 在簇分离、F1 分数和约 2.3 秒的构图时间上最优，DT 与 RF 则得到近似完美的回归路径。作者称这是首个对差分聚类效应进行图可视化的框架，且在两种轻量级密码上结果一致。
Motivation: 现有针对 Feistel 密码的差分密码分析评估主要依赖启发式和采样来提高效率，鲜有工作将机器学习引导的图表示学习 (GRL) 用于高效识别和可视化高概率差分簇。
Method: 提出一种特征工程策略，从部分差分分布表 (pDDT) 中提取四种差分属性以揭示原始差分数据中的结构信息；利用增强特征分别用 KNN、决策树和随机森林为 SIMON32 与 SIMECK32 构建并比较三种有向图。
Result: 三个模型在识别高概率差分上均达到 1.0 的精确率，确认零假阳性；KNN 取得最强的簇分离、最高的 F1 分数以及约 2.3 秒的最低图构建时间，DT 和 RF 则产生近完美回归的最优路径，结果在两种 LCA 上保持一致。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架具备对差分聚类效应的图可视化能力，并适用于其他 AND-rotation 轻量级密码族。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 三个模型在识别高概率差分上均达到 1.0 的精确率，确认零假阳性；KNN 取得最强的簇分离、最高的 F1 分数以及约 2.3 秒的最低图构建时间，DT 和 RF 则产生近完美回归的最优路径，结果在两种 LCA 上保持一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为该框架具备对差分聚类效应的图可视化能力，并适用于其他 AND-rotation 轻量级密码族。

papers.title: Reservoir of Importance: Learning Semi-Structured Sparsity with Differentiable Subset Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Semi-structured $N$:$M$ sparsity has emerged as a practical direction for accelerating large language models (LLMs). However, existing learnable-mask approaches incur substantial parameter and memory overhead, limiting their scalability to large models and aggressive sparsity regimes. In this work, we revisit semi-structured pruning from a perspective that reconciles efficiency with scalability. We propose Reservoir of Importance (RoI), a lightweight semi-structured pruning framework that learns sparsity masks through differentiable subset sampling. Unlike prior methods that model full categorical distributions over all feasible $N$:$M$ patterns, RoI introduces a compact-logit parameterization for sparsity mask learning and performs sampling without replacement to select masks, thereby reducing trainable parameters from combinatorial complexity to $\mathcal{O}({M})$. As a result, RoI requires 1.5-8.75$\times$ fewer learnable parameters and significantly lower memory cost, while remaining fully aligned with hardware-friendly sparsity patterns. Extensive evaluations across multiple scales of the Qwen2.5 LLM family (0.5-7B parameters) demonstrate that RoI achieves competitive performance with strong memory efficiency, stability, and scalability to more aggressive $N$:$M$ sparsity patterns, offering a practical path toward efficient LLM deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted as an EMNLP 2026 Main Conference paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reservoir of Importance (RoI)，一种面向大语言模型 (LLM) 半结构化 N:M 稀疏化的轻量级剪枝框架。RoI 通过可微子集采样 (differentiable subset sampling) 学习稀疏掩码，并采用紧凑 logit 参数化，将可训练参数规模从组合复杂度降到 O(M)。在 Qwen2.5 系列 (0.5-7B) 上的实验表明，RoI 以显著更低的参数与内存开销取得有竞争力的性能，并保持与硬件友好的稀疏模式一致。
Motivation: 现有可学习掩码 (learnable-mask) 的半结构化 N:M 稀疏方法需要建模所有可行 N:M 模式的完整类别分布，带来大量参数和内存开销，限制了其向大规模模型和激进稀疏率场景的扩展。
Method: RoI 提出紧凑 logit 参数化，并采用无放回采样 (sampling without replacement) 进行可微子集采样来选择掩码，从而将可训练参数量从组合复杂度降为 O(M)，同时保持与硬件友好的稀疏模式完全对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 RoI 相比基线减少 1.5-8.75 倍可训练参数并显著降低内存开销；在 Qwen2.5 系列 (0.5-7B) 的多个规模上取得有竞争力的性能，且展现出较强的稳定性，并可扩展到更激进的 N:M 稀疏模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RoI 兼顾了效率与可扩展性，提供了一条面向高效 LLM 部署的实用路径；该工作已被 EMNLP 2026 主会接收。

papers.title: Beyond Verdicts: A Graph-Based Analysis of Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking
papers.abstract_en: Misinformation that cites legitimate papers can be especially harmful when it distorts what those studies actually report. While existing automatic fact-checking systems based on large language models (LLMs) can assess whether a model assigns an Incorrect verdict and can gen- erate explanations for that decision, they typi- cally do not indicate whether the model follows the same reasoning path as human experts or arrives at the verdict through a different but still valid path. In this work, we introduce a graph- based framework (typed reasoning graph) for comparing human and LLM reasoning paths in scientific fact-checking. Building on prior work on fallacious reasoning in biomedical misinformation, MISSCIPLUS (Glockner et al., 2025), we model each explanation as a rea- soning graph that links the false claim to the relevant study context, study findings, fallacy- supporting premises, and fallacy labels. This representation enables one-to-one alignment of human and LLM reasoning at the level of fallacy-specific sub-graphs. For non-human- aligned LLM paths, we validate grounding in the cited study, relevance to the claim, and suf- ficiency for the verdict. Using 84 false claims from MISSCIPLUS, we evaluate GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Qwen3-32B across prompt and evidence settings. Results show distinct perfor- mance dimensions: Qwen3-32B has the lowest verdict failure rate, GPT-5 the highest human alignment, and Claude Opus 4.7 weak verdict prediction but often valid reasoning in success- ful cases
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图的框架（typed reasoning graph）来比较人类专家与LLM在科学事实核查中的推理路径。基于MISSCIPLUS中的84条错误声明，作者评估了GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.7和Qwen3-32B在不同提示与证据设置下的表现，结果显示模型在不同维度各有优劣：Qwen3-32B的判定失败率最低，GPT-5的人类对齐程度最高，Claude Opus 4.7的判定预测较弱但在成功案例中推理往往有效。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动事实核查系统能够给出判定和解释，但通常不能说明模型是否与人类专家遵循相同的推理路径，还是通过不同但仍然有效的路径得出判定。本文针对这一评估缺口，希望区分判定正确性与推理路径对齐性。
Method: 引入typed reasoning graph，将每条解释建模为连接错误声明、研究背景、研究发现、支持谬误的前提和谬误标签的推理图，从而在谬误特定子图层面实现人类与LLM推理的一一对齐。对于未与人类对齐的LLM路径，作者进一步验证其在所引研究中的grounding、与声明的相关性以及对该判定的充分性。
Result: 在MISSCIPLUS的84条错误声明上评估GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.7和Qwen3-32B，结果呈现多个独立性能维度：Qwen3-32B的verdict failure rate最低，GPT-5的人类对齐最高，Claude Opus 4.7的判定预测较弱但在成功案例中推理通常有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应把判定正确性与推理路径对齐视为不同维度分别评估；LLM可能通过不同但有效的推理路径得到正确判定，因此评估事实核查解释时需要考虑推理路径的多样性。

papers.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
papers.abstract_en: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon \textbf{inertia bias}. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior action. We find that models are substantially worse when they ``own'' the preceding search step, showing that self-authored action history can systematically distort subsequent judgment. We further show that this bias propagates into two forms of system-level degradation: search noise at the worker level and contextual noise at the manager level. To address this problem, we propose NIS-Agent, which applies context isolation at the two decision points most vulnerable to inertia bias: webpage triage and final-answer validation. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-zh, NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33\% compared to our baseline. We further train an 8B model to be intrinsically more resistant to inertia bias; under the same NIS-Agent framework, it attains average performance comparable to GPT-4o on deep research benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 驱动的深度研究型 web 搜索智能体中的系统性失败模式：智能体在产生查询、计划或中间结论后，会更不客观地判断同一行动的结果，作者将此称为惯性偏差（inertia bias）。为了量化该现象，他们提出 IBIS 基准，通过控制搜索观测并改变模型是否评估自身先前行动的结果来测量偏差。基于此，他们提出 NIS-Agent，在网页分诊和最终答案验证两个决策点应用上下文隔离（context isolation），在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-zh 上取得有竞争力的性能，同时较基线降低 33% 的 token 成本；他们还训练了一个 8B 模型以内在抵抗惯性偏差，在该框架下平均性能接近 GPT-4o。
Motivation: 深度研究任务中，web 搜索智能体一旦产生自己的查询、计划或中间结论，后续判断同一行动后果时会更不客观，这种自我行动历史导致系统性判断失真，并进一步表现为 worker 级搜索噪声和 manager 级上下文噪声。现有方法缺乏对这一偏差的显式度量和针对性缓解。
Method: 提出惯性偏差的概念，并构建 IBIS 基准来对照测量模型评估自身先前行动结果与评估他人行动结果时的差异。针对该偏差，提出 NIS-Agent，在最易受影响的网页分诊（webpage triage）和最终答案验证（final-answer validation）两个决策点实施上下文隔离；此外还训练一个 8B 模型使其对惯性偏差更具内在抵抗力。
Result: 在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-zh 上，NIS-Agent 达到有竞争力的性能，相比基线减少 33% 的 token 成本；在相同框架下，所训练的 8B 模型在深度研究基准上取得与 GPT-4o 相当的平均性能。
Conclusion: 作者表明惯性偏差是深度研究智能体系统层面性能退化的一个来源，且可以通过在两个关键决策点进行上下文隔离来缓解；训练更抗偏差的小模型能够在同等框架下接近更强通用模型的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. We propose AutoSaddler, an automatic harness optimization framework that formulates harness improvement as an offline learning problem and iteratively updates the harness using failure signals from mini-batches. AutoSaddler combines failure-trace diagnosis, structured patch generation that treats the harness as code, and validation-based update selection. Experiments on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that AutoSaddler substantially improves agent performance over the corresponding base harnesses, achieving gains of 9.0, 9.6, and 10.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further suggest that effective harness optimization benefits from three ingredients: deep debugging rather than shallow reflection, targeted modifications rather than unconstrained editing, and generalization-aware selection rather than trajectory-specific repair. Together, these results suggest that automatic harness optimization is a promising path toward more performant and reliable agent systems.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 15 figures. Project website and code: https://aka.ms/AutoSaddler-website
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoSaddler，一种自动化的 agent 外部脚手架（harness）优化框架，将 harness 改进建模为离线学习问题，通过失败轨迹诊断、把 harness 视为代码的结构化补丁生成以及基于验证的更新选择来迭代改进。在 GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，相对基础 harness 分别提升 9.0、9.6 和 10.0 个百分点。消融实验表明，深层调试、定向修改和泛化感知的选择是有效优化的重要因素。
Motivation: LLM agent 在长周期任务上仍不可靠，局部小失败会在长交互中累积导致整体失败；虽然外部 harness 能显著提升鲁棒性，但其设计仍依赖人工，且需要在大规模提示、工具配置和控制逻辑空间中搜索。
Method: AutoSaddler 将 harness 改进形式化为离线学习问题，用 mini-batch 的失败信号迭代更新 harness；具体包含失败轨迹诊断、将 harness 作为代码进行结构化补丁生成，以及基于验证的更新选择。
Result: 在 GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，AutoSaddler 相对对应基础 harness 分别取得 9.0、9.6 和 10.0 个百分点的性能提升；消融研究显示有效优化依赖深层调试而非浅层反思、定向修改而非无约束编辑、泛化感知选择而非轨迹特定修复。
Conclusion: 自动化的 harness 优化是提升 agent 系统性能与可靠性的有前景的途径；摘要强调其组成成分（诊断、结构化补丁、验证选择）共同作用。

papers.title: The Multilingual FrameNet Corpus
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces the Multilingual FrameNet Corpus (mFNC), a novel resource that extends the English Berkeley FrameNet corpus by collecting and harmonizing existing language-specific corpora across nine additional languages: Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Korean, Latvian and Swedish. By training models that rely on different architectures on the mFNC, we consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art Frame Semantic Parsers in both multilingual and cross-lingual settings, underscoring the importance of multilingual training data. The mFNC and our trained FSP models are openly available at https://github.com/beatrice-f/mFNC.

papers.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract_en: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present \textbf{MobilePA-Bench}, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning $13$ functional domains and $212$ realistic mobile tools. Beyond basic tool use, it evaluates a central planning agent along three advanced dimensions: \emph{(1)~Sub-agent Collaboration}---decomposing a complex task and delegating specialized work to capable sub-agents; \emph{(2)~Memory Usage}---recalling stored memories, user profiles, and past preferences to resolve implicit requests; and \emph{(3)~Skill Usage}---invoking pre-packaged composite skills instead of planning every step from scratch. Extensive experiments show that current frontier LLMs remain unreliable in mobile settings: performance drops sharply under strict tool ordering, permission limits, and unexpected runtime errors. By pairing an interactive function-calling sandbox with evidence-based verification, MobilePA-Bench serves as both a practical diagnostic benchmark and an interactive foundation for agentic reinforcement learning---accelerating the development of dependable mobile agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobilePA-Bench，一个面向移动规划智能体 (mobile planning agent) 的交互式、有状态 (stateful)、以工具为中心 (tool-centric) 的基准。该基准运行在可执行的沙箱中，维护实时应用数据库并返回结构化反馈，覆盖 13 个功能域和 212 个真实移动工具。除基础工具调用外，基准从子智能体协作、记忆使用和技能使用三个高级维度评估中心规划智能体。实验显示当前前沿 LLM 在移动场景下仍不可靠，在严格工具顺序、权限限制和意外运行时错误下性能显著下降。
Motivation: 现有基准存在两类盲区：以 GUI 为中心的基准只测试表面屏幕操作，忽略后台工具使用和长时程规划；而静态函数调用基准依赖脱离真实运行时约束的离线 API 匹配。这导致移动操作系统上个人助手式 LLM 智能体的能力评估不够严格。
Method: MobilePA-Bench 在可执行沙箱中运行，维护实时应用数据库并返回结构化反馈；将交互式函数调用沙箱与基于证据的验证 (evidence-based verification) 相结合。它覆盖 13 个功能域和 212 个真实移动工具，并沿三个高级维度评估中心规划智能体：子智能体协作 (sub-agent collaboration)、记忆使用 (memory usage) 和技能使用 (skill usage)。
Result: 大量实验表明，当前前沿 LLM 在移动设定下仍不可靠：在严格的工具顺序约束、权限限制和意外运行时错误下性能大幅下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MobilePA-Bench 既可作为实用的诊断基准，也可作为智能体强化学习 (agentic reinforcement learning) 的交互式基础，从而加速可靠移动智能体的开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ST$^2$U: Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control
papers.abstract_en: Controlling restricted knowledge in large language models is essential for model alignment and safe deployment. Test-time unlearning avoids costly retraining and parameter updates by intervening only during inference. However, existing activation-editing methods apply isolated pointwise corrections, overlooking how autoregressive generation continually reconstructs hidden states from the prompt, cache, and generated prefix. Consequently, later states may return to restricted knowledge regions after a locally successful correction, causing restricted knowledge re-entry. In this work, we propose Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via restricted knowledge boundary control (ST$^2$U), which formulates test-time unlearning as trajectory-wide boundary control. ST$^2$U first models restricted knowledge boundaries in low-dimensional invertible coordinates while leaving orthogonal non-target components unchanged. During inference, ST$^2$U monitors risk along the trajectory, applies minimal boundary corrections with contextual anchoring, and propagates historical correction states across tokens to mitigate knowledge re-entry. This trajectory-wide control enables more persistent forgetting while preserving non-target capabilities and limiting inference overhead. Across three benchmarks and three model families, ST$^2$U delivers the strongest overall balance, combining best or second-best retention with competitive forgetting and substantially less restricted-knowledge re-entry than test-time baselines (13.76%-19.84% versus 46.50%-59.10%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via restricted knowledge boundary control (ST$^2$U)，针对测试时遗忘 (test-time unlearning) 中激活编辑方法只做孤立逐点修正、导致受限知识在自回归生成过程中重新进入的问题。方法将测试时遗忘建模为轨迹级边界控制，在低维可逆坐标中刻画受限知识边界，推理时沿轨迹监测风险并跨 token 传播历史修正状态。在三个基准和三个模型族上，ST$^2$U 达到最强综合平衡，并将受限知识再进入率从 46.50%-59.10% 降至 13.76%-19.84%。
Motivation: 现有激活编辑方法在推理时只做孤立的逐点修正，忽略了自回归生成会从 prompt、缓存和已生成前缀持续重建隐状态，导致局部修正成功后后续状态可能重新进入受限知识区域 (restricted knowledge re-entry)。因此需要轨迹级、有状态的测试时遗忘机制。
Method: 提出 ST$^2$U，将测试时遗忘形式化为轨迹级边界控制 (trajectory-wide boundary control)。先在低维可逆坐标中建模受限知识边界，同时保持正交的非目标分量不变；推理时沿轨迹监测风险，施加带上下文锚定 (contextual anchoring) 的最小边界修正，并跨 token 传播历史修正状态以缓解知识再进入。
Result: 在三个基准和三个模型族上，ST$^2$U 在保留非目标能力与遗忘效果之间取得最强综合平衡，保留率最佳或次佳；受限知识再进入率显著低于测试时基线 (13.76%-19.84% 对 46.50%-59.10%)，且推理开销有限。
Conclusion: 作者认为轨迹级边界控制能够实现更持久的遗忘，同时保持非目标能力并限制推理开销；摘要未明确给出方法的局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FedCC: Towards Addressing Label Distribution Skews in Distillation-Based Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed clients to collaboratively train models without sharing raw data, making it promising for leveraging massive devices in communication networks. In distillation-based FL, each client applies its local model on an unlabeled public dataset, and shares only prediction results with the server. While heterogeneous local data introduces label distribution skew, thus biasing client models toward majority classes and leading to potentially inaccurate predictions. The lack of ground-truth labels in the public dataset hampers the server's ability to calibrate predictions, which ultimately degrades overall performance. To address this, we propose FedCC, a simple and effective algorithm for mitigating client misclassification. Instead of being forced to classify and risking error propagation, clients are allowed to tag ambiguous samples as 'unknown'. This additional class, together with calibrated pseudo-labels on the public data, balances confidence in majority classes against uncertainty in under-represented ones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCC significantly outperforms existing methods, especially under severe label skew. In the extreme scenario where each client holds samples from only one of ten classes, FedCC achieves 67.3% accuracy, while baselines collapse to near-random results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCC，一种针对蒸馏式联邦学习 (distillation-based FL) 中标签分布倾斜 (label distribution skew) 的简单有效算法。核心思路是允许客户端将不确定样本标记为 'unknown'，并配合校准后的伪标签 (pseudo-labels)，从而缓解客户端模型偏向多数类的问题。实验显示在严重标签倾斜下 FedCC 显著优于现有方法；在极端情况下（每个客户端只持有十个类别中的一个类）达到 67.3% 准确率，而基线接近随机。
Motivation: 蒸馏式联邦学习中，客户端本地数据异质会造成标签分布倾斜，使模型偏向多数类并产生不准确预测；公共数据集缺少真实标签，服务器难以校准预测，最终损害整体性能。
Method: FedCC 允许客户端不强制分类，而是将模糊样本标记为 'unknown'（额外类别），并结合对公共数据校准后的伪标签，在多数类的置信度与少数类的不确定性之间取得平衡。
Result: 广泛实验表明 FedCC 显著优于现有方法，尤其在严重标签倾斜场景；在极端情况下（每个客户端仅持有十个类别中的一个类）FedCC 达到 67.3% 准确率，而基线方法崩溃至接近随机。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过允许 'unknown' 标签和校准伪标签，可以有效缓解蒸馏式联邦学习中的客户端误分类问题，改善标签倾斜下的整体性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Artificial Empathy: Towards a Framework for Unsupervised Agency Detection and Policy Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We study how an AI system can identify and model other agents in its environment from observation alone, which is a capability necessary for cooperative behaviour in the real world. This problem is less constrained than inverse reinforcement learning and remains largely unexplored. We propose a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent, trained on an independent task as a prior about agentic dynamics, to perform agency detection and policy reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督的智能体检测与策略重建框架：以在独立任务上训练的强化学习智能体作为智能体动力学的先验，仅凭观测识别环境中的其他智能体并重建其策略。摘要指出该问题比逆强化学习约束更少，且此前研究较少；该能力被视为现实世界合作行为的基础。
Motivation: 现实世界中的合作行为要求AI系统仅从观测中识别并建模其他智能体，而这一问题比逆强化学习约束更少，目前基本未被探索。
Method: 提出一个框架：使用在独立任务上训练的强化学习智能体作为关于智能体动力学的先验，并基于该先验执行智能体检测与策略重建。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数据或基准结果，主要贡献为问题定义与框架设计。
Conclusion: 论文将无监督的智能体检测与策略重建视为实现真实世界合作行为的关键能力，并强调该问题相比逆强化学习约束更少、仍有较大探索空间。

papers.title: PsychJail: Exploring Psychological Jailbreaks via Multi-Turn Persuasion of LLM Policies
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in education, healthcare, policy advising, and other interactive settings, where users engage them as sustained social interlocutors rather than one-shot query engines. This shift makes jailbreaks a growing safety threat, yet most research emphasizes single-turn prompt optimization or iterative attack refinement, leaving psychologically grounded multi-turn vulnerabilities underexplored. We present PsychJail, a psychology-guided framework for red teaming aligned LLMs through theory-grounded, multi-turn persuasion. PsychJail maps established social-psychological persuasion techniques into a tactic-conditioned attack policy. It factorizes each attacker action into a Change-of-Meaning analysis, tactic selection, and victim-visible message, operationalizing the Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM). The policy is refined with trajectory-level reinforcement learning using a PKM-gated reward that credits early jailbreak success only when every turn contains a well-formed Change-of-Meaning analysis. Across four aligned victim models, PsychJail achieves the highest average attack success rate (87.3%) and outperforms strong single-turn and multi-turn baselines on every model. We also measure susceptibility at the action that breaks each victim, revealing four distinct model-level fingerprints that identify which persuasion levers affect each model and how broadly. These fingerprints help explain cross-model transfer asymmetry. We interpret them as four candidate psychological profiles-rationalist, credibility-driven, narrative-monoculture, and broadly persuadable-while treating this interpretation as a conjecture requiring future validation. Our findings establish psychological jailbreaks as a distinct red-teaming frontier for increasingly interactive LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PsychJail，一个以心理学理论指导的多轮说服框架，用于对已对齐的大语言模型进行红队测试 (red teaming)。该框架将社会心理学中的说服技巧映射为基于策略 (tactic-conditioned) 的攻击策略，并把每个攻击动作分解为 Change-of-Meaning 分析、策略选择和受害者可见消息，以操作化 Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM)。作者用轨迹级强化学习和 PKM 门控奖励训练策略；在四个对齐受害者模型上，PsychJail 达到最高平均攻击成功率 (87.3%)，并在每个模型上都优于强单轮与多轮基线。文章还测量了各受害者在导致其被突破的那个动作上的易感性，揭示出四种模型级指纹，并将其解释为四种候选心理画像，但明确表示该解释是需要未来验证的猜想。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被部署在教育、医疗、政策建议等交互场景中，用户会将其视为持续的社会对话者而非一次性查询引擎，使越狱 (jailbreak) 成为日益严重的安全威胁。然而现有研究大多聚焦于单轮提示优化或迭代攻击精化，心理学基础的多轮脆弱性仍未被充分探索。
Method: PsychJail 将既有的社会心理学说服技巧映射为策略条件化的攻击策略，并把每个攻击动作分解为 Change-of-Meaning 分析、策略选择和受害者可见消息三部分，从而操作化 Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM)。攻击策略通过轨迹级强化学习进行训练，使用 PKM 门控奖励，仅在每一轮都包含格式良好的 Change-of-Meaning 分析时才奖励早期的越狱成功。

papers.title: Beyond Surface Cues: Disentangling Sociocultural Signals in Multilingual LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual LLM outputs can vary across sociocultural contexts. However, evidence of cultural grounding can be misleading: identity labels may be inferred from explicit or indirect textual cues, while names and wording can reveal the source language. Treating all these signals as evidence of cultural grounding may obscure potential biases. We present a human-validated, multi-agent audit that separates three questions: whether outputs reproduce social biases, whether identity groups are represented differently, and whether outputs reflect cross-cultural patterns. The study analyzes 89,253 outputs from 12 LLMs in English, French, and Chinese, spanning 18 occupations and three task conditions. We find that bias representation varies systematically across languages and tasks. Removing direct identity cues sharply reduces identity-label prediction in English and Chinese, but has a much smaller effect in French. Across all language-genre settings, the cultural context associated with the source language receives the highest average relevance score, with moderate agreement between automated and human ratings. However, the ability to identify the source language drops substantially after translation and again after masking names. Without these controls, multilingual audits may mistake surface cues for cultural understanding, leading to misleading conclusions about cross-cultural variation and bias. Our audit offers a practical framework for separating such shortcuts from more meaningful cross-cultural patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种人工验证的多智能体审计框架，用于区分多语言 LLM 输出中的三类问题：是否复现社会偏见、身份群体是否被不同地表征、以及输出是否反映跨文化模式。研究分析了 12 个 LLM 在英语、法语、中文下的 89,253 条输出，覆盖 18 个职业和三种任务条件。结果显示偏见表征随语言和任务系统变化；移除直接身份线索在英语和中文中显著降低身份标签预测，但在法语中效果较小；翻译和掩码名字会大幅降低源语言识别能力。
Motivation: 多语言 LLM 输出的文化接地证据可能被表面线索误导：身份标签可从显式或间接文本线索推断，名字和措辞也可泄露源语言。把这些信号都当作文化接地证据，会掩盖潜在偏见并导致误导性结论。
Method: 提出人工验证的多智能体审计，将文化接地问题拆分为三个独立问题，并使用翻译和掩码名字作为控制条件。研究在 12 个 LLM、英法中三种语言、18 个职业和三种任务条件下分析输出，并对比自动化与人工评分。
Result: 偏见表征在不同语言和任务间系统变化；移除直接身份线索在英语和中文中大幅降低身份标签预测，但对法语影响较小。在所有语言-体裁设置中，与源语言相关的文化语境获得最高平均相关性分数，自动化与人工评分中度一致；翻译后源语言识别能力大幅下降，掩码名字后进一步下降。
Conclusion: 缺乏这些控制时，多语言审计可能把表面线索误认为文化理解，从而对跨文化变异和偏见得出误导性结论。该审计框架用于把这类捷径与更有意义的跨文化模式分离开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When the Edit Changes the Patient: Measuring Identity Preservation in Counterfactual Retinal Images
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual medical image generation aims to modify an existing image to reflect a hypothetical scenario in which certain characteristics of the imaged subject are altered, while keeping their identity fixed. Most existing works repurpose established image editing methods, which do not directly supervise identity preservation. Instead, they assume that identity is implicitly preserved by anchoring generation to the source image. This assumption is rarely tested and may fail in domains where biometric cues are subtle, such as retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). In this work, we explicitly measure identity preservation for three groups of text-conditioned editing methods - source-anchored, structured-prompt, and paired-training - using referee classifiers, embedding alignment scores, and a blind reader study. We find that all methods produce high-quality OCT images with comparable editing success, yet their identity preservation differs markedly. Source-anchored editing frequently alters the depicted subject, while paired-training preserves it best. We argue that future work on medical counterfactual generation must explicitly measure and report identity preservation alongside image realism and editing success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对反事实医学图像生成中身份保持（identity preservation）未被显式监督和评估的问题，在视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像上系统测量三类文本条件编辑方法（source-anchored、structured-prompt、paired-training）的身份保持能力。评估使用裁判分类器（referee classifiers）、嵌入对齐分数（embedding alignment scores）和盲读研究，发现所有方法生成的图像质量与编辑成功率相当，但身份保持差异显著。
Motivation: 现有反事实医学图像生成大多复用通用图像编辑方法，假设以源图锚定即可隐式保持身份，这一假设很少被检验，且在视网膜 OCT 这类生物特征线索微弱的领域可能失效。
Method: 提出显式测量身份保持的评估框架，对三类文本条件编辑方法分别采用裁判分类器、嵌入对齐分数以及盲读研究进行对比评估。
Result: 摘要报告所有方法都能生成高质量的 OCT 图像且编辑成功率相近，但身份保持表现差异明显：source-anchored 编辑经常改变被成像对象，paired-training 方法保持身份效果最好。
Conclusion: 作者主张未来的医学反事实生成工作必须将身份保持与图像真实感、编辑成功率一起显式测量并报告，因为当前方法在该维度上表现不一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Boltzmann Equations
papers.abstract_en: The dynamics of particles in the early universe are described by Boltzmann equations, which involve high-dimensional phase-space integrals. Classical approaches use quadrature integration and evolve the system on a fixed momentum grid, which scales poorly to complicated systems and parameter scans, severely limiting the complexity of processes that can be studied. We introduce Neural Boltzmann Equations (NBEs), which combine three coupled concepts to overcome these limitations. First, particle properties are encoded in physics-inspired neural distribution functions, with parameters that can be predicted using neural networks, enabling efficient parameter scans. Second, phase-space integrals are evaluated with Monte Carlo, using importance sampling tools from collider physics. Third, we use the natural gradient method to evolve the system. After demonstrating the individual benefits of NBEs, we use the framework to perform a precision calculation of the effective number of relativistic neutrino degrees of freedom in the early universe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural Boltzmann Equations (NBEs)，用神经网络分布函数、Monte Carlo 重要性采样和自然梯度演化三种耦合技术求解早期宇宙的玻尔兹曼方程，并以此对早期宇宙有效相对论性中微子自由度数量进行精密计算。
Motivation: 经典方法采用 quadrature 积分并在固定动量网格上演化系统，对复杂过程与参数扫描扩展性差，严重限制了可研究的物理过程复杂度。
Method: 方法包含三个耦合部分：用物理启发的神经网络分布函数编码粒子性质并可用网络预测参数，以实现高效参数扫描；用来自对撞机物理的重要性采样工具做 Monte Carlo 相空间积分；用自然梯度 (natural gradient) 方法演化系统。
Result: 摘要先展示各组成部分的独立收益，随后用该框架完成了早期宇宙有效相对论性中微子自由度数的一种精密计算。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在克服传统玻尔兹曼方程求解方法在复杂系统和参数扫描上的扩展性限制，并可应用于早期宇宙的精密宇宙学计算。

papers.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) require effective unlearning to address privacy regulations and safety concerns. However, achieving precise forgetting without compromising general utility remains challenging. Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure to contextual attention-pathway decoupling. Exploiting the functional distinction between local and global attention heads, ADU identifies preplan positions that retrieve persistent sensitive anchors and fixes their candidate paths under the original model. It then trains attention-projection adapters to suppress attention mass along these paths while preserving local-attention structure and retain-set language modeling. Post-training activation exchange tests whether the modified attention-output module transmits the learned forgetting effect. ADU achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated baselines on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, including a Forget Quality of (0.93) on TOFU. It preserves 87--98% of model utility (92.9% on average versus 81.9% for baselines) while reducing side effects in benign contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADU，一个基于训练的细粒度 LLM 遗忘框架，将遗忘从 token 级擦除转向上下文注意力路径解耦（contextual attention-pathway decoupling）。ADU 利用局部与全局注意力头的功能差异，定位检索敏感锚点的预规划位置并在原始模型下固定候选路径，训练注意力投影适配器以抑制沿路径的注意力质量，同时保留局部注意力结构与保留集语言建模。在 TOFU 与 WMDP 基准上，ADU 在评估基线中取得最强综合性能，TOFU 上 Forget Quality 为 0.93，并保留 87–98% 的模型效用（平均 92.9%，基线为 81.9%）。
Motivation: 现有序列级与 token 级遗忘方法直接惩罚目标输出而不建模其上下文相关的检索路径，可能破坏语言结构或抑制良性知识，难以在精确遗忘与保持通用能力之间取得平衡。
Method: 提出 ADU 框架，利用局部与全局注意力头的功能差异识别检索持久敏感锚点的预规划位置，在原始模型下固定候选路径；随后训练注意力投影适配器抑制这些路径上的注意力质量，同时保持局部注意力结构与保留集语言建模，并通过激活交换测试验证遗忘效果是否传递。
Result: 在 TOFU 与 WMDP 基准上取得最强综合性能，TOFU 的 Forget Quality 为 0.93；保留 87–98% 的模型效用（平均 92.9%，高于基线的 81.9%），并减少良性上下文中的副作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将遗忘从 token 擦除转向上下文注意力路径解耦可实现更精确且副作用更小的遗忘，但结论范围限于所评测的遗忘基准与模型场景。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有序列级与 token 级遗忘方法直接惩罚目标输出而不建模其上下文相关的检索路径，可能破坏语言结构或抑制良性知识，难以在精确遗忘与保持通用能力之间取得平衡。
summary_sections.method: 提出 ADU 框架，利用局部与全局注意力头的功能差异识别检索持久敏感锚点的预规划位置，在原始模型下固定候选路径；随后训练注意力投影适配器抑制这些路径上的注意力质量，同时保持局部注意力结构与保留集语言建模，并通过激活交换测试验证遗忘效果是否传递。
summary_sections.result: 在 TOFU 与 WMDP 基准上取得最强综合性能，TOFU 的 Forget Quality 为 0.93；保留 87–98% 的模型效用（平均 92.9%，高于基线的 81.9%），并减少良性上下文中的副作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将遗忘从 token 擦除转向上下文注意力路径解耦可实现更精确且副作用更小的遗忘，但结论范围限于所评测的遗忘基准与模型场景。

papers.title: SplitLite: Low-Rank Residual Compression for Split Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning of on-device large language models (LLMs) faces a significant computing burden. To overcome this limitation, split learning (SL) has emerged as a promising solution, which offloads the primary training workload to a powerful server. However, SL requires exchanging high-dimensional activations and gradients between clients and the server, resulting in prohibitive communication costs. To overcome this challenge, we propose SplitLite, a communication-efficient split federated LoRA fine-tuning method that exploits the low effective rank structure of consecutive-epoch activation and gradient residuals. Our key finding is that, when LoRA uses rank $r$ updates in parameter space, the activation and gradient residuals of the same data sample between adjacent epochs also exhibit effective rank-$2r$ and rank-$4r$ structures, respectively. By revealing this property, SplitLite transmits only quantized truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) residual factors, thereby significantly reducing both activation uplink and gradient downlink traffic. Extensive experiments on the GLUE benchmark across a series of advanced on-device LLMs demonstrate that our method reduces activation uplink communication costs by up to 93.5\% and total communication costs by up to 83.7\%, without performance degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SplitLite，一种面向拆分学习 (split learning) 的通信高效联邦 LoRA 微调方法，旨在降低端侧大语言模型 (LLM) 微调时客户端与服务器之间激活和梯度的通信开销。作者发现当 LoRA 在参数空间使用秩 r 更新时，相邻训练轮次间同一样本的激活残差和梯度残差分别具有有效秩 2r 与 4r 的结构，据此只传输量化截断 SVD (truncated SVD) 残差因子。在 GLUE 基准和多种端侧 LLM 上的实验显示，该方法最多减少 93.5% 的激活上行通信和 83.7% 的总通信量，且不带来性能下降。
Motivation: 联邦微调端侧 LLM 面临严重计算负担，拆分学习通过将主要训练负载卸载到服务器解决该问题，但客户端与服务器之间需要交换高维激活和梯度，导致通信成本过高。
Method: 提出 SplitLite，利用连续训练轮次间激活与梯度残差的低有效秩结构；具体而言，当 LoRA 使用秩 r 参数更新时，激活残差和梯度残差分别表现出秩 2r 与秩 4r 的有效结构，因此仅需传输量化截断 SVD 后的残差因子，同时压缩激活上行与梯度下行流量。
Result: 在 GLUE 基准上对一系列先进端侧 LLM 的实验表明，该方法最多降低 93.5% 的激活上行通信成本与 83.7% 的总通信成本，且不造成性能退化。
Conclusion: 作者将收益归因于残差的低秩结构，并认为该机制使拆分联邦 LoRA 微调能够在保持性能的同时显著减少通信开销。

papers.title: AnaDiffusion: Anatomically CompositionalLatent Diffusion for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
papers.abstract_en: 3D brain MRI generation has made significant advances in medical imaging, simulation, and controllable anatomical analysis. However, existing generative models typically synthesize 3D volumes monolithically, often overlooking regional anatomical structures and limiting local controllability. To address these limitations, we introduce AnaDiffusion, an anatomically compositional latent diffusion framework that factorizes the generation process into distinct, anatomically meaningful regions, followed by part-to-whole assembly and global refinement. Our approach first trains part diffusion models to capture local structural priors. We then inject an assembled anatomical composite of the parts into the whole-brain latent representation and continue denoising. This mechanism enables the model to resolve global context while preserving the injected anatomy. As a result, AnaDiffusion produces both explicit part assets and a globally coherent volume, thereby enabling controllable part editing without requiring subject-specific dense segmentation maps at inference time while maintaining consistent part-to-whole brain structure. On the subject-disjoint ADNI test split, AnaDiffusion achieves the lowest FID across the whole brain, left and right hemispheres, cerebellar-brainstem complex, and seam regions. It also achieves the best cerebellar and second-best ventricular and brainstem absolute Cohen's d values among the evaluated methods. In localized editing experiments, paired MS-SSIM demonstrates high target transfer and off-target preservation, supporting controllable part replacement with minimal unintended anatomical alterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnaDiffusion，一个解剖学组合式隐空间扩散框架，用于可控的 3D 脑部 MRI 生成。该方法将生成过程分解为不同的解剖区域，先训练局部区域扩散模型，再将组装好的解剖组合注入全脑隐表示并继续去噪，从而同时产出显式的局部部件资产和全局一致的体数据。在受试者不相交的 ADNI 测试集上，该方法在多个区域取得最低 FID，并支持无需推理时稠密分割图的局部部件编辑。
Motivation: 现有生成模型通常整体式地合成 3D 体数据，忽略了区域解剖结构，导致局部可控性受限。
Method: 先为不同解剖区域训练部件扩散模型以捕捉局部结构先验，然后将各部件组装成解剖组合注入全脑隐表示，再继续去噪以在保持注入解剖结构的同时解析全局上下文。
Result: 在 subject-disjoint ADNI 测试集上，AnaDiffusion 在全脑、左右半球、小脑-脑干复合体和接缝区域取得最低 FID；在小脑上取得最佳、在脑室和脑干上取得次佳的绝对 Cohen's d 值。局部编辑实验中，配对 MS-SSIM 显示较高的目标转移和离目标保留。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在推理时无需受试者特定的稠密分割图即可实现可控部件编辑，同时保持部件到全脑解剖结构的一致性。

papers.title: Misanthrope: A Privacy-Preserving Keypoint Detector
papers.abstract_en: Image matching is a core component of applications such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), Visual Localization, and Structure from Motion (SfM). However, the local image features central to this task are vulnerable to inversion attacks, which enable adversaries to reconstruct privacy-sensitive scene content from local features. These attacks pose a particular threat in distributed computing scenarios where the pre-computed features leave edge devices to be processed by remote servers. In this work, we introduce Misanthrope, a novel privacy-preserving keypoint detector trained through self-distillation to avoid detecting keypoints on people---a predominant source of privacy-sensitive content in most localization scenarios---thus mitigating inversion attacks at the source rather than through post-hoc obfuscation. We demonstrate how inverted images from traditional feature detection pipelines can be used to detect and re-identify people in the scene, while Misanthrope is able to mitigate these attacks. Furthermore, Misanthrope maintains image matching performance on par with the state of the art and even surpasses it in challenging settings where people act as distractors, such as phototourism and in-the-wild odometry. On the Image Matching Challenge 2021 Phototourism test set, Misanthrope is the top-performing sparse feature extractor in 7 out of 9 scenes. We make our model and its evaluation script available here: https://github.com/fratopa/misanthrope
papers.comment: Accepted to Privacy preserving Visual Localization (PPVLM) workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Misanthrope，一种隐私保护的关键点检测器，通过自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 训练来避免在人物上检测关键点，从而在源头缓解基于局部特征反演的攻击，而非采用事后混淆。结果显示该方法保持与现有技术相当甚至更优的图像匹配性能，并在 IMC 2021 Phototourism 测试集的 9 个场景中于 7 个场景成为最佳稀疏特征提取器。
Motivation: 局部图像特征是 SLAM、视觉定位和 SfM 等应用的核心，但易受反演攻击：攻击者可从预计算特征重建含隐私的场景内容。尤其在分布式计算中特征被发送到远程服务器处理时威胁更大，现有缓解手段多为事后混淆，作者希望在检测源头直接避免检出人物这一主要隐私源。
Method: 提出名为 Misanthrope 的隐私保护关键点检测器，采用自蒸馏训练方式，使模型学习不检测人物身上的关键点；同时提供模型和评估脚本，用于验证反演攻击下的人物检测与重识别是否被缓解。
Result: 摘要报告 Misanthrope 能有效缓解从传统特征检测管线反演图像中检测和重识别人物的问题；图像匹配性能与现有技术水平相当，在人物作为干扰物的挑战场景（如 phototourism 和 in-the-wild odometry）中甚至更优；在 Image Matching Challenge 2021 Phototourism 测试集上，9 个场景中有 7 个为最佳稀疏特征提取器。
Conclusion: 作者认为在源头避免检测人物关键点可在不影响匹配性能的前提下有效缓解反演攻击，并已开源模型与评估脚本。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Coarse Indexing, Fine Evidence: Decoupling Temporal Granularity in Long-Video RAG
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides a scalable paradigm for long-video understanding, but existing systems typically inherit a fixed temporal granularity from video segmentation when constructing their retrieval index. We argue that this design unnecessarily couples indexing granularity with evidence granularity: coarse representations can often suffice for locating relevant temporal regions, while fine-grained evidence remains important for downstream reasoning. We propose \textbf{Density-Aware Graph Construction (DAGC)}, a training-free approach that decouples a query-independent coarse retrieval index from the original fine-grained evidence space. DAGC constructs a compact, density-adaptive graph index by merging visually redundant neighboring chunks, while preserving mappings to the original temporal units. Retrieved coarse regions are subsequently expanded back to the original chunk granularity for fine-grained evidence refinement and answer generation. Experiments on MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench show that DAGC retains only about 40--50\% of the original graph nodes and achieves $1.3$--$1.7\times$ end-to-end wall-clock acceleration while preserving approximately 99\% of the original QA performance. The gains transfer across different LVLM backbones and video RAG pipelines, suggesting that long-video RAG need not maintain the same temporal granularity for indexing and evidence reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Density-Aware Graph Construction (DAGC)，一种免训练的长视频 RAG 方法，将索引时间粒度与证据时间粒度解耦。DAGC 通过合并视觉冗余的相邻视频块，构建紧凑的密度自适应图索引，同时保留到原始时间单元的映射，检索到的粗粒度区域再扩展回原始块粒度用于证据精化。在 MLVU、VideoMME 和 LongVideoBench 上，DAGC 仅保留约 40–50% 的图节点，端到端加速 1.3–1.7 倍，并保持约 99% 的 QA 性能。
Motivation: 现有基于图的检索增强生成 (RAG) 用于长视频理解时，通常从视频分割中继承固定的时间粒度来构建检索索引，导致索引粒度与证据推理粒度不必要地耦合；事实上粗粒度表示往往足以定位相关时间区域，而细粒度证据对下游推理依然重要。
Method: 提出 DAGC，一种免训练、查询无关的图构建方法：通过在视觉上合并冗余的相邻块来构造紧凑、密度自适应的图索引，并保留到原始时间单位的映射；检索到的粗粒度区域随后被扩展回原始块粒度，以进行细粒度证据精化和答案生成。
Result: 在 MLVU、VideoMME 和 LongVideoBench 基准上，DAGC 保留约 40–50% 的原始图节点，取得 1.3–1.7 倍的端到端墙钟加速，同时保持约 99% 的原始 QA 性能；增益可迁移到不同的 LVLM 主干和视频 RAG 流水线。
Conclusion: 作者认为长视频 RAG 无需为索引和证据推理维持相同的时间粒度，粗索引与细证据的解耦可以带来计算效率提升而几乎不损失性能。
Relevance: 2
