papers.title: PatchWrite: One Line, Not One Section -- Compile-Gated, Validity-Preserving Editing for AI-Drafted Manuscripts
papers.abstract_en: Automated manuscript pipelines often regenerate an entire section to repair a local defect, allowing unrelated metrics and citations to change even when the resulting PDF still builds. PatchWrite instead constrains how candidate edits become committed manuscript states: it reuses bounded EDIT N M editing and rollback, but tightens compilation acceptance with fatal-log checks and adds evidence locks that require every cited key and experimental numeric token to be attested by a reference registry or experimental log. Candidates that fail either check are rejected and the previous HEAD is retained. On a 24-manuscript x 8-fault oracle stress test (768 jobs, evenly split between compile-breaking and content-only faults), whole-slot rewriting mutated an unrelated "12-layer" line in every case (0/192 preserved; numeric Jaccard 0.6667), whereas PatchWrite preserved it in 192/192 cases. Removing the compile gate reduced acceptance to 0, while removing the evidence gate allowed a hallucinated citation to pass. The same pattern held across all eight faults. To test the protocol with generation rather than oracle edits, we reran the 192 jobs with the writer model proposing the edits. The model's candidates were accepted in 75% of cases; nearly all rejections came from one reproducible failure mode in which the model attempted to delete a line using an empty replacement unsupported by the current grammar. Every accepted candidate passed both gates, and 93.75% fixed the injected fault; the remaining cases involved a technically valid but sentence-inappropriate citation and one markup-changing near-miss. In a blind evaluation of sixteen PDF pairs, both raters preferred PatchWrite for preserving lab-grounded facts (C1 Likert 5.0 vs. 2.0), while rating prose quality nearly identically. Logs from 193 in-product drafting tasks show the same classes of failures occurring in practice.

TL;DR: 本文提出 PatchWrite，一种面向 AI 起草手稿的编译门控、保留有效性的编辑协议。它复用受限的 EDIT N M 编辑与回滚，但通过致命日志检查收紧编译验收，并加入证据锁，要求每个引文键和实验数字 token 由参考注册表或实验日志证明。在 24 篇手稿 × 8 种故障的 oracle 压力测试（768 个任务）中，整段重写在每种情况下都改变了无关的“12-layer”行（0/192 保留），而 PatchWrite 在 192/192 情况下保留；移除编译门导致接受率为 0，移除证据门则允许幻觉引文通过。用作家模型提出编辑时，75% 的候选被接受，几乎全部拒绝源于一种可复现的失败模式（模型试图用当前语法不支持的空替换删除一行）；每个被接受的候选都通过两扇门，93.75% 修复了注入的故障。盲评 16 个 PDF 对时，两位评估者都偏好 PatchWrite 对实验室事实的保留，而散文质量评分几乎相同。
Motivation: 自动化手稿流水线通常为了修复局部缺陷而重新生成整个章节，导致无关的指标和引文发生改变，即使生成的 PDF 仍然能编译。
Method: PatchWrite 通过约束候选编辑如何成为已提交的手稿状态来工作：复用受限的 EDIT N M 编辑和回滚，但用致命日志检查收紧编译验收，并添加证据锁，要求每个被引用的键和实验数字 token 由参考注册表或实验日志证明。无法通过任一项检查的候选将被拒绝，并保留之前的 HEAD。
Result: 在 24 篇手稿 × 8 种故障的 oracle 压力测试中（768 个任务），整段重写在每种情况下都改变了无关的“12-layer”行（0/192 保留；数字 Jaccard 0.6667），而 PatchWrite 在 192/192 情况下保留。移除编译门导致接受率降至 0，移除证据门则允许幻觉引文通过。在作家模型提出编辑的测试中，75% 的候选被接受，接近全部拒绝来自一种可复现的失败模式；每个被接受的候选都通过两扇门，93.75% 修复了注入的故障。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将编译门控与证据锁定结合起来，可以在保持散文质量的同时，防止 AI 起草的手稿中产生无关的改动和幻觉引文。摘要还指出，来自 193 个产品内起草任务的日志显示，同一类故障在实践中也会出现。

papers.title: ENCORE: Entropy-Guided Cropping and Attention Regularization for Robust Vision--Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on diverse vision-language tasks, but transformer-based visual encoders split images into fixed-resolution sub-images, compromising object integrity in lightweight VLMs. Existing methods only focus on the visual modality and fail to dynamically preserve the integrity of prompt-relevant regions, limiting performance. In this work, we observe that the early-layer image-text entropy of cross-modal attention strongly correlates with answer grounding quality and task accuracy. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ENCORE}, an entropy-guided framework with two components: At inference, an \textbf{Entropy-based Cropping Strategy} (ECS) evaluates a small set of candidate crops and selects the one with minimal entropy, preserving contiguous regions relevant to the prompt. At training, \textbf{Entropy Regularization Training} (ERT) augments next-token prediction with an entropy term that sharpens attention on key visual tokens while down-weighting irrelevant ones. Experiments on ten VQA benchmarks show that ENCORE, fine-tuning only 0.14\% of parameters, achieves an average 1.43\% accuracy gain and state-of-the-art performance among recent 2B-parameter VLMs. Our code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/ENCORE.
papers.journal_ref: ICASSP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ENCORE，一个基于熵引导的视觉-语言理解框架，用于提升轻量级视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的推理性能。作者发现跨模态注意力的早期层图像-文本熵与答案 grounding 质量和任务准确率强相关，据此设计了推理时的 Entropy-based Cropping Strategy (ECS) 和训练时的 Entropy Regularization Training (ERT)。在十个 VQA 基准上，仅微调 0.14% 参数即取得平均 1.43% 的准确率提升，并在近期 2B 参数 VLM 中达到最优。
Motivation: 现有的 transformer 视觉编码器将图像切分为固定分辨率的子图，会破坏轻量级 VLM 中目标的完整性；已有方法只关注视觉模态，无法动态保留与提示相关的连续区域，限制了性能。
Method: 观察到交叉注意力中早期层图像-文本熵与答案 grounding 质量强相关，据此提出两组件框架：推理时用 ECS 评估少量候选裁剪区域并选择熵最小的一个，以保留与提示相关的连续区域；训练时用 ERT 在下一 token 预测中加入熵正则项，强化关键视觉 token 的注意力并降低无关 token 的权重。
Result: 在十个 VQA 基准上，仅微调 0.14% 参数，平均准确率提升 1.43%，并在最近 2B 参数规模的 VLM 中取得最优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，熵可作为跨模态注意力中 grounding 质量的可靠信号，基于熵的裁剪与正则化能有效增强轻量级 VLM 的视觉-语言理解能力；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Physical Response-and-Memory Model for Muon Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models is costly. How low a loss the same compute can ultimately reach depends on how each step's gradient is converted into a weight update; the rule that performs this conversion is the optimizer. From SGD and AdamW to the recent Muon, effective update rules have mostly been shaped by engineering intuition and then selected on benchmarks. Muon semi-orthogonalizes the momentum matrix before applying the update and has kept breaking records on public training benchmarks; yet why the semi-orthogonalized direction works, and over how long a history the momentum should average, are two questions at present answered mainly by experience. Here we treat the weight matrix during training as a responsive medium with memory and build a physical model for it, in which both questions find answers: the semi-orthogonalized direction is the maximally dissipative response under an output-side safety budget, which explains why it works; momentum is the internal stress accumulated by the medium; how long it should average is set by the relaxation of this stress, and a real medium relaxes on more than one timescale, the simplest form being one fast and one slow. On this basis we propose the Bi-Maxwell optimizer. The framework further yields a testable consequence: gradient directions change fast early in training and more slowly later, so the optimal memory length should grow with training stage; step-by-step measurements of a proxy for it by a read-only probe across 8 independent training trajectories are consistent with this consequence. Replacing the memory kernel alone, from a single timescale to two, brings training to the target loss in noticeably fewer steps on a public large-language-model optimizer benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把训练中的权重矩阵建模为具有记忆的响应介质，从物理角度解释 Muon 优化器中半正交化方向为何有效，以及动量平均窗口该如何设定。基于此提出 Bi-Maxwell 优化器，用快慢两个弛豫时间刻画介质应力释放，并在公开大语言模型优化器基准上以更少训练步达到目标损失。
Motivation: Muon 等更新规则主要由工程直觉驱动并在基准上挑选，半正交化方向为何有效以及动量平均历史长度应取多长，目前主要靠经验回答，缺少统一的理论解释。
Method: 将权重矩阵视为带记忆的响应介质，把半正交化方向解释为输出端安全预算下的最大耗散响应；把动量视为介质内累积的内部应力，并假设介质在多个时间尺度上弛豫，最简形式为一个快时间尺度加一个慢时间尺度，据此提出 Bi-Maxwell 优化器。
Result: 摘要报告，将记忆核从单时间尺度替换为双时间尺度，在公开大语言模型优化器基准上以明显更少的训练步达到目标损失；梯度方向变化速度随训练阶段减慢的预测也与 8 条独立训练轨迹上的测量一致。
Conclusion: 该物理框架同时回答了 Muon 半正交化方向有效的原因和动量平均长度由应力弛豫决定的问题，并给出可检验的预测：最优记忆长度应随训练阶段增长。

papers.title: Channel-Token Attention for Reliable Dynamic Spectrum Access under Bursty Primary-User Traffic
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic spectrum access must coordinate secondary users under bursty primary-user activity while preserving packet reliability and delay. We present TACAN, a centralized policy that represents each channel as a token containing occupancy history and automatic-modulation-classification entropy; a context token supplies queue class, delay and user identity. A Transformer encoder is warm-started from an occupancy-greedy policy and refined with proximal policy optimization. The frozen policies were trained to maintain a channel assignment in every slot, including when queues were empty. We therefore replay them on held-out trajectories and distinguish standby assignment success from packet-present access and packet delivery. In a 20-channel network with 60 primary devices and 4 secondary users, TACAN achieves 92.53% +/- 0.47 packet-present access success, compared with 89.94% for Greedy and 83.53% for PPO+MLP. Its paired gain over Greedy is 2.59 points (parametric 95% CI 1.89-3.29), with wins in all five seeds; the exact two-sided sign-test value is 0.0625. The gain rises from 0.57 points at normal primary-user load to 7.67 points at extreme load. TACAN also reduces mean delivery delay from 1.208 to 1.123 slots and the conditional user-reliability gap from 9.69 to 3.15 points. Delivered packets per SU-slot remain arrival-limited (30.12% versus 30.11%), so no packet-throughput gain is claimed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TACAN，一种集中式动态频谱接入策略，将每个信道表示为包含占用历史与自动调制分类熵的 token，并用 Transformer 编码器结合近端策略优化（PPO）进行训练。在 20 信道、60 个主设备、4 个次用户的网络中，TACAN 在突发主用户流量下取得 92.53% 的包存在接入成功率，优于 Greedy 和 PPO+MLP，并降低平均投递延迟与用户可靠性差距。作者强调投递包数仍受到达限制，因此未声称包吞吐量增益。
Motivation: 动态频谱接入需要在突发主用户活动下协调次用户，同时保持包可靠性和低延迟；现有策略在极端主用户负载下接入成功率下降且用户间可靠性差距较大，需要更有效地利用信道占用历史和调制信息。
Method: TACAN 将每个信道编码为包含占用历史与自动调制分类熵的 token，另设一个携带队列类别、延迟和用户身份的上下文 token；Transformer 编码器从占用贪心策略热启动，再用 PPO 精炼。由于训练时在队列为空也保持信道分配，作者在留出轨迹上回放策略，并区分待机分配成功、包存在接入与包投递三个层次。
Result: 在 20 信道、60 主设备、4 次用户的网络中，TACAN 的包存在接入成功率为 92.53%±0.47，高于 Greedy 的 89.94% 与 PPO+MLP 的 83.53%；相对 Greedy 的配对增益为 2.59 点（95% CI 1.89–3.29），五个种子全胜，精确符号检验 p=0.0625。增益从正常主用户负载下的 0.57 点升至极端负载下的 7.67 点；平均投递延迟从 1.208 降至 1.123 时隙，条件用户可靠性差距从 9.69 降至 3.15 点。投递包数仍受到达限制（30.12% 对 30.11%），未声称包吞吐量增益。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 TACAN 能在突发主用户流量下提升接入可靠性和延迟表现，但包吞吐量受到达限制，作者明确不声称吞吐量改进；该方法面向带信道占用历史与调制分类信息的集中式频谱共享场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchy-Aware Semantic Losses for Knowledge Graph Link Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs are often accompanied by ontological class hierarchies that encode valuable semantic information, yet many link prediction methods either ignore such hierarchies or incorporate them indirectly through additional graph edges. Recent work introduced hierarchy-aware graph neural networks (GNNs), which use semantic losses derived from box embeddings to encourage satisfaction of subclass relationships during GNN-based representation learning. While this approach has shown promise for biological regression tasks, its effectiveness for knowledge graph link prediction has not been investigated. In this paper we evaluate hierarchy-aware semantic losses on link prediction across three benchmark datasets: AIFB, CoDEx, and BioKG. We combine graph neural network encoders with box-embedding-based semantic losses that encourage learned representations to better satisfy ontology-derived class hierarchies, and compare this approach to both standard link prediction models and models incorporating subclass relations as graph edges. Across all datasets, hierarchy-aware semantic losses significantly improve mean reciprocal rank (MRR) and consistently outperform models that incorporate hierarchy information through additional subclass edges. Relative to the baseline GNN models, MRR improved by 7.6%, 2.4%, and 15.5% on AIFB, CoDEx, and BioKG, respectively. Furthermore, semantic losses consistently outperform the alternative of augmenting the graph with subclass edges. These results are consistent with ontology-derived class hierarchies providing complementary information to graph structure, and suggest that encouraging hierarchical consistency through semantic losses is an effective and comparatively parameter-efficient mechanism for improving knowledge graph link prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了基于 box embeddings 的层级感知语义损失（hierarchy-aware semantic losses）在知识图谱链接预测中的效果。作者将 GNN 编码器与该语义损失结合，在 AIFB、CoDEx、BioKG 三个基准上验证：相对基线 GNN，MRR 分别提升 7.6%、2.4%、15.5%，且一致优于把子类关系作为额外图边的做法。作者认为本体派生的类层级与图结构信息互补，语义损失是一种有效且参数较高效的改进方式。
Motivation: 知识图谱常伴随本体类层级，但多数链接预测方法要么忽略这类信息，要么仅通过额外图边间接使用；已有基于语义损失的层级感知 GNN 尚缺乏在知识图谱链接预测任务上的验证。
Method: 将图神经网络编码器与 box-embedding 派生的语义损失相结合，在表示学习过程中鼓励学到的表示满足本体类层级约束，并与纳入子类边作为图结构的模型进行对比。
Result: 在 AIFB、CoDEx、BioKG 三个数据集上，层级感知语义损失相对基线 GNN 的 MRR 分别提升 7.6%、2.4%、15.5%，并在所有数据集上稳定优于通过附加子类边注入层级信息的方法。
Conclusion: 结果表明本体类层级提供了与图结构互补的信息，通过语义损失鼓励层级一致性是提升知识图谱链接预测的有效且相对参数高效的途径。摘要未报告局限性。

papers.title: Hypergraph Embedding Indexing for Efficient Dense Vector Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Dense vector retrieval has become the foundation of modern semantic search, yet existing approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes treat an embedding as an indivisible point in a high-dimensional space. In this work, we propose the Hypergraph Embedding Index (HEI), a framework that instead organizes documents according to combinations of highly activated latent embedding dimensions. This formulation enables inverted-index style candidate generation while preserving the semantic ranking capabilities of dense embeddings. We further demonstrate that constructing multiple complementary hypergraphs substantially improves retrieval coverage without the combinatorial growth associated with increasing the dimensionality of a single hypergraph. Finally, we establish that the statistical properties of embedding activations strongly influence coordinate-inverted indexing efficiency, introducing \emph{activation diversity} as a diagnostic metric governing embedding indexability in coordinate-inverted frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hypergraph Embedding Index (HEI)，将文档按照高激活的潜在嵌入维度组合进行组织，从而在保留密集嵌入语义排序能力的同时支持倒排索引风格的候选生成。作者进一步表明构造多个互补超图可以在不引发单超图维度组合增长的前提下显著提升检索覆盖率，并引入 activation diversity 作为衡量坐标倒排索引可索引性的诊断指标。
Motivation: 现有近似最近邻 (ANN) 索引把嵌入视为高维空间中的不可分点，忽略了各维度激活模式中蕴含的结构，这限制了稠密向量检索的索引效率与语义排序能力。
Method: 提出 HEI 框架，基于高度激活的潜在嵌入维度组合来组织文档，实现倒排索引式候选生成，同时保留稠密嵌入的语义排序；通过构建多个互补超图提升检索覆盖，并定义 activation diversity 以刻画嵌入激活统计特性对坐标倒排索引效率的影响。
Result: 摘要报告多互补超图构造能大幅提高检索覆盖率，且避免单个超图维度上升导致的组合增长；同时表明嵌入激活的统计性质显著影响坐标倒排索引效率。
Conclusion: 论文主张利用激活维度组合可有效桥接倒排索引与稠密语义检索，activation diversity 为该类框架下的嵌入可索引性提供了诊断工具。

papers.title: SA-RSQ: A Versatile Sparse Representation Framework for Multi-modal Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deploying high-dimensional multimodal features in industrial recommender systems incurs substantial storage and latency overhead. Hard quantization is compact but introduces boundary distortion, whereas dense soft quantization couples representation quality to the limited storage budget. We propose Sparse Activation-based Residual Soft Quantization (SA-RSQ), which uses Top-K sparse routing and softmax weights to store compact (Index, Probability) tuples. The stored tuples decouple per-item storage from codebook dimensionality; for a fixed selected support, gradients propagate through the routing weights and weighted reconstruction without relying on a straight-through estimator. Experiments on a proprietary food-delivery advertising dataset show favorable reconstruction-performance and CTR trade-offs across storage budgets of 8-48 bytes per item. A preliminary Next-Distribution Prediction study and a one-week online A/B test further demonstrate the practical potential of SA-RSQ, with relative lifts of +2.51% in CTR and +3.66% in CPM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SA-RSQ (Sparse Activation-based Residual Soft Quantization)，一种面向多模态推荐系统的稀疏表示框架。它通过 Top-K 稀疏路由和 softmax 权重存储紧凑的 (Index, Probability) 元组，使每个条目的存储与码本维度解耦，并在固定支撑集上让梯度经由路由权重和加权重建传播，无需直通估计器 (straight-through estimator)。在专有外卖广告数据集上的实验显示，在每项 8-48 字节的存储预算下取得了良好的重建性能与 CTR 权衡；初步的 Next-Distribution Prediction 研究及一周在线 A/B 测试报告了 CTR +2.51%、CPM +3.66% 的相对提升。
Motivation: 工业推荐系统中部署高维多模态特征会带来巨大的存储和延迟开销。硬量化 (hard quantization) 紧凑但引入边界失真，而稠密软量化 (dense soft quantization) 将表示质量与有限的存储预算耦合，两者均存在不足。
Method: SA-RSQ 使用 Top-K 稀疏路由和 softmax 权重来存储紧凑的 (Index, Probability) 元组，从而将每项存储与码本维度解耦。对于固定的选定支撑集，梯度直接通过路由权重和加权重建传播，避免使用 straight-through estimator。
Result: 在专有外卖广告数据集上，SA-RSQ 在每项 8-48 字节的存储预算下显示出有利的重建性能与 CTR 权衡。初步 Next-Distribution Prediction 研究与一周在线 A/B 测试进一步报告了 CTR 相对提升 +2.51%、CPM 相对提升 +3.66%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SA-RSQ 在工业推荐场景中具有实际应用潜力，能够在受限存储预算下兼顾表示质量与点击率表现。

papers.title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B
papers.abstract_en: Embodied multimodal agents must answer from growing observation streams under a fixed per-decision token budget. We formalize this constraint through four resource walls: a perceptual Shannon wall for bounded state, a horizon wall for query-independent frame selection, a round wall for non-adaptive retrieval, and a conditional composition wall for fixed-depth inference. We introduce ASP, a training-free wrapper for frozen multimodal models that combines a capped structured state, a verbatim episodic index, and query-conditioned budget allocation with iterative access. Following a pre-registered protocol, we evaluate seven open-weight models from 3B to 31B on SEW-Bench, a license-free synthetic long-horizon walkthrough benchmark constructed to instantiate these walls. The registered natural-video benchmarks were not run because their frames require dataset agreements; our evidence therefore concerns access mechanisms, not natural-scene perception. Under a 4,096-token decision budget, ASP reaches 75 to 94% episodic retrieval accuracy, compared with 3 to 19% for equal-budget query-independent sampling, and budget reallocation outperforms quadrupling the sampling budget on every backbone. However, the full three-component architecture does not validate channel duality: removing the compressive state raises the flagship mean from 35.4 to 58.0, ASP does not outperform the verbatim-only baseline on any backbone, and two of four pre-registered falsification criteria fire. These results show that query-conditioned access, rather than parameter count or context growth alone, is decisive under a fixed budget, while prompted online compression does not earn its cost in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具身多模态智能体在固定每决策 token 预算下感知资源受限的问题，形式化出四条资源墙（perceptual Shannon wall、horizon wall、round wall、conditional composition wall），并提出无需训练的 ASP 包装器，结合受限结构化状态、逐字情节索引和查询条件化预算分配。作者在 SEW-Bench 合成基准上对 7 个 3B 到 31B 的开源模型进行预注册评估，发现查询条件化访问是固定预算下的决定性因素，但完整三组件架构未通过验证，提示在线压缩在该设定下得不偿失。
Motivation: 具身多模态智能体必须在固定预算下从不断增长的观测流中作答，现有方法缺乏对这种约束的系统形式化，也没有针对开放小模型的受控评估。
Method: 提出四条资源墙来刻画预算约束，并引入 ASP——一个作用于冻结多模态模型的免训练包装器，包含有容量上限的结构化状态、逐字情节索引，以及结合迭代访问的查询条件化预算分配；同时构建免许可的合成长程漫游基准 SEW-Bench 并采用预注册评估协议。
Result: 在 4,096 token 决策预算下，ASP 的情节检索准确率达 75–94%，而同等预算的查询无关采样仅为 3–19%；预算再分配在所有骨干模型上优于四倍采样预算。但去除压缩状态后旗舰均值从 35.4 升至 58.0，ASP 在任意骨干上均未超过仅逐字索引的基线，四条预注册证伪标准中有两条被触发。
Conclusion: 作者认为固定预算下查询条件化访问比参数规模或单纯扩展上下文更关键，而提示驱动的在线压缩在该设定中未体现价值；由于自然视频基准因数据协议未能运行，证据仅涉及访问机制而非自然场景感知。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely heavily on knowledge encoded in model parameters or presented as unstructured context. In domain-specific tasks, this leaves important semantic connections implicit. This often results in incomplete evidence use and brittle multi-step decisions. Ontologies offer a way to externalize domain concepts and relations as machine-interpretable structures, but constructing task-usable ontologies traditionally requires substantial effort from domain experts and is difficult to scale. Automatic construction is also challenging: an ontology that appears semantically plausible may not contain the relational structures needed for actual decision making. We present OaK, an ontology-as-a-kernel framework that dynamically constructs and refines task-oriented ontologies for LLM agents. Given task requirements and training data, OaK constructs an ontology and its knowledge graph, generates task-adaptation functions for graph reasoning, and uses judge feedback to iteratively refine both. By making relevant concepts and relations explicit, the ontology grounds knowledge retrieval and multi-step decision making. We evaluate OaK on TravelPlanner, CRMArenaPro, and ToolQA. Results show that OaK improves standard LLM agents, strengthens evidence grounding, and boosts the reliability of multi-step reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OaK，一个为大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体动态构建并细化任务导向本体 (ontology) 的框架。给定任务需求和训练数据，OaK 构建本体及其知识图谱，生成用于图推理的任务适配函数，并利用评判反馈迭代优化两者。在 TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro 和 ToolQA 上的评估显示，OaK 能提升标准 LLM 智能体的表现、增强证据锚定并提高多步推理的可靠性。
Motivation: LLM 智能体主要依赖模型参数中的知识或非结构化上下文，在领域特定任务中会遗漏重要的语义联系，导致证据利用不完整和多步决策脆弱。传统本体构建需要领域专家的大量投入且难以规模化，而自动构建的本体即使语义上看似合理，也可能缺少实际决策所需的关系结构。
Method: 提出本体即内核 (ontology-as-a-kernel) 框架 OaK：根据任务需求和训练数据动态构建本体及其知识图谱，生成用于图推理的任务适配函数，并通过评判反馈 (judge feedback) 对本体和知识图谱进行迭代细化。
Result: 在 TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro 和 ToolQA 三个基准上的实验表明，OaK 改进了标准 LLM 智能体的性能，增强了证据锚定 (evidence grounding)，并提升了多步推理的可靠性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 通过将相关概念和关系显式化，本体可以锚定知识检索和多步决策过程；作者强调自动构建并动态精化任务导向本体是提高 LLM 智能体可靠性的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 OaK，一个为大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体动态构建并细化任务导向本体 (ontology) 的框架。给定任务需求和训练数据，OaK 构建本体及其知识图谱，生成用于图推理的任务适配函数，并利用评判反馈迭代优化两者。在 TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro 和 ToolQA 上的评估显示，OaK 能提升标准 LLM 智能体的表现、增强证据锚定并提高多步推理的可靠性。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 智能体主要依赖模型参数中的知识或非结构化上下文，在领域特定任务中会遗漏重要的语义联系，导致证据利用不完整和多步决策脆弱。传统本体构建需要领域专家的大量投入且难以规模化，而自动构建的本体即使语义上看似合理，也可能缺少实际决策所需的关系结构。

papers.title: Optimize Surgical Triplet Recognition: A Knowledge-Driven Mixture-of-Experts Solution
papers.abstract_en: Surgical action triplet recognition constitutes a critical task in context-aware robot-assisted surgery, facilitating automatic surgical action perception by identifying instrument, verb, target, and their association. However, existing works struggle to analyze such complex surgical scenes due to three main issues: (1) component-level optimization conflicts caused by entangled feature spaces, (2) category-level optimization conflicts arising from severe data imbalance, and (3) lack of domain knowledge guidance that limits model interpretability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose a Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (\textit{MoeCo}) framework powered by knowledge-driven learning. Within the co-optimization pipeline, to first mitigate component-level conflicts, we introduce a component-tailored adapter that disentangles task-specific features across spatial-temporal regimes, facilitating effective component specialization. Next, we develop a coordinated gradient learning strategy to handle category-level conflicts, which adaptively rebalances positive-negative gradients to enhance the perception of rare categories. Notably, inspired by surgical domain expertise, we introduce a knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism that dynamically integrates multimodal large language model-guided knowledge via activated experts, thereby enriching the co-optimization pipeline with more expressive and robust representations. Extensive experiments on the public CholecT45 and CholecT50 datasets confirm the effectiveness of the proposed co-optimization pipeline and the superiority of dynamic priors integration via the knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 MoeCo 的混合专家引导联合优化框架，用于手术动作三元组识别（surgical triplet recognition）。该框架通过组件特化适配器解耦时空特征、协调梯度学习策略缓解类别不平衡，并引入知识驱动的混合专家机制动态整合多模态大语言模型引导的领域知识。在公开的 CholecT45 和 CholecT50 数据集上的实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有手术动作三元组识别方法面临三个主要问题：特征空间纠缠导致组件级优化冲突、严重数据不平衡导致类别级优化冲突，以及缺乏领域知识指导限制模型的解释性和鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 MoeCo 联合优化管线：引入组件特化适配器（component-tailored adapter）在时空维度上解耦任务特定特征；设计协调梯度学习策略（coordinated gradient learning）自适应地重新平衡正负梯度以增强对稀有类别的感知；并受外科领域专业知识启发，通过知识驱动的混合专家机制（knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts）动态整合多模态大语言模型引导的知识。
Result: 在 CholecT45 和 CholecT50 公开数据集上的大量实验确认了所提联合优化管线的有效性，并表明知识驱动的混合专家机制在动态先验整合方面具有优越性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过组件级特征解耦、类别级梯度协调和知识驱动的动态专家整合，可以显著提升手术三元组识别的鲁棒性与表现；摘要未说明明确局限性。

papers.title: ParallelWorld: Test-Time Scaling for Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Embodied Reasoning constitutes a fundamental capability of embodied intelligence, serving as the basis for autonomous perception, reasoning, and interaction within physical environments. Recent studies have shifted the paradigm of embodied reasoning from static perception toward dynamic exploration, where agents acquire task-relevant information through interactions with the environment. However, existing active reasoning approaches generally generate exploration trajectories incrementally without long-horizon planning. Even recently emerged test-time scaling frameworks often resort to myopic, single-step lookaheads, which struggle to resolve the delayed feedback inherent in complex, occluded spatial environments. To address this limitation, we propose ParallelWorld, a multi-horizon test-time scaling framework for embodied reasoning. Instead of greedy, single-step trials, ParallelWorld empowers agents to simulate and evaluate multi-step future trajectories in parallel before committing to an action. Specifically, we introduce a verifier-guided tree-search paradigm. Starting from the current state, ParallelWorld branches into multiple parallel trajectories and rolls them out continuously across a multi-step horizon. At each simulation step, a verifier agent evaluates the intermediate state transitions, dynamically pruning unpromising branches and prioritizing paths with the highest information gain. Once the multi-step prospective simulation is complete, the agent synthesizes the long-horizon outcomes to commit to the optimal action sequence. Finally, an answer agent performs reasoning over the selected trajectory to produce the final reasoning. Extensive experiments on ESI-Bench demonstrate that ParallelWorld consistently improves active perception and reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ParallelWorld，一个面向具身推理的多时域测试时扩展框架。针对现有主动推理方法缺乏长时域规划、常采用短视单步前瞻的问题，该方法在提交动作前并行模拟并评估多步未来轨迹，并采用验证器引导的树搜索范式：每一步由验证器评估中间状态转移、剪枝低价值分支并优先信息增益最高的路径，最终由答案智能体综合选定轨迹生成推理结果。在 ESI-Bench 上的实验显示该方法持续提升主动感知与推理性能。
Motivation: 现有具身推理已从静态感知转向动态探索，但主动推理方法通常增量生成探索轨迹而缺乏长时域规划；新出现的测试时扩展框架也多采用贪心式单步前瞻，难以应对复杂、遮挡空间环境中固有的延迟反馈。
Method: 提出多时域测试时缩放框架 ParallelWorld，采用验证器引导的树搜索（verifier-guided tree-search）：从当前状态分支出多条并行轨迹并持续多步 rollout，验证器在每个模拟步骤评估中间状态转移、动态剪枝低潜力分支并优先高信息增益路径；完成多步前瞻模拟后，综合长时域结果选择最优动作序列，再由答案智能体做最终推理。
Result: 在 ESI-Bench 上，ParallelWorld 一致地改进了主动感知和推理性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多步并行前瞻模拟与验证器引导的动态剪枝能够缓解复杂遮挡环境中的延迟反馈问题，从而提升具身推理的主动感知表现；实验评估限于 ESI-Bench。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Time-Series Foundation Models Pay Off for Industrial Monitoring? A Cost-Aware Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Industrial monitoring models must detect operationally relevant deviations while satisfying target-specific data, calibration, and resource constraints. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise reusable representations and zero-shot forecasts, yet evidence for their deployment value remains mixed when task definitions are heterogeneous and lightweight baselines are competitive. This work presents a protocol-aware empirical assessment across three settings: a C-MAPSS degradation-risk proxy, normal-only training for anomalous-sound detection on MIMII, and BDG2 forecasting-residual diagnostics with synthetic target perturbations. We assess classical one-class methods, compact neural autoencoders, residual forecasters, MOMENT-small, Chronos-T5, and TimesFM 2.5 in terms of anomaly-ranking performance, risk-horizon sensitivity, residual forecasting and perturbation sensitivity, and local implementation cost. Across 100 C-MAPSS engines evaluated out of fold, TCN-AE reaches fold-weighted AUROC/AUPRC 0.9570/0.8960, compared with 0.7310/0.3080 for MOMENT reconstruction; paired engine-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero for both differences. Across five matched MIMII pump evaluations, OCSVM also exceeds MOMENT reconstruction in AUROC and AUPRC. On a fixed 12-meter BDG2 panel, TimesFM 2.5 has the lowest aligned forecast error and the highest synthetic AUROC point estimate, although synthetic AUPRC is similar across TSFM and fitted residual models. Same-device measurements show that MOMENT incurs higher latency, peak allocated VRAM, and serialized state-dictionary size than TCN-AE. Under the evaluated frozen and zero-shot settings, TSFMs are task-dependent deployment options rather than default replacements for fitted lightweight models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在工业监测场景中的部署价值进行了成本感知的实证评估，覆盖三个任务：C-MAPSS 退化风险代理、MIMII 正常样本训练的异常声音检测、BDG2 预测残差诊断。作者对比经典单类方法、紧凑神经自编码器、残差预测器以及 MOMENT-small、Chronos-T5、TimesFM 2.5，从异常排序性能、风险时域敏感性、预测误差、扰动敏感性和本地实施成本等维度考察。结论是，在所评估的冻结和零样本设置下，TSFM 是依赖任务的部署选项，而非轻量拟合模型的默认替代品。
Motivation: 工业监测模型需在满足目标数据、校准和资源约束的同时检测运行相关偏差，而时间序列基础模型在不同任务定义和轻量基线竞争下，其部署价值证据仍然混杂。
Method: 提出协议感知的实证评估框架，在三个异构数据集上对六类方法进行比较，并加入同设备测量的延迟、峰值显存和序列化状态字典大小等成本指标。
Result: 在 C-MAPSS 的 100 台发动机折外评估中，TCN-AE 的折加权 AUROC/AUPRC 为 0.9570/0.8960，而 MOMENT 重建为 0.7310/0.3080，配对引擎簇 bootstrap 置信区间排除零差异；MIMII 泵评估中 OCSVM 也超过 MOMENT 重建。TimesFM 2.5 在 BDG2 面板上取得最低对齐预测误差和最高合成 AUROC 点估计，但合成 AUPRC 与拟合残差模型相近；MOMENT 的延迟、峰值显存和状态字典大小均高于 TCN-AE。
Conclusion: 在评估的冻结与零样本设置下，TSFM 应视为任务相关的部署选项，而非轻量拟合模型的默认替代品。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Simplified Cross-Modal Calibration for Heterogeneous Event-RGB Stereo Systems
papers.abstract_en: Accurate extrinsic calibration between event-based and frame-based cameras remains a practical bottleneck for heterogeneous stereo systems. Existing approaches often require sensor or target motion, precise synchronization, or computationally expensive event-to-image reconstruction. We propose a simple, motion-free cross-modal calibration framework that uses a temporally modulated, blended ChArUco target presented on standard consumer displays. By alternating between the original pattern and a partially blended version, the target reliably triggers events while remaining continuously observable to a frame-based camera, avoiding blank frames and reducing synchronization constraints to a coarse, trigger-based alignment. We discretize events into frames coarsely aligned with the RGB images, apply lightweight denoising, and perform ChArUco-based intrinsic and stereo extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments assess robustness to blending opacity, display brightness, external illumination, viewing angle, and handheld acquisition. Compared to the strongest motion-based reference (E2Calib + Kalibr) and a non-motion-based reference (Plasberg et al.), our approach reduces the mean reprojection error by $44\%$ and $6\%$, respectively, while substantially simplifying the calibration procedure. Finally, we demonstrate practical utility in a robotic eye-to-hand calibration case study, showing consistent transformations and stable downstream geometric measurements even under partial occlusions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/nhessenthaler/simple-evrgb-cal.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向事件相机与帧相机构成的异构立体系统的无运动交叉模态标定框架。方法使用消费级显示器上呈现的时序调制混合 ChArUco 靶标，通过交替原始图案与部分混合版本触发事件，同时保持帧相机持续可见，从而避免空白帧并仅需粗粒度的触发对齐。作者将事件离散为与 RGB 图像粗对齐的帧、轻量去噪后进行 ChArUco 内参和立体外参标定，并在多种光照、视角和手持采集条件下验证鲁棒性。
Motivation: 事件相机与帧相机之间的精确外参标定仍是异构立体系统的实际瓶颈，现有方法常要求传感器或靶标运动、精确同步或昂贵的重建步骤，限制了实用性。
Method: 提出无运动的交叉模态标定框架：在普通显示器上显示时间调制的混合 ChArUco 靶标，交替切换原始与部分混合图案以稳定触发事件并保持帧相机可视；将事件离散成与 RGB 粗对齐的帧，进行轻量去噪后执行基于 ChArUco 的内参与立体外参标定，仅需基于触发的粗对齐。
Result: 与最强的基于运动的方法 (E2Calib+Kalibr) 和一种非运动方法 (Plasberg et al.) 相比，平均重投影误差分别降低 44% 和 6%；在机器人眼-手标定案例中，即使存在部分遮挡也得到一致的变换和稳定的几何测量。
Conclusion: 该方法显著简化了事件-RGB 异质立体系统的标定流程，并在真实机器人应用中展示了实用价值；代码已公开。

summary_sections.result: 与最强的基于运动的方法 (E2Calib+Kalibr) 和一种非运动方法 (Plasberg et al.) 相比，平均重投影误差分别降低 44% 和 6%；在机器人眼-手标定案例中，即使存在部分遮挡也得到一致的变换和稳定的几何测量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法显著简化了事件-RGB 异质立体系统的标定流程，并在真实机器人应用中展示了实用价值；代码已公开。

papers.title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-step agents, where explicit reasoning supports task decomposition and tool coordination but also accumulates self-generated text. Over long trajectories, this text can dominate the context and suppress visual evidence, creating textual debt. We observe that reasoning becomes redundant once task-relevant visual evidence is grounded, while stale hypotheses can misguide later inference when grounding remains uncertain. Pruning must therefore remove redundant text without discarding visual evidence. We propose SPARE, a Kullback--Leibler (KL)-guided framework for pruning accumulated reasoning in multimodal tool-use agents. SPARE uses a compact task-state summary as privileged diagnostic context. For each candidate segment, it replays the same model under the original and summary-conditioned contexts. Reverse-KL divergence from on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) then tests whether the summary sufficiently covers the segment without disrupting future reasoning. We further fine-tune the summarizer with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), enabling more compact summaries, broader coverage, and more aggressive pruning. Across multi-step visual tool-use benchmarks, SPARE achieves the highest average accuracy among pruning methods while removing 37.89--64.58\% of reasoning tokens. This favorable accuracy--context trade-off shows that reducing textual dominance restores reliance on visual evidence and mitigates over-conditioning on self-generated language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为多步智能体时，自生成文本在长轨迹中占据上下文、压制视觉证据的“文本债务”（textual debt）问题。作者提出 SPARE，一个基于 KL 散度的推理文本剪枝框架，利用紧凑任务状态摘要作为诊断上下文，并通过反向 KL 散度判断候选文本段是否已被摘要充分覆盖。在多步视觉工具使用基准上，SPARE 在剪枝方法中取得最高平均准确率，同时移除 37.89%–64.58% 的推理 token。
Motivation: MLLM 智能体在长轨迹中会积累大量自生成推理文本，这些文本可能主导上下文并抑制视觉证据；同时，一旦任务相关视觉证据被落地，冗余推理不再必要，而接地不确定时的过时假设会误导后续推理。现有剪枝需要在不丢弃视觉证据的前提下移除冗余文本。
Method: 提出 SPARE 框架，使用紧凑任务状态摘要作为特权诊断上下文；对每个候选文本段，在原始上下文与摘要条件下重放同一模型，通过基于策略内自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation, OPSD）的反向 KL 散度检验摘要是否充分覆盖该段且不干扰未来推理。摘要器还经监督微调（SFT）以支持更紧凑的摘要和更激进的剪枝。
Result: 在多步视觉工具使用基准上，SPARE 在所有剪枝方法中取得最高平均准确率，同时移除 37.89%–64.58% 的推理 token，表明其实现了有利的准确率–上下文长度权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为减少文本主导性可以恢复模型对视觉证据的依赖，并缓解对自生成语言的过度条件化（over-conditioning）。

papers.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly evaluated not only by whether they solve a task, but also by how they execute it. However, existing process-level evaluations often treat action prediction, task uncertainty, and step attribution as if they were the same problem, which makes it unclear what such evaluations actually measure. In this paper, we introduce a measurement framework for process evaluation in coding agents and instantiate step-level causal attribution with SCAE, a replay-based estimator derived from a structural causal model of agent execution. Our framework combines prefix-conditioned identification, replay/intervention-based estimation, and controlled judge-information manipulation to study process evaluation at the action, task, and step levels. Experiments on 499 file-localization episodes from 12 repositories show that next actions are driven primarily by execution provenance rather than code-graph transitions, execution uncertainty is structured at the task rather than step level, and full-trace judges exhibit systematic collider bias, suggesting that current process evaluation often measures semantic relevance rather than certified causal contribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对编码智能体 (coding agents) 的过程级评估 (process-level evaluation) 提出测量框架，指出行动预测、任务不确定性与步骤归因常被混为一谈。作者用结构因果模型推导出基于重放的估计器 SCAE，并在 12 个仓库的 499 个文件定位 episode 上从行动、任务、步骤三个层面做实验。结果显示下一行动主要由执行来源 (execution provenance) 而非代码图转移驱动，执行不确定性主要在任务层面而非步骤层面，且全轨迹裁判存在系统性 collider bias，说明当前过程评估往往度量语义相关性而非经认证的因果贡献。
Motivation: 编码智能体越来越强调‘如何执行’而不只是‘是否解决’，但现有过程级评估常把行动预测、任务不确定性和步骤归因当作同一问题处理，导致这些评估实际在测量什么并不清晰。
Method: 引入面向编码智能体过程评估的测量框架，并用 SCAE 实例化步骤级因果归因；SCAE 是基于智能体执行结构因果模型导出的重放式估计器。框架结合前缀条件识别 (prefix-conditioned identification)、基于重放/干预的估计，以及对裁判信息的受控操纵，以区分行动、任务、步骤三个层面。
Result: 摘要报告在 499 个文件定位 episode 上的实验：下一行动主要由执行来源驱动而非代码图转移；执行不确定性呈现任务级而非步骤级结构；全轨迹裁判展现出系统性 collider bias，提示当前过程评估往往测的是语义相关性而非因果贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为过程评估应当明确区分行动、任务、步骤三个层面，并指出现有评估常测量语义相关性而非经过认证的因果贡献；这为后续设计更严谨的编码智能体过程评估提供了框架性依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WildHandBench: A Benchmark for Handwritten Text Understanding that Challenges MLLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: While the top model on OmniDocBench now reaches 96.34% overall on printed-document parsing, the ability of current models to handle challenging handwritten documents remains largely uncharacterized. Existing benchmarks focus on isolated text or formulas, overlook handwritten tables and real-world degradation, and report aggregate accuracy without explaining why models fail. We present WildHandBench, a benchmark containing 500 handwritten documents across three structures (free text, tables, formulas), four languages, and nine real-world scenarios. We introduce a Prior-Driven Error (PDE) metric that quantifies whether errors originate from language priors rather than visual evidence. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art models together with calibrated human baselines, we find: (1) the best model achieves only 71.85% overall; (2) humans outperform all models yet the gap is narrow (77.09% vs. 71.85%); and (3) model errors are qualitatively different from human errors -- 63-91% of model errors are prior-driven versus only 49% for humans, exposing systematic reliance on language priors that conventional accuracy metrics cannot capture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WildHandBench，一个包含 500 份手写文档的手写文本理解基准，覆盖自由文本、表格和公式三种结构，四种语言和九个真实场景。作者引入 Prior-Driven Error (PDE) 指标来区分错误源于语言先验还是视觉证据，并评估了 18 个最先进模型与校准后的人类基线。结果显示最佳模型仅为 71.85%，人类为 77.09%，且模型 63-91% 的错误是先验驱动，而人类仅 49%，揭示了现有模型对手写文档中语言先验的系统性依赖。
Motivation: 现有模型在打印文档解析上已接近饱和，但对手写文档的处理能力尚未被充分刻画。已有基准多聚焦于孤立文本或公式，忽略了手写表格和真实退化情况，且仅报告聚合准确率，无法解释模型失败的原因。
Method: 构建了 WildHandBench 基准，包含 500 份手写文档，涵盖三种结构（自由文本、表格、公式）、四种语言和九个真实场景。提出 Prior-Driven Error (PDE) 指标，用于量化错误是来自语言先验而非视觉证据，并基于该指标对模型和人类基线进行对比分析。
Result: 在 18 个最先进模型和校准人类基线的评估中，最佳模型整体准确率仅 71.85%；人类为 77.09%，尽管人类全面优于模型但差距不大。模型错误中 63-91% 被判定为先验驱动，而人类仅为 49%，表明模型错误与人类错误存在定性差异。
Conclusion: 论文指出常规准确率指标无法捕捉模型对手写文档中语言先验的系统性依赖，WildHandBench 与 PDE 指标有助于暴露此类失败模式，为手写文档理解评估提供了新的维度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization
papers.abstract_en: We analyze a variant of stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization (SGDIR) and derive dimension-free upper bounds on its expected excess risk for the squared loss. In the noiseless case, we obtain new bounds for both averaged and non-averaged SGDIR under moment, source, and capacity assumptions. For a particular value of the source parameter, these bounds are of order $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$, where the number of training samples is of order $m$. For another value of the source parameter, we obtain, for any $ε>0$, bounds of order $m^{-3+ε}$, provided that the capacity parameter exceeds $ε^{-1}$. We also establish a lower bound that matches our upper bounds in certain regimes up to a polylogarithmic factor. In the noisy case, we provide an instance-based comparison between SGDIR and ridge regression. Under general assumptions and a mild lower bound on the regularization parameter, we show that the expected excess risk of SGDIR is no larger than that of ridge regression, up to a polylogarithmic factor. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real data are consistent with our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析带初始正则化的随机梯度下降（SGDIR）在平方损失下的期望超额风险，给出与维度无关的上界。无噪声情形下，在矩、源和容量假设下得到平均与非平均 SGDIR 的新界：对某一源参数取值为 $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$，对另一取值为 $m^{-3+\varepsilon}$（容量参数超过 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 时），并建立在某些区域与上界相差多对数因子的下界。有噪声情形下，在一般假设和正则化参数的温和下界条件下，证明 SGDIR 的期望超额风险不超过岭回归（ridge regression）的多对数因子倍数，合成与真实数据实验与理论一致。
Motivation: 现有随机梯度下降理论通常忽略正则化的作用，或在维数相关假设下给出边界；本文针对带初始正则化的 SGD 变体，希望在源条件、容量条件和矩假设下获得维度无关的期望超额风险界，并刻画其与岭回归的关系。
Method: 对带初始正则化的随机梯度下降（SGDIR）进行理论分析，分别处理无噪声和有噪声情形；在无噪声情形下推导平均与非平均 SGDIR 的上界及匹配的下界，在有噪声情形下通过实例化比较（instance-based comparison）建立 SGDIR 与岭回归的风险序关系。
Result: 无噪声情形下，对某个源参数值获得阶为 $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$ 的界；对另一个源参数值，当容量参数超过 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 时获得阶为 $m^{-3+\varepsilon}$ 的界，且下界在特定区域与上界匹配至多对数因子。有噪声情形下，在正则化参数满足温和下界时，SGDIR 的期望超额风险至多比岭回归大多项式对数因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SGDIR 在平方损失下具有维度无关的风险上界，并且其有噪声表现可被证明不差于岭回归；数值实验支持理论结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: WADE: A Reasoning-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Instance Floating-Waste Grounding with Compact Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Floating waste in inland waterways threatens aquatic ecosystems and requires timely monitoring under cluttered, multi-object conditions. Existing aquatic-waste datasets provide limited geographic coverage, sparse multi-instance annotations, and little supervision beyond boxes and labels. Compact vision-language models (VLMs) therefore remain insufficiently evaluated for jointly localizing, classifying, counting, and explaining floating waste. We introduce WADE, a reasoning-annotated benchmark containing 2,167 images from rural Bangladesh, 13,608 bounding boxes, and ten waste categories. Each annotation is associated with class-level recognition rules covering visual cues, likely confusions, and discriminative features. We evaluate six VLMs under zero-shot, two-shot, reasoning-guided, and fine-tuned settings using detection, counting, and hallucination metrics. For resource-efficient adaptation, we jointly fine-tune Qwen3-VL-2B on boxes, labels, and reasoning chains using QLoRA. Fine-tuning increases recall from 0.0248 to 0.2339 and F1 from 0.0257 to 0.2163, while reducing image-level hallucination from 0.6836 to 0.0883. However, over three-quarters of instances remain undetected, establishing WADE as a challenging benchmark for dense floating-waste grounding with compact VLMs.

papers.title: What Proves You Wrong: Benchmarking Language Models on Falsifiable Research Ideation
authors: Haoli Bai (5) ((1) State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to propose research ideas, yet the prevailing ways of judging such ideas supply no shared decision rule: free-form judging sways with style and position, and scoring against a later paper rewards recovery of one realized trajectory. We introduce a benchmark that carries a proposal from Literature to Test: the Lit2Test benchmark centers on a six-field contract organized around a falsifying outcome, so that every proposal precommits the observation that would prove it wrong, making its quality decidable in the first place rather than merely arguable. Built prospectively from 200 real-paper neighborhoods, Lit2Test elicits proposals from four frontier models and compares them through 1,200 pairwise comparisons judged blind in both presentation orders. The protocol audits its own reliability through diagnostic controls and bounded human calibration, with three annotators corroborating the conclusions within explicitly stated reliability bounds. Lit2Test recovers a strict ranking of the four models in all 10,000 bootstrap replicates, and the separation comes from the quality of the proposed tests and metrics rather than from surface fluency. We release the benchmark, construction pipeline, and audit artifacts for public use.
papers.comment: Equal contribution by Ziyue Wang, Aomufei Yuan and Yiran Yao. Corresponding authors: Tong Yang and Xu Sun
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lit2Test 基准，用于评测大语言模型生成可证伪研究构思的能力。该基准要求每个提案围绕一个可证伪结果预承诺其证伪观测，将构思质量从可争论变为可判定；基于 200 个真实论文邻域前瞻性构建，通过 1200 次成对比较、盲评和两种呈现顺序，并辅以诊断控制与有界人工校准。结果表明四个前沿模型的严格排序在全部 10000 次 bootstrap 重复中保持一致，且区分度来自测试与度量质量而非表面流畅度。
Motivation: 现有对大语言模型研究构思的评判缺乏共享决策规则：自由形式评判受风格和位置影响，而对照后来论文打分只奖励还原单一实现轨迹。作者希望建立一种可判定、可复现的基准来比较模型的研究构思能力。
Method: Lit2Test 基准围绕一个六字段契约（以证伪结果为中心），让每个提案预先承诺会证明其错误的观测；从 200 个真实论文邻域前瞻性生成提案，由四个前沿模型产出，通过 1200 次成对比较、盲评及两种呈现顺序进行评估，并使用诊断控制与有界人工校准审计协议可靠性。
Result: Lit2Test 在全部 10000 次 bootstrap 重复中恢复出四个模型的严格排序；作者指出该排序差异来自提案中测试与度量质量，而非表面流畅度。
Conclusion: 论文发布基准、构建流程与审计产物供公开使用，强调通过预承诺证伪观测可使研究构思质量变得更加可判定。

papers.title: A Momentum-Based Variance-Reduced Algorithm for Federated Multiobjective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning has traditionally been formulated as a single-objective optimization problem, primarily focused on maximizing model utility. In real-world applications, however, machine learning models often need to optimize multiple and potentially conflicting objectives simultaneously. This motivates federated multiobjective optimization (FMOO), which provides a natural framework for jointly handling multiple task-specific objectives in federated learning. In this paper, we propose a momentum-based variance-reduced algorithm for federated multiobjective optimization. The method incorporates a momentum-driven gradient estimator into the local updates to reduce the variance of stochastic updates, leading to an improved convergence rate. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that the expected Pareto stationarity measure of a randomly selected output iterate decays at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3})$, improving upon the $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ rates established for existing methods such as FSMGDA and FedCMOO. Numerical experiments on federated multiobjective optimization benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于联邦多目标优化（FMOO）的动量方差缩减算法。方法在局部更新中引入动量驱动的梯度估计器以降低随机更新的方差，从而改善收敛速率。理论上证明随机选取输出迭代点的期望 Pareto 平稳性度量以 O(T^{-2/3}) 速率衰减，优于现有方法（如 FSMGDA 和 FedCMOO）的 O(T^{-1/2})。数值实验在联邦多目标优化基准上验证了该算法的有效性与竞争性能。
Motivation: 联邦学习通常被建模为单目标优化问题，但实际应用中的模型往往需要同时优化多个潜在冲突的目标，因此需要联邦多目标优化这一自然框架来联合处理多个任务特定目标。
Method: 提出一种基于动量的方差缩减算法，在联邦多目标优化的局部更新中采用动量驱动的梯度估计器，以减少随机更新的方差并改进收敛速率。
Result: 理论保证显示期望 Pareto 平稳性度量以 O(T^{-2/3}) 速率衰减，优于 FSMGDA、FedCMOO 等现有方法的 O(T^{-1/2})；基准数值实验表明算法有效且具有竞争性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提动量方差缩减方法能够带来比现有联邦多目标优化算法更优的理论收敛率，并在基准任务上展现出竞争性能。

papers.title: Quality Inspection of Printed Circuit Board Pin Insertion via Semantic Segmentation and Board-Level Feature Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Quality control during printed circuit board (PCB) assembly is a critical step in ensuring reliable electronic products. Detecting misaligned pins during or after pin insertion remains a particularly challenging inspection task. This paper presents an automated defect detection method for identifying incorrectly inserted pins on PCBs. The proposed pipeline combines semantic segmentation using a U-Net architecture with contour-based feature extraction and logistic regression for board-level pass/fail classification. Segmentation masks are used to derive contour representations of individual pins, from which board-level features -such as average contour size- are extracted and used to train a logistic regression classifier. We evaluate the method on two datasets: an industrial collection of real-world PCB images, and a publicly available PCB pin-inspection dataset with substantially different visual characteristics. To assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach, a comparison against PatchCore, an anomaly detection technique new to be applied to pin inspection, as well as instance segmentation-based pin detection is made. The developed method achieved Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (ROC-AUC) values of 0.990 on a random test set split from the industrial data and 1.000 on the public dataset indicating strong separation between pass and fail boards. The results indicate that the proposed approach is a promising candidate for automated pin inspection in industrial environments and achieves strong performance on datasets with substantially different visual characteristics after dataset-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 PCB 引脚插入质量的自动缺陷检测方法，将 U-Net 语义分割与基于轮廓的特征提取及逻辑回归相结合，用于板级 pass/fail 分类。方法在工业 PCB 图像随机测试集上取得 ROC-AUC 0.990，在公开引脚检测数据集上取得 1.000，并与 PatchCore 异常检测及基于实例分割的引脚检测方法进行了对比。
Motivation: PCB 组装中错位引脚的检测是一项困难的质量控制任务，现有方法在插入期间或之后自动检测错位引脚的能力仍有限，需要更可靠且能适应不同视觉特征的检测方案。
Method: 提出一个三条流水线：先用 U-Net 进行语义分割得到引脚掩码，再从掩码中提取单个引脚的轮廓表示并计算板级特征（如平均轮廓大小），最后用这些特征训练逻辑回归分类器完成板级通过/失败判定；同时与 PatchCore 异常检测和基于实例分割的引脚检测方法进行比较。
Result: 在工业数据随机测试集上 ROC-AUC 达到 0.990，在公开数据集上达到 1.000，表明通过/失败板之间存在很强的区分度，且在视觉特征差异明显的数据集上经针对性训练后表现良好。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法是有前景的工业自动化引脚检测方案，能够在不同视觉特征的数据集上获得强性能，但需要针对具体数据集进行训练。

papers.title: Concepts for Securing Agentic AI Coding and the Terok Environment
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is a fascinating new tool for software development. It is a huge step forward compared to "conventional" AI assisted coding, which in turn was a considerable breakthrough earlier. AI support through LLMs is a young and very fast-moving field. The "conventional" (non-agentic) flavor became useful and productive in early 2025 (around 18 months ago) and the agentic flavor followed in fall 2025 (approximately 9 months ago). Besides all its benefits and potential, it also carries some fundamental risks for IT security. And the agentic approach added very severe risks while making others much more dangerous. With all the motivation to explore this fascinating new tool we should not ignore the risks but actively address them. We present (I) an assessment of the IT security risks, (II) a concept for mitigating them without breaking its benefits, and (III) an overview about an implementation of our concept. In this very dynamic field this is likely not the final and once-and-for-all answer to the identified issues but still a substantial step forward in responsible usage of Agentic AI for software development. It should also be a contribution to the community to allow early and eager evaluation of the potential of agentic AI for software development without actually suffering from its implied IT security risks.
papers.comment: to be published in the proceedings of the AGENSYS workshop (Workshop on Knowledge Discovery, Maintenance and Distributed Intelligence in Multi-Agent Systems) at ECML PKDD 2026 conference in Sept. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体式 AI 编程（agentic AI coding）带来的 IT 安全风险，提出一套风险评估、缓解概念和实现概览。作者认为与传统 AI 辅助编程相比，agentic 方式引入了更严重的安全风险，需要主动应对而非回避。文章以知识型贡献为主，并介绍了其所提出的 Terok 环境下安全化智能体编程的实现思路。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的智能体式 AI 编程在带来生产力提升的同时引入了显著且更危险的 IT 安全风险；作者主张在探索该工具潜力的同时必须主动识别和缓解这些风险，而不是忽略它们。
Method: 文章由三部分组成：(I) 对 IT 安全风险进行评估；(II) 提出在不破坏 AI 编程收益的前提下缓解这些风险的概念框架；(III) 给出该概念在 Terok 环境中的实现概览。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果或基准评测，主要贡献是系统性的风险识别、缓解概念设计以及一个实现层面的概览。
Conclusion: 作者承认在快速演进的领域中这不太可能是最终定论，但认为该工作是负责任使用 Agentic AI 进行软件开发的重要一步，也让社区能够在避免安全风险的前提下尽早评估其潜力。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者承认在快速演进的领域中这不太可能是最终定论，但认为该工作是负责任使用 Agentic AI 进行软件开发的重要一步，也让社区能够在避免安全风险的前提下尽早评估其潜力。

papers.title: Motion-Based Tokenization for Cross-Dataset Egocentric Gaze Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Gaze is increasingly used as an input signal for vision and multimodal models, yet no consensus exists on how to represent it across datasets. Raw traces preserve detail but are noisy and device-dependent, while coarse event labels are easy to model but can discard local motion structure. We formulate event-aligned, fixed-horizon angular displacement as an interpretable, event-conditioned motion vocabulary and compare it with event-only, spatial, absolute-angle, learned vector-quantized, and continuous representations. To assess transfer alongside target predictability and token collapse, our evaluation combines next-token prediction with target-domain regret, low-order target references, paired bootstrap, order sensitivity, motif overlap, and frozen structural probes. In an event-aligned headset benchmark, angular-motion tokens have lower target-domain regret than frozen-codebook VQ tokens in one transfer direction, while the reverse direction is inconclusive. The probes reveal complementary representation properties, and event-only tokens show that low perplexity can retain little motion information. On a third egocentric dataset, a matched comparison of I-VT, native, and frame-span interfaces shows that event construction materially changes transfer: native events have the lowest regret into EGTEA, while frame-span events have zero motif overlap and fail severely as a source. Motion-based tokenization therefore provides a compact representation for event-aligned egocentric gaze streams, while the evaluation identifies how target predictability and event construction shape cross-dataset conclusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨数据集的第一人称视角眼动建模提出基于运动的token化方法，将事件对齐的固定视界角位移（angular displacement）构建为可解释的、以事件为条件的运动词表，并与事件only、空间、绝对角度、学习式向量量化及连续表示进行比较。评估结合下一token预测、目标域regret、配对bootstrap、motif重叠和冻结结构探针等指标。在事件对齐的头戴设备基准上，角运动token在一个迁移方向上的目标域regret低于冻结码本VQ token，而反向结果不具结论性；事件构造方式会显著改变跨数据集结论。
Motivation: 眼动越来越多地被用作视觉和多模态模型的输入信号，但不同数据集之间缺乏统一的眼动表示方式。原始轨迹保留细节但噪声大且依赖设备，粗糙的事件标签易于建模却可能丢失局部运动结构。
Method: 将事件对齐的固定视界角位移形式化为可解释的、以事件为条件的运动词表，并与事件only、空间、绝对角度、学习式向量量化（VQ）和连续表示进行对比。评估采用下一token预测结合目标域regret、低阶目标参考、配对bootstrap、顺序敏感性、motif重叠及冻结结构探针的综合方案。
Result: 在事件对齐的头戴设备基准上，角运动token在一个迁移方向上的目标域regret低于冻结码本VQ token，反向方向则无法得出明确结论。探针显示不同表示具有互补性质；事件only token表明低困惑度也可能保留很少的运动信息。在第三个第一人称数据集上，native事件迁移到EGTEA的regret最低，而frame-span事件的motif重叠为零，作为源域时严重失效。
Conclusion: 基于运动的token化可为事件对齐的第一人称眼动流提供紧凑表示，同时评估揭示目标可预测性和事件构造方式如何影响跨数据集结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Multi-User Communication Design for Dense IoT Networks: Interference-Aware Finite-Blocklength Communication and Preliminary MIMO Extensions
papers.abstract_en: Dense IoT networks require reliable communication despite limited spectrum and substantial multi-user interference while maintaining manageable receiver complexity. This work introduces a deep-learning-based end-to-end multi-user communication design for interference-limited finite-blocklength IoT scenarios, focusing on short and medium blocklengths. We extend a prior 2-user SiameseNet transceiver framework to accommodate 2, 4, and 8 users, leveraging learned redundancy for interference suppression and noise robustness. Compared to conventional non-orthogonal access baselines, our method demonstrates strong Block Error Rate (BLER) performance across various scenarios without resorting to joint detection; the per-user decoder scales roughly linearly with the number of users. Further, we examine the robustness under interference mismatch and unequal interference strengths, critical for practical deployments with heterogeneous devices. The Latent-space analysis reveals that the learned codeword distance increases as the effective per-user rate decreases, corroborating with the observed BLER improvements. In addition, we also present preliminary results for a 2X2 MIMO setup under fixed-channel CSIT and CSIR, indicating potential for extending the framework to IoT gateways with multiple antennas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的端到端多用户通信设计，针对干扰受限的有限块长（finite-blocklength）密集物联网场景，将先前的2用户SiameseNet收发器框架扩展到2、4、8个用户。与传统非正交接入基线相比，该方法无需联合检测即可在多种场景下取得较强的块错误率（BLER）表现，且每用户解码器复杂度随用户数近似线性增长。潜在空间分析显示学习码字距离随有效每用户速率降低而增大，与BLER改进一致。初步2x2 MIMO实验表明该框架有潜力扩展到多天线物联网网关。
Motivation: 密集物联网网络在有限频谱和大量多用户干扰下需要可靠通信，同时要保持接收机复杂度可控；传统非正交接入方案可能依赖联合检测导致复杂度高，而深度学习在多用户有限块长场景中的系统化扩展尚未充分探索。
Method: 将先前的2用户SiameseNet收发器框架扩展为支持2、4、8个用户的版本，利用学习到的冗余实现干扰抑制与噪声鲁棒性；在干扰失配和不等干扰强度条件下评估鲁棒性，并在固定CSIT/CSIR的2x2 MIMO设置下给出初步扩展结果。
Result: 与传统非正交接入基线相比，该方法在多种场景下取得更强的BLER性能且无需联合检测；每用户解码器复杂度随用户数近似线性扩展。潜在空间分析显示学习码字距离随有效每用户速率降低而增加，与BLER改进一致；2x2 MIMO初步结果显示向多天线物联网网关扩展的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要总结该深度学习框架在干扰受限的有限块长IoT场景下是传统非正交接入的可行替代，且解码器复杂度可控；初步MIMO结果提示可进一步扩展到多天线物联网网关场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Observed Auxiliary Relations: Environment-Conditioned Modeling for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-behavior recommendation (MBR) leverages auxiliary behavioral signals, such as clicks and add-to-cart, to enhance target behavior prediction like purchases. While recent graph neural network-based approaches have achieved strong performance by systematically propagating auxiliary behavior signals, they still suffer from two fundamental challenges inherent to auxiliary behaviors: (1) missing auxiliary signals, which hinder generalization to items without auxiliary observations, and (2) unreliable auxiliary signals, which amplify noise misaligned with the target behavior. To address these challenges in a unified manner, we propose BOAR, an environment-conditioned MBR framework that addresses missing and unreliable auxiliary signals through two complementary modules conditioned on auxiliary observability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BOAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 7.82% gains in HR@10 overall and up to 44.2% gains for target items without auxiliary observations, highlighting its ability to capture hidden preferences beyond observed auxiliary relations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/LSH0411/BOAR.
papers.comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management). 11 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BOAR，一个环境条件化的多行为推荐 (multi-behavior recommendation, MBR) 框架，统一处理辅助行为信号中的缺失 (missing) 与不可靠 (unreliable) 问题。框架通过两个基于辅助可观测性 (auxiliary observability) 条件化的互补模块来建模，实验在 HR@10 上最高获得 7.82% 的总体提升，对无辅助观测的目标项目获得最高 44.2% 的提升。作者强调该方法能捕捉超出已观测辅助关系的隐藏偏好。
Motivation: 现有基于图神经网络的多行为推荐方法在传播辅助行为信号时仍面临两个固有挑战：缺失的辅助信号会阻碍对无辅助观测项目的泛化，而不可靠的辅助信号会放大与目标行为不一致的噪声。
Method: 提出环境条件化的 BOAR 框架，通过两个互补模块来分别或联合处理缺失与不可靠的辅助信号，并以辅助观测性作为条件进行建模。
Result: 大量实验表明 BOAR 持续优于现有的最先进基线，在 HR@10 上总体最高提升 7.82%，对没有辅助观测的目标项目最高提升 44.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BOAR 能够捕捉超出已观测辅助关系的隐藏偏好，并开源代码；未在摘要中明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Safety Hacking in Constrained Best-of-$N$ Inference-time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time pipelines often sample multiple outputs, filter them with a learned safety model, and return the proxy-feasible output with the highest learned reward. We show that this composition creates a two-stage failure: an imperfect safety proxy first contaminates the feasible set with unsafe outputs, and reward maximization can then amplify this residual contamination. We define \emph{safety hacking} as selecting an output that passes the learned constraint but violates the true safety criterion. For constrained Best-of-$N$ sampling, we derive finite-$N$ bounds governed by the joint upper reward tails of safe and unsafe outputs within the proxy-feasible set. If unsafe-but-feasible outputs have the heavier tail, safety hacking becomes asymptotically certain as $N$ grows, even when false-positive mass and average safety- and reward-proxy errors are arbitrarily small. We also show that policies within a bounded $χ^2$ divergence from the proxy-feasible reference distribution admit an $N$-independent safety-hacking bound, and instantiate this general coverage-control principle with constrained pessimistic sampling. Coverage control limits amplification but cannot repair a contaminated feasible set: admitted unsafe outputs may still be favored, and regularized selection is not necessarily safer than constrained Best-of-$N$ for every reward proxy. Toy and language-model experiments characterize both contamination and its reward-tail amplification, which exposes an inherent difficulty in inference-time scaling with learned safety models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于约束 Best-of-N 采样的推理时缩放（inference-time scaling）中的两阶段失效：不完美的安全代理先用伪可行输出污染可行集，随后奖励最大化放大这一残留污染，导致“安全破解”（safety hacking），即所选输出通过代理约束但违反真实安全标准。作者推导了有限 N 下的界，并指出在不可行但可行的输出具有更重奖励上尾时，随着 N 增大安全破解渐近必然发生，即使假阳性质量与平均代理误差任意小。玩具与语言模型实验刻画了污染及其尾放大效应。
Motivation: 推理时 pipeline 常用学习的安全模型过滤采样输出并返回最大奖励的伪可行输出，但该组合存在一个尚未充分理论化的系统性缺陷：安全代理误差与奖励最大化相互叠加，可能使安全破解随采样数增加而趋于必然。
Method: 定义安全破解，并为约束 Best-of-N 采样推导有限 N 界，该界由代理可行集内安全与不安全输出的联合奖励上尾（joint upper reward tails）控制。作者进一步证明，与代理可行参考分布的 χ² 散度（χ² divergence）有界的策略族存在与 N 无关的安全破解界，并用约束悲观采样（constrained pessimistic sampling）实例化该覆盖控制原则。
Result: 摘要表明：若不可行但伪可行的输出具有更重奖励尾，即使假阳性质量和平均安全/奖励代理误差任意小，安全破解在 N 增长时也渐近确定；覆盖控制能限制放大但无法修复被污染的可行集，被接纳的不安全输出仍可能被偏好，且正则化选择不一定对每个奖励代理都比约束 Best-of-N 更安全。
Conclusion: 研究表明使用学习的安全模型进行推理时缩放存在固有困难：污染集无法修复、奖励放大不可避免，设计者需警惕安全破解的渐近风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in Conjunction with CVPR 2026
papers.abstract_en: This report summarizes the contributions and results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in conjunction with CVPR 2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是CVPR 2026联合自我中心视觉研讨会上第一届异步CASTLE挑战赛的总结报告，汇总了该挑战赛的参赛贡献和最终结果。

papers.title: A Commutator Framework for Selective Spectral Alignment in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We develop a finite-width geometric framework describing how learned feature geometries are organized, transported, and selectively aligned in deep neural networks. Incompatibility among weight-generated covariance, gates, and backward sensitivities is quantified through three families of commutators: between gates and covariance, between sensitivities and covariance, and between average gradient outer products (AGOPs) and neural feature matrices (NFMs). An exact layerwise identity decomposes the sensitivity-covariance commutator into four sources: downstream transport, adjacent-layer imbalance, pointwise sensitivity fluctuations, and nonlinear gate-covariance interactions. The AGOP-NFM commutator is a singular-value-weighted transport of the internal commutator, explaining why observed feature-side alignment alone does not determine the internal geometry from which it emerges. Buffered localized energies resolve mixing between separated covariance subspaces. We establish spectral-gap, projector-evolution, and stabilization estimates, and formulate conditional Lyapunov principles that yield decay under explicit geometric error-bound or intrinsic-damping assumptions. These criteria do not follow from gradient flow alone and clarify why risk reduction need not imply commutator collapse. Analytic examples and numerical experiments exhibit factorization of spectral and activation geometry, transient growth, and cancellation among nonzero sources. In tested finite-time regimes, cancellation dominated by a negative transport-imbalance interaction persists across depths, widths, and two regression benchmarks. Spectral alignment therefore appears as a layer- and scale-dependent compatibility phenomenon governed by transport, interaction, cancellation, and possible damping, rather than a universal consequence of training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个有限宽度几何框架，用三类交换子（commutator）量化深度神经网络中权重生成协方差、门控和反向灵敏度之间的不兼容性，并推导逐层恒等式与谱隙、投影子演化、稳定性估计。数值实验显示有限时间区间内负输运-相互作用项主导的抵消在深度、宽度和两个回归基准上持续存在，表明谱对齐是分层、尺度相关的兼容性现象。
Motivation: 现有梯度流分析不足以解释为何风险降低不必然导致交换子坍缩（commutator collapse），需要更精细的几何框架来刻画特征几何的组织、输运与选择性对齐。
Method: 建立有限宽度几何框架，引入门控-协方差、灵敏度-协方差和AGOP-NFM三类交换子族，将灵敏度-协方差交换子逐层分解为下游输运、邻层失衡、逐点灵敏度涨落和非线性门控-协方差相互作用四个来源，并借助缓冲局域化能量和条件Lyapunov原理建立谱隙、投影子演化和稳定性估计。
Result: 解析例子和数值实验展示谱与激活几何的分解、瞬态增长及非零来源间的抵消；在测试的有限时间区间内，由负输运-相互作用项主导的抵消在深度、宽度和两个回归基准上持续存在。
Conclusion: 谱对齐并非训练的普遍结果，而是受输运、相互作用、抵消和可能阻尼支配的层依赖与尺度依赖的兼容性现象。

papers.title: Do Spoken Language Models Hear Speech as They Read Text? Bridging Structural Gaps Between Speech and Text
papers.abstract_en: Spoken Language Models (SLMs) generate textual responses directly from speech, offering an alternative to cascaded systems. Despite recent advances, existing SLMs still exhibit weaker instruction-following behavior and limited generalization across diverse tasks compared to text-based language models. Our analysis shows that speech and text representations in current SLMs remain weakly aligned despite strong downstream performance, indicating that structural differences between continuous, temporally varying speech and discrete text remain insufficiently addressed. To address this, we propose a simple framework that decouples length mismatch from semantic alignment and encourages closer correspondence between speech and text representations. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against strong baselines, underscoring the importance of explicitly addressing structural differences between speech and text in SLM training. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jaykim9870/Do_SLMs_Hear_Speech_as_They_Read_Text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语音语言模型（SLM）中语音与文本表征的结构性差异，指出当前 SLM 虽在下游任务上表现强劲，但语音与文本表征仍呈弱对齐。作者提出一个简单框架，将长度不匹配（length mismatch）与语义对齐解耦，并鼓励语音与文本表征更紧密的对应；在多个基准上与强基线相比取得有竞争力的性能，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有 SLM 相比基于文本的语言模型在指令跟随和跨任务泛化上仍较弱，且分析表明语音与文本表征即使在下游性能良好时也并未充分对齐。连续时变语音与离散文本之间的结构差异被认为是尚未充分解决的问题。
Method: 提出一个简单框架，核心是解耦长度不匹配与语义对齐两个环节，并通过训练目标促使语音表征与文本表征之间建立更紧密的对应关系。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个基准上的实验性能与强基线相比具有竞争力，但没有给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者强调在 SLM 训练中显式处理语音与文本之间的结构差异具有重要意义，并公开了代码；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: AquaFlow: A Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Underwater Streaming Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) streaming reconstruction methods have achieved impressive performance by balancing reconstruction quality and efficiency. However, extending these frameworks to underwater scenes remains challenging due to severe visual degradation, such as light attenuation and scattering, which degrades camera pose tracking and distorts scene geometry. To address these challenges, we propose AquaFlow, a monocular Gaussian Splatting streaming reconstruction framework for efficient and high-fidelity underwater reconstruction. Specifically, AquaFlow fine-tunes a 3D vision foundation model on large-scale underwater data for robust pose and pointmap estimation, and introduces a medium-guided incremental Gaussian initialization strategy for streaming mapping. Furthermore, we develop a streaming-compatible hybrid scene representation that integrates structured, distance-conditioned neural Gaussians with a physics-inspired optical model to compensate for underwater image formation effects, enabling accurate scene reconstruction. We evaluate AquaFlow on a comprehensive dataset of 62 diverse underwater trajectories, collected from both public benchmarks and in-the-wild web videos across various scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AquaFlow achieves state-of-the-art tracking and rendering performance, reducing average localization error by 13.2% and improving PSNR by 4.74 dB compared to WaterSplat-SLAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AquaFlow，一个面向水下场景的基于单目 3D 高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）的流式重建框架。作者通过在大型水下数据上微调 3D 视觉基础模型来提升位姿和 pointmap 估计，并设计介质引导的增量高斯初始化以及集成物理光学模型的混合场景表征。在 62 条水下轨迹（涵盖公共基准与网络视频）上的实验显示，相比 WaterSplat-SLAM，平均定位误差降低 13.2%，PSNR 提升 4.74 dB。
Motivation: 现有单目 3DGS 流式重建方法在陆地场景表现良好，但水下场景存在光衰减与散射等严重视觉退化，会损害相机位姿跟踪并扭曲场景几何，因此难以直接推广到水下重建。
Method: 提出 AquaFlow 框架：微调 3D 视觉基础模型以进行稳健的位姿与 pointmap 估计；引入介质引导的增量高斯初始化策略用于流式建图；并开发流式兼容的混合场景表征，将结构化的距离条件神经高斯（distance-conditioned neural Gaussians）与基于物理的光学模型结合，补偿水下图像形成效应。
Result: 在包含 62 条多样化水下轨迹的数据集上（来自公共基准和野外网络视频），AquaFlow 在跟踪与渲染方面达到当前最优结果；与 WaterSplat-SLAM 相比，平均定位误差降低 13.2%，PSNR 提高 4.74 dB。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架能够在具有严重视觉退化的水下场景中实现高效、高保真的单目流式重建，其适用场景限定为水下单目流式重建任务。

papers.title: CDEG: Learning Decision-Critical Evidence for Long-Horizon Diagnostic Agents
papers.abstract_en: Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CDEG，一个基于图（graph-based）的框架，用于从历史诊断轨迹中学习可复用的决策关键证据（decision-critical evidence），以改进长时程（long-horizon）诊断智能体。CDEG 通过对比同一病例的成功与失败轨迹识别候选证据，用受控反事实干预（counterfactual interventions）验证其诊断影响，并将诊断-证据-行动关系组织为结构化图；推理时跟踪患者证据状态，检索相关关系以引导缺失证据获取或对被忽视证据进行重新评估。在域内与分布外基准上，结合多个医生智能体骨干，CDEG 相对 vanilla agents 最高取得 11.5% 的准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有医生智能体在长时程诊断中常因关键证据未被获取或未充分纳入推理而失败；近期智能体方法复用历史轨迹或蒸馏记忆，但其中可能包含噪声或附带信息，且通常未验证哪些证据真正驱动诊断决策。
Method: 提出图框架 CDEG：从同一病例的成功与失败轨迹对比中识别候选证据，通过受控反事实干预验证证据的诊断影响，并将诊断-证据-行动关系组织为结构化图；推理时跟踪患者证据状态，检索相关诊断关系，选择性引导缺失证据获取或被忽视证据的重新评估。
Result: 在域内和分布外（out-of-distribution）基准上，结合多个医生智能体骨干，CDEG 一致提升诊断性能，相对 vanilla agents 最高获得 11.5% 的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为可靠的长时程诊断需要超越轨迹级经验复用，转向证据级（evidence-level）学习真正影响临床决策的因素。该结论立足于诊断智能体场景，未在摘要中说明局限性。

papers.title: AraDetox: A Multi-Dialect Arabic Detoxification Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Arabic harmful-language detection has received considerable attention, yet Arabic text detoxification remains underexplored. We introduce AraDetox, a multi-dialect Arabic detoxification dataset comprising 10,500 harmful social-media posts and 84,000 detoxified rewrites generated using GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash across Modern Standard Arabic, Gulf, Levantine, and Egyptian Arabic. The generated outputs were assessed through human evaluation and automatic analyses of lexical change, semantic preservation, sentiment, and dialectal style. Results show that detoxification is primarily a meaning-preserving rewriting task: substantial lexical and structural reformulation is accompanied by consistently high semantic similarity. Human evaluation confirms successful harmful-language removal while largely preserving the original meaning. Dialectal analyses further indicate that the generated variants exhibit measurable stylistic alignment with reference Arabic dialect corpora. Comparison with existing resources highlights two complementary approaches to detoxification: minimal-edit lexical substitution and meaning-preserving reformulation. Our findings demonstrate that large-scale Arabic detoxification resources can be constructed through LLM-assisted generation and human verification. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/ArabicNLP-UK/AraDetox to support future research on Arabic detoxification, safe text generation, and multi-dialect Arabic NLP.
papers.journal_ref: ArabicNLP 2026 at EMNLP 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AraDetox，一个多方言阿拉伯语去毒化 (detoxification) 数据集，包含 10,500 条有害社交媒体帖子和 84,000 条由 GPT-5 与 Gemini 2.5 Flash 生成的去毒化改写，覆盖现代标准阿拉伯语、海湾、黎凡特和埃及方言。人工评估与自动分析显示去毒化主要是保持语义的改写任务，改写后语义相似度高且有害语言被有效移除；方言分析表明生成变体与参考方言语料库在风格上可测度地对齐。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语有害语言检测已被广泛研究，但阿拉伯语文本去毒化仍缺乏探索，且缺少覆盖多方言的大规模去毒化资源。
Method: 通过 LLM 辅助生成与人工验证构建数据集：使用 GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 对有害社交媒体帖子进行去毒化改写，并辅以人工评估以及词汇变化、语义保持、情感和方言风格等自动分析。
Result: 去毒化主要表现为保持语义的改写任务，改写伴随大量词汇和结构重组，同时保持高语义相似度；人工评估确认有害语言被有效移除而意义大体保留；方言分析显示生成文本与参考阿拉伯语方言语料库存在可测度的风格对齐。
Conclusion: 大规模阿拉伯语去毒化资源可通过 LLM 辅助生成与人工验证构建；与现有资源的对比揭示了去毒化的两种互补路径：最小编辑词汇替换与保持语义的重述。数据集已公开以支持未来研究。

papers.title: NemoSplat: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Media-Aware Underwater Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing photorealistic scenes in unconstrained underwater environments remains challenging due to severe media-induced light scattering and unpredictable dynamic objects. Recent feed-forward visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generalized novel view synthesis and tracking. However, when directly applied to aquatic videos, optical attenuation and motion interference fatally corrupt their feature aggregation, leading to severe tracking and reconstruction failures. To overcome these limitations, we present NemoSplat, the first feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored for media-aware dynamic reconstruction directly from uncalibrated marine videos. Beyond providing robust estimations of camera poses and dense scene depth, we devise a Promptable Dynamic Disentangler that utilizes a confidence-aware fusion strategy of learned dynamic probabilities and optional semantic text priors, effectively isolating massive transient entities. Furthermore, to counteract visual degradation, a Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor is formulated to jointly estimate intrinsic 3D Gaussian attributes alongside physical media parameters, rendering pristine scene appearance in a single forward pass. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale underwater dataset with massive dynamic elements to facilitate training and evaluation. Extensive experiments on our dataset demonstrate that NemoSplat achieves state-of-the-art tracking accuracy and high-fidelity rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NemoSplat，据称是首个面向无标定海洋视频的前馈 4D 高斯泼溅 (feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting) 框架，用于媒体感知的动态场景重建。方法通过提示式动态解耦器分离瞬态实体，并由媒体感知高斯预测器联合估计 3D 高斯属性与物理介质参数，在单次前向中完成渲染。作者还引入了一个包含大量动态元素的大规模水下数据集，并在该数据集上报告了最先进的跟踪精度与高保真渲染结果。
Motivation: 无约束水下场景重建因介质引起的光散射和不可预测的动态物体而困难；现有前馈视觉基础模型直接用于水下视频时，光衰减与运动干扰会破坏其特征聚合，导致跟踪和重建严重失败。
Method: 提出 NemoSplat，一个前馈 4D 高斯泼溅框架，包含 Promptable Dynamic Disentangler，通过置信度感知融合学习到的动态概率和可选的语义文本先验来隔离大量瞬态实体；同时提出 Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor，联合估计内在 3D 高斯属性与物理介质参数，从而在单次前向传播中渲染清晰的场景外观。
Result: 在论文自建的大规模水下数据集上，摘要报告 NemoSplat 取得了最先进的跟踪精度和高保真渲染效果。
Conclusion: 作者强调 NemoSplat 是首个针对媒体感知动态重建的前馈 4D 高斯泼溅方法，并贡献了大规模水下数据集以支持训练与评估。

papers.title: Proxy reliance in large language model decisions is uncalibrated to predictive evidence
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are entering decisions in triage and lending, where task-relevant inference must be distinguished from impermissible proxy use. Current audits ask whether decisions change when demographics change. But attributes correlated with a protected group carry predictive value, so a changed decision can be discrimination or sound inference. We measure causal proxy effects in four LLMs on a clinical-ranking task with known ground truth, where the reliance the evidence warrants can be computed exactly and used as the reference. One audit signal yields three verdicts: over-reliance, warranted and under-reliance. Under neutral labels every model relies on proxies with no information. Informative proxies draw all three. Social field names push reliance down, below the reference in one model. Two findings explain this. Reliance severely undertracks the evidence, and social-label suppression is fragile, since in-context examples raise it above zero in every model. Accuracy-based evaluation detects none of this.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在高风险决策（如分诊、借贷）中的代理变量（proxy）依赖问题，主张将任务相关推断与不可允许的代理变量使用区分开。作者在具有已知真实标签的临床排序任务上，对四个 LLM 测量因果代理效应，并以证据所合理支持的依赖程度作为精确参考，得出过度依赖、恰当依赖与依赖不足三种判定。结果显示，在中性标签下所有模型都会依赖无信息量的代理变量；社会领域标签会压低依赖，但这种抑制很脆弱；基于准确率的评估无法发现这些现象。
Motivation: 现有审计只检查当人口统计学属性改变时决策是否改变，但与被保护群体相关的属性本身带有预测信息，因此决策变化既可能是歧视也可能是合理推断，现有方法无法区分二者。需要一种以预测证据为基准来校准代理变量依赖的审计方式。
Method: 提出在具有已知 ground truth 的临床排序任务上测量因果代理效应（causal proxy effects），并利用可精确计算的证据合理依赖量作为参考，将单一审计信号转换为过度依赖、恰当依赖和依赖不足三种判定；在四个 LLM 上比较中性标签与具有信息量的标签、以及社会领域标签对依赖强度的影响。
Result: 中性标签下所有模型都会依赖无信息量的代理变量；有信息量的代理变量则同时产生三种判定结果。社会领域标签使依赖下降，其中有一个模型低于参考水平。此外，依赖程度严重低于证据所支持的水平，且社会标签的抑制作用很脆弱——添加上下文示例（in-context examples）后所有模型的该依赖都重新变为非零；基于准确率的评估完全检测不到这些现象。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 的代理变量依赖与预测证据之间未校准（uncalibrated），社会标签带来的抑制效果在上下文学到示例后会被破坏，且准确率指标无法反映这类校准问题；该结论基于具有可计算真实依赖参考的临床排序任务，对分诊与借贷等场景的审计方法有启示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DRAgent: Discriminative Reasoning Agent for Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to generate a pixel-level mask for the object specified by a language expression. Recent methods based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often rely on one-pass coordinate prediction for visual localization, which serializes continuous spatial locations as discrete text tokens and may lead to localization bias and alignment errors. To address these issues, we propose DRAgent, an MLLM-driven discriminative reasoning (DR) framework for RES. Instead of requiring the MLLM to generate localization coordinates, DRAgent first constructs a detector-generated candidate space and then uses the MLLM as a visual-semantic target discriminator. Specifically, the MLLM performs reliable target selection among potential distractors through a two-stage DR mechanism, which first screens high-recall candidates and then performs instance-wise verification. The selected target box is subsequently used as a spatial prompt for a foundation segmentation model to produce the final pixel-level mask. Furthermore, we construct a self-consistency-filtered reasoning-chain data pipeline for LoRA-based fine-tuning, providing more reliable supervision for enhancing the MLLM's discriminative reasoning capability. Experiments demonstrate that DRAgent achieves competitive performance on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRAgent，一个基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的判别式推理 (discriminative reasoning) 框架，用于指称表达分割 (Referring Expression Segmentation, RES)。与让 MLLM 一次性输出坐标的做法不同，DRAgent 先由检测器生成候选框空间，再由 MLLM 作为视觉-语义判别器，通过两阶段机制筛选并验证目标；选定框作为空间提示交给基础分割模型生成像素级掩码。实验在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+ 和 RefCOCOg 上取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的 RES 方法通常采用一次性坐标预测来做视觉定位，将连续空间位置序列化为离散文本 token，容易带来定位偏差和对齐误差。作者针对这一问题，提出不依赖 MLLM 直接生成坐标的判别式方案。
Method: DRAgent 先利用检测器构建候选空间，再用 MLLM 作为视觉-语义目标判别器；通过两阶段判别推理机制先筛选高召回候选、再逐实例验证，选出目标框后作为空间提示输入基础分割模型。此外，作者构建了经自一致性过滤的推理链数据管线，用于 LoRA 微调以增强 MLLM 的判别推理能力。
Result: 摘要报告 DRAgent 在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+ 和 RefCOCOg 三个基准上取得有竞争力的性能，摘要中未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，强调将 MLLM 的角色从坐标生成器转为判别器，并结合基础分割模型，可以缓解一次坐标预测带来的定位偏差。具体数值与消融需参考全文。
