papers.title: FOVEA: Focused On-Demand Visual Evidence Adaptation for Cache-Friendly Multimodal Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. Existing methods typically condition the drafter on a fixed visual interface, such as a predefined visual-token budget or a static compressed representation. However, our controlled visual-budget analysis shows that visual demand varies substantially across tasks and decoding stages, which means more visual input is not always beneficial. Actually, insufficient evidence may weaken visual grounding, while excessive context adds overhead and may disrupt drafting. We propose FOVEA (Focused On-demand Visual Evidence Adaptation), a cache-friendly approach that builds a reusable visual memory and dynamically retrieves a bounded subset for a draft state. A cumulative-mass rule determines both how many and which entries are selected. The selected entries are aggregated into a visual readout and fused with the current draft hidden state through a lightweight gated residual correction. Rather than inserting visual tokens into the autoregressive context, the correction modifies only the representation passed to the language-model head. Experiments across multiple vision-language backbones and multimodal benchmarks show that FOVEA improves draft acceptance and end-to-end decoding speed, achieving up to $2.13\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding. These results demonstrate that state-conditioned evidence retrieval is an effective alternative to reusing a fixed visual representation throughout multimodal generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FOVEA，一种面向多模态投机解码 (multimodal speculative decoding) 的按需视觉证据自适应方法。FOVEA 构建可复用的视觉记忆，并根据当前草稿状态动态检索有界子集，经门控残差校正融合进语言模型头所用的表征，而非把视觉 token 插入自回归上下文。实验显示该方法在多个视觉-语言骨干和基准上提升草稿接受率与端到端解码速度，最高可达自回归解码的 2.13 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有方法通常让轻量草稿模型依赖固定的视觉接口，如预定义视觉 token 预算或静态压缩表示；但受控视觉预算分析表明，不同任务和解码阶段对视觉证据的需求差异很大，更多视觉输入并不总是有利。证据不足会削弱视觉 grounding，而过量上下文会增加开销并可能干扰草稿生成。
Method: FOVEA 建立可复用的视觉记忆 (visual memory)，并为每个草稿状态动态检索一个受限子集；通过累积质量规则 (cumulative-mass rule) 决定选取多少条、选取哪些条目，将选中的条目聚合成视觉读出 (visual readout)，再通过轻量门控残差校正 (gated residual correction) 与当前草稿隐藏状态融合。该方法不把视觉 token 插入自回归上下文，而是只修改传给语言模型头的表征。
Result: 在多个视觉-语言骨干和多种多模态基准上的实验表明，FOVEA 提高了草稿接受率 (draft acceptance) 和端到端解码速度，相比自回归解码最高取得 2.13 倍加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为，状态条件化的证据检索 (state-conditioned evidence retrieval) 是贯穿整个多模态生成过程复用固定视觉表示的有效替代方案。

summary_sections.result: 在多个视觉-语言骨干和多种多模态基准上的实验表明，FOVEA 提高了草稿接受率 (draft acceptance) 和端到端解码速度，相比自回归解码最高取得 2.13 倍加速。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，状态条件化的证据检索 (state-conditioned evidence retrieval) 是贯穿整个多模态生成过程复用固定视觉表示的有效替代方案。

papers.title: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Zero-Shot Surgical Phase Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Task-specific lightweight models for surgical phase recognition excel at capturing temporal dynamics but generalize poorly under domain shift. Conversely, surgical foundation models (FMs) offer superior transferability via large-scale pretraining, yet their lack of explicit temporal modeling often yields temporally inconsistent predictions, leading to degraded performance. To exploit the complementary strengths of both paradigms, we propose \textbf{La}rge-\textbf{S}mall \textbf{T}emporal adaptation (\textbf{LaST}), a novel large-small collaborative framework that enables zero-shot adaptation to unseen clinical domains. In LaST, the FM initiates the pipeline by generating frame-level phase priors that serve as initial weak supervision. To effectively utilize these noisy phase priors, we introduce an iterative temporal refinement scheme that integrates dynamic quality control to filter reliable predictions and dual-model cross-learning to mitigate confirmation bias. Simultaneously, the lightweight model leverages its intrinsic temporal modeling ability to progressively correct inconsistent predictions and enhance overall accuracy across iterations. At the end, a cycle replay strategy is employed to close the loop: the refined, more accurate predictions are utilized as upgraded supervision signals for the subsequent iterations, fostering a self-reinforcing evolution of both label quality and model capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaST achieves robust adaptation to unseen domains for zero-shot surgical phase recognition, outperforming the baseline (PeskaVLP) by 24.85\%-43.17\% in accuracy and even surpassing fully supervised linear probing and several state-of-the-art few-shot approaches. Codes will be released at https://github.com/YIYIZH/LaST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LaST (Large-Small Temporal adaptation)，一种大-小模型协作的零样本手术阶段识别框架。摘要称该方法利用手术基础模型 (surgical foundation model) 生成帧级阶段先验作为弱监督，并通过迭代时序细化、动态质量控制和双模型交叉学习，让轻量级模型利用其时序建模能力逐步修正不一致预测，最后以循环重放策略形成自强化的闭环。在未见临床域上，该方法相比基线 PeskaVLP 准确率提升 24.85%-43.17%，并超过全监督线性探针和若干最先进的少样本方法。
Motivation: 任务特定的轻量级手术阶段识别模型擅长捕获时序动态，但在域偏移 (domain shift) 下泛化差；手术基础模型迁移性好，却缺乏显式时序建模，常产生时间不一致的预测。两种范式互补，需要一种零样本适应未见临床域的协作机制。
Method: 提出 LaST 框架：基础模型先生成帧级阶段先验作为初始弱监督；引入迭代时序细化方案，包含动态质量控制 (dynamic quality control) 筛选可靠预测，以及双模型交叉学习 (dual-model cross-learning) 缓解确认偏差；轻量级模型利用其内在时序建模能力逐步修正不一致预测；最后采用循环重放 (cycle replay) 策略，将细化后的更准确预测作为下一轮升级监督信号，形成标签质量与模型能力的自强化演进。
Result: 实验表明 LaST 在零样本手术阶段识别中能稳健适应未见域，相比基线 PeskaVLP 准确率提升 24.85%-43.17%，并超过全监督线性探针和若干最先进的少样本方法。代码将在 GitHub 发布。
Conclusion: 摘要强调大型基础模型与轻量级时序模型的协作，配合迭代自强化监督，可以在无目标域标注条件下实现稳健的零样本手术阶段识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: We formalize prefix invariance: representations at position t must not depend on future inputs. We give a lightweight audit, two forward passes, no training or gradients, that localizes exactly where causality breaks. Attention-mask inspection is incomplete: leaks can occur via scans or normalization despite correct masks. Across 192 injected-fault trials on eight checkpoints, mask inspection found none, while our audit localized all 192/192, also finding a defect in Zamba2 and Nemotron-H.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化“前缀不变性”(prefix invariance)：位置 t 的表示不得依赖未来输入，并提出一种轻量审计方法，仅需两次前向传播、无需训练或梯度即可精确定位因果性破坏的位置。通过在八个检查点上的 192 次注入故障试验，掩码检查未发现任何问题，而该方法定位了全部 192/192，并发现 Zamba2 和 Nemotron-H 中的缺陷。
Motivation: 现有对因果性的检查往往依赖注意力掩码，但掩码检查并不完整：泄露可能通过扫描 (scans) 或归一化 (normalization) 发生，即使掩码正确也会出现因果破坏。
Method: 提出一个轻量审计流程：通过两次前向传播、无训练和无梯度，精确地局部化因果性破坏发生在何处，而不是仅检查注意力掩码。
Result: 在八个检查点上的 192 次注入故障试验中，掩码检查未发现任何故障，而审计方法定位了全部 192/192 的故障，并额外发现 Zamba2 和 Nemotron-H 中的缺陷。
Conclusion: 作者强调“掩码不是模型”，仅靠注意力掩码检查不足以保证序列模型的前缀不变性，所提出的审计方法可作为更可靠的因果性验证工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Stochastic Separability of Embedding Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Neurobiological studies and representation learning have observed that representations of objects belonging to the same category in high-dimensional neural spaces exhibit low-dimensional object manifold characteristics, and different object manifolds are linearly separable in these neural spaces. However, these experimentally observed phenomena lack rigorous theoretical validation to date. This paper proposes a new stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. First, we establish a projection measure concentration theorem for embedding manifolds under general conditions. We develop a new two-layer measure concentration analysis technique, which unifies two estimation bounds via the law of total expectation to derive measure concentration inequalities. Based on the measure concentration theorem, we further prove a stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. If two datasets have distinct means and bounded total variances, their samples become linearly separable with high probability, provided that the projection direction satisfies a non-singularity condition. The main contributions of this paper are twofold: 1. We prove the projection concentration properties of embedding manifolds in high-dimensional spaces by using two-lawyer tail-bound inequalities. 2. We identify a non-singularity condition for the stochastic separability between embedding manifolds, and rigorously prove the stochastic projection separability theorem. The theorem not only uncovers geometric and statistical properties of the object embedding manifolds, but also provides a novel mechanism for representation learning in deep networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经科学和表示学习中发现的高维神经空间中同类对象表示呈低维流形、且不同对象流形可线性分离的现象，提出嵌入流形 (embedding manifold) 的随机可分性定理。作者先建立一般条件下的投影测度集中定理，利用两层测度集中分析技术结合全期望定律导出集中不等式，再据此证明两个不同类别嵌入流形的随机投影可分性。论文为这一经验现象提供了严格理论验证，并指出其可作为深度网络表示学习的一种新机制。
Motivation: 神经生物学与表示学习实验观察到高维空间中同类对象的向量表示形成低维对象流形，且不同对象流形可线性分离，但这些观察长期以来缺乏严格的理论证明。
Method: 提出投影测度集中定理以及新的两层测度集中分析技术，通过全期望定律把两类估计界统一起来得到测度集中不等式；基于该定理进一步证明两个不同类别嵌入流形的随机可分性定理，核心条件是两数据集均值不同、总方差有界且投影方向满足非奇异条件。
Result: 论文严格证明：在投影方向满足非奇异条件下，若两数据集具有不同均值和有界总方差，则其样本以高概率线性可分；同时证明了高维空间中嵌入流形的投影集中性质。
Conclusion: 该定理揭示了对象嵌入流形的几何与统计性质，并为深度网络中的表示学习提供了一种新的理论机制；摘要未提及实验验证，属于纯理论贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: UniMem: Unifying Multimodal Memory and Control for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have leveraged internet-scale pretraining and task-focused finetuning to achieve strong performance on long-horizon tasks, they often struggle with non-Markovian tasks that require memory. Existing approaches to memory typically involve additional Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) for long-term memory management, introducing a memory bottleneck and a fractured training pipeline. Conditioning on multiple historical frames can provide the VLA with access to more descriptive features of past scenes, but can degrade performance if frames are chosen at arbitrary, fixed intervals. To address these limitations, we present UniMem, a framework that unifies high-level, multimodal memory and low-level control under one backbone. UniMem employs an event classifier for memory updates, a keyframe encoder for dense spatial memory, and a keyframe caching technique to minimize overhead during policy rollouts. We evaluate UniMem across five simulation and four hardware tasks targeting sequential and spatial memory, demonstrating that our unified, single-model system outperforms fixed-interval image sampling baselines (93.4% vs. 68.2%) in simulation and hierarchical baselines (80.0% vs. 43.5%) in hardware, while offering faster inference and a simple training pipeline for easy adoption. Project website: https://losterberg3.github.io/unimem-vla/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniMem，一个将高层多模态记忆与低层控制统一到单一 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 主干中的框架，用于解决非马尔可夫任务中的记忆需求。UniMem 使用事件分类器进行记忆更新、关键帧编码器提供稠密空间记忆，并通过关键帧缓存降低策略 rollout 开销。在五个仿真与四个硬件任务上，UniMem 分别以 93.4% 对 68.2% 和 80.0% 对 43.5% 超越固定间隔图像采样基线与分层基线。
Motivation: VLA 模型在长时程任务上表现强，但缺乏处理需要记忆的非马尔可夫任务的能力；现有做法额外引入 VLM 管理长期记忆，造成记忆瓶颈和割裂的训练流程，而固定间隔采样历史帧又可能损害性能。
Method: 提出单一主干下的统一框架：事件分类器触发记忆更新，关键帧编码器编码稠密空间记忆，关键帧缓存技术降低推理期开销，从而将高层多模态记忆与低层控制整合在一个模型中。
Result: 在仿真任务中，UniMem 达到 93.4% 的成功率，优于固定间隔图像采样基线的 68.2%；在硬件任务中达到 80.0%，优于分层基线的 43.5%，同时拥有更快的推理速度和更简单的训练流程。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一的单模型系统可以替代分层记忆和固定间隔采样的做法，兼顾记忆能力与推理效率，并易于被采用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Sub-1 kB Identity-Preserving Face Compression: A Benchmark of Codecs, a Custom Learned Codec, and Studies of Resolution, Demographic Fairness, Recompression, and Adversarial Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Storing face images under a hard sub-kilobyte budget, as required for identity documents, smart-card biometrics and bandwidth-constrained verification, forces a codec to discard most of the signal while keeping what a face matcher actually reads: identity. Generic codecs optimize pixel fidelity, not the embedding distances that drive verification, so which codec, resolution and setting best preserve identity at 1024 bytes or less, and how that degrades at 512, is unclear. We benchmark ten general and face-specific codecs across resolutions, byte budgets, two datasets (controlled Color FERET, in-the-wild AI-Solutions-KK) and four anchor face matchers, with a fourteen-model ViT and CNN roster confirming the ranking is backbone-invariant. We then train a custom identity-preserving codec that hits the byte budget exactly via binary search over a frozen gain table, and run four studies: resolution, demographic fairness, recompression, and no-box adversarial robustness. Sub-kilobyte identity preservation is feasible, but which codec to deploy depends entirely on the budget. At 1024 bytes and the 112 px working resolution the problem is close to solved: modern codecs hold Color FERET equal-error rate under 0.35 percent on the ArcFace anchor. At 512 bytes the field re-sorts: AVIF, HEIF, JPEG XL and legacy JPEG collapse to 28 to 98 percent false-non-match rate at FMR 1e-4, while WebP, JPEG-AI and our byte-budgeted learned codecs stay out of that band, with 24.3 percent for WebP against 6.9 percent for our accurate variant in the wild. That re-sort, not the 1024-byte ranking, is the operational result: a codec chosen at 1 kB is not the codec to deploy at half that.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究亚千字节预算下的人脸图像压缩，目标是保留人脸匹配器所需的身份信息而非像素保真度。作者在 Color FERET 和 AI-Solutions-KK 两个数据集上、以四种锚定人脸匹配器和十种编解码器进行基准测试，并训练了一个通过冻结增益表上的二分搜索精确达到字节预算的自定义学习编解码器。摘要报告在 1024 字节和 112 px 分辨率下现代编解码器可将 Color FERET 等错误率控制在 0.35% 以下，但在 512 字节下编解码器排名重新洗牌，AVIF、HEIF、JPEG XL 和 JPEG 在 FMR 1e-4 下出现 28% 至 98% 的误拒率，而 WebP、JPEG-AI 和作者的学习编解码器表现更好。
Motivation: 身份文件、智能卡生物识别和带宽受限验证要求在硬性的亚千字节预算下存储人脸图像，通用编解码器优化像素保真度而非驱动验证的嵌入距离，因此哪种编解码器、分辨率和设置在 1024 字节或更少预算下最能保留身份、以及 512 字节下如何退化尚不明确。
Method: 先对十种通用和专用人脸编解码器在不同分辨率、字节预算、两个数据集和四种锚定人脸匹配器上进行基准测试，并用十四个 ViT 和 CNN 模型确认排名与骨干网络无关；然后训练一个自定义身份保留编解码器，通过冻结增益表上的二分搜索精确达到字节预算，并开展分辨率、人口统计公平性、再压缩和无盒对抗鲁棒性四项研究。
Result: 1024 字节和 112 px 下问题接近解决，现代编解码器在 ArcFace 锚定匹配器上将 Color FERET 等错误率保持在 0.35% 以下；512 字节下排名重新洗牌，AVIF、HEIF、JPEG XL 和旧版 JPEG 在 FMR 1e-4 下误拒率达 28% 至 98%，而 WebP 为 24.3%、作者的高精度变体在真实场景中为 6.9%。
Conclusion: 亚千字节身份保留是可行的，但部署哪种编解码器完全取决于预算；512 字节下的重新排序才是实际操作结果——在 1 kB 选择的编解码器在预算减半时并不适用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Following Motion for Sequential Modeling in Video Frame Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) have surfaced as a promising architecture in Video Frame Interpolation (VFI), as they can capture long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. However, their predefined scanning order limits their effectiveness in modeling the dynamic motion trajectories inherent in VFI problems. To tackle this challenge, we propose Motion-Guided Mamba for Video Frame Interpolation (MGMVFI), an adaptation of the selective state space model tailored explicitly for VFI. MGMVFI introduces Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS), which leverages optical flow to define a motion-adaptive 1D input order for the SSM. This aligns the causal state updates with semantically related tokens, enabling motion-consistent feature propagation, particularly for large and dynamic motions. Additionally, to mitigate the unreliable feature representations caused by inaccurate optical flow estimates, we introduce contextual synthesis that utilizes the surrounding spatial context for robust inter-frame feature synthesis. These components are seamlessly integrated within our tailored Mamba architecture, which also employs a lightweight refinement block to enhance local detail reconstruction at a reduced computational cost. Extensive experiments on standard VFI benchmarks demonstrate that MGMVFI achievesstate-of-the-artperformance,particularly on complex and dynamic motions, thereby establishing a new direction for sequence modeling in video interpolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Motion-Guided Mamba for Video Frame Interpolation (MGMVFI)，将选择性状态空间模型 (selective state space model, SSM) 适配到视频帧插值任务。核心是 Motion-Guided Serialization (MGS)，利用光流定义运动自适应的 1D 输入顺序，使因果状态更新与语义相关的 token 对齐；同时引入 contextual synthesis，利用周围空间上下文来缓解光流估计不准确带来的不可靠特征，并加入轻量级细化模块。实验表明 MGMVFI 在标准 VFI 基准上达到最新最优 (state-of-the-art)，尤其在复杂和大动态运动场景下表现突出。
Motivation: SSM 因线性复杂度能捕获长程依赖，已被引入视频帧插值，但其预定义的扫描顺序限制了建模 VFI 中动态运动轨迹的能力。
Method: 提出 MGS 机制，用光流为 SSM 定义运动自适应的 1D 输入顺序，使状态更新沿着语义相关的 token 传播；另引入 contextual synthesis 利用空间上下文合成鲁棒的帧间特征，并在定制 Mamba 架构中加入轻量级细化块以降低计算开销。
Result: 在标准 VFI 基准上的大量实验表明，MGMVFI 达到最先进性能，尤其在复杂和动态运动场景中提升明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为视频插值中的序列建模指明了新方向；其方法针对视频帧插值，并非面向天气或降水问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mapping the Concept Landscape: Structural Perception of Global Distributions for Transparent Data Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Existing data pruning methods predominantly rely on high-dimensional feature embeddings to measure sample importance. However, these compressed vectors often obscure fine-grained semantic interactions, leading to suboptimal coverage of rare semantic concepts in the pruned subsets. In this paper, we propose Mapping the Concept Landscape (MCL), a novel structural perception framework for transparent data pruning. Instead of abstract embeddings, we represent each image-caption pair as an explicit sample-level graph comprising entities, events, and attributes. By integrating these individual graphs into a comprehensive dataset-level graph, we characterize the global distribution of semantic concepts and quantify their rarity across the entire corpus. Based on this structured perception, we develop a greedy concept-coverage maximization algorithm that iteratively selects samples to maximize the marginal gain of high-value, under-represented concepts. Experimental results on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior pruning efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods but also provides a transparent and interpretable audit trail for the selection process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mapping the Concept Landscape (MCL)，一种面向透明数据剪枝的结构感知框架。与依赖高维特征嵌入的现有方法不同，该方法将每个图像-文本对表示为包含实体、事件和属性的显式样本级图，再整合为数据集级图以刻画语义概念的全局分布与稀有度，并基于贪心概念覆盖最大化算法挑选样本。摘要报告该方法在多个基准上取得优于现有方法的剪枝效率，并为选择过程提供透明、可解释的审计轨迹。
Motivation: 现有数据剪枝方法主要依赖高维特征嵌入来衡量样本重要性，但这些压缩向量往往掩盖细粒度的语义交互，导致剪枝后的子集对稀有语义概念的覆盖不足。
Method: 将每个图像-标题对构建为包含实体、事件和属性的样本级图，并将这些图整合成数据集级图来表征语义概念的全局分布和稀缺程度；基于这种结构感知，使用贪心概念覆盖最大化算法迭代选择能使高价值、低表示概念边际增益最大的样本。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，该方法相比 state-of-the-art 方法实现了更优的剪枝效率，同时为样本选择过程提供了透明且可解释的审计轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者认为用显式结构化的概念图取代抽象嵌入，可以改善稀有概念覆盖，并提升数据剪枝过程的透明度和可解释性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires families of post-trained variants---instruction-tuned, reasoning-tuned, and chat-style models---each at multiple sizes to meet diverse latency and memory budgets. Producing each (variant, size) pair independently is prohibitive, so model families typically span only a handful of coarse-grained sizes per post-trained variant. Boomerang distillation (Kangaslahti et al., 2026) reduces this cost along the size axis for base models. Through model size interpolation, it constructs models of intermediate sizes from a single teacher-student pair without additional training. However, it still treats each post-trained variant as a separate object of optimization. We introduce ADAPT---Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs---a framework for amortizing distillation across both axes of a model family: size and post-training variant, producing $L \times K$ models for $L$ interpolated sizes across $K$ post-trained variants with a single distillation run. ADAPT combines two components. First, a two-phase distillation procedure constructs post-trained students through pre-training alignment and supervised fine-tuning distillation, enabling smooth size--performance interpolation on generation and reasoning tasks. Second, weight-delta initialization approximates this construction across post-trained variants by transferring the distillation-induced weight change from the base model to students initialized from different post-trained variants. The resulting continuum of interpolated models also enables adaptive model-size selection at inference time, improving the compute--accuracy trade-off for long-form reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADAPT（Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs），一个将蒸馏成本同时分摊到模型族两个轴（规模与后训练变体）的框架。它用两阶段蒸馏构造后训练学生模型，并通过权重差初始化在不同后训练变体间迁移蒸馏带来的权重变化，从而以单次蒸馏运行生成 L 个插值规模 × K 个后训练变体的模型。摘要还指出该连续插值模型族支持推理时自适应选择模型大小，改善长程推理任务的计算-精度权衡。
Motivation: 实际部署大语言模型需要覆盖多种后训练变体（指令微调、推理微调、对话风格）和多种规模，但逐一训练每个 (变体, 规模) 组合成本过高；现有 Boomerang 蒸馏只沿规模轴降低基础模型的成本，仍把每个后训练变体当作独立优化对象。
Method: ADAPT 结合两个组件：一是两阶段蒸馏流程，通过预训练对齐和监督微调蒸馏构造后训练学生，使规模-性能插值在生成与推理任务上平滑；二是权重差初始化（weight-delta initialization），将基础模型上蒸馏引起的权重变化迁移到从不同后训练变体初始化的学生上，从而跨变体分摊蒸馏成本。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能以单次蒸馏运行产生 L 个插值规模 × K 个后训练变体的模型，并支持推理时自适应模型规模选择，从而改善长程推理任务的计算-精度权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为将蒸馏同时分摊到规模和后训练变体两个轴可以高效构建连续模型族，并带来推理时模型选择的额外收益。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Your AI, On a Dial: Controlling Investment Bias in LLMs with a Single Neuron
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment decision-making, yet prior work shows that they exhibit systematic, model-specific investment preferences. We study whether a model's overall investment stance can be calibrated to a specified direction and strength. We introduce an investment-bias dial, an inference-time intervention on a single neuron that continuously adjusts a model-level decision prior---its overall tendency toward buying or selling---without targeting specific firms or investment attributes. Using matched positive and negative evidence, we evaluate five open-weight LLMs and find that the dial produces monotonic changes in investment stance without modifying prompts or model parameters. At the response level, the dial shifts both investment decisions and the evidential emphasis of generated rationales under identical inputs. In an agentic retrieval setting, the dial also changes what information the model searches for, which evidence it selects, and which evidence is reflected in its final analysis. In a long-context evaluation, the dial maintains stable stance control as context length increases, whereas a matched system-prompt instruction progressively attenuates. We further show that changes in the dial propagate to security rankings and downstream portfolio composition in an exploratory backtest. Overall, our results show that an LLM's aggregate investment stance can be calibrated toward a specified target at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否在推理时校准大语言模型（LLM）的整体投资立场。作者提出一种对单个神经元的推理时干预，称为投资偏置拨盘（investment-bias dial），可连续调整模型层面的决策先验（倾向于买入或卖出），无需修改提示词或模型参数。在五个开放权重 LLM 上，该拨盘产生投资立场的单调变化，并在智能体检索与长上下文设置中保持控制效果。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于投资决策，但已有工作表明它们表现出系统性、模型特定的投资偏好。本文针对的问题是能否将模型的整体投资立场按指定方向和强度进行校准。
Method: 引入投资偏置拨盘，一种在推理时对单个神经元进行干预的技术，用于连续调节模型层面的决策先验，而不针对特定公司或投资属性。作者使用匹配的正负证据，在五个开放权重 LLM 上评估该干预。
Result: 拨盘在相同输入下产生投资立场的单调变化，并同时改变投资决策与生成理由中对证据的侧重；在智能体检索设置中，它改变了模型搜索的信息、选择的证据以及最终分析所反映的证据；在长上下文评估中，拨盘随着上下文长度增加仍保持稳定的立场控制，而匹配的系统提示指令则逐渐衰减；此外，拨盘的变化会传播到证券排名和探索性回测中的下游投资组合构成。
Conclusion: 结果表明，LLM 的总体投资立场可以在推理时被校准到指定的目标方向和强度。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究能否在推理时校准大语言模型（LLM）的整体投资立场。作者提出一种对单个神经元的推理时干预，称为投资偏置拨盘（investment-bias dial），可连续调整模型层面的决策先验（倾向于买入或卖出），无需修改提示词或模型参数。在五个开放权重 LLM 上，该拨盘产生投资立场的单调变化，并在智能体检索与长上下文设置中保持控制效果。

summary_sections.method: 引入投资偏置拨盘，一种在推理时对单个神经元进行干预的技术，用于连续调节模型层面的决策先验，而不针对特定公司或投资属性。作者使用匹配的正负证据，在五个开放权重 LLM 上评估该干预。
summary_sections.result: 拨盘在相同输入下产生投资立场的单调变化，并同时改变投资决策与生成理由中对证据的侧重；在智能体检索设置中，它改变了模型搜索的信息、选择的证据以及最终分析所反映的证据；在长上下文评估中，拨盘随着上下文长度增加仍保持稳定的立场控制，而匹配的系统提示指令则逐渐衰减；此外，拨盘的变化会传播到证券排名和探索性回测中的下游投资组合构成。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明，LLM 的总体投资立场可以在推理时被校准到指定的目标方向和强度。

papers.title: RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Full-length RNAs, particularly messenger RNAs, often exceed the context lengths used to pretrain existing RNA foundation models, limiting complete-transcript modeling at single-nucleotide resolution. We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt. RIBOSPAN combines dense bidirectional self-attention, single-nucleotide tokenization, and attention-isolated sequence packing to enable high-resolution modeling of complete long RNAs. We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis. Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40% masking improves recovery under heavy corruption while preserving representation quality. The long-context benchmark further shows that native 10K models maintain strong contextual responsiveness and context-specific representation separation while keeping perturbation-induced representation changes highly localized. Inference-time YaRN scaling recovers much of the contextual organization lost by direct extrapolation of short-context models, but induces substantially greater distal representation diffusion. Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN achieving the strongest overall performance across diverse RNA types and retaining a clear advantage on long RNAs. Building on the same backbone, we develop a multidimensionally conditioned discrete-diffusion framework for full-length mRNA generation and redesign, including synonymous-codon diffusion for protein-preserving CDS optimization. Together, RIBOSPAN establishes a powerful long-context foundation for transferable RNA representation learning and full-transcript mRNA design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RIBOSPAN，一个 16.1 亿参数的 RNA 基础模型，原生以最长 10,240 nt 的上下文长度进行预训练，结合双向稠密自注意力、单核苷酸 tokenization 和注意力隔离的序列打包 (attention-isolated sequence packing)，用于完整长 RNA 的高分辨率建模。评估覆盖核苷酸重建、受控长上下文表示基准和冻结 RNA 类型表示分析；摘要报告在多种 RNA 类型上取得最强总体表示质量，并在长 RNA 上保持明显优势。作者还基于同一骨干开发了多维条件离散扩散框架，用于全长 mRNA 生成与再设计。
Motivation: 全长 RNA（尤其是 mRNA）通常超过现有 RNA 基础模型预训练所用的上下文长度，限制了在单核苷酸分辨率下对完整转录本的建模能力。
Method: RIBOSPAN 采用 10,240 nt 的原生长上下文预训练，结合双向稠密自注意力、单核苷酸 tokenization 与注意力隔离的序列打包；还探索了 40% 掩码率的继续预训练，以及推理时的 YaRN 长度外推。在生成侧，作者构建了多维条件离散扩散 (discrete-diffusion) 框架用于全长 mRNA 生成与再设计，包括保持蛋白质序列的同义密码子扩散 (synonymous-codon diffusion)。
Result: 原生 10K 预训练在 10,240 token 下保持强重建能力；40% 掩码继续预训练提升重损毁下的恢复并保持表示质量。长上下文基准显示原生 10K 模型保持强上下文响应性与上下文特异性表示分离，且扰动引起的表示变化高度局部化；YaRN 缩放可恢复短上下文模型直接外推丢失的大部分上下文组织，但会带来更大的远端表示扩散。冻结表示评估表明 RIBOSPAN 在不同 RNA 类型上取得最强总体性能，并在长 RNA 上优势明显。
Conclusion: 摘要将 RIBOSPAN 定位为可迁移 RNA 表示学习与全转录本 mRNA 设计的强大长上下文基础模型，并强调在完整转录本尺度上进行原生预训练的价值。

papers.title: GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) based GUI agents stand to benefit significantly from online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their training is bottlenecked by two fundamental issues: current data synthesis methods for GUI Agents rely on specific environments and struggle to generate diverse data, while existing evaluators either suffer from limited scalability or provide inaccurate and unreliable reward signals. To overcome these challenges, we introduce GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward), a RL reward framework that supports scalable task generation and delivers reliable reward signals for stable and efficient policy optimization. Our approach features self-evolving data synthesis, which produces multiple environments through task execution and generates diverse tasks and goal states. Complementing this, a state-anchor mechanism automatically annotates task-relevant UI elements in successful goal states as reference anchors. During RL training, these reference anchors provide accurate, scalable reward signals that substantially enhance efficiency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and performs closest to rule-based methods. Furthermore, agents trained using our reward framework exhibit strong performance on both AndroidWorld and our constructed benchmark, establishing a scalable approach for GUI agent training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward)，一种面向移动 GUI 智能体的强化学习奖励框架，解决数据合成依赖特定环境、奖励信号不准确且可扩展性差的问题。框架通过自进化数据合成生成多样任务与目标状态，并用状态锚定机制自动标注成功目标状态中的相关 UI 元素作为参考锚点，为策略优化提供准确可扩展的奖励信号。实验显示其在离线轨迹验证上准确率超过 90%，并接近基于规则的方法，且训练出的智能体在 AndroidWorld 与自建基准上表现良好。
Motivation: 基于 VLM 的 GUI 智能体可从在线强化学习中受益，但训练受两个瓶颈制约：现有数据合成方法依赖特定环境且难以生成多样数据；现有评估器要么可扩展性有限，要么提供不准确不可靠的奖励信号。
Method: 提出 GSAR 奖励框架，包含自进化数据合成：通过任务执行生成多个环境并产生多样任务与目标状态；同时设计状态锚定机制，自动标注成功目标状态中与任务相关的 UI 元素作为参考锚点，在 RL 训练中提供可靠且可扩展的奖励信号。
Result: 实验表明该框架在离线轨迹验证上达到 90% 以上准确率，表现最接近基于规则的方法；使用该奖励框架训练的智能体在 AndroidWorld 和自建基准上均展现出强性能。
Conclusion: GSAR 为 GUI 智能体训练提供了一种可扩展的奖励框架，能够兼顾可靠奖励信号与多样化数据生成。

papers.title: FinixDoc: Rethinking Financial Document Parsing Beyond Saturated Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Financial document parsing requires accuracy, structural consistency, and verifiability that current benchmarks often fail to reflect. We present FinixDoc, an end-to-end agentic parsing system for real-world financial documents, with FinixDoc-VL, a 4B-scale vision-language model built on Qwen3-VL-4B, as its core parser. To characterize the gap between benchmark and deployment performance, we introduce a Document Parsing Capability Matrix organized along two practical axes: visual quality and document scale. Guided by this matrix, FinixDoc-VL is trained with a domain-adapted recipe combining homoglyph-aware contrastive learning and multi-stage reinforcement learning with composite domain-specific rewards. To better leverage our accumulated advantage in low-quality financial-document data and support large-scale, high-quality data production, we further build a human-in-the-loop Data Factory pipeline with confidence-aware expert review. For evaluation, we construct FinixDocBench, a financial-domain evaluation suite covering digital-native, camera-captured, ultra-large-page, and internal-workflow scenarios, with a compliance-reviewed subset released alongside this technical report. On its main subsets, FinixDoc-VL achieves the highest overall score (81.43) among evaluated baselines, outperforming the next-best open-source model by 5.13 points, with the largest gains on internal financial workflows (FinixInner: 84.08 vs. 78.73).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinixDoc，一个面向真实金融文档的端到端智能体解析系统，其核心解析器是基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 构建的 4B 规模视觉语言模型 FinixDoc-VL。作者引入 Document Parsing Capability Matrix，沿视觉质量和文档规模两个实用维度刻画基准测试与部署性能之间的差距，并据此设计了结合同形字感知对比学习 (homoglyph-aware contrastive learning) 与多阶段强化学习的领域自适应训练方案。他们还构建了带人类在环 (human-in-the-loop) 审核的 Data Factory 数据生产流程，以及金融领域评测套件 FinixDocBench。评测中 FinixDoc-VL 获得最高总分 81.43，领先次优开源模型 5.13 分。
Motivation: 现有金融文档解析基准无法反映实际部署对准确性、结构一致性和可验证性的要求，导致基准性能与真实场景性能之间存在明显差距，需要更贴近实际的数据组织方式和评测体系。
Method: 提出 FinixDoc 端到端智能体解析系统，核心为 FinixDoc-VL 模型。引入 Document Parsing Capability Matrix 沿视觉质量和文档规模组织数据；训练采用同形字感知对比学习与多阶段强化学习，并使用复合领域特定奖励；另构建含置信度感知专家审核的 Data Factory 人工在环流水线，用于大规模高质量数据生产。
Result: 在 FinixDocBench 各主要子集上，FinixDoc-VL 总体得分最高（81.43），超过次优开源模型 5.13 分；在内部金融工作流子集 FinixInner 上为 84.08，对比基线 78.73，增益最大。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过能力矩阵指导数据组织、领域自适应训练以及人工审核数据流水线，可以有效缩小金融文档解析中基准与部署性能之间的差距。

papers.title: Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperform a token-likelihood baseline for micro discrimination and selective prediction under a single global rejection threshold, improving micro AUROC from 0.57 to 0.75--0.80. The best results are achieved by a rank-specific multi-head design (H3), suggesting that accounting for hierarchical output structure is important when a unified abstention rule is required. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/uoguelph-mlrg/hierarchy-aware-llm-uq
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒大语言模型（LLM）在层级式生物分类推理中的不确定性估计问题，提出用开源工具 LLM 提取代理特征、训练层级感知监督估计器来预测按秩（rank-wise）正确性。在三种工具 LLM 上，该方法在微判别和选择性预测上一致优于 token 似然基线，将微 AUROC 从 0.57 提升到 0.75–0.80，其中按秩多头的 H3 设计效果最好。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多用于科学决策支持，但黑盒场景下可靠的置信度估计仍然困难，尤其是在长尾生物多样性监控流水线中进行层级式分类推理时。
Method: 利用开源工具 LLM 提取代理特征，训练轻量级监督估计器，并引入层级感知监督（hierarchy-aware supervision）来预测按秩正确性；对比了不同设计，包括按秩多头的 H3 结构。
Result: 在三种工具 LLM 上，监督估计器在微判别（micro discrimination）和单一全局拒绝阈值下的选择性预测上一致优于 token 似然基线，微 AUROC 从 0.57 提升至 0.75–0.80；最佳结果来自按秩多头设计 H3。
Conclusion: 作者强调在需要统一弃权规则时，考虑层级输出结构对不确定性估计很重要，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Mirror descent algorithms with logarithmic barriers
papers.abstract_en: This work derives convergence guarantees for mirror descent and proximal mirror descent algorithms when a logarithmic barrier is used as a distance-generating function. Standard approaches cannot be applied when the solution lies on the boundary, where the Bregman divergence blows up. We show that, in a specific setting, both methods enjoy an $O(\log k / k)$ rate, which is also tight. In addition, our contributions include: (i) a new technique for handling the blow-up; (ii) a resolution of a gap in the theory of relative smoothness; and (iii) a comparison of the proposed approach with interior-point methods.

papers.title: Minimal Local Simulation Foundations for LLM- and VLM-Driven Agents in 2D and 3D Environments
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are expanding the range of behaviors that can be represented in agent-based simulations, but many contemporary platforms are difficult to study, modify, or run on ordinary computers. We present two intentionally minimal simulation foundations for education and rapid prototyping. SD-AgentFoundry-2D provides a two-dimensional multi-agent environment in which locally hosted LLM agents move, communicate, respond to place occupancy, and encounter spatially localized fire events. SD-AgentFoundry-3D provides a three-dimensional digital-twin environment in which a locally hosted VLM receives first-person images and produces natural-language movement instructions. Both codebases are designed to run locally on macOS, Windows, and Linux and are deliberately left open to modification rather than developed as finished applications. Together, they offer accessible starting points for learning about generative social simulation and for building domain-specific extensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两个刻意保持极简的仿真基础，用于教育和快速原型：SD-AgentFoundry-2D 是一个二维多智能体环境，本地托管的 LLM 智能体可以移动、通信、响应地点占用并遭遇空间局部的火灾事件；SD-AgentFoundry-3D 是一个三维数字孪生环境，本地托管的 VLM 接收第一人称图像并输出自然语言移动指令。两个代码库均设计为在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 本地运行，并刻意保持开放可修改，而不是成品应用。
Motivation: 现有许多 LLM/VLM 驱动的智能体仿真平台难以研究、修改或在普通计算机上运行，作者希望提供易访问的极简起点来降低学习与扩展的门槛。
Method: 发布两个开源代码库：一个二维多智能体环境（支持本地 LLM 代理的移动、通信、占位响应和火灾事件），一个三维数字孪生环境（支持本地 VLM 基于第一人称视觉生成自然语言运动指令），均强调本地运行、跨平台与开放性。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献是功能性的轻量仿真基础及其可用性设计。
Conclusion: 作者将其定位为学习生成式社会模拟（generative social simulation）和构建领域专用扩展的起点，而非完成度高的应用系统。

papers.title: Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku
papers.abstract_en: The social interactions among crowds via \textit{Danmaku} (a.k.a., bullet comments) on modern multimedia platforms can facilitate both viewpoint conflicts and consensus, providing fine-grained discriminative social signals that can benefit fake news detection. However, the inherent accumulation latency of \textit{Danmaku} in real-world scenarios violates the real-time necessity of fake news detection, making the studies of \textit{Danmaku}-related fake news detection underexplored. To break this violation, we simulate this temporal-aware user interactive process by proposing a novel temporal \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{da}nmaku framework, called \textbf{Genda}, which consists of: (1) a \textit{Danmaku} Trigger for predicting the timing and intensity of user reactions; and (2) a \textit{Danmaku} Generator for synthesizing corresponding semantic and emotional expressions, thereby mutually constructing a temporally aligned and human-like pseudo \textit{Danmaku} streams. To make the generated \textit{Danmaku} useful for identifying fake news videos, we further design a \textit{Danmaku}-guided Temporal Multimodal fake news detection model - \textbf{DM-FEND}, which enables fine-grained multimodal interactions among video, audio, text, and \textit{Danmaku}, enhancing dynamic modalities alignment and semantic noise inhibition. The experimental results demonstrate that \emph{DM-FEND} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across both Chinese (FakeSV) and English (FakeTT) benchmarks. Further ablations validate the crucial role of temporal \textit{Danmaku} modeling in enhancing robustness and discriminative capability. Finally, this study offers a bright and robust solution for multimodal fake news detection in modern social interactive fashions by bridging the temporal inconsistency between news and user behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弹幕 (Danmaku) 在真实场景中累积延迟、无法满足虚假新闻检测实时性的问题，提出时间感知的生成式弹幕框架 Genda，包含预测用户反应时机与强度的 Danmaku Trigger 和合成语义情感表达的 Danmaku Generator，共同构造时间对齐的类人伪弹幕流；并进一步设计弹幕引导的时间多模态虚假新闻检测模型 DM-FEND，在视频、音频、文本和弹幕间进行细粒度多模态交互。实验表明 DM-FEND 在中文 FakeSV 和英文 FakeTT 基准上持续优于已有的 SOTA 方法，消融实验验证了时间弹幕建模对鲁棒性和判别能力的关键作用。
Motivation: 弹幕承载的群体交互能提供细粒度、可判别性的社会信号，对虚假新闻检测有益；但其固有的累积延迟违反虚假新闻检测对实时性的要求，导致相关研究尚未充分探索，因此需要打破这种时间不一致性。
Method: 提出 Genda 框架：先用 Danmaku Trigger 预测用户反应的时机和强度，再用 Danmaku Generator 合成对应的语义与情感表达，从而构造时间对齐且类人的伪弹幕流；随后设计 DM-FEND 模型，在这些生成弹幕的引导下实现视频、音频、文本与弹幕之间的细粒度多模态交互，增强动态模态对齐并抑制语义噪声。
Result: 摘要报告 DM-FEND 在中文基准 FakeSV 和英文基准 FakeTT 上均一致优于 SOTA 基线；消融实验进一步验证了时间弹幕建模对模型鲁棒性和判别能力的决定性作用。
Conclusion: 该研究通过弥合新闻内容与用户行为之间的时间不一致性，为现代社交互动方式下的多模态虚假新闻检测提供了一种可行且稳健的解决方案。

papers.title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 production queries from a major online retailer, optimizing these context artifacts yields larger gains (${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST similarity) than optimizing the retrieval harness (${\sim}3$--$12\%$). On the public BEAVER benchmark, which lacks the production-usage signals available in our internal setting, the picture is more mixed: table cards alone perform about the same as raw historical SQL. The best optimized variant retrieves both cards and raw SQL, scoring $9.00\%$ versus $6.33\%$ (p-value $0.12$) for the comparable baseline on a held-out $N{=}300$ subset, using retrieved context and harness changes but no agentic loop.
papers.journal_ref: COLM 2026 Workshop - Context Beyond the Window
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业级 Text-to-SQL 部署中的瓶颈提出介入点不是模型本身，而是模型消费的知识库上下文（knowledge-base context），并主张该上下文应基于历史使用记录来构建而非当作固定输入。作者利用从生产 SQL 中恢复的 query-DAG 分解，比较 oracle 查询图与检索式知识库上下文的价值，并优化蒸馏流程将历史查询画像转化为可复用的 SQL 参考卡（SQL reference cards）。在包含 5176 条生产查询的内部基准上，优化上下文工件比优化检索 harness 带来更大收益；在公开 BEAVER 基准上结果更混杂，最佳变体同时检索参考卡和原始 SQL。
Motivation: 企业 Text-to-SQL 的瓶颈更多在于什么上下文能到达模型：业务逻辑横跨数千张表，模型无法一次性摄入完整目录，因此最有效的干预位置是模型消费的知识库上下文，且该上下文应当从历史使用中构建。
Method: 使用 query-DAG 分解（与 BEAVER 等企业基准标注的中间表示同族）从生产 SQL 中恢复查询图，通过消融对比 oracle 查询图与检索式知识库上下文的价值；在此基础上优化蒸馏流程，把历史查询画像变成可复用的 SQL 参考卡，并调整检索 harness。
Result: 在 5176 条生产查询基准上，优化上下文工件带来约 12–25% 的 AST 相似度提升，优于优化检索 harness 的约 3–12%；在公开 BEAVER 基准上，仅表格卡与原始历史 SQL 表现相近，最佳变体同时检索卡片与原始 SQL，在保留的 N=300 子集上得分为 9.00% 对基线 6.33%（p 值 0.12），使用检索上下文与 harness 改动但无 agentic loop。
Conclusion: 作者认为从历史使用构建上下文工件的收益大于单纯优化检索 harness；但在缺少生产使用信号的公开基准 BEAVER 上结果更混杂，最优变体相对基线的差异未达到统计显著（p=0.12）。

papers.title: VeCAS: Vessel-Focused Contrast-Free Angiogram Synthesis for Vascular Interventions
papers.abstract_en: X-ray angiography relies on iodinated contrast agents to visualize vascular structures during image-guided interventions. However, contrast administration carries risks of adverse events, motivating the development of contrast-free alternatives. Generating X-ray angiograms directly from non-contrast X-ray images offers a potential solution, but existing approaches remain limited by (i) insufficient control over vascular localization and (ii) inefficient modeling of redundant background content. To address these challenges, we propose VeCAS, a two-stage vessel-focused contrast-free angiogram synthesis framework that separates vascular structure localization from angiographic appearance synthesis. In Stage I, a discriminative model localizes vascular structures in non-contrast X-ray images, while cross-modality latent distillation transfers vessel-sensitive knowledge from X-ray angiograms during training. In Stage II, a vessel-focused inpainting model synthesizes angiographic appearance within the localized vascular regions while preserving the non-vascular background. Experiments on an in-house lower-limb vascular intervention dataset show that VeCAS outperforms the comparison methods in terms of vascular structural fidelity and image quality. Visual Turing tests and physician assessments indicate the perceptual realism of the synthesized angiograms. In addition, robotic guidewire navigation experiments in vascular phantoms show that VeCAS guidance reduces the time to target by 41.4% and the number of operation steps by 40.7% compared with non-contrast guidance. Together, these results suggest the potential of VeCAS to serve as ``meta contrast agent'' for vascular interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VeCAS，一个两阶段的免造影剂血管造影合成框架，用于血管介入手术。该方法将血管结构定位与造影外观生成分离：第一阶段用判别模型在非造影 X 光图像中定位血管，并通过跨模态潜在蒸馏学习造影图像中的血管敏感知识；第二阶段用血管聚焦修复模型在局部血管区域合成造影外观，同时保留非血管背景。在自建下肢血管介入数据集上，VeCAS 在血管结构保真度和图像质量上优于对比方法，并在机器人导丝导航实验中将到达目标时间降低 41.4%、操作步骤减少 40.7%。
Motivation: X 射线血管造影依赖碘造影剂显示血管，但造影剂注射有不良事件风险，因此需要免造影剂的替代方案。现有从非造影 X 光图像直接生成血管造影的方法存在两个局限：对血管定位的控制不足，以及对冗余背景内容建模低效。
Method: 提出两阶段血管聚焦合成框架 VeCAS：阶段一使用判别模型在非造影 X 光图像中定位血管结构，训练时通过跨模态潜在蒸馏（cross-modality latent distillation）从 X 射线血管造影中迁移血管敏感知识；阶段二使用血管聚焦修复模型（vessel-focused inpainting model）在定位到的血管区域内合成造影外观，同时保留非血管背景。
Result: 在自建下肢血管介入数据集上，VeCAS 在血管结构保真度和图像质量上优于对比方法；视觉图灵测试和医生评估表明合成血管造影具有感知真实感。在血管体模上的机器人导丝导航实验中，与无造影引导相比，VeCAS 引导将到达目标时间缩短 41.4%，操作步骤减少 40.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 VeCAS 有潜力作为血管介入中的“元造影剂”（meta contrast agent），提供免造影剂条件下的高质量造影合成引导。

papers.title: DIME: Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference on Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks expose whether individual records were used to train a model, yet existing attacks on diffusion models are largely heuristic and can require substantial query budgets. We introduce DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error), a theoretically grounded and query-efficient framework for membership inference on diffusion models. Our starting point is an exact characterization of the optimal diffusion denoiser for a finite training set, which reveals that membership leakage is governed by the denoiser's implicit reconstruction error. This error decomposes into two complementary signals: a bias term, capturing reconstruction accuracy, and a previously unexplored local crowding term, capturing the geometry of nearby training examples. Both admit efficient estimators using only model queries, yielding a practical attack with as few as two queries. Across CIFAR-10/100, STL10-U, CelebA, and ImageNet, DIME consistently outperforms prior attacks at comparable or substantially lower query cost, improving TPR at 1% FPR by up to $3\times$; remarkably, its two-query variant can outperform existing 30-query baselines. Finally, we suggest, discuss, and evaluate specific defenses to counteract such powerful membership tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error)，一个理论驱动且查询高效的扩散模型成员推断攻击框架。作者给出有限训练集下最优扩散去噪器的精确刻画，将成员泄露分解为偏差项与局部拥挤项，并利用模型查询高效估计，最少仅需两次查询即可攻击。在 CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA 和 ImageNet 上，DIME 以相当或更低的查询成本持续优于此前攻击，在 1% FPR 下的 TPR 最高提升 3 倍，且两查询版本可胜过 30 查询的基线。文中还讨论并评估了针对此类攻击的防御措施。
Motivation: 现有针对扩散模型的成员推断攻击 largely heuristic，且需要大量查询预算，缺乏理论基础。本文旨在给出一个理论上严谨、查询高效的框架来揭示扩散模型中的成员泄露机制。
Method: 通过精确刻画有限训练集上的最优扩散去噪器，证明成员泄露由去噪器的隐式重构误差决定；该误差分解为捕获重构精度的偏差项和捕获邻近训练样本几何结构的局部拥挤项。两者均可仅通过模型查询得到高效估计，形成最少两次查询的实用攻击框架 DIME。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA 和 ImageNet 上，DIME 在可比或显著更低的查询成本下持续优于既有攻击，1% FPR 下 TPR 最高提升 3 倍；其两查询变体即可超越现有 30 查询基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DIME 是一种强大且查询高效的成员推断方法，并建议、讨论和评估了若干针对这类测试的防御措施；摘要未提及明确的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SiZeUp: Fast 3D Proxy from Aerial Images via Depth Ordinal Loss
papers.abstract_en: We present SiZeUp, a fast and scalable approach for constructing large-scale 3D urban proxy models directly from calibrated oblique aerial imagery. Our method adopts a height-from-footprint representation, reducing 3D building abstraction to a low-dimensional optimization problem in which building footprints are extruded by a single height parameter. To enable efficient and robust height estimation, we introduce an ordinal depth consistency loss that enforces agreement between the relative depth ordering of rendered proxies and depth priors predicted by a monocular depth model. This is realized through a differentiable renderer that maps parametric building proxies into multi-view depth images, allowing gradients to be propagated from depth supervision to building heights. Our ordinal formulation produces stable optimization in practice and avoids explicit feature matching or dense point cloud reconstruction. Rather than relying on metric depth, which can be unreliable under monocular scale ambiguity, our ordinal depth consistency loss operates on relative depths, providing a more reliable signal across views. Combined with an efficient dynamic view selection, our approach achieves a 23-52$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art proxy reconstruction pipelines while maintaining comparable proxy-level coverage and volume consistency, making it well suited for large-scale urban modeling tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiZeUp，一种从标定斜射航空影像快速构建大规模三维城市代理模型的方法。该方法采用 height-from-footprint 表示，将建筑抽象为单一高度参数拉伸的足迹，并通过可微渲染器结合单目深度模型，以序数深度一致性损失（ordinal depth consistency loss）优化建筑高度，避免显式特征匹配或稠密点云重建。摘要报告相比现有代理重建管线取得 23-52 倍加速，同时保持可比的代理覆盖率和体积一致性。
Motivation: 大规模城市三维建模中，现有代理重建管线通常依赖特征匹配或稠密点云重建，速度较慢，且直接使用度量深度会受到单目尺度模糊的影响；本文希望将建筑抽象简化为低维高度优化问题，并利用跨视图更稳定的相对深度信号实现快速稳健的高度估计。
Method: 采用 height-from-footprint 表示，将每个建筑足迹用一个高度参数拉伸；引入序数深度一致性损失，约束可微渲染器生成的多视深度图与单目深度模型预测之间的相对深度排序一致，从而将梯度从深度监督传播到建筑高度参数；并结合高效的动态视图选择。
Result: 摘要报告该方法相对最先进的代理重建管线实现 23-52 倍速度提升，同时保持相当的代理级覆盖率和体积一致性。
Conclusion: 序数深度一致性损失在相对深度上运作，规避了单目尺度模糊下度量深度不可靠的问题，使优化过程稳定；该方法面向大规模城市建模任务。摘要未提及与降水、临近预报或气象数据同化相关的任何内容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models often produce performance disparities across demographic groups, due to the training data imbalance with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender or age. To address this problem, existing work has explored fair representation learning, data re-sampling, and adversarial training, which can be broadly categorized into two main approaches. Single-stage methods typically learn a shared representation for fairness, but often struggle to handle heterogeneous subgroup distributions. Two-stage methods learn representations separately from the final prediction task, which can lead to misalignment between fairness objectives and downstream predictions. We identify routing-induced bias, a failure mode in which subgroup imbalance drives the gating network to route subgroups onto a few experts, and propose an end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that corrects it. Specifically, we apply subgroup reweighting to correct data imbalance, and introduce gate entropy regularization to prevent routing from collapsing onto subgroup attributes, keeping expert utilization both balanced and interpretable. Beyond improving fairness, the routing distribution offers an interpretable view of how subgroups are allocated across experts. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves fairness while maintaining competitive predictive performance.
papers.journal_ref: AVSS 2026 (22nd International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度学习模型在不同人口统计子群（如性别、年龄）上的性能差异问题，提出一种端到端的 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 框架。作者识别出路由诱导偏差 (routing-induced bias)：子群数据不平衡会驱使其门控网络把子群路由到少数专家上。通过子群重加权 (subgroup reweighting) 和门控熵正则化 (gate entropy regularization) 来纠正该偏差，实验显示在改善公平性的同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。
Motivation: 现有公平性方法分为单阶段和两阶段：单阶段方法学习共享表示但难以处理异质的子群分布，两阶段方法将表示学习与预测任务分离，导致公平目标与下游预测错位。本文聚焦于子群不平衡使门控网络产生路由坍塌的新失败模式。
Method: 提出端到端的 MoE 框架，采用子群重加权修正数据不平衡，并引入门控熵正则化防止路由分布针对子群属性坍塌，从而保持专家利用率的平衡和可解释性。
Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在提升公平性的同时维持了有竞争力的预测性能；路由分布还提供了子群在专家间分配的可解释视图。
Conclusion: 作者强调纠正路由诱导偏差可以兼顾公平性与预测性能，并指出该框架的专家分配具有可解释性。

papers.title: Direct, Parallel, or Sequential? A Comparative Study of Training-Free Multi-Subject Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned image-to-video (I2V) generation has advanced rapidly, yet generating videos with multiple subjects remains challenging. A model must simultaneously preserve the appearance of each subject, assign distinct motions, and maintain coherent spatial and temporal interactions. This paper presents a systematic study of three representative paradigms for training-free multi-subject I2V generation: direct, parallel, and sequential generation. Direct generation applies a pretrained I2V model to the complete reference image and prompt, requiring all subjects and motions to be synthesized jointly. Parallel and sequential generation instead decompose the reference image and prompt into subject-specific visual and textual conditions. Parallel generation synthesizes each subject independently and subsequently composes the resulting videos, reducing the complexity of each generation step at the cost of weaker inter-subject context. Sequential generation first synthesizes a background video and then progressively introduces individual subjects. This preserves accumulated scene context but introduces sensitivity to subject ordering and error propagation. We empirically evaluate the three paradigms across diverse multi-subject scenes, comparing appearance preservation, motion fidelity, temporal consistency, and inter-subject coherence, while also characterizing their distinct failure modes. Our findings reveal the strengths and limitations of each paradigm and offer practical insights for designing controllable multi-subject video generation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了无训练的多主体图像到视频（image-to-video, I2V）生成的三种代表范式：直接生成（direct）、并行生成（parallel）和顺序生成（sequential）。论文在多种多主体场景下评估了外观保持、运动保真、时间一致性和主体间一致性，并刻画了各自的失败模式。研究发表于 ACM Multimedia Workshop 2026。
Motivation: 多主体 I2V 生成的难点在于模型需要同时保持每个主体的外观、分配不同的运动，并维持主体间连贯的空间与时间交互，现有工作缺乏对这些生成范式的系统比较。
Method: 直接生成将完整参考图像和提示词交给预训练 I2V 模型联合合成所有主体；并行生成将参考图像与提示词分解为主体特定的视觉和文本条件，独立合成每个主体后再组合视频；顺序生成先合成背景视频，再逐步引入各主体。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅报告了三种范式在多样化多主体场景下的实证比较结果，揭示了各自的优势、局限与典型失败模式。
Conclusion: 研究指出三种范式各有取舍：并行生成降低单步复杂度但主体间上下文较弱，顺序生成保留场景上下文但对主体顺序敏感且存在误差传播；作者据此为可控多主体视频生成系统的设计提供了实用见解。

summary_sections.motivation: 多主体 I2V 生成的难点在于模型需要同时保持每个主体的外观、分配不同的运动，并维持主体间连贯的空间与时间交互，现有工作缺乏对这些生成范式的系统比较。
summary_sections.method: 直接生成将完整参考图像和提示词交给预训练 I2V 模型联合合成所有主体；并行生成将参考图像与提示词分解为主体特定的视觉和文本条件，独立合成每个主体后再组合视频；顺序生成先合成背景视频，再逐步引入各主体。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅报告了三种范式在多样化多主体场景下的实证比较结果，揭示了各自的优势、局限与典型失败模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究指出三种范式各有取舍：并行生成降低单步复杂度但主体间上下文较弱，顺序生成保留场景上下文但对主体顺序敏感且存在误差传播；作者据此为可控多主体视频生成系统的设计提供了实用见解。

papers.title: SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Postpartum depression (PPD) poses a major burden on maternal and child health, especially in low- and middle-income countries where prevalence exceeds 19%. Despite advancements in machine learning for PPD prediction, current approaches are limited by opaque global explanations that lack clinical usefulness at the patient level, unstable feature selection, and poor generalization under class imbalance. We propose SAGE, a Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble feature selection system that incorporates both local explainable AI and a genetically optimized artificial neural network (GA-ANN). Using a primary cohort of 766 postpartum women, SAGE combines information-theoretic relevance, PCA-based structure, and graph-based interactions with bootstrap stability weighting to identify robust and non-redundant predictors. The GA-ANN architecture, optimized using a genetic algorithm and enhanced with GAN based oversampling, achieved strong performance with 87.96% accuracy, 86.32% F1 score, and 0.88 AUC using only 16 features, outperforming baseline and other feature selection methods. Psychological and socioeconomic factors such as EPDS score, PHQ-9 score, feelings about motherhood, and abuse history are the main predictors, while demographic factors have less influence. The LIME-based explanations allow instance-based insight into selected features from the graph, enabling personalized risk assessment. The findings make SAGE a scalable, interpretable, and clinical tool for early identification of PPD in health-care limited resources.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at 10th International Artificial Intelligence and Data Processing Symposium (IDAP'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE，一种面向产后抑郁症 (PPD) 风险预测的稳定性感知图基集成特征选择系统，结合局部可解释 AI (LIME) 与遗传算法优化的神经网络 (GA-ANN)。在 766 名产后女性的队列上，使用仅 16 个特征达到 87.96% 准确率、86.32% F1 和 0.88 AUC，优于基线与其他特征选择方法。摘要指出 EPDS、PHQ-9、对母亲身份的感受及虐待史等心理社会因素是主要预测因子，LIME 解释支持个体化风险评估。
Motivation: 现有 PPD 预测方法存在全局解释缺乏患者层面临床实用性、特征选择不稳定以及在类不平衡下泛化差的问题，而 PPD 在中低收入国家患病率超过 19%，需要可解释且稳健的预测工具。
Method: SAGE 将信息论相关性、PCA 结构与图基交互结合，并通过 bootstrap 稳定性加权选择稳健且非冗余的特征；预测模型为遗传算法优化的 GA-ANN，并使用 GAN 过采样缓解类不平衡，最后用 LIME 提供实例级解释。
Result: 摘要报告 SAGE 以 16 个特征取得 87.96% 准确率、86.32% F1 分数与 0.88 AUC，超过基线和对比特征选择方法；主要预测因子包括 EPDS 分数、PHQ-9 分数、对母亲身份的感受和虐待史，人口学因素影响较小。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 SAGE 是一种可扩展、可解释且适用于医疗资源有限环境的临床工具，可用于 PPD 的早期识别；其价值体现在以少量特征兼顾性能与个体化解释。

papers.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?
papers.abstract_en: When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts carry their own labels and metrics rather than one leaderboard. Four are evidential; three are Gold-derived mechanism diagnostics. The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs. Most of the arena does not order: 47 of 118 pre-declared contrasts separate, and the rest are published unresolved rather than ranked. The two sharpest results cut against our own data. One rule ignores every name and permission; it flags each capability declared after the first. On one of six configuration sources it reaches a perfect F1, so a score there measures how the corpus was built rather than how well a method reasons. Our admissibility bar then rejected one injected substrate and withheld evidential status from the other. A benchmark number is therefore not interpretable until the process behind its labels is published and tested for the shortcut it may leave. We report both, and regenerate every ordering from released predictions with no model call.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Work in progress. Code and data: https://github.com/yzhao062/catchbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CatchBench 是一个评测 agent 失败可捕获性的基准，将审计问题放在三种信息状态下：运行前的声明配置 (PRE)、运行中不断增长的 trace 前缀 (LIVE) 和完成后的完整 trace (POST)。该基准引入七个任务契约，各自带独立标签和指标，而非单一排行榜。作者对 72 个参赛者（包括规则扫描器、结构模型和 11 个 LLM 裁判）在 1187 个声明配置和 1162 个记录运行上进行了评测，结果发现大部分对比无法排序，且最尖锐的结果指向标签生成过程本身的捷径问题。
Motivation: 现有基准要么固定某一种信息状态，要么变化遥测数据，但没有在统一的任务-方法接口下同时评分三种信息状态。作者认为审计通常受限于记录而不是方法，因此需要明确一个失败何时能被捕获，并区分可证据化的结论与机制诊断。
Method: 定义 PRE/LIVE/POST 三种信息状态，设计七个任务契约：四个为证据性任务，三个为 Gold 派生机制诊断任务。每个任务使用自己的标签和指标，避免单一排行榜。评测包含 72 个参赛者，跨越九大模型家族的 11 个 LLM 裁判，并对预测结果进行可复现的排序再生。
Result: 在 118 个预先声明的对比中只有 47 个能够区分，其余以未解决状态发布而非排名。一个简单规则忽略所有名称和权限，只标记第一个之后声明的每个能力，在六个配置源之一达到完美 F1，说明该分数反映语料构建方式而非方法推理能力。作者因此拒绝了一个注入的基板，并对另一个保留证据性状态。
Conclusion: 基准数值在标签生成过程未被公开并检验其可能留下的捷径之前是不可解释的。作者同时报告数据和方法，并从已发布的预测中重新生成所有排序，无需模型调用。

papers.title: Change Detection in Probability Flow ODE: Online Testing in Diffusion Latent Spaces
papers.abstract_en: A rapidly growing range of sequential data tasks, such as identifying trend reversals in financial markets, auto-segmenting video and audio recordings, detecting changes in movement direction from motion sensors cannot be fully addressed without detection of distributional shifts in time-ordered data. We consider a sequential change-point detection problem where the conditional density switches at an unknown time, yet neither the pre- nor post-change distribution admits a closed-form. Classical likelihood-ratio statistics are inapplicable in this settings. A conditional diffusion model, trained on pre-change-point data with a frozen context encoder, defines a deterministic bijection via the probability flow ODE. Pre-change observations are mapped onto standard Gaussian latent variables. Post-change observations, processed through the same frozen map, deviate from this reference. We employ the Maximum Mean Discrepancy as the test statistic, derive closed-form expressions for its components under the Gaussian null, and establish its asymptotic distribution as a degenerate U-statistic. Afterwards we apply an online detection procedure of Shiryaev--Roberts to the resulting statistic with exact threshold calibration. The method detects arbitrary distributional shifts, including covariance rotations and higher-order structural breaks, without parametric assumptions on either regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究顺序变化点检测 (sequential change-point detection) 在条件密度切换时刻未知、且变化前后分布均无闭式形式时的在线检测问题。作者用冻结上下文编码器在变化前数据上训练条件扩散模型，通过概率流 ODE (probability flow ODE) 得到确定性双射，将变化前观测映射到标准高斯潜变量；变化后观测经同一冻结映射后会偏离该参考分布。检验统计量采用最大均值差异 (MMD)，在 Gaussian 原假设下给出其分量的闭式表达式，并将渐近分布刻画为退化 U 统计量 (degenerate U-statistic)，最后用 Shiryaev-Roberts 在线检测程序实现精确阈值校准。
Motivation: 许多时序任务需要在没有参数假设的情况下检测分布漂移，但经典似然比统计量要求变化前后的分布具有闭式形式，难以应对金融趋势反转、音视频自动分段、运动传感器方向变化等真实场景。
Method: 利用条件扩散模型与概率流 ODE 把变化前观测编码为接近标准高斯的潜变量，并冻结该映射处理后续观测；以 MMD 衡量潜变量偏离高斯参考的程度，在 Gaussian 原假设下解析推导统计量分量并建立退化 U 统计量的渐近分布，再采用 Shiryaev-Roberts 在线检测程序并精确校准阈值。
Result: 摘要声称该方法无需对任一时间段作参数假设，即可检测任意分布漂移，包括协方差旋转 (covariance rotations) 和更高阶的结构突变。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的核心是将无闭式分布的变化点检测转化为扩散潜空间中的高斯偏离检验，并借助退化 U 统计量的渐近理论实现在线检测的精确阈值校准。

papers.title: Contrastive Representation-Guided Genetic Minority Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time-series classification tasks often exhibit class imbalance, which can be extremely severe in some applications. To avoid training biased classifiers on imbalanced data, sampling is one of the most popular data pre-processing techniques because of its classifier-agnostic nature. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies in original time-series data and the scarcity of minority-class samples, existing sampling methods, including interpolation-based oversampling methods and deep learning-based generative models, usually suffer from limited generalization and poor diversity when generating new time-series samples. This paper proposes a Frequency-domain representation-guided Multi-tree Genetic Programming-based oversampling approach (FreMGP) to imbalanced time-series classification, where each individual represents a set of synthetic samples for the minority class. A frequency-domain class-discriminative representation module based on contrastive learning is also developed, guiding the evolutionary search toward high-quality synthetic time-series samples. Experiments on imbalanced time-series datasets demonstrate that FreMGP outperforms existing oversampling methods and consistently improves the performance of different classifiers, including both general machine learning and deep learning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向不平衡时间序列分类的过采样方法 FreMGP，将多树遗传编程 (multi-tree genetic programming) 与基于对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的频域类判别表示模块结合，由每个个体表示一组少数类合成样本，并引导进化搜索生成高质量的时间序列样本。实验表明 FreMGP 在多个不平衡时间序列数据集上优于现有过采样方法，并能一致提升不同机器学习与深度学习分类器的性能。
Motivation: 真实时间序列分类常面临类别不平衡，甚至极度不平衡。现有采样方法（包括插值式过采样和深度学习生成模型）受限于时间序列的复杂时序依赖和少数类样本稀缺，生成的新样本泛化性有限、多样性不足。
Method: 提出 FreMGP：基于频域表示的、多树遗传编程的过采样方法，每个个体编码一组少数类合成样本；同时开发基于对比学习的频域类别判别表示模块，指导进化搜索朝向高质量合成时间序列。
Result: 在不平衡时间序列数据集上的实验表明，FreMGP 优于现有过采样方法，并能一致提升多种分类器（包括通用机器学习和深度学习模型）的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过频域判别表征结合进化搜索，能生成更高质量且更多样的少数类时间序列样本，从而改善不平衡分类。

papers.title: SDoH-Aware Narrative Anchoring Bias in Medical LLMs for Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Medical large language models are often judged by how many clinical questions they answer correctly. That view is useful, but it misses a practical risk. A model may know the right answer and still change its response when the same case is written in a different patient voice. This paper evaluates that risk as SDoH aware narrative anchoring bias. We use NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA, a counterfactual medical question answering dataset in which each case appears in persona based narratives while the answer key remains fixed. The dataset is reshaped from wide format into case grouped persona rows. We evaluate three open source instruction tuned LLMs from the Qwen2.5 family: 1.5B, 3B, and 7B. The final experiment uses 300 clinical cases and produces 8,100 model responses across three prompting conditions. We report persona level accuracy, counterfactual consistency, correct consistency, and narrative sensitivity error. Qwen2.5 7B achieves the best accuracy at 56.33 percent and the best correct consistency at 40.33 percent. Paired McNemar exact tests show significant accuracy gains for 7B over 3B in all prompt settings. Even so, narrative sensitivity remains, with the lowest error still at 31.67 percent. These results suggest that trustworthy clinical decision support should be evaluated by both average correctness and stability across medically equivalent patient narratives.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注医学大语言模型的一个实际风险：模型可能知道正确答案，但当同一病例以不同患者口吻叙述时仍会改变回答。作者将该风险定义为 SDoH 感知的叙事锚定偏差 (narrative anchoring bias)，并构建反事实医学问答数据集 NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA，其中每个病例以 persona 化叙事呈现而答案保持不变。研究在 Qwen2.5 家族的 1.5B、3B、7B 三个开源指令微调模型上评估，最终实验使用 300 个临床病例、3 种提示条件，共产生 8,100 条模型响应，并报告 persona 级准确率、反事实一致性、正确一致性与叙事敏感误差。
Motivation: 现有医学大模型评测主要看回答正确的数量，但正确率无法捕捉同一病例在不同患者叙事下回答不稳定的风险；对于可信的临床决策支持，需要在医学等价的患者叙事之间保持稳定性。
Method: 提出反事实医学问答数据集 NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA，将每个病例从宽格式重塑为按病例分组的 persona 行，保持答案键固定；在三种提示条件下评估 Qwen2.5 1.5B、3B、7B 三个模型，使用 persona 级准确率、反事实一致性、正确一致性和叙事敏感误差作为指标，并采用配对的 McNemar 精确检验比较模型间差异。
Result: Qwen2.5 7B 取得最佳准确率 56.33% 和最佳正确一致性 40.33%；配对 McNemar 精确检验显示 7B 在所有提示设置下相对 3B 均有显著准确率提升。尽管如此，叙事敏感误差仍然存在，最低误差仍达 31.67%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，可信的临床决策支持评估应同时考虑平均正确性和在医学等价的患者叙事之间的稳定性，而非只看正确率。

papers.title: Triplet2Track: A Hierarchical System with Object-Centric Representations for Reliable Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring reliability in uncertain environments remains difficult for long-horizon robotic manipulation. End-to-end VLA models are data-heavy and opaque, making diagnosis and verification difficult. Hierarchical pipelines are more interpretable, but their plans are often weakly grounded in observations, weakly aligned with low-level actions, and computed without online feedback, leading to open-loop behavior and hallucinations. To address these issues, we introduce the Triplet-to-Track System (TTS), a closed-loop long-horizon imitation learning system that uses human videos to reduce reliance on robot-collected data. TTS represents high-level subgoals as instance-grounded triplets, translates them into continuous track priors for execution, and monitors task progress from observations for online replanning. Across diverse real-world long-horizon tasks, TTS achieves a 74.8\% average success rate and supports object-level and compositional generalization.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Triplet-to-Track System (TTS)，一个面向长时程机器人操作任务的闭环模仿学习系统。TTS 将高层子目标表示为实例级三元组 (triplets)，再转换为连续轨迹先验 (track priors) 用于执行，并通过在线反馈监控任务进度以实现重规划。在多样化的真实世界长时程任务上，该系统达到 74.8% 的平均成功率，并支持物体级和组合泛化。
Motivation: 长时程机器人操作在不确定环境中难以保证可靠性：端到端 VLA 模型数据需求大且不透明，难以诊断和验证；分层管线虽然更可解释，但其计划往往与观测联系弱、与底层动作对齐差，且缺少在线反馈，导致开环行为和幻觉。
Method: TTS 是一个闭环长时程模仿学习系统，利用人类视频来减少对机器人采集数据的依赖。它把高层子目标表示为实例级三元组，将其转化为连续轨迹先验供执行模块使用，并从观测中监控任务进度以支持在线重规划。
Result: 在多样的真实世界长时程操作任务上，TTS 达到 74.8% 的平均成功率，并展现出物体级 (object-level) 与组合泛化 (compositional generalization) 能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将实例级三元组与闭环在线反馈结合，可以提升长时程操作在不确定环境中的可靠性，并借助人类视频降低对机器人数据的依赖。

papers.title: Reproducible Vision-Guided 6-DoF Robotic Manipulator with a Mixed Stepper-Driver Architecture and Browser-Native Control
papers.abstract_en: We present the NeuralNexus Arm, an open, low-cost 6-DOF robotic manipulator built by an undergraduate engineering team, together with the design decisions and debugging experience needed to reproduce it. The arm is driven by a single STM32H743 microcontroller on a custom printed circuit board (PCB) and combines two stepper-driver strategies on one controller: push-pull 3.3 V step/direction outputs for onboard TMC2209 drivers on the three wrist joints, and open-drain outputs for external CL57T and DM542 drivers on the three high-torque proximal joints. We describe the mechanical design, mixed-driver electronics, interrupt-driven firmware, a MATLAB/Simscape-based inverse-kinematics pipeline, a browser-native control interface using the Web Serial API, and a lightweight vision pipeline for object localisation and autonomous pick-and-place tasks. We also document non-obvious hardware and firmware failure modes encountered during the transition from a development board to the custom PCB as reproducibility guidance. All design files and firmware are released openly. The platform actuates all six axes under coordinated control at a 2 kHz update rate and executes both manual and pre-recorded motions from the browser interface.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 16 figures, 7 tables. Design files and firmware: https://github.com/Lasan-Perera/6-dof-arm-neuralnexus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 NeuralNexus Arm，一个由本科生团队构建的开源低成本 6-DOF 机械臂，重点记录其设计决策与可复现经验。该臂由单块 STM32H743 微控制器驱动，在一块定制 PCB 上混合使用两种步进驱动方案：腕部三个关节采用板载 TMC2209 驱动器的推挽式 3.3V step/direction 输出，近端三个高扭矩关节则采用开漏输出连接外部 CL57T 和 DM542 驱动器。系统还包括基于 MATLAB/Simscape 的逆运动学流水线、基于 Web Serial API 的浏览器原生控制界面，以及用于物体定位和自主抓取/放置任务的轻量视觉流水线。摘要报告该平台能在 2 kHz 更新率下协调控制全部六个轴，并通过浏览器界面执行手动和预录制运动。
Motivation: 低成本开源机械臂平台虽多，但从开发板移植到定制 PCB 的过程中经常出现非显而易见的硬件与固件故障，缺少可复现的工程指导。本文旨在通过公开设计文件和固件，提供一份包含真实调试经验的完整复现指南。
Method: 提出一个混合步进驱动器架构的整体设计方案：单颗 STM32H743 配合定制 PCB，同时驱动 3.3V step/direction 的 TMC2209（腕部）和外部 CL57T/DM542 开漏驱动（近端关节）；配套中断驱动固件、MATLAB/Simscape 逆运动学流水线、基于 Web Serial API 的浏览器控制界面，以及用于物体定位和自主抓取放置的轻量视觉流水线。
Result: 摘要报告该机械臂在 2 kHz 更新率下能协调控制全部六个轴，并可从浏览器界面执行手动与预录制运动；同时记录了从开发板过渡到定制 PCB 过程中的多种非显而易见故障模式。
Conclusion: 作者强调开放设计文件与固件，并将硬件/固件调试经验整理为可复现性指导，使低成本 6-DOF 机械臂平台可被他人复现和扩展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Performance of a domain-specific large language model in answering patient questions in psychiatry
papers.abstract_en: Background This study was designed to evaluate whether a domain-specific large language model (LLM) trained exclusively on patient education resources can answer questions about psychiatric medications, in a manner superior to LLM chatbots. We developed an LLM ("MIND") fine-tuned for clinical fidelity, trained on patient education resources from authoritative medical organizations. Methods We compared the responses of MIND, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence to patient questions about escitalopram, using two methods: (1) computer analysis according to a rubric measuring accuracy, clarity, completeness, nuance, safety, and referral appropriateness; (2) ratings from N=10 board-licensed psychiatrists on similar metrics. Results When rated by rubric, MIND was rated highest in all domains (p<0.001). When rated by psychiatrists, ChatGPT was rated accurate more often than MIND with a negligible effect size (p=0.021, r=0.073); MIND was rated complete more often than ChatGPT with a small effect size (p<0.001, r=0.160); and MIND and ChatGPT were rated safe with the same frequency (p=0.955, r=0.002). The majority of psychiatrists preferred the responses generated by ChatGPT (57.6%) compared to MIND (42.4%, p=0.003). Conclusions MIND was able to answer many questions about escitalopram in a manner deemed accurate, complete, and safe by psychiatrists the majority of the time. However, despite MIND's ability to provide more complete responses, psychiatrists preferred ChatGPT's responses. MIND represents a step towards building safe LLM systems to enhance patient education in psychiatry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发并评估了一个仅用权威患者教育资源训练的领域特定大语言模型“MIND”，用于回答精神病学药物（艾司西酞普兰）的患者问题，并与 ChatGPT 和 OpenEvidence 对比。通过自动化量表（rubric）和 10 位执业精神科医生评分，结果显示 MIND 在量表所有领域得分最高，但多数精神科医生实际更偏好 ChatGPT 的回答。
Motivation: 旨在检验仅基于权威患者教育资源训练的领域特定 LLM 是否能在回答精神科药物问题时优于通用聊天机器人，从而为构建安全、可靠的精神病学患者教育 AI 系统提供依据。
Method: 开发名为 MIND 的 LLM，使用来自权威医疗组织的患者教育资源微调以提高临床保真度；将 MIND、ChatGPT 和 OpenEvidence 对艾司西酞普兰患者问题的回答，分别通过自动化 rubric（准确性、清晰度、完整性、细微差别、安全性和转诊适当性）和 10 位精神科医生的评分进行对比。
Result: Rubric 评估中 MIND 在所有领域得分最高（p<0.001）。精神科医生评分中，ChatGPT 在准确性上略高（p=0.021, r=0.073），MIND 在完整性上更高（p<0.001, r=0.160），两者安全性相同（p=0.955, r=0.002）；多数精神科医生偏好 ChatGPT（57.6% vs 42.4%, p=0.003）。
Conclusion: MIND 的回答大多数时候被精神科医生认为准确、完整且安全，尽管其回答更完整，医生仍偏好 ChatGPT；作者将 MIND 视为构建安全精神病学患者教育 LLM 系统的一步。

papers.title: VersaDB: A High-Performance AI Storage Database for Unifying Mutimodal Datasets
papers.abstract_en: The AI field has been rapidly developing, leading to the emergence of a large number of AI training datasets of various types. These datasets contain different modalities, including text, images, audio, etc., and may come in various data storage formats. With the advancement of AI hardware, AI computation units like GPUs, TPUs, and NPUs can greatly accelerate the training speed of AI models, which in turn increases the demand for faster data processing. When using existing AI processing frameworks to handle datasets with different modalities and storage formats, processing speeds may be suboptimal due to issues such as data layout and the way users handle the data. Therefore, using a unified database to store multiple data formats can better manage and optimize data access. In this paper, we introduce VersaDB, a database designed specifically for AI datasets with various modalities. We implemented a page-based storage system, separating structured and unstructured data. Additionally, we generated B+ tree-based index files to accelerate data access. VersaDB supports automatic sharding and maintains a hierarchical metadata management system, with corresponding metadata maintained at the page, shard, and global levels, forming the foundation for the efficient operation of the database. We also focused on ease of use by providing APIs for directly converting datasets into VersaDB, as well as APIs for converting popular AI data storage formats (e.g., CSV, TFRecord, .bin) into VersaDB.Our experiments show that using VersaDB can achieve up to 5.35x acceleration and maintain consistent performance across different parallelism levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VersaDB，一个面向多模态 AI 训练数据集的统一存储数据库。系统采用基于页面的存储并分离结构化与非结构化数据，同时建立 B+ 树索引、自动分片与分层元数据管理。实验表明，相比现有 AI 处理框架，VersaDB 最高可实现 5.35x 加速，并在不同并行度下保持一致的性能。
Motivation: AI 训练数据集包含文本、图像、音频等多种模态和多种存储格式，而 GPU、TPU、NPU 等硬件加速了模型训练，也提升了对数据处理速度的需求。现有 AI 处理框架在数据布局和用户处理方式上存在不足，导致处理速度次优，因此需要统一的数据库来管理多种数据格式并优化数据访问。
Method: 实现基于页面的存储系统，将结构化与非结构化数据分离；生成基于 B+ 树的索引文件以加速数据访问。系统支持自动分片，并在页面、分片和全局三个层级维护分层元数据，同时提供将数据集直接转换以及将 CSV、TFRecord、.bin 等常见 AI 数据存储格式转换为 VersaDB 的 API。
Result: 实验表明，使用 VersaDB 最高可实现 5.35x 的加速，并在不同并行度下保持一致的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调使用统一数据库存储多种数据格式，结合易用 API 与分层元数据管理，可以更好地管理和优化 AI 数据访问。摘要未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhering to domain policies. Even frontier models show a substantial gap between what they can solve at least once (Pass@3) and what they solve consistently across trials (Pass^k). We bridge this gap with TRACE (TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution), which iteratively improves a skill-based agent's behavioral knowledge without modifying model weights. This knowledge is organized as a Skill Bank of modular, retrievable skills, each encoding a self-contained set of tool-use rules and behavioral guidelines. TRACE evolves this bank through an agentic self-evolution loop: after each evaluation round, it groups trajectories by the skills invoked and refines each skill by contrasting successful and failed behaviors. The updated bank then guides subsequent rounds, while during deployment the Actor performs state-conditioned skill orchestration at every turn. On GPT-5.5, TRACE improves consistency (Pass^3) by 34.6 points, from 59.9% to 94.5%, while shrinking the gap between potential and reliable performance to just 4.0 points. On the official hidden set, TRACE achieved first place using GPT-5.6-Sol, attaining a Pass^3 score of 70%-a 40% relative improvement over the baseline. These results show that TRACE converts high model potential into stable, consistent performance gain. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE（TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution），一种无需修改模型权重的自进化技能库方法，用于提升 LLM agent 在用户端产品中的一致性与边界感知能力。作者在车载助手场景的 CAR-bench 基准上验证，TRACE 通过对比成功与失败轨迹来迭代精炼 Skill Bank，显著提升了重复实验间的一致性（Pass^3）。在 GPT-5.5 上，TRACE 将 Pass^3 从 59.9% 提升至 94.5%，并在官方隐藏集上取得第一名。
Motivation: LLM agent 在真实用户产品中的可靠部署不仅依赖原始任务解决能力，更依赖一致性和边界感知：即多次尝试中行为一致，并能识别请求何时无法或尚不能安全完成。CAR-bench 暴露了这一可靠性差距：即使前沿模型也显著存在一次性可解（Pass@3）与跨试验稳定可解（Pass^k）之间的差距。
Method: TRACE 将行为知识组织为模块化、可检索的 Skill Bank，每个技能编码一组独立的工具使用规则和行为指南。它通过智能体自进化循环迭代改进该知识库：每轮评估后将轨迹按所调用技能分组，对比成功与失败行为来精炼对应技能；更新后的 Skill Bank 指导后续轮次，部署时 Actor 每步执行状态条件化的技能编排（state-conditioned skill orchestration）。
Result: 在 GPT-5.5 上，TRACE 将一致性（Pass^3）提升 34.6 个百分点（从 59.9% 到 94.5%），并将潜在性能与可靠性能之间的差距缩小至 4.0 个百分点。在 CAR-bench 官方隐藏集上，TRACE 使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 获得第一名，Pass^3 为 70%，相对基线提升 40%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，TRACE 能够将模型的高潜在能力转化为稳定、一致的实际性能增益，在不改动模型权重的前提下弥合潜在能力与可靠表现之间的差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GuidedFlow: An Attention-Guided Framework for Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Additive Manufacturing (AM) plays a vital role in the ongoing industrial revolution. However, quality control remains crucial and challenging due to printing defects or potential cyber-physical intrusions. Image or video-based anomaly detection is a key effort towards addressing these challenges. Various approaches have been explored in this domain, including reconstruction-based, embedding-based, and flow-based methods. Though normalizing flow-based methods address some of the core challenges of unforeseen defects and generalization while maintaining detection performance, existing approaches struggle with tiny/stringing defects common in 3D printing. In a small-data setting, this poses a limitation in generalization. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GuidedFlow}, a novel attention-guided normalizing flow model for anomaly detection and localization. GuidedFlow employs a pre-trained ResNet model, fine-tuned on the domain dataset. An attention-guided spatial and temporal flow framework models the dynamics across multiple scales and frames. A Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (SAN) enables the flow model to prioritize relevant contextual cues from input frames. We evaluate GuidedFlow on our AM3D-AD dataset, consisting of benign and anomalous real 3D printed object images and videos. We also conduct a comparative study using the MVTec-AD industrial image anomaly detection dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that GuidedFlow outperforms most of the state-of-the-art models with enhanced detection accuracy and AUROC.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GuidedFlow，一种面向增材制造 (Additive Manufacturing) 异常检测与定位的注意力引导归一化流 (normalizing flow) 框架。方法使用在领域数据集上微调的预训练 ResNet 作为骨干，并通过 Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (SAN) 让空间和时间流模型优先关注输入帧中的相关上下文线索，建模多尺度、多帧动态。作者在自建 AM3D-AD 数据集以及 MVTec-AD 工业图像异常检测数据集上评估，称其在检测精度和 AUROC 上优于大部分现有方法。
Motivation: 增材制造中的质量控制因打印缺陷或潜在的网络物理入侵而充满挑战，现有基于重建、嵌入和归一化流的方法难以处理 3D 打印中常见的微小/拉丝 (tiny/stringing) 缺陷，且在小数据场景下泛化受限。
Method: GuidedFlow 采用注意力引导的归一化流模型，结合在域数据集上微调的预训练 ResNet，并设计注意力引导的空间和时间流框架来建模跨尺度与跨帧的动态；SAN 帮助流模型优先利用输入帧中相关的上下文线索。
Result: 在 AM3D-AD 数据集和 MVTec-AD 数据集上的实验表明，GuidedFlow 在检测准确率和 AUROC 上优于大部分现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为注意力引导的归一化流方法能够改善增材制造中微小缺陷的检测与泛化能力，并在真实 3D 打印对象数据上得到验证。
